## **Item Glow** adds true emissive rendering to items in Minecraft.

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-JOIN-3f0f0f?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/6NJZSxXFPV) [![Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-SUPPORT-3f0f0f?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/bobotweaks) [![Fiverr](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fiverr-HIRE%20ME-3f0f0f?style=for-the-badge&logo=fiverr&logoColor=white)](https://www.fiverr.com/s/1qZlPl6)

Any item that uses an _emissive texture variant will render at full brightness - glowing in your hand, in inventories, and anywhere items are rendered. No shaders. No OptiFine.

This is a lightweight, client-side mod designed to feel like a missing vanilla feature.

## Features
- Emissive items render at full brightness
- Works in-hand, in GUIs, and all item render contexts
- Automatic detection via _emissive textures
- Compatible with modded items and resource packs
- No shaders or OptiFine required
- Minimal performance impact

## How it works

Simply add an _emissive texture variant to your item model.
Item Glow handles the rest.
No configs required. No special APIs. Just works.

Example: https://bobotweaks.gitbook.io/item-glow/

## Compatibility
- Client-side only
- Works alongside most rendering and content mods
- Safe to use on servers (visual only)

title: drunk-n-high
description: Drunk-n-High is a novelty challenge shader that intentionally distorts the player’s vision to make normal gameplay harder.
body:
**Drunk-n-High** is a lightweight novelty challenge shader designed to intentionally distort visual clarity and make Minecraft harder to play in a “cursed” but controlled way. The shader focuses purely on screen-space visual effects and does not modify gameplay mechanics, world data, or player state.

The shader introduces visual disorientation through a combination of optional screen mirroring, time-based wobble distortion, and hue rotation using YIQ color-space manipulation. These effects interfere with spatial awareness, color perception, and visual comfort, making routine tasks such as navigation, combat, and building more difficult over time.

**Drunk-n-High** is intended for short challenge sessions, experimental gameplay, and content creation rather than extended play. All effects can be enabled or disabled instantly by toggling the shader.

**Installation:**  
Install Iris for Minecraft Java Edition, then place the Drunk-n-High shader folder or ZIP into your `shaderpacks` directory and enable it from the in-game shader menu.

> **⚠ Warning:**
> This shader intentionally applies visual distortion and color shifting. Some users may experience discomfort or disorientation. Use for short sessions and **disable immediately if discomfort occurs**.

title: Fly with nostalgia
description: Adds a platform flight mode similar to the pre-creative age of Minecraft
body:
# Fly with nostalgia

Fly with nostalgia is a mod adding a retro flight mode, similar to the pre-creative days of Minecraft. Players with the retro flight mode active can walk through the air on glass platforms which slowly disappear behind them.

![Steve standing on a glass platform above the forest. Screenshot is taken from a third-person camera in front of the player. Programmer's art texture pack is active](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8241831a0b517426f2feacd385de38801d9d6e4_0.webp)

## Commands

### /fly

Enables or disables retro flight mode for the player. All the arguments are optional.

Command format: `/fly <targets> <radius> <enable>`

`targets` - choose one or more players for whom the retro flight mode will be toggled.\
`radius` - set how big the platform should be (in blocks around the player). Defaults to 3.\
`enable` - specify if the flight should be enabled (true) or disabled (false).

## Permissions

Command responsible for toggling the retro flight mode offers granular permissions for target selection
and platform radius specification as well as a general permission for the base command usage.

`fly_with_nostalgia.command.fly` - usage of base /fly command (with an optional true/false *enable/disable* parameter)\
`fly_with_nostalgia.command.fly.target` - selection of a different player to enable flight mode for 
using the *target* parameter\
`fly_with_nostalgia.command.fly.radius` - customization of a platform radius using the *radius* parameter\
All specified permissions are *false* by default. Server operators with vanilla permission level equal
or above 2 are considered to have all permissions.

### Loader-specific information

**(Neo)Forge** - corresponding loader's native permissions systems are used. External permission management mod 
is required for assigning them only.\
**Sponge** - native permission system is used. Permission management plugin is needed for assigning them.\
**Fabric** - this loader does not provide any permission checking out of the box.
Permissions will be checked using *fabric-permissions-api* mod, if available. 
The *fabric-permissions-api-v0* library mod for registering the permissions as well as 
a compatible permission management mod for assigning the registered permissions need to be installed.
Otherwise, the mod falls back to vanilla permission levels (op).

# <center>Cobblemobs is a mod that replaces vanilla Minecraft mobs with Pokemon.</center>

---

### <center>The Cobblemobs are _feral_ pokemon that are not fit for capture or training. You can not interact with them like normal pokemon, and should treat them like vanilla mobs.</center>

---

In other words, this mod is just a visual client-side change. Creepers (now Electrodes) will still chase you and explode, zombies (now Parasects) will still attack you and break down doors, etc etc.

This does not affect spawns or behaviours in any way. Because of that, it has 100% compatibiity with any mods that make changes to vanilla mobs.

The goal for this mod is immersion by seamlessly replacing mobs with Pokemon that make sense from a visual, behavior, and/or lore standpoint. Some vanilla mobs have obvious candidates for appropriate Pokemon equivalents, while some do not. I'll be doing my best to choose Pokemon that are a good fit.

<details>
<summary>Changed Mob List</summary>

| Mob           | Pokemon     |
|---------------|-------------|
| Creeper       | Electrode   |
| Zombie        | Parasect    |

</details>

**This mod is a work in progess. The following features are planned but unimplemented:**
- More replacements
- Particle effects and render layers to help differentiate from regular Pokemon
- Adding Pokemon crys
- Support for kotlin animations, such as the ones used by some quadrupeds

title: Material Replication
description: Simple addon to GTCEu that adds matter system like GregTech5.
body:
### What is this mod?
Material Replication is a simple addon to GTCEu that adds matter system like GregTech5. \
The latest version of this mod adds new 3 machines and new 4 materials.

### New Machines
- **Deconstructor** \
Deconstructor decomposes the corresponding material into a new MATERIAL, *Positive Matter* and *Neutral Matter*. Duration and the amount of each matter obtained depends on the material. \
A slight chance of obtaining *Primal Matter* during deconstruction.

- **Replicator** \
Replicator replicates pure MATERIAL from the *Positive Matter* and *Neutral Matter*. For duplication, the special USB with the data of the target material written on it is required.

- **Scrap Maker** \
Scrap Maker erases **all but the energy brought in**. Upon elimination, there is a small chance of obtaining Scrap, and a material, *Matter Amplifier* is obtained from Scrap.

*Matter Amplifier* is a special material that can replicate two types of matter.

### Configuration

This mod can set various things with config. \
For more information about config \
English : [here](https://github.com/MrKono/MaterialReplication/blob/master/Setting.md) \
Japanese : [here](https://github.com/MrKono/MaterialReplication/blob/master/Setting_JP.md)

title: HexJS
description: Adds Hexcasting support for KubeJS!
body:
# About
HexJS is a mod integrating Hexcasting and KubeJS for modpack makers and server owners.

# Features
### Whitelists and Blacklists
The server and each player has their own list of patterns they can cast, this list can either be a whitelist, or a blacklist. (Default is an empty blacklist)

The per-player lists are persistent, while the global list is not.
If there is a conflict, the per-player list takes priority.

Tip: Blocking the base number literal (0) for either positive or negative numbers will block all numbers of that type
### Redirects
The server and each player has their own list of redirects which redirect a drawn pattern to another pattern, this is handled after the whitelists and blacklists.

Only 1 pass is done so it is easily possible to swap the effects of 2 patterns.
If there is a conflict, the per-player redirect takes priority.
### Custom Patterns
This is probably what most of you are here for, the ability to make your own patterns and spells, all from inside KubeJS!

This happens in 2 parts, first you register the pattern with a name and such, and then you check if the pattern in question was the one cast in the `registeredPatternCastEvent` to do your logic. This can be used to override existing patterns.
### Pre-Imbued Casting Items
Create cyphers, trinkets, and artifacts with pre-imbued spells and media!

This can be used for loot chests, mob drops, and more!
### Force Casting
Cast any list of patterns as any player from KubeJS!

This can be used for proxies as well as making fake players from CarpetMod cast spells!
### Misc
- Ability to create custom ancient scrolls.

- Ability to get the angle signature of Great Spells from KubeJS.

- Ability to set a max length for Bookkeeper's Gambit. (Global and/or Per-Player, as per Whitelists and Blacklists)
# Disclaimer
Due to most of my testing happening on Fabric, there may be a lot more bugs on the Forge version of this mod.

Please do report any bugs you find on the Github. Thank you in advance!

title: Maleficium: Vampires, Magic & More!

body:
![maleficium banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/58d6402a95d140d3c370dff651f16e7c2e8cd517.png)
# Maleficium: Vampires, Magic & More!
Welcome to Maleficium! This mod adds magic and vampires into Minecraft, allowing players to hone their magical abilities or become a creature of the night. The choice is yours!

## Supporting the project
I know that it's a big ask, but if you like the mod and want to support it, please consider [supporting me on Patreon](https://patreon.com/mitlit). This will help me continue to work on this mod and other projects in the future. If you can't support me financially, please consider sharing the mod with your friends. Thanks for playing my mod!

## Fabric Support
Creating a proper/full fabric port is on my to-do list but as of now I have tested and it is possible to run the mod on fabric via the [Kilt](https://modrinth.com/mod/kilt) project.

## Main Features
<details>
<summary>Witchcraft - Dominate your world by learning spells, rituals, and more!</summary>

### Witchcraft
*Dominate your world by learning spells, rituals, and more!*

Witchcraft has been added to the mod and the grimoires, etc but I haven't written about it here yet. I have written the vampirism and in-game documentation sections though. 
</details>
<details>
<summary>Vampirism - Become a creature of the night and feast on the blood of your enemies!</summary>

## Vampirism
*Become a creature of the night and feast on the blood of your enemies!*

### Abilities

#### Bloodsucking
![vampire fangs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7856aec2851bc0687e3c29510983fd3c4df84ba5.png)

As a vampire, you now feast on blood to survive. Failing to do so will lead you to either death or desiccation. The amount of blood a mob has is calculated based on the amount of health it has with Villagers being the most **nutritious**.

#### Compulsion
![vampire fangs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7856aec2851bc0687e3c29510983fd3c4df84ba5.png)

A perk of being a vampire is that you can compell mobs to do your bidding. Currently, you can tell almost any mob to follow you and even instruct villagers to offer you lower prices on trades.

#### Fast Travel
![fast travel image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98ba09aa4cb5605dc76025dfcb82774588951f8b.png)

As a vampire, you are able to move at incredible speeds leaving nothing but a black trail in your wake. Please be aware that this ability uses up some of your blood/hunger.

#### Enhanced Senses
![enhanced senses image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07f997070cb521c4d6b909e954bc09517f0b1561.png)

By closing your eyes and utilising your enhanced sense of smell and hearing, you can locate nearby mobs and players along with their species.

#### Feed Blood
![feed blood image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d094e2a5586cc46934c8d5832f0a888d760c1e0.png)

By feeding your blood to other players, they can be turned into vampires too or gain a temporary regen boost. To turn into a vampire, players need to die with the **vampire blood effect** and then drink blood.
</details>
<details>
<summary>In-Game Documentation - Use the in-game grimoires to figure out how the mod works.</summary>

## In-Game Documentation
*Use the in-game grimoires to figure out how the mod works.*

### The Grimoires

#### Crafting Grimoire
![crafting grimoire image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c52bdd7e0eed53780206be8d200b9c11e3660a76.png)

_You obtain this grimoire when you first join the game and it contains important information about the mod such as project links, the Discord server, and crafting recipies._

#### Witchcraft Grimoire
![witchcraft grimoire image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5e2c75a449f5e9a33a25bea07443f62cd2130f5.png)

*The witchcraft grimoire is obtained by combining **1x book** and **1x glowstone dust** inside of a crafting table. This grimoire contains information on the general things you need to know about magic/witchcraft in the Maleficium mod alongside details and guides on how to obtain/use various items and spells.*

#### Vampirism Grimoire
![vampirism grimoire image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d99a63dba05da6ad00e6cd7ffe694a7cd14fcf1.png)

*The vampirism grimoire is obtained by combining **1x book** and **1x rotten flesh** inside of a crafting table. This grimoire contains information on the general things you need to know about becoming, being, and killing vampires in the Maleficium mod alongside details and guides on how to obtain/use various items and tools.*
</details>

**More details can be found in the in-game documentation (grimoires)**

- Adds documentation for how features work.

**[TerraBlender](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrablender)** - *required*

Please report issues and create suggestions on the project's [issue tracker](https://github.com/ItsMitlit/Maleficium/issues)

title: Just Block Shapes
description: Completes the vanilla building palette with 365+ missing block shape variants.
body:
## 🧱 Just Block Shapes - Complete Your Building Palette

**Every vanilla material deserves a full set of block shapes.**

Just Block Shapes adds the missing walls, stairs, slabs, fences, fence gates, trapdoors, doors, pressure plates, and buttons for vanilla building blocks that should have had them all along. No new textures, no custom assets — every block looks like it was always part of vanilla Minecraft.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🧩 Missing Shape Variants

Vanilla Minecraft has inconsistencies where certain building materials lack shape variants that similar materials have. This mod fills those gaps:

- **Walls** for Quartz, Smooth Quartz, Polished Andesite/Granite/Diorite, Dark Prismarine, Prismarine Bricks, Purpur, Smooth Stone, Smooth Sandstone, Smooth Red Sandstone, Cut Sandstone, Cut Red Sandstone, Stone, and more
- **Stairs** for Smooth Stone, Cut Sandstone, Cut Red Sandstone, Calcite, Cracked Stone Bricks, and more
- **Slabs** for Calcite, Cracked Stone Bricks, Smooth Basalt, End Stone, and more
- **Fences, Fence Gates** for all targeted blocks
- **Trapdoors, Doors, Pressure Plates, Buttons** for most targeted blocks

### 🎨 Terracotta & Concrete — Full Shape Sets

All **16 dyed terracotta** colors and all **16 concrete** colors get the full treatment: stairs, slabs, walls, fences, fence gates, trapdoors, doors, pressure plates, and buttons.

Plain **terracotta** is also included.

### 🏗️ Vanilla-First Design

- Uses existing vanilla textures — no resource pack needed
- Block properties (hardness, blast resistance, sounds) match the base block exactly
- Standard vanilla recipe patterns (stonecutter support included)
- Blocks appear in vanilla creative tabs alongside their base blocks

---

## 📋 Target Blocks

| Base Block | Added Variants |
|---|---|
| Cobblestone, Mossy Cobblestone, Stone Bricks, Mossy Stone Bricks, Granite, Diorite, Andesite, Bricks, Sandstone, Red Sandstone, Prismarine, Blackstone, Polished Blackstone Bricks, Cobbled Deepslate, Polished Deepslate, Deepslate Bricks, Deepslate Tiles, Red Nether Bricks, End Stone Bricks, Mud Bricks, Tuff Bricks, Polished Tuff | Fence, Fence Gate, Trapdoor, Door, Pressure Plate, Button |
| Nether Bricks | Fence Gate, Trapdoor, Door, Pressure Plate, Button |
| Polished Granite/Diorite/Andesite, Dark Prismarine, Prismarine Bricks, Purpur, Smooth Sandstone, Smooth Red Sandstone, Quartz, Smooth Quartz | Wall, Fence, Fence Gate, Trapdoor, Door, Pressure Plate, Button |
| Smooth Stone, Cut Sandstone, Cut Red Sandstone | Stairs, Wall, Fence, Fence Gate, Trapdoor, Door, Pressure Plate, Button |
| Stone | Wall, Fence, Fence Gate, Trapdoor, Door |
| Calcite, Cracked Stone Bricks, Smooth Basalt, Cracked Deepslate Bricks/Tiles, Cracked Polished Blackstone Bricks, Cracked Nether Bricks, End Stone, Gilded Blackstone, Tuff, Obsidian, Crying Obsidian, Packed Mud, Dripstone Block, Amethyst Block, Terracotta | All variants |
| 16 Dyed Terracotta, 16 Concrete | All variants |

Only shapes that are **missing in vanilla** are added — no duplicates.

---

## 🛠️ Technical Details

### Multi-Loader Support

This mod supports **Fabric**, **NeoForge**, and **Forge**!
- Download the correct version for your mod loader
- Consistent experience across all loaders

### Requirements

- **Minecraft**: Java Edition 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.3–1.21.11, 26.1
- **Mod Loader**:
  - **Fabric**: Fabric Loader + Fabric API (1.20.1, 1.21.1–1.21.11)
  - **NeoForge**: NeoForge (1.21.1–1.21.11, 26.1)
  - **Forge**: Forge (1.20.1, 1.21.1–1.21.11) *(26.1 blocked by upstream bug)*
- **No additional dependencies** — no Architectury API or other library mods required at runtime

### Compatibility

- Works with most building and decoration mods
- Compatible with performance mods (Sodium, Starlight, etc.)
- No runtime dependencies beyond the mod loader

This resource pack is an edit of the Sparkles resource pack with Better Combat support.
This obviously requires Better Combat.
What follows is the original description.


We have rebranded! This resourcepack combines the old "Incendium Optional Resource Pack" and "Stardust Biome Name Fix".
Sparkles: Stardust Labs Resourcepack

This is an optional resource pack for all of Stardust Labs' projects! Here are the main features:

    Custom mob/item textures for Incendium
    A fix to allow biome names to show on minimaps and similar mods
    Translations for Incendium, and all future projects in need of them

Addons

Sparkles has a set goal: Incendium textures and translations. However, if you want more from the Stardust Labs datapacks/mods, we have addons! At this moment, we have only one.

    Alpha Islands adds old alpha textures to Terralith's two Alpha Islands biomes

Why can't I see some textures?

In order to see the custom textures/models for the mobs, shields, and Elytra, you must use a mod that supports custom entity textures. If on Forge, Optifine does work, but we no longer recommend Optifine in any scenario. Otherwise, for both Fabric and Forge, download the following mods:

    Entity Texture Features
    Entity Model Features
    CIT Resewn
        Fabric
        Forge 1.18 - 1.19 (unofficial fork)
        Forge 1.20 (unofficial fork)

Don't worry, though! They are not required, but just recommended. Most (~85%) of the other textures will display fine, such as the swords, tools, and items!

It should be noted that even though our wiki shows the Voltaic Trident as having a texture, that texture is not implemented.
What about Bedrock Edition?

Some Java server owners may choose to run their Incendium server using GeyserMC, which allows Bedrock users to connect. However, Java resourcepacks do not work on Bedrock, so Bedrock users will not be able to enjoy the textures. Thankfully Dat1Mexican has created a Bedrock port of Sparkles! You can check it out here.
Can I translate it to my own language?

Yes! This resourcepack provides translations for several languages just by using it. They are added the the main resourcepack periodically. Click the button below to visit our translation website - this is the only place we accept translation contributions. If you need assistance with contributing, ask in our Discord Server.

Weblate project translated
Credits

    Kuma, for making the original Biome Name Fix resourcepack. This handled just the biome translations, until it was merged into Sparkles.

title: Cherries, The Forbidden Fruit
description: Adds a new fruit, which can be used for many things!
body:
# Cherries, The Forbidden Fruit:

Ever wanted to get Cherries from Cherry Trees, make Cherry Pies, or Potions of Nausea?

Well, now you can with Cherries, a new fruity addition!

**Cherries:**

A new fruit that has a 25% chance to drop from Cherry Leaves when broken.

Eating one gives 1 point of hunger, or 0.5 hunger shanks.

Since Cherries in real life have poisonous pits, if you eat five of them, you have a 25% chance to get the Poison effect for 5 seconds.

Can be used to make Golden Cherries and Cherry Pies.

**Golden Cherries:**

A golden variant of Cherries that have a 1% chance to drop from Cherry Leaves when broken.

Can also be made in a Crafting Table by surrounding 1 Cherries with 8 Golden Nuggets.

Eating one gives 4 point of hunger, or 2 hunger shanks.

If you eat five of them, you have a 10% chance to get the Nausea effect for 5 seconds.

Can be brewed in a Brewing Stand to make Potions of Nausea.

Can be used to make Golden Cherry Pies.

**Cherry Pie:**

Made in a Crafting Table with 1 Cherries, 1 Egg, 1 Sugar, and 1 Wheat.

They are placeable like a Cake, but it only has 4 slices, and each slice only gives 1 point of hunger, or 0.5 hunger shanks.

**Golden Cherry Pie:**

Made like Cherry Pies, but the Cherries are replaced with 1 Golden Cherries.

Like a Cherry Pie, it only has 4 slices, but each slice gives 3 points of hunger, or 1.5 shanks.

title: Streamer Friendly
description: This is a modpack designed for players who prefer a highly optimized and stable experience. Designed for Youtubers / streamers, it also has the replay mod and essential features such as world map / minimap.
body:
## What mods does this modpack include?

This modpack includes common optimization mods that have been tested to be safe with your worlds and compatible with each other. It also includes commonly used features: in-game map and mini map, replay mod for recording, Fabrishot for taking clearer screenshots (Press F9 instead of F2).

## How does this modpack compare to [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized) and [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop)?

[Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized) is known for its awesome experience and Optifine-parity features. This modpack shares many optimization mods with Fabulously Optimized but removes many QoL(Quality of Life) features such as connected textures, better grass and dynamic lights. You can add these yourself though.

[Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop) shares a common goal with this pack - to be performance-focused. However, Simply Optimized uses many mods that are still in alpha state and the pack itself [is quite experimental](https://github.com/HyperSoop/Simply-Optimized/wiki/FAQ#is-so-safe-enough-for-my-worlds). This pack however is designed for people who wants a generally stable experience, especially for Youtubers and streamers since they rely heavily on the stability.

Apart from the above, this modpack also adds replay mod to record gameplay. If you don't need it, either disable/delete it from your launcher, or uncheck the "Record Singleplayer" / "Record Multiplayer" checkbox when you select a world or a server.  Fabrishot provides a great way to make clear screenshots and you can simply press F9 in-game. The large screenshot will be saved with your ordinary screenshots under your `.minecraft/screenshots` folder.

## Bug Report and More

Feel free to reach out to me at [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/code004Accepted/Streamer_Friendly/issues) if anything goes wrong. This pack is still in its early state and an official discord server and more are on the way.

This modpack includes the mods [Xaero's World Map](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/xaeros-world-map) and [Xaero's Minimap (Fair-play Edition)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/xaeros-minimap-fair-play-edition). They are developed by Chocolate Minecraft, and you can visit their official website [here](https://chocolateminecraft.com/index.php). They are a fantastic addition to this modpack.

~~The Full Bright resource pack is developed by [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/). You can get more cool resource pack modifications [here](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs).~~

- Xaero's Minimap (Fair-play Edition): https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/xaeros-minimap-fair-play-edition

title: Mixin Helper
description: Utility mod for modpack developers that provides complete control over mixin behavior
body:
# Mixin Helper

Take control of mixin conflicts in your modpack. Mixin Helper lets you blacklist, prioritize, and surgically modify mixins from any loaded mod — all from a single JSON config file. No code, no recompiling, no removing mods.

## Documentation

Full documentation, guides, and examples at **https://tysontheember.dev/mixin-helper/intro/**

***

# ⚠️ USE AT YOUR OWN RISK ⚠️

**This is an advanced tool. If you don't know what mixins are or how they work, this mod is not for you.**

While there are guardrails Mixin Helper directly interferes with how other mods patch the game. Incorrect use **will** break things. This includes but is not limited to:

*   **Game crashes** with difficult-to-diagnose stacktraces
*   **Broken mod features** that may not be immediately obvious
*   **World corruption** — back up your worlds before making changes
*   **Incompatible save files** if disabled mixins affect world data

**Do NOT report bugs to mod authors if you have modified their mixins with this tool.** Any issues caused by Mixin Helper are your responsibility.

***

## Features

*   **Mixin Blacklisting** — Disable individual mixins, entire mixin configs, or block all mixins targeting a specific class
*   **Priority Control** — Override mixin execution order to resolve load-order conflicts between mods
*   **Method Removal** — Neutralize or remove specific injected methods without disabling the entire mixin
*   **Audit Report** — Generate a detailed JSON report of every loaded mixin config, including annotations, to diagnose conflicts fast

## Supported Versions

| Minecraft Version |Loader   |Status          |
| ----------------- |-------- |--------------- |
| 1.20.1            |Forge    |Fully Supported |
| 1.20.1            |Fabric   |Fully Supported |
| 1.21.1            |NeoForge |Fully Supported |
| 1.21.1            |Fabric   |Fully Supported |

## How It Works

1.  Install Mixin Helper — drop the jar in your `mods` folder
2.  Launch the game — a default config is generated at `config/mixinhelper.json`
3.  Check the audit report at `config/mixinhelper-report.json` to see every mixin loaded in your game
4.  Edit the config to blacklist, reprioritize, or strip methods as needed
5.  Restart and you're done

## Quick Example

Two mods crash because they both modify the same class? Blacklist the offending mixin:

```
{
  "enabled": true,
  "blacklist": {
    "mixins": ["com.conflictingmod.mixin.MixinLevelRenderer"],
    "mixinConfigs": [],
    "targetClasses": []
  }
}
```

Need finer control? Neutralize a single injected method instead of the whole mixin:

```
{
  "methodRemovals": {
    "rules": [
      {
        "targetClass": "net.minecraft.world.level.Level",
        "method": "brokenMethod",
        "action": "nop"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Use Cases

*   **Modpack developers** resolving mod conflicts without waiting for mod authors to fix them
*   **Server admins** disabling specific mod behaviors that cause instability
*   **Debugging** which mixins are causing crashes or unexpected behavior
*   **Fine-tuning** mod interactions by controlling execution order

## Notes

*   Config changes require a full game restart — mixins load very early in startup
*   Mixin Helper itself has no mixins — it uses the Mixin plugin system to intercept other mods
*   Zero runtime performance impact — all work is done during startup

title: Simple SIT
description: A super simple, easy to use, lightweight sit plugin. Now with piggyback riding!
body:
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-NA?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=000000&color=00AF5C)](https://modrinth.com/project/simple-sit) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-NA?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=000000&color=5865F2)](https://discord.gg/DfWRnvmSkb) [![Github](https://img.shields.io/badge/Github-NA?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=%23ffffff&color=%23000000)](https://github.com/doccyt/Simple-SIT) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-NA?style=for-the-badge&color=%23ffa200)](https://doccdev.xyz)

SIT is a straightforward plugin designed to make sitting in Minecraft feel natural and polished. I built this because I wanted a lightweight solution that works on modern servers without the bloat or lag often found in older plugins.

right-click on any stair or slab block to sit down instantly. The plugin automatically detects which way the stair is facing, so you won't end up looking at the back of your chair. You can also use the /sit command to sit down wherever you are standing.

SIT also allows you to run /lay and /crawl to sleep anywhere or crawl anywhere in the world! you can turn these both on or off in the Config.

It also supports player stacking. If you have it enabled in the config, you can right-click another player to sit on their shoulders. I've added a check to prevent circular stacking (where two players try to ride each other), so it won't glitch out.

SIT also allows you to sneak and right-click to hoist a friend onto your shoulders. When you're ready, just crouch again to set them down safely, or left-click to yeet them through the air! When you chuck them through the air another player can right click the thrown player to catch them as well! Turning throwing players around into a game of Volleyball!

It is built for Minecraft 1.21+ and specifically designed to support Folia's multi-threading, as well as standard Paper, Spigot, Bukkit, and Purpur servers.

Commands:
/sit - Sit down at your current location.
/lay - lay down and take a nap.
/crawl - crawl around on the ground!
/sit reload - Reloads the config file.

Permissions:
sit.command - Allows using the /sit command.
sit.stairs - Allows sitting on stairs and slabs (on by default).
sit.player - Allows sitting on other players (on by default).
sit.reload - Allows reloading the plugin (OP only by default).

**Find more of my plugins and mods check out my [Website!](https://doccdev.xyz/)**

title: Big Signs
description: Adds Signs with BIGGER TEXT to Minecraft! More planned in the future!
body:
Overview
--------

Big Signs is a new mod which adds **Signs with Bigger Text** to Minecraft. At the moment, there are **two** new varieties of sign:

*   **One-Line Signs**
*   **One-Line Hanging Signs**

These new signs come in every vanilla wood type, as well as **20 colours** of metal. They display much larger text than vanilla signs. The sign's model stays the same, so there is only **One Line** of text, with room for only a few characters.

Resource Pack in Images: Vanilla Tweaks - Smoother Font ![One-Line Signs in the world](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_46acca58-8f3c-4371-8ef7-c92542069ea5.png) ![One-Line Signs in the inventory](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_f0c22620-6df1-4c74-baf8-83ebff1cb62f.png) ![Colourful Metal One-Line Signs](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1158019/description_e7d0e581-7252-4daa-8ab4-48191c5204fc.png)

* * *

One-Line Signs are perfect for displaying large numbers in your world. Say goodbye to typing out large Block characters on each line of a vanilla sign - now you can simply type the number into a One-Line Sign, which will display it much more clearly! This is great for train-related builds in the Create mod (as shown below)

![Station platform example](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_e966dd01-36f4-452e-a0e6-567fe3c6fcad.png)

* * *

One-Line Signs are also a much more elegant solution than Letter tile blocks, found in some mods. Now, you can fit more than one large letter in the space of one block!

![Letter tiles example](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_d6b23184-ef8e-437d-933e-fd2a1c2ee5fa.png)

* * *

Crafting
--------

Wooden One-Line Signs are crafted using 1-to-1 recipes with the vanilla signs. 
![Wooden One-Line Sign crafting recipes](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1158019/description_17a40908-e52a-4009-af8f-56874633fd89.png)

Metal One-Line Signs can be dyed into any colour variant, from any other colour. The white variants can be crafted in a 3x3 crafting grid using Iron. 
![Metal Sign crafting recipes](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1158019/description_a54bfa32-41e5-4a98-a48b-502d5c7eeddd.png)

* * *

Download and Install
--------------------

Big Signs is available for Minecraft **1.20.1** on **Forge or NeoForge**. There are no required dependencies - No other mods are needed to use this mod! Simply place it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder, and you're good to go.

I will not be porting the mod to other versions of the game yet. I want to get the main features implemented before doing this.

* * *

Planned Features
----------------

I have many more features planned for the Big Signs mod, including physically bigger signs of course!

**Thin Signs**

*   A type of One-Line Sign, but with the vanilla text size and a physically thinner body.
*   Can be placed on either the top, middle or bottom part of a block.

**Directional Signs**

*   Allowing any sign to be pointed on either end, to act as an arrow sign.
*   For Thin Signs, this would be very similar to Way Signs from the [Supplementaries](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/supplementaries) mod.

**Billboard Blocks**

*   A type of sign which uses a full block of space. Acts similar to the Framed Wall Board from **[Framed Blocks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/framedblocks)**.
*   Can be placed on either the Back, Middle or Front of a block.
*   When placed next to each other (in a rectangle shape), they form a larger sign which takes up the whole area.
*   This would allow for long bodies of text to be displayed in the world, or for large advertisements, for instance.

**Improved Text GUI**

*   Eventually, I plan to overhaul the vanilla text-editing GUI for signs. This includes:
*   Options for Bold, Underlined and Italic text
*   Text size and colour options, allowing for different text size on each line, or a different colour per character.
*   Text alignment options - Left, Centred or Right.
*   In Creative Mode, there would be the option to add a command to execute when the sign is right-clicked in the world.

This is an addon for [TerraFirmaCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrafirmacraft), that does simple things; change the entire world to one continuous desert and make the world devoid of life. Oceans are removed, and the only way to get water are from hot springs or perhaps other subsurface sources. For proper survivability you'll likely have to customize your game with other mods, that add alternative methods for acquiring sticks, wood, food and the like.

This addon works very well with my other addons [TFC Improved Badlands](https://modrinth.com/mod/tfc-improved-badlands) and [TFC Weather](https://modrinth.com/mod/tfc-weather), as they respectively add sand dune terrain and layered sand blocks, both working in harmony to make the terrain smoother, easier to traverse, and more aesthetic. This also fits the desert theme very well. TFC Weather also adds sand storms to TFC, which might be of interest to some -- this is of course configurable.

title: RoomRecipes
description: RoomRecipes is a utility mod which can detect a "rooms" and "room recipes". It is not much use on its own, and is typically used as a dependency for other mods.
body:
RoomRecipes is a utility mod which adds two things:
- Room Detection
- Room Recipes

## Note
RoomRecipes was created to power the [Questown](https://modrinth.com/mod/questown) mod. But it may also be used for other mods.

## Room Detection
When given an X,Z coordinate, this library can identify an enclosed space (a "room"). The simplest example of this would be a set of four straight walls connected at the corners to form a rectangle. But RoomRecipe can also detect more complex shapes and has an extensive set of unit tests to protect its detection logic from breaking.

## Room Recipes
A Room Recipe is a JSON file which consists of a set of items that correspond to blocks. These files go in the typical "recipes" folder that mods and resource packs use to add crafting recipes to Minecraft. 

The RoomRecipes mod can be used to check if a Room contains all of those blocks. If the room contains all of the recipe's blocks, that recipe is complete.

Room recipes can added via mods or resource packs. A room recipe looks like this:

`crafting_room.json`
```
{
  "type": "roomrecipes:room",
  "recipe_strength": 1,
  "ingredients": [
    {
      "item": "minecraft:torch"
    },
    {
      "item": "minecraft:crafting_table"
    }
  ]
}
```

description: Freezes the player when entering water above a certain height.
body:
# ❄️ Freezing Water

**Freezing Water** is a simple Minecraft datapack that causes players to freeze when they enter water above a certain height.

![Main](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/neERVxt6/images/b3c5a729b12612079871449c3cb6170b51237412.gif)
## ✨ Features

- Provides visual alerts when freezing.
- You can individually enable or disable the regeneration system for each player.
- You can customize the freezing height with only one command.
- Works in singleplayer and multiplayer.

## 🛠️ Toggle Alerts

You can easily enable or disable each players water freezing at any time using the following commands:

- ✅ **Enable freezing:**  
  `/tag (player) add disable_water_freezing`

- ❌ **Disable freezing:**  
  `/tag (player) remove disable_water_freezing`

You can easily customize height at any time using the following command:
- 🛠️ **Customize height:**  
  `/scoreboard players set .min playery [height]` (Default Value:124)

**Example:** `/scoreboard players set .min playery 124`

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the datapack `.zip` file.
2. Place it in your world's `datapacks` folder.
3. Use `/reload` after joining the world.
4. You're all set! Move around and see your coordinates at the bottom of your screen.

## 🧱 Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.13+
- No external resource packs needed

# SquidCraft M

**SquidCraft M** is a Fabric 1.20.1 modpack that aims to combine well-known exploration, building, QOL, and world generation mods for an extensive minecraft experience.

## ❓ Who is this Modpack for?
If you are looking for a fun singleplayer experience or a complete modpack for an enjoyable SMP, this modpack is for you.
### Players
This modpack is primarily built for a singleplayer or client experience. Installing should be very easy and you can get right into playing with very little setup.
### Server Owners
In the 'Modpack Contents' section below, a link to a complete list of mods is included. This list details which mods are client-sided and which are server-sided, which will help you setup a server-sided modpack. A completely configured server modpack will be coming soon (~80% complete).

## 📥 How to Install/Play
*WARNING: You will likely need to increase the memory allocated to the instance! 4GB-8GB is recommended.*
### Method 1 (Modrinth App)
1. Download and install the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app)
2. Click the search button and type "SquidCraft M" in the Modpacks section
3. Click Install
4. Run the newly created **SquidCraft M** instance from the **Library** tab in the Modrinth App

## 📖 Modpack Contents
The following is a brief summary of the major mods in this modpack. A complete list can be found [here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vRwOSKnGtb8oiqKCfDCtku7Wn3tY3azyYM6sg7mT1fMKeJ2Mk1MadUGrls7VLGefywWpEkQN4TbmePK/pubhtml?gid=0&single=true).

title: Croparium: Arphex
description: Skip grinding tough bosses for Arthropod Phobia Expansions’  biomasses—grow them with biomass farmland instead!
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91ef9783825b18f5809794c8df87488f12281daf.png)

Two required dependencies: [**Croparium**](https://modrinth.com/mod/croparium) & [**Arthropod Phobia Expansions + Horror Bosses**](https://modrinth.com/mod/arphex/). 

In the Arthropod Phobia Expansions + Horror Bosses mod, some biomass resources have long been a hassle for players to obtain: you not only have to defeat extremely difficult bosses, but these bosses also drop only tiny amounts of the biomass—barely enough to meet sustained usage needs. 

This mod addresses this problem by adding a stable farming method for 9 biomass types. Now you won’t have to repeatedly grind against tough bosses; instead, you can grow and harvest the required resources consistently through crop cultivation.

**How to Grow?**

To grow this biomass, you first need to prepare special farmland— just hold any type of shovel in your right hand and right-click on soul sand or soul soil. This will convert the block into farmland suitable for growing the biomass crops. Note that this farmland differs from vanilla Minecraft farmland in its “moisture” requirement: it doesn’t rely on water to stay viable. Instead, **Lava** is required within a 4-block horizontal radius.

For details, refer to [**Croparium**](https://modrinth.com/mod/croparium) mod. It includes more comprehensive cultivation instructions to help you get started with farming smoothly.

title: Cube Waypoints
description: A waypoint mod that highlights blocks marked by the player.
body:
Cube Waypoints is a waypoint mod that highlights marked blocks instead of placing a floating icon in the world. It's client-side only and designed with Hoplite-style PvP and trapping in mind as opposed to regular play.

To mark a block, look at it and press the keybind.

The mod has keybinds for two different colours of markers without changing settings, but an unlimited number can exist at once. Waypoints currently don't persist between closing and reopening the game.

Cube Waypoints is fully open-source, meaning it's free to use and modify with attribution.

title: ItemDuper-Pro
description: Perfect for players who want convenient item duplication with modern improvements and reliable functionality.
body:
# ItemDuper-Pro

**A recreated and enhanced version of the original DupeTrigger mod by AstraLucid**

## What it does
Press a single keybind to instantly duplicate items in your main hand - no commands, no cheats required!

## Key Features
- **One-key duplication** - Default 'G' key (fully customizable)
- **Enhanced stack limits** - Duplicate up to 2,048 items per stack
- **Server-side synchronization** - Real duplication that persists when moved or placed
- **Customizable controls** - Change keybind in Controls menu under "ItemDuper-Pro"
- **No cheats needed** - Works in survival mode and multiplayer servers
- **Smart inventory management** - Handles full inventories gracefully

## How to Use
1. Hold any item in your main hand
2. Press 'G' (or your custom keybind)
3. Watch your items double instantly!
4. Repeat to keep doubling (1→2→4→8→16→32→64→128→256→512→1024→2048)

## Configuration
- Open **Options → Controls → Key Binds**
- Find **"ItemDuper-Pro"** category
- Set your preferred key for **"Duplicate Item"**

## Requirements
- **Fabric Loader 0.16.14+**
- **Fabric API**

## Credits
- **Original concept**: AstraLucid (DupeTrigger mod)
- **Enhanced recreation**: Void

---
*Perfect for creative building, testing, and convenient item management!*

description: Turns every item into a totem. Has a blacklist.

# EIIAT
**Turns every item into a totem.**
**This mod was a quick idea because of a video on TikTok. I will not put any further work in it.**


## Config
**EIIAT lets you add items to a blacklist.**
This is done via commands or the config file at (`/config/eiiat_excluded_items.json`)

Replace <item> with your actual item, e.g. minecraft:cobblestone
```command
/eiiat exclude <item> //Blacklist item
/eiiat include <item> //Remove from blacklist
/eiiat get            //List all blacklisted items. Click to remove supported.
```

title: Chat Tweaks
description: Various chat tweaks that change the look and feel of the chat, for better or for worse.
body:
## Features
- Adds unintrusive timestamps to chat. It's only visible when the chat is open and the mouse cursor is hovering over the chat box (but it can be configured to show at all times)
  - Text color, background color and the format is configurable
  - Timestamps will be grouped to reduce noise in spammy situations
     - The time frame this grouping will activate in is also configurable
- Adds highlights for every other chat message
  - The highlight color can be configured, but please note that the color will be overlaid on top of the background color, so the actual color displayed might be slightly different to what is configured if the highlight color is translucent.
- Removes that pesky white line at the left of chat called the message indicator, and moves the chat slightly left to fill the gap left behind
- Increases the chat's input limit
  - Note that messages containing over 256 characters will still be truncated to 256 characters when sent as the server expects a maximum of 256 characters.
- Allow changing the width and the focused/unfocused height of the chat beyond normal limits (via the mod's configs)
- Adds key to peek the chat, defaults to `V`
  - There's an option to make it permanently show chat

Almost all of these features can be toggled on or off. For those that can't be toggled, their values can be changed to effectively turn them off/default back to minecraft's values.

## Configuring
Simply use modmenu and/or run `/chattweaks config`.

## Compatibility
The mod should be compatible with pretty much every mod that does not implement custom chat behaviour. I've avoided using a custom chat screen and only made modifications to the existing screen for this reason.

title: GeneralPVP
description: General PVP configurations: bed/crystal/anchor pvp disabler, item limiter, potion limiter, enchantment limiter
body:
![Dependencies](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/Dependencies.png?raw=true)
* [**BukkitOfUtils**](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bukkitofutils)

![Discord](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/JoinTheDiscord.png?raw=true)
Please join the Streamline Hub Discord in order to get updates and for me to fully assist you with bugs, questions, or suggestions.

Discord: [**click here**](https://dsc.gg/streamline)

![Summary](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/Summary.png?raw=true)
A one-stop plugin for any PVP server. You can get rid of <u>five</u> plugins with just this <u>one</u> plugin!

### Main Features
- Disable types of PVP:
  - Crystal PVP.
    - Only allow exploding Crystals when there are no other players (besides the one blowing the crystal up) within 15 blocks of the explosion.
      - Allows for fighting the Ender Dragon.
  - Bed bombing PVP.
    - Only allow bed bombing when there are no other players (besides the one bed bombing) within 15 blocks of the explosion.
      - This allows players to bed bomb for netherite still.
  - Anchor PVP.
    - Completely disable, or completely allow respawn anchor explosions.
      - When an anchor "blows up" and Anchor PVP is disabled, the anchor will not blow up and will not allow you to put more glowstone in it.
- Item Limiter.
  - Block or limit the amount of items a player can have.
- Potion Limiter.
  - Block or limit the amplification of potions. (Ex: max of `Speed I`)
- Enchantment Limiter.
  - Block or limit the amplification of enchantments. (Ex: max of `Protection III`)

![Why This?](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/WhyThis.png?raw=true)
- Lightweight.
- 1 plugin instead of 5.
- Easy to configure.

![How to Install](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/HowToInstall.png?raw=true)
1. Download and install BukkitOfUtils. Found here: [**BukkitOfUtils**](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bukkitofutils)
2. Download the correct version of this plugin for you server version.
3. Place in your `plugins` folder.
4. Stop server.
5. Start server.
6. Use to your liking.

![More Info](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/MoreInfo.png?raw=true)
## Configuration Help
**Item Configuration**
```yaml
# Item configurations.
items:
  # Drop extra on ground.
  drop-excess: true
  # If ENCHANTED_GOLDEN_APPLE should be treated like GOLDEN_APPLE.
  # If true, just put the material as GOLDEN_APPLE.
  all-golden-apples-similar: true
  totems:
    material: TOTEM_OF_UNDYING # The Bukkit Material of the item you want to limit.
    max-amount: 1 # The maximum amount of the item the player can have in their inventory.
```

**Potion Configuration**
```yaml
# Potion configurations.
potions:
  strength:
    type: STRENGTH # The Bukkit Potion Type of the potion you want to limit.
    amplifier: 2 # STRENGTH II and above is blocked (Keep in mind, 2 = only Strength I is allowed.)
```

**Enchantment Configuration**
```yaml
# Enchantment configurations.
enchantments:
  protection:
    # The enchantment type.
    # NOTE:
    # - This can be a Bukkit Enchantment.
    # - This can be a key. (Such as "minecraft:protection".)
    # - No ":" in it, means it is a default (Minecraft provided) enchantment type.
    type: "protection"
    amplifier: 4 # PROTECTION IV and above is blocked (Keep in mind, 4 = only up to Protection III is allowed.)
```

![Commands and Permissions](https://github.com/Streamline-Essentials/StreamlineWiki/blob/main/website/images/CommandsAndPermissions.png?raw=true)
## Commands
* `/gpvpreload`
  * Reloads the configuration.
  * Note: this is not really needed, as it will reload the config itself.

title: Rope
description: Adds a simple climbable rope. One click to place, one shift-click to drop an entire column to the ground.
body:
[![JOIN OUR DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/JOIN%20OUR%20DISCORD-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA)

A simple, lightweight mod that adds a craftable climbable rope block. Hang it from any solid surface above you and traverse vertically with ease.

### What it does
- Right-click below a solid block to place a single rope segment.
- Sneak + Right-click to instantly drop a full column of rope straight down, limited only by the rope in your inventory and free space below.
- Rope can hang from another rope — extend any column segment by segment.
- Uses familiar scaffold-like placement and break sounds.

**Please report any bugs, errors, or feature suggestions on Discord:** https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE

### How it works
> Hold Jump to climb up and crouch to slide down! Unlike ladders, ropes don't need a wall to lean on, and you can walk right through them without getting stuck.

![or place by click on another rope](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfbebb03c937dbf4a8a73a1cf4760c23aa2689b4_0.webp)
> You can manually extend the column by Right-Clicking an existing rope segment to place another one directly below it.

![Shift + RMB TO auto-place rope downward](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a449c252e47ee2637a925937b263bd8c690ad89_0.webp)
> Sneak + Right-Click to instantly drop a full column of rope straight to the ground.

### Crafting
![Rope craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b7d27fd39718f72a741056aabc958a691458f98_0.webp)
```
Stick | String | Stick
Stick | String | Stick
Stick | String | Stick
```
**Yields 3 rope per craft**
> (if you are modpacker - read below)

### Misc
**Fully translated into 10 languages:** English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, and Italian.

### For Modpack Creators
The mod is intentionally minimal — one item, one block, no worldgen, no entities, no GUIs. Everything is easy to override from the outside without touching the jar.

#### Changing the Recipe
The recipe is data-driven and can be replaced by any datapack using the same recipe id: `rope:rope`
Use the same id to replace the default recipe — Minecraft will use your version instead.

Where to put the datapack:
| Environment      | Path                                |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Singleplayer     | .minecraft/saves/<world>/datapacks/ |
| Dedicated server | <server folder>/world/datapacks/    |

After adding or changing the datapack — restart the world or run /reload.

##### Which folder structure to use depends on your Minecraft version.

Legacy layout (Forge 1.20.1, Fabric 1.20.1)
```
your_datapack/
  pack.mcmeta
  data/
    rope/
      recipes/
        rope.json
      advancements/
        recipes/misc/rope.json
```

Modern layout (NeoForge 1.21.1+, Fabric 1.21.11+)
```
your_datapack/
  pack.mcmeta
  data/
    rope/
      recipe/
        rope.json
      advancement/
        recipes/misc/rope.json
```

##### Ready-to-use Recipe JSON

Legacy `data/rope/recipes/rope.json`
```
{
  "type": "minecraft:crafting_shaped",
  "category": "misc",
  "pattern": ["ABA","ABA","ABA"],
  "key": {
    "A": { "item": "minecraft:stick" },
    "B": { "item": "minecraft:string" }
  },
  "result": { "item": "rope:rope", "count": 3 }
}
```

Modern `data/rope/recipe/rope.json`
```
{
  "type": "minecraft:crafting_shaped",
  "category": "misc",
  "pattern": ["ABA","ABA","ABA"],
  "key": {
    "A": { "item": "minecraft:stick" },
    "B": { "item": "minecraft:string" }
  },
  "result": { "count": 3, "id": "rope:rope" }
}
```
To change ingredients or output, only modify `key.A.item`, `key.B.item`, and `result.count`. For a clean recipe book unlock, also override the advancement file at the matching path (`advancements/recipes/misc/rope.json` or `advancement/recipes/misc/rope.json`) and update the ingredient criteria to match your new items.


#### Changing Translations
Override via a resource pack — no source code needed.

Resource pack path: `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` (singleplayer) or include in your modpack override folder.

Translation file path: `assets/rope/lang/<locale>.json`

Key translation keys:
- `block.rope.rope` — block name in the world
- `item.rope.rope` — item name in inventory

To simply rename the item, this is all you need:
```
{
  "block.rope.rope": "Climbing Rope",
  "item.rope.rope": "Climbing Rope"
}
```

The mod already ships with built-in translations for: `en_us`, `ru_ru`, `de_de`, `es_es`, `fr_fr`, `it_it`, `ja_jp`, `ko_kr`, `pt_br`, `zh_cn`.

title: MobMoney
description: This plugin makes killing various mobs valuable for which you will receive money
body:
## MobMoney
Please make sure you have dependency plugins as Vault 2.1 economy plugins required!

MobMoney is a Minecraft plugin that rewards players with money for killing mobs, offering a configurable and customizable economy system. Compatible with Minecraft versions from **1.8 up to 26.х**, it integrates with **Vault** to support various economy plugins.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2aec9a47c2015c430ef4203fe9382afbfeb0dfd5.png)

---

## Key features include

* Players earn virtual money upon killing mobs, with rewards customizable per mob type.

* Supports configurable messages and action bar notifications to inform players of their earnings.

* Options to enable or disable rewards for mobs spawned from spawn eggs or monster spawners.

* Ability to restrict rewards for players in creative mode.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c46a159bf72b07cb242fcc2e95760267b3d7c11.png)

* Configurable pickup sounds and volumes for money collection.

* Chance settings for mobs to drop money items, allowing for event-based double drops.

* Metrics collection to track plugin usage.

* Commands for reloading the configuration and toggling messages.

* Support for economy stealing in PvP scenarios, configurable by server admins.

---

## Description

This plugin is ideal for **survival, PvE, and PvP servers**, enhancing gameplay by incentivizing mob hunting and adding economic depth.

It is simple to install! But Don't forget to donwload dependacy plagins very important! — just place the **.jar** in the **plugins folder**, configure the settings, and restart the server.

title: ChunkEntityLimiter
description: This system boosts performance by automatically capping entities/items in loaded chunks and player-adjacent areas
body:
# ChunkEntityLimiter **High-Performance Entity & Item Limiter for Folia, Paper, Bukkit, Purpur, and Spigot.** This plugin optimizes server performance by intelligently limiting entity and item counts. It employs a **dual-check system** (Single Chunk Limit + Player Surrounding Chunks Limit) to prevent lag from mob farms or massive item drops, while ensuring important entities are protected. ## Key Features * **Native Folia Support:** Fully optimized for Folia's regional threading architecture. * **Smart Cleanup Logic:** **Oldest First.** Entities are removed based on their generation time. The longest-living entities are removed first to preserve newly spawned mobs. * **Dual-Layer Limiting:** Limits are applied to individual chunks *and* the aggregate group of chunks around a player. * **Precise Item Counting:** Configurable option to count item stacks by their actual amount (e.g., a stack of 64 Cobblestone counts as 64, not 1). * **Granular Notifications:** Separate controls for **Cleanup Reports** and **Overload Warnings**, with configurable scopes (None, OP only, or All Players nearby). * **Performance Monitoring:** Built-in performance profiler to track cleanup phases. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Cleanup Logic 1. **Classification:** Entities are categorized into "Protected" and "Removable". 2. **Protection Check:** Protected entities (Named, Leashed, Tamed, Equipped, Bosses) are skipped unless `clean-protected-if-over-limit` is enabled. 3. **Sorting:** Removable entities are sorted by **Spawn Time**. 4. **Execution:** The plugin removes entities starting from the **Earliest Generated (Oldest)** until the count drops below the limit. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Commands & Permissions **Main Command:** `/chunklimit` **Aliases:** `/cl`, `/climit` | Command | Description | Permission | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **`/chunklimit reload`** | Reloads the configuration file. | `chunklimiter.reload` (default: op) | | **`/chunklimit stats`** | Displays detailed entity statistics for the current chunk and surrounding radius. | `chunklimiter.stats` (default: true) | | **`/chunklimit notify [type] [scope]`** | Set notification preferences.
• **Type:** `report` (Cleanup result) or `warning` (Near limit)
• **Scope:** `none` (Off), `op` (Admins only), `all` (Everyone nearby)
_Example:_ `/cl notify report op` | `chunklimiter.notify` (default: op) | | **`/chunklimit performance [reset]`** | View performance metrics (execution time for classification, cleanup, etc.). | `chunklimiter.performance` (default: op) | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ #### config.yml ``` # Entity and item drop limits configuration. It will only clear parts that exceed the limits. # 区块实体、掉落物限制配置，只会清理超出的部分 entity-limits: # Default maximum number of entities allowed per chunk (all entities except those with special configurations) # 默认每个区块允许的最大实体数量（除特殊配置外的所有实体） default-limit: 100 # Maximum number of item entities allowed (item drops) # 物品实体的最大数量限制（掉落物） item-limit: 300 # Check interval (in game ticks, 20 ticks = 1 second) # Recommended: 600 (30s) or 1200 (60s) for performance # 检查间隔（单位：游戏刻，20 ticks = 1秒） # 推荐设置：600 (30秒) 或 1200 (60秒) 以节省性能 check-interval-ticks: 600 # Whether to check chunks around the player. 0 means disabled. # Example: If chunk-check-radius: 1, the total limit for all chunks (3x3) within radius 1 around the player is calculated. # 是否包含检查玩家周围的区块，0表示禁用 # 例如: 设置为 1 表示检查玩家周围 3x3 的区块范围 chunk-check-radius: 2 # Multiplier for entity limits in chunks around the player. # Example: If set to 1.5, the limit for chunks in the radius will be 1.5x the default limit. # 玩家周围的区块实体限制倍数 (宽松系数) # 例如: 设置为 1.5，则周围区块的实体上限是默认值的 1.5 倍 chunk_entity_multiplier: 1.5 # Multiplier for item entity limits in chunks around the player. # 玩家周围的区块物品实体限制倍数 chunk_item_multiplier: 1.5 # Whether to count item stack amounts towards the limit # If true, a stack of 64 items counts as 64. If false, it counts as 1 entity. # 是否计算物品堆叠数量 # 若为 true，一组64个物品算作64。若为 false，算作1个实体。 count-item-stack-amount: false # Ignored entity types (these will not be counted or cleared) # 忽略的实体类型（不会被计数和清理） ignored-types: - IRON_GOLEM # Iron Golem / 铁傀儡 - VILLAGER # Villager / 村民 # Ignored item types (these will not be counted or cleared) # 忽略的物品类型（不会被计数和清理） ignored-items: - DIAMOND # Diamond / 钻石 - NETHERITE_INGOT # Netherite Ingot / 下界合金锭 - ENCHANTED_GOLDEN_APPLE # Enchanted Golden Apple / 附魔金苹果 # Custom entity limits (override the default limits) # 自定义实体限制（覆盖默认限制） custom-limits: ZOMBIE: 200 # Maximum number of Zombies / 僵尸最大数量 CREEPER: 200 # Maximum number of Creepers / 苦力怕最大数量 ZOMBIFIED_PIGLIN: 200 # Maximum number of Zombified Piglins / 猪人最大数量 # Protection Settings, entities exceeding the limit will not be prioritized for cleaning, and protected entities exceeding the limit will still be cleaned up # 保护设置，实体超过限制时不会被优先清理，受保护的实体数量超过限制时仍将被清理 protection: # Protect entities with custom names # 保护被命名的实体 protect-named-entities: true # Protect leashed mobs (horses/donkeys excluded by default) # 保护被拴住的实体 protect-leashed-entities: true # Prevent harming tamed pets (dogs/cats/parrots) # 保护驯服的动物 protect-tamed-animals: true # Protect mobs wearing armor/items (including dropped gear) # 保护有装备的实体 protect-equipped-entities: true # Prevent altering boss-type mobs (Ender Dragon, Wither, etc.) # 保护Boss实体 protect-boss-entities: true # Notification settings # 通知设置 settings: # Whether to clean up protected entities when the limit is exceeded # If true: Normal entities are removed first, then protected ones if still over limit. # If false: Protected entities are never removed (but count towards the total). # 当数量超限时，是否强制清理受保护的实体 # 若为 true：先清理普通实体，若仍超限则清理保护实体。 # 若为 false：受保护实体永远不会被清理（但会占用数量名额）。 clean-protected-if-over-limit: true # Whether to enable global single chunk cleaning (Phase 1). # If false: Skips global scan, only cleans chunks near players (Phase 2). Recommended false for Folia. # 是否启用全局单区块清理（阶段1）。 # 若为 false：跳过全局扫描，仅清理玩家附近的区块（阶段2）。Folia 端建议设为 false 以提升性能。 clean-all-loaded-chunks: true # Notification scope for cleanup reports (when entities are removed) # Options: NONE (disable), OP (admins only), ALL (all players in radius) # 清理报告通知范围（当实体被清理时） # 选项: NONE (禁用), OP (仅管理员), ALL (所有玩家) cleanup-report-scope: ALL # Notification scope for overload warnings (when nearing limit) # Options: NONE (disable), OP (admins only), ALL (all players in radius) # 超限预警通知范围（当接近上限时） # 选项: NONE (禁用), OP (仅管理员), ALL (所有玩家) overload-warning-scope: ALL # Whether OPs should receive global notifications for cleanup reports # If true: OPs receive reports from all chunks. If false: OPs must be nearby. # 是否向OP发送全局清理报告通知（全服广播给OP） # 若为 true：OP 接收所有区块的报告。若为 false：OP 必须在附近。 op-global-cleanup-report: true # Whether OPs should receive global notifications for overload warnings # If true: OPs receive warnings from all chunks. If false: OPs must be nearby. # 是否向OP发送全局超限预警通知（全服广播给OP） # 若为 true：OP 接收所有区块的预警。若为 false：OP 必须在附近。 op-global-overload-warning: false # Whether to send cleanup reports to the server console # 是否将清理报告发送到服务器控制台 console-cleanup-report: true # Warning notification percentage (0-100). # 预警通知百分比（0-100） notify-threshold: 90 # Warning cooldown time, in seconds # 预警冷却时间，单位秒 notify-cooldown: 10 # Player notification scope radius # 玩家通知范围半径 notification-radius: 128.0 # Set to true to enable performance monitoring # 设为 true 启用性能监控 performance-monitoring: false # Set to true to enable debug mode (verbose logging) # 设为 true 启用调试模式（详细日志） debug-mode: false # Language option (en/zh) # 语言选项（en/zh） language: en ``` ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ### bStats ![bStats](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/ChunkEntityLimiter.svg)

# Better Bonemeal

## Description
Better Bonemeal lets you use bonemeal more crops, including bonemealing sugar cane! Better Bonemeal also adds subtle feature improvements to enhance your gameplay experience.
![Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/008add4d2a3a9cdd5a783e07cedc618999166655.gif)

1. Install **Fabric Loader >=0.16.9** for Minecraft 1.21.4 and above  
2. Place `better-bonemeal-v.x.x.jar` in your `mods` folder  
3. Start Minecraft with the Fabric profile
5. **Make sure you have the fabric api mod**

## Features

* Bonemealing the following blocks is now allowed:
  * Sugar cane
  * Cactus
  * Nether wart
* Bonemealing now has a 10% chance to grow crops twice
* Wasting bonemeal is now prevented (e.g. trying to grow a sapling with a block above)

title: Explosion Control & Rebalance
description: Simple server-side mod (works in singleplayer as well) that gives you configurable control over explosions by allowing you to toggle griefing, add extra knockback, and/or modify damage for each source.
body:
# Explosion Control & Rebalance
Simple server-side mod (works in singleplayer as well) that gives you configurable control over explosions by allowing you to toggle griefing, add extra knockback, and/or modify damage for each source.

![gif](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/809569af-e4d0-46eb-86a7-cb23bd56eda2)

## Config

The mod is highly configurable allowing you to tweak aspects of the knockback and falloff as well as settings for each different type of explosion. You are also able to configure explosions from other mods using the `Explosions.Custom.Exploders` config option.

<details>
<summary>Click to see the default config file</summary>
  
```toml
# Controls aspects of the added knockback
[Knockback]
	# Strength of extra knockback caused by the explosion.
	# Default: 3.0
	KnockbackStrength = 3.0
	# Multiplier of extra knockback caused by the explosion to players.
	# Default: 0.9
	PlayerKnockbackMultiplier = 0.9
	# The amount of upward velocity added by the explosion as part of its knockback.
	# Default: 0.1
	UpwardsKnockback = 0.1

# Controls the falloff used for knockback and damage
[Falloff]
	# Exponent used for calculating the falloff.
	# Default: 2.0
	FalloffExponent = 2.0
	# Adds to the radius when calculating the falloff. Allows for entities near the edge of the explosion to still get some knockback
	# Default: 1.0
	FalloffExtension = 1.0

# Controls aspects of different types of explosions
[Explosions]

	[Explosions.Creeper]
		# Prevents creeper explosions from breaking blocks.
		# Default: true
		DisableCreeperGriefing = true
		# Enables extra knockback for creeper explosions.
		# Default: true
		EnableCreeperKnockback = true
		# Multiplier for extra knockback caused by creeper explosions.
		# Default: 1.0
		CreeperKnockbackMultiplier = 1.0
		# Multiplier for the total damage caused by creeper explosions.
		# Default: 1.0
		CreeperDamageMultiplier = 1.0

	[Explosions.EndCrystal]
		# Prevents end crystal explosions from breaking blocks and setting blocks on fire.
		# Default: false
		DisableEndCrystalGriefing = false
		# Enables extra knockback for end crystal explosions.
		# Default: true
		EnableEndCrystalKnockback = true
		# Multiplier for extra knockback caused by end crystal explosions.
		# Default: 0.75
		EndCrystalKnockbackMultiplier = 0.75
		# Multiplier for the total damage caused by end crystal explosions.
		# Default: 1.0
		EndCrystalDamageMultiplier = 1.0

	[Explosions.Fireball]
		# Prevents fireball explosions from breaking blocks and setting blocks on fire.
		# Default: false
		DisableFireballGriefing = false
		# Enables extra knockback for fireball explosions.
		# Default: true
		EnableFireballKnockback = true
		# Multiplier for extra knockback caused by fireball explosions.
		# Default: 0.75
		FireballKnockbackMultiplier = 0.75
		# Multiplier for the total damage caused by fireball explosions.
		# Default: 1.0
		FireballDamageMultiplier = 1.0

	[Explosions.TNT]
		# Prevents TNT explosions from breaking blocks.
		# Default: false
		DisableTNTGriefing = false
		# Enables extra knockback for TNT explosions.
		# Default: true
		EnableTNTKnockback = true
		# Multiplier for extra knockback caused by TNT explosions.
		# Default: 1.25
		TNTKnockbackMultiplier = 1.25
		# Multiplier for the total damage caused by TNT explosions.
		# Default: 1.0
		TNTDamageMultiplier = 1.0

	# Wither
	[Explosions.Wither]

		[Explosions.Wither.Spawn]
			# Prevents wither spawning explosions from breaking blocks.
			# Default: false
			DisableWitherGriefing = false
			# Enables extra knockback for wither spawning explosions.
			# Default: true
			EnableWitherKnockback = true
			# Multiplier for extra knockback caused by wither spawning explosions.
			# Default: 2.0
			WitherKnockbackMultiplier = 2.0
			# Multiplier for the total damage caused by wither spawning explosions.
			# Default: 1.0
			WitherDamageMultiplier = 1.0

		[Explosions.Wither.Skull]
			# Prevents wither skull explosions from breaking blocks.
			# Default: false
			DisableWitherSkullGriefing = false
			# Enables extra knockback for wither skull explosions.
			# Default: true
			EnableWitherSkullKnockback = true
			# Multiplier for extra knockback caused by wither skull explosions.
			# Default: 0.75
			WitherSkullKnockbackMultiplier = 0.75
			# Multiplier for the total damage caused by wither skull explosions.
			# Default: 1.0
			WitherSkullDamageMultiplier = 1.0

	[Explosions.Custom]
		# Allows for adding explosions from other mods.
		# Format: [EntityID, DisableGriefing, EnableKnockback, KnockbackMultiplier, DamageMultiplier]
		# Example: [["entity.minecraft.creeper", true, true, 1.0, 1.0], ["entity.minecraft.tnt", false, true, 1.25, 1.0]]
		Exploders = [[]]
```
</details>
