title: Artificer's Armory
description: (Beta) A weapon expansion for mage and spellcaster playstyles.
body:
_Requires GeckoLib_

This mod introduces several new magical weapons and tools designed for mage or spellcaster playstyles while attempting to be somewhat vanilla friendly. This mod is also meant to be complimentary to the [Iron's Spells](https://iron.wiki/) and [Better Combat](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-combat-by-daedelus) mods, but can be used without them. Each weapon has its own unique playstyle and abilities, and is designed to be easy to pick up and understand, and rewarding to master, with a plethora of unique enchantments that affect how they function. **This mod is currently incomplete, and considered to be in beta. The full version of this mod will have at least 10 unique weapons. Please feel free to leave feedback or suggestions in the issues page on Github or in [my discord](https://discord.gg/ehTCanCgXa).** --- # Weapons See the [wiki](https://github.com/TrashElemental/Artificers-Armory/wiki) for more detailed information on weapons and their unique enchantments. ## Tuning Fork ![The recipe pattern for the tuning fork.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HwSC3CR4/images/b7200112b316a827f585436e7cc08edc0850a640.png) A resonating tuning fork that can be used as a melee or area of effect weapon that can create shockwaves of sound when it strikes foes. Its primary use, however, is to apply a temporary enchantment to your other gear called 'Resonance'. Resonant armors will have increased damage negation, resonant tools can break extra blocks, resonant weapons will cause delayed shockwaves when they strike foes, and resonant bows and crossbows can fire a second shot after a short delay. The tuning fork can be further enchanted to increase the frequency, power, or effectiveness of your shockwaves and the resonance enchantment. ## Wrench ![The recipe pattern for the wrench.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HwSC3CR4/images/1962c54cbf91dac92fc2d65754323751c497a592.png) An artificer's wrench that can be used as a melee weapon, or to construct sentries that will autonomously attack nearby enemies. By default, you can construct two types of sentries, a basic sentry that will shoot arrows at nearby enemies, and a hover sentry that will fly over your shoulder and attack when you attack. By interacting with a sentry using a wrench, you can 'overclock' the sentry, causing it to attack faster, but also shortening its lifespan. By enchanting the wrench, you can construct additional sentry types like area-denial electro coils, ridable mobile gears, or long range laser arrays. The type of sentry you create using the wrench can be cycled by shift-using the item. Permanent sentries can also be created by using the wrench on one of three blocks placed on top of an Iron Bars block. Use a dispenser to create a basic sentry, a lightning rod to create an electro coil, or a redstone block to create a redstone laser array. ![Sentries!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HwSC3CR4/images/29da2e5312a1be1b0ce7213ddf2ad33bc22c56d6.png) ## Sprig ![The recipe pattern for the sprig.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HwSC3CR4/images/1a28ec5f8c7ffb10ccf3277fc70a7a281a7ea40d.png) The Sprig is a druidic staff used to fire a beam of concentrated nature magic. This weapon excels at area control and shaping the battlefield, as well as unlocking new movement options for its wielder. By firing normally, you can grow a line of bushes along the ground that will slow and damage enemies. By crouching while you fire, you will create a Sprout that can be climbed to reach new heights. This weapon is also a stout shilellagh, capable of delivering a hearty whack. Enchant it further to unlock the full potential of nature, create goodberries that can be eaten to restore health and hunger, create a small army of mandrakes, or recover your energy in the sunlight. The Sprig's full potential can be unlocked by firing its beam at natural blocks like flowers, leaves, or logs. ## Oculus ![The recipe pattern for qthe oculus.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HwSC3CR4/images/fd7b25a2e2b23ecf71298ddbde2a87131a045821.png) The Oculus is a ponderous orb used to create volleys of magical homing projectiles. By channeling the item, you can create up to three magical projectiles that will orbit you until you release the oculus, at which point they will become able to chase down and deal substantial damage to enemies. By further enchanting the oculus, you can cause it to create black holes, control the projectiles with your mind, or create defensive fields. ## Firebrand ![The recipe pattern for the firebrand.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/599fdcc0104ffe35f0398a1b5d961d6dd3240877.png) The Firebrand is a weaponized torch enchanted with a perpetual flame that can be used to cast fireballs or light up your surroundings. While held in either hand, it will shed light like a torch at your location, and can also be used to break certain blocks like cobwebs and ice very quickly. Melee attacks with this weapon will ignite enemies, but it shines the brightest as a ranged weapon capable of shooting fireballs. The firebrand can be further enchanted to become a flamethrower, a healing beacon, a charged blaster, or capable of burning even fireproof enemies. ## Censer ![The recipe pattern for the censer.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3a3467207972c662ef5fdea6e5acbdd3f729bf5.png) A blessed flail with a censer as its head. A melee weapon which can also be used to disperse clouds of incense that will apply an effect to nearby entities. By default, this effect is 'Blessing,' a minor boost to several attributes. However, by using the censer with a potion in your offhand, you can change the stored effect the incense will apply. You can use a milk bucket to reset the effect to Blessing. Positive effects will only affect you and your allies, while negative effects will ignore you and your allies. The censer can be further enchanted to transmute positive effects into negative ones for your enemies (and vice versa for your allies), affect a wider area, or heal your allies with the incense while amaging your enemies. ## Blight ![The recipe pattern for the blight.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3332f632ba2309a3ea99af71e3c3aedb4393439.png) A plague doctor's cane enchanted with a lingering hex that allows its wielder to exhale a cloud of noxious breath. A melee weapon that can be used for up to four seconds to blast a cone in front of you with a toxic cloud, dealing damage and inflicting the Plague effect, which debilitates and slowly damages enemies. By further enchanting the blight, you can cause the plague effect to create rats that seek out uninfected targets and spread the plague, cause riots among enemies with delirium, or cause chain reactions of black death when enemies die. ## Spirit Candle ![The recipe pattern for the Spirit Candle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d20ed75b9ebcf8c0db441f70782159d108972a09.png) Crafted from bone ash and compacted grave wax, the spirit candle enables a necromancer to conjure undead servants from the ethereal plane, so long as they **maintain their concentration by holding the candle in either hand.** Your undead servants will proactively target your enemies, and try to spread out their aggression to take on crowds. By using the candle, you can continually channel it to empower your minions, slowly healing them and boosting their offensive abilities. If you want all your minions to focus on one target, you can crouch-use the item while looking at a target to mark it. The spirit candle can be further enchanted to provide a stronger buff to your minions, summon skeletal priests that bless them, or even sacrifice all your minions to avoid your own death. ## Chime ![The recipe pattern for the chime.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7baf987b518766c47a9c03c82f912e03af3fa0f.png) A hand bell that can be rung to get the attention of a familiar spirit that takes the form of a golden allay. Your familiar is pretty handy, and has a variety of abilities it can use in and out of combat, such as protecting you from falling or fire, highlighting nearby monsters, or even alerting you to hidden loot. Your familiar will also pick up and carry items for you, which can be toggled to either deposit held items in nearby containers, or ignore them, by interacting with the familiar using a chime. You can dismiss your familiar by crouch-using the chime on them. Unlike the Spirit Candle, you do **not** need to keep the chime in your hand, but it can still be used to highlight an item for your familiar to retrieve or an enemy to target. While your familiar is active, a small icon of the familiar's face and a heart will appear to the right of your hotbar. The heart will indicate the familiar's health, and the face will indicate when the familiar is ready to use one of its 'triggered' abilities, such as catching you from a fall or putting you out when you are on fire. Your familiar can be further enhanced by the chime's unique enchantments, allowing it to specialize into a combat role from healer, bruiser, protector, or prankster. ![A lineup of the base familiar and its subclasses.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/165e31e634a64b3148645ccf4eca56dcced6bfc3.png) By giving the Chime used to summon a familiar certain names in an anvil, you can cause the familiar to take on a special appearance... ![Costumes your familiar can wear through special names given to the chime used to summon it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e3133b6892f76134397a40c5edf36d1f1aa23d9.png) ## Future Weapon Plans The full version of this mod is expected to have at least 10 weapon types. The following are planned: * Deck Of Cards - A magical deck of cards that can be placed on the ground or thrown, with a different effect for each suit. * Voodoo Pin - A cursed pin that can be used to cause mischief among your enemies. ## Credits * The Scarecrow costume for the Familiar references the [Tameable Beasts](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tameable-beasts) mod by [themodderg](https://www.curseforge.com/members/themodderg/projects). * The Mage costume for the familiar references the [Companions!](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/companions-mod) mod by [xylonity](https://www.curseforge.com/members/xylonity/projects). * The 'Calling Card' and 'Amethyst Candy' textures are modified textures purchased from [Glionox](https://glionox.itch.io/items16). * The 'Mandrake Salad' and 'Mandrake Root' textures are modified textures purchased from [PixelTier](https://pixeltier.itch.io/)

title: davdeo's Item Magnet
description: A mod that adds an Item Magnet to speed up the pick up of items and blocks.
body:
**ATTENTION: The magnet might break your automatic farms since it has quite a big range (32 Blocks) and just pulls items towards you ignoring walls or blocks between the player and the item**

# Features of the mod

This mod adds an Item Magnet to the game. It is a quality of life tool, that pulls in items and blocks in a 32 block radius around the player.

![Items Pulled by the Magnet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a691db16f053ea72680dda221e27c872c8cc102.jpeg)

For crafting the magnet you will have to find a Magnet Core. This item can be found in various dungeons in all dimensions. Since the item magnet is intended to be a late game item, it can only be found in the more harder dungeons of the game and also has a rather low chance of appearing.

![Magnet Core in dungeon chest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e093ff19772195638a4be9411b0db86558f5b44.png)

<details>
<summary>Spoiler Dungeons and Chances</summary>
  
- Ancient City (35% per chest)  

- Bastion (15% per chest - normal chests / up to two cores with 35% each for treasure chest)  

- End City (15% per chest)  

- Stronghold (10% per chest - library only)  

</details>

Once you found a Magnet Core, you can use it to craft your magnet like this: 

![Crafting Magnet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b35392b983df1d4ba0d64d84b654a08c937bd31e.png)

You can toggle the magnet on and off by right clicking with it.
Once the magnet is turned on, it will pull items in a 32 block range on the ground towards you. It then looses durability for each item you pick up, while it is active.
Once the magnet breaks, it is converted to a Broken Magnet. 

To restore it, you can put it in a furnace / blast furnace to smelt off the broken parts and you will end up with a magnet core once more.

![Restore Magnet Core I](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35a4f69cf3db7443cff577a7d6e4453be06dac81.png)
![Restore Magnet Core II](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2794671ff39bbf768c243c1478d6dc50162b7c43.png)

# Future plans

- It is planned to add more magnet variants to the mod (Teaser: Ender Magnet, Crafting Magnet, ...)
- With more variations, the durability and range of the base magnet will change aswell.

title: Endless Suffering SMP
description: E-SMP is a modpack designed for modded survival multiplayer that is fun and engaging for both beginners and experienced players. Inspired by Hermitcraft, it adds new twists and challenges to the base game without heavily changing it.
body:
The Endless Suffering SMP (E-SMP) is a modpack which aims to provide a modded survival multiplayer experience that is both fun, and engaging to play. E-SMP is designed to be simple for the average Vanilla survialist, while adding a modded twist for those who are looking for an experience that doesn't heavily change the base game, but adds some new twists for a bit of flavor and challenge.

E-SMP is inspired by the Hermitcraft modpack created originally by xisuma, called [Xisuma's Hermitcraft Enhancements](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/xisumas-hermitcraft-mods), and aims to expand off of it with a Vanilla+ experience. While this modpack is created with the express intent for use within the Endless Suffering community, with a lightly modded server anyone can recreate the experience for themself and their friends. 

This modpack is also being periodically updated and upgraded with different QoL changes without making too many jarring changes that will cause whiplash. Like Hermitcraft, the modpack's intention is to be present for "seasons," with each major modpack update being to either upgrade to a newer version of Minecraft, and/or to prepare for a new season of gameplay. We (the E-SMP Team) strive to keep this modpack relevant.

title: b8ches SMP 1 - The Modpack
description: A modpack for certified b8ches who want to join our SMP!
body:
# b8ches SMP - The Modpack
A collection of client-side mods used on the b8ches SMP. The mods were selected to provide a "Vanilla Plus" experience that enhances, but does not fundamentally alter, Minecraft gameplay. While some client-side mods may be safe to remove if not to your liking, some will be required by the server itself, and therefore are not removable. Tamper at your own risk.

## Installation
Simply install this pack via the Modrinth launcher to get started. From there, you can add your own resource and shader packs as you wish. For a guide on how to use shaders with Iris, see [here](https://github.com/IrisShaders/Iris/blob/1.21/docs/guide.md). Once you have everything you want and need, you can join the server with the link found in the Discord!

## Helpful Hints (read before playing!)
- If you are on lower-end hardware, I would highly recommend disabling Distant Horizons, the distant LOD generating mod that gives you a greater render distance than Minecraft would be default, as it will likely cause you performance issues due to the increased load it will put your hardware under.

<details>
<summary>A Short Guide to disabling Distant Horizons</summary>
  
Open the Distant Horizons Menu in Options.
![A screenshot of the Minecraft options menu, with a red arrow pointing to the Distant Horizons option button, which is to the left of the Field of View slider.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b562fe0dd46123badb076807506de11d7077bdcd.png)
  
Disable "Enable Rendering" and hit "Done".
![A screenshot of the Distant Horizons config, with a red arrow pointing at the Enable Rendering option, indicating that it must be toggled from true to false to disable Distant Horizons.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4a5eb113ca7d6ccc0be11035ed302f69f35f91a.png)

Thank you Joschino for the screenshots!
</details>

- I would recommend allocating at least 4GB (4096MB) of RAM to this modpack profile without Distant Horizons, and at least 6GB (6144MB) if you are running Distant Horizons. For a guide on how to change your RAM allocation on the Modrinth launcher, see [here](https://www.meloncube.net/clients/knowledgebase/187/How-To-Allocate-More-Ram-in-the-Modrinth-Launcher.html). If your device has 4GB of RAM or less, try using [Mem Reduct](https://github.com/henrypp/memreduct) to reduce your system RAM usage, and leave your RAM allocation as the default 2GB (2048MB), only increasing it to 3GB (3072MB) if the game is unplayable with 2GB of RAM allocated.

- The mod "Spyglass Improvements" adds a key binding for your Spyglass! Simply press Z, and you'll be using your spyglass, even if it's not in your hand! Check the config in the Mod menu for other spyglass features, such as enabling a smoother camera, or switching to another overlay!

- The only resource pack included, Fresh Animations, adds a ton of new animations to mobs to inject some much-needed life into their models! It may not activate by default, so double-check your resource pack settings in-game!

- If you don't like having your full player model rendered in first-person, simply hit F6 to return to the vanilla first-person view. Alternatively, you can toggle it in the Mods menu. To properly use Camerapture, you will need to disable the first-person model when taking photos, else the photos you capture will contain your model holding the camera.

- As we have many new blocks added by mods to enhance your designs and builds, we have EMI installed to allow you to explore the full range of blocks on offer! Click on a block to see its crafting recipe, as well as any other functions the block may have! EMI's documentation largely revolves around mod integration for developers, but you can see examples of the EMI UI in action [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi/gallery).

- Craftify allows you to control your desktop music apps from within your game, saving you an ALT+TAB out to change your music! It currently supports [Spotify](https://www.spotify.com/), YouTube Music via [YouTube Music Desktop App](https://ytmdesktop.app/), Apple Music via [Cider.sh](https://cider.sh/), and [Tidal](https://tidal.com/)! Craftify will provide a set-up tutorial in-game, and is perfectly safe to disable if you have no need for it.

- The server features proximity voice chat via Simple Voice Chat! You will be prompted to set up your audio devices when you join, but you can press V to set it up at any time! It also integrates with Sound Physics Remastered, so you'll be able to hear other people's voices (and your own, if enabled in the SPR config) echo in caves!

- The world will be affected by Seasons, which will impact the weather, flora, and crop growth! If you want more info on Serene Seasons, the mod the pack uses to achieve this, you can read about it [here](https://github.com/Glitchfiend/SereneSeasons/wiki).

- When you die, your items and 75% of your XP will be stored in a soul that will persist at the place of your death for 30 minutes after you died! Once this period expires, the soul will break and your items and XP will be at the mercy of others, and will start their despawn countdown!

- For help on using the Spyglass Astronomy mod, see [here](https://github.com/Nettakrim/Spyglass-Astronomy/blob/Main/README.md). Don't forget to share your names and creations with others!

## Feedback
If you have any suggestions for how to improve the b8ches SMP experience, be it a mod related suggestion or otherwise, please ping me in the #gaming channel on Discord, and I'll happily take on board any feedback you have!

title: CC Ballistix Reborn
description: Integrates ComputerCraft: Tweaked with Ballistix 0.9.2 for missile silo control and coordinate-based launches via the new control panel.
body:
"CC: Ballistix Updated" is now compatible with the newer version of Ballistix. Please use [CC: Ballistix Updated](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cc-ballistix-updated) instead.

# CC Ballistix Reborn

This mod is a fork of CC: Ballistix Updated it was made to fill the short gap between updates for [CC: Ballistix Updated](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cc-ballistix-updated).

## Functions:

* **`launch()`**
    * Attempts to launch the missile.
    * Returns `true` if the launch command was successfully sent, otherwise `false`.
    * This function will also queue a `ccballistixreborn_launch` event, providing the X, Y, and Z coordinates of the target.
  
* **`getRange()`**
    * Returns the maximum range of the connected missile launcher as an integer.
    * Returns `0` if no launcher is found or the range cannot be determined.

* **`getPosition()`**
    * Returns a table containing the current target coordinates of the missile launcher with keys `x`, `y`, and `z`.
    * Returns an empty table if no launcher is found or no target is set.

* **`setPosition(x, y, z)`**
    * Sets the target position of the control panel to the given X, Y, and Z coordinates.
    * This function will also queue a `ccballistixreborn_update_position` event, providing the new X, Y, and Z coordinates.

* **`getFrequency()`**
    * Returns the frequency of the connected missile launcher as an integer.
    * Returns `0` if no launcher is found.

title: BiomeAnnouncer
description: This plugin announces biomes with animated titles - supports both vanilla and Terra biomes
body:
# BiomeAnnouncer

A Minecraft plugin that announces the biome players are in with animated titles and sound effects. Compatible with both vanilla Minecraft biomes and Terra biomes.

## Features
- Animated biome name announcements
- Configurable sound effects
- Support for both vanilla and Terra biomes
- Toggle command for players
- Customizable cooldown system
- Per-world configuration

## Commands
- `/togglebiomeannouncer` - Toggles biome announcements on/off
  - Permission: `biomeannouncer.toggle`

## Configuration
```yaml
# Animation settings
animation:
  typing-speed: 3
  sound:
    enabled: true
    volume: 0.3
    pitch: 2.0

# Cooldown settings
cooldown:
  duration: 3 # seconds

# Messages
messages:
  prefix: "&8[&aBiomeAnnouncer&8] "
  enabled: "&aEnabled biome announcements!"
  disabled: "&cDisabled biome announcements!"
  no-permission: "&cYou don't have permission to use this command!"

# Worlds where the plugin is enabled
enabled-worlds:
  - "world"
```

## Installation
1. Download the plugin JAR file
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure the plugin in `plugins/BiomeAnnouncer/config.yml`

## Permissions
- `biomeannouncer.toggle` - Allows players to toggle biome announcements

## Support
For issues and feature requests, please join our [Discord server](https://discord.primalmc.fun/) or use the GitHub Issues tab.

title: PvpSense
description: AI Player Position Prediction for Mace PVP using neural networks
body:
**This Mods uses Neural Networks to predict the future position of the Players.**
 
 **!!! It is not trained when you install it you have to train it yourself !!!**


⚠️ Important:
It only predicts your **OWN** position 40 ticks into the future therefore it is no cheat.
If you run into problems, read all instructions carefully and check your log files.

Stats:
Uses movement data from:
Input Data Used
Velocitys
Yaw & pitch
Jumping
On ground
Shield usage
Eating
Holding a Wind Charge
Holding an Ender Pearl
Gliding
Right-click action in that tick
x,y and z distance to the nearest Player or Zombie

The neural network analyzes how your position changes over the next 40 ticks based on this data and trains itself accordingly.
Nothing happens automatically when you join a world.

**How to Use:**
Start Collecting Data: /trainSense toggleGathering
Enable the information HUD: /trainSense toggleHud
The HUD shows how many data ticks have been collected.
All of this data is stored temporarily in RAM.
If you stop moving or acting for 1 second, data collection stops automatically.
In newer Versions its /pvpSense

**Training the Neural Network:**
Train Using Saved Data
/trainSense useSaved addToNet ,Loads saved training data and adds it to the existing network
/trainSense useSaved overwriteNet ,Creates a new network using only the saved training data
Earlystop training if it doesnt advande by pressing "Y"

**Saving Training Data**
You can permanently store gathered data to combine multiple gathering sessions:
/trainSense saveData addToOld ,Saves RAM data into new file
Once a neural network has been trained and saved:
Press the default keybind Z
The mod will render your predicted position 40 ticks into the future



Read all instructions carefully again and check your logs if you find to have problems
also its recomendet to use the build in information hud during network creation

All recordet data is saved in: config/pvpSense
If you change versions clear all files.
Problems: The mod isn't acurate for far Enderpearling, or Movement speed over 20 Blocks/second

**!!!!Further versions may change the struckture of the net so don't spend a tremendous amount of time training with the first verion!!!!!**

Its also recommendet to completely clear your pvpSense config folder if you experience problems after swiching versions.



This project uses Encog™ (Apache License 2.0)

If you were a coder just could change the lines marked with .?.?.? but dont do that.
This project will recive major updates very often so be sure to allways get the latest version


Get help and talk about the mod: [discord.gg/MX4y9Nsk](https://discord.gg/MX4y9Nsk)

title: Advanced Classroom Furniture
description: Desks and chairs that you can knock around and move - experimental physics mod
body:
# Advanced Classroom Furniture
### Made for ModFest 26

This mod adds rigid-body physics based furniture props themed around the classroom.

Included are classroom desks of all wood types, and corresponding chairs.
Interact with the desks and chairs by punching them to knock them around and make them fall over, or by right-clicking to sit in them.

![Furniture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2B2ITxoC/images/0de1607a3c4204616cdd31f3a942e0bbe8e6676d.png)

You can also manipulate furniture with one of three special items:
- Furniture Dismantling Hammer: Attack a piece of furniture to destroy it.
- Furniture Grabbing Hand: Hold attack on a piece of furniture and drag it around to move it in the air. While dragging, also hold the interact button to rotate the furniture.
- Furniture Gluing Hand: Functions like the grabbing hand, but upon releasing the piece of furniture, it will glue itself to any other furniture pieces it is touching.

All items are only accessible in creative mode. The physics engine is unfinished and not stable/optimized. This mod is primarily a technical test.

title: A177 Added modified enchantments
description: The mod contains more than 200 enchantments, with a wide variety of types.
body:
Note: <The author does not know English, so these translations are machine-assisted and may contain errors.>, <Also, the author has no programming knowledge. Most of the code is done by Tongyi Lingma, and a small part by Deepseek. The code is entirely AI-generated.>

[Introduction content]

The mod contains 231 enchantments.

Almost all enchantments can be configured for availability (whether they can be found, are treasure enchantments, or can be traded). [Note: Found and treasure enchantments are mutually exclusive]

A small number of enchantments can be configured in detail. For example, Ore Sight can be configured to add support for detecting ores from other mods and adjust the detection range (Note: Setting the detection range too large may cause lag).

Range Block Placer can also be configured to change the placement range. Farmer's Hoe can be configured to change the planting range and the types of crops planted (Note: It was originally called Farmer's Boots, so the config file might still call it Farmer's Boots, same for Bountiful Harvest, etc.).

Note: The cloud blocks created by Skystrider can only be stepped on by players wearing the Skystrider enchantment. Other players or creatures cannot touch them.

Note: For Farmer's Hoe, Block Placer, and Range Block Placer enchantments, item consumption will prioritize using items in the inventory first, and only use the item in the player's hand as a last resort.

Players wearing the Skystrider enchantment can generate cloud blocks at any height while holding a Nether Star in their hand (Note: Falling on cloud blocks negates fall damage).

If the main hand holds an item with the Ore Sight enchantment and the off-hand holds a Nether Star, players can see the locations of ores through walls (Note: Without a Nether Star, the ore vision feature cannot be activated. Only players with this enchantment can see the highlighted ore locations. The location is visible, but the specific type of ore must be guessed).


_________________________________________________________________________________________________________


[Enchantment Book Content]

[-Uncategorized Enchantments-]

《Mending》

Basic Mending (Rarity: Uncommon, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): 20% chance per absorbed experience point to repair 1 durability of the item (Max Level 5, +20% chance per level).

Basic Chrono Mending (Rarity: Uncommon, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Repairs 1% durability every 8 seconds.

Chrono Mending (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): Repairs 1% durability, minimum 1 point, every 4 seconds.

Chrono God Mending (Rarity: Very Rare, Is Treasure, Not Discoverable, Not Tradable): Repairs 5% durability, minimum 5 points, every second.

Desire Flame God Mending (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): If the player is on fire, repairs 1 durability of this enchanted item (cooldown 0.2 seconds) (Works when worn, in inventory, or held).

Manual Rough Mending (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): When player sneaks (only enabled when item durability is at or below 30% or 30 points), each left-click in the air (cannot break blocks or attack entities, must be empty) has 20% chance to repair 1 durability, and 10% chance to lose 5 durability (Repair sound uses anvil use sound. Damage sound uses item break sound).

Manual Fine Mending (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): When player sneaks (only enabled when item durability is at or below 60% or 60 points), each left-click in the air (cannot break blocks or attack entities, must be empty) has 40% chance to repair 1 durability, and 10% chance to lose 2 durability (Repair sound uses anvil use sound. Damage sound uses item break sound).

《Special》

Soul Bound (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Item does not drop on death and remains in player's inventory.

Blaze Sanctuary (Rarity: Uncommon, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Immune to damage from fire, lava, etc. (Items with this enchantment are immune to burning).

《Uncategorized Negative Enchantments》

Nether Corrosion (Rarity: Common, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Player in the Nether, item loses 1% durability (minimum 1 point) every 1 second (Stops if item durability is at or below 5% or 10 points) (Durability loss occurs whether item is held, worn, or in inventory).

End Corrosion (Rarity: Common, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Player in the End, item loses 1% durability (minimum 1 point) every 30 seconds (Stops if item durability is at or below 5% or 10 points) (Durability loss occurs whether item is held, worn, or in inventory).

Overworld Corrosion (Rarity: Common, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Player in the Overworld, item loses 1% durability (minimum 1 point) every 30 seconds (Stops if item durability is at or below 5% or 10 points) (Durability loss occurs whether item is held, worn, or in inventory).

Chrono Decay (Rarity: Common, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Loses 1% durability (minimum 1 point) every 10 seconds (Stops if item durability is at or below 1% or 10 points).

-Weapons & Tools-

《Damage Weapons & Tools》

Combo Slash (Swords only) (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Attacking again within 0.5 seconds of the last attack stacks damage (Each stack +20%, max 10 stacks). Resets if pause exceeds 1 second (Max Level 3, +10 max stacks per level).

Cursed Blade (Tools or Weapons only) [Conflicts with Soul Bound] (Rarity: Uncommon, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Enchanted item deals 10x damage. If any damage is taken while the item is in the inventory, player's health is immediately reduced to zero. If the player dies, this item is immediately deleted.

Mass Slaughter (Swords only) [Conflicts with Lone Wolf] (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): More enemies in a 10x10 block range around the player increases attack speed and damage (Max Level 3, max 5 enemies, each enemy adds 10% damage and attack speed).

Lone Wolf (Swords only) [Conflicts with Mass Slaughter] (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Fewer enemies in a 10x10 block range around the player increases attack speed and damage (Max Level 3, min 0 enemies, each missing enemy adds 10% damage and attack speed, max 5 enemies meaning 5 or more enemies grants no damage bonus).

Reinforced Sharpness (Tools and Weapons only) (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): Damage +2 (Max Level 5, +2 per level).

Extreme Sharpness (Tools and Weapons only) (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): Damage +40%, each use consumes额外 2% durability (Max Level 10, +40% damage per level).

Reinforced Sweeping (Swords only) (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): (Only affects other targets hit by sweep, not the main target) Sweep damage +3 (Max Level 3, +3 sweep damage per level).

Annihilating Sweep (Swords only) (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): (Only affects other targets hit by sweep, not the main target) Sweep damage +100%, deals 5% of max health as damage to swept enemies, each use consumes 5% durability (Max Level 5, +100% sweep damage per level).

Fiery Sweep (Swords only) (Rarity: Common, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Targets hit by sweep are set on fire for 2 seconds (Max Level 3, +2 seconds burn duration per level).

Blazing Soul Sweep (Swords only) (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): (Only affects other targets hit by sweep, not the main target) If swept target is on fire, damage increased by 200% (Max Level 5, +200% burning sweep damage per level).

Leader (Swords only) [Conflicts with Lone Wolf] (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): If (friendly players) are within 8 blocks, enchantment holder gains +100% damage. If a player with the same enchantment is within range, the holder deals no damage (Max Level 3, +100% damage per level).

Lone Wolf (Swords only) [Conflicts with Leader] (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): If no (friendly players) are within 8 blocks, enchantment holder gains +50% damage. If a player with the same enchantment is within range, the holder deals no damage (Max Level 3, +50% damage per level).

Blunt Crush (Weapons and Tools only) [Conflicts with Sharp Edge] (Rarity: Uncommon, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Damage +25%, Attack Speed -15% (Max Level 3, +40% damage, -20% attack speed per level).

Brutal (Weapons and Tools only) (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): If target health > 50%, player damage +100%. If target health < 40%, player damage -50%. If target health < 20%, player damage further reduced by 40%.

Battle-Hardened (Weapons only) [Conflicts with New Edge] (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): For every 1% durability lost, weapon damage increases by 1% (Meaning lower durability = higher damage) (Max 100%).

Titan Slayer (Weapons only) (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): For every 10 max health the highest health enemy within 10 blocks has, this weapon gains +1 damage (Only calculates based on the highest health enemy in range) (No bonus if out of range or enemy health less than 10).

Shadow Hunt (Weapons only) [Conflicts with Summon Army] (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): Player takes 50% extra damage when invisible. Player gains invisibility for 8 seconds after sneaking continuously for 0.5 seconds (Effect cooldown 6 seconds) (Taking damage or attacking removes invisibility). Player deals 40% more damage while invisible, and 50% extra damage to glowing targets. (While invisible, enemies lose target, even if you wear armor they can't find you).

Piercing Heart (Pickaxes only) (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): Damage increased by 50% for each point of armor the target has (Max Level 10).

Armor Shatter (Pickaxes only) (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): If target is a mob, 5% chance to break one random piece of armor the enemy is wearing. If target is a player, always consumes 5% durability of one random piece of armor the player is wearing.

Flint Strike (Pickaxes only) (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Each level adds 0.8 damage and 40% mining speed (Max Level 10).

Strength Sigh Slash (Weapons only) (Rarity: Very Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): Lower oxygen levels increase damage (Max +120%).

Devour Strength Slash (Weapons only) [Conflicts with Devour] (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Each attack consumes 4 hunger, each hunger point adds 10% damage (Lower hunger = lower damage bonus).

《Effect Enhancement Weapons & Tools》

Wither Blade (Swords only) [Conflicts with Poison Scar and Poison Devour] (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Attacks inflict Wither I for 2 seconds (Max Level 3, +2 seconds Wither duration per level).

Weakness Wound (Weapons only) [Conflicts with Heavy Slow Hit and Slow Heavy Weakness] (Rarity: Common, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Attacks inflict Weakness I for 3 seconds (Max Level 3, +1 Weakness level and +3 seconds duration per level).

Weakness Trauma (Weapons only) [Conflicts with Heavy Slow Hit and Slow Heavy Weakness] (Rarity: Uncommon, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): Damage increased by 25% if target has Weakness. Damage further increased by 25% if target is not holding anything.

Strength Burst (Weapons only) (Rarity: Common, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Tradable): 10% chance on hit to grant player Strength I for 3 seconds (Max Level 10, +10% chance per level).

《Utility Tools》

Bloodthirst (Swords only) (Rarity: Rare, Not Treasure, Discoverable, Not Tradable): Heal 1 health per level when attacking a target (Max Level 5).

title: Mods Type Checker
description: Checks if mods are client-side, server-side, or required on both.
body:
# ModsChecker

CLI tool to audit Minecraft mods and flag client-only mods. It scans a `mods` folder, calculates hashes, and queries Modrinth and CurseForge to classify mods.

Гайд на русском: [тут](https://superhub.host/guides/scan-client-mods)

## Features
- Modrinth lookup by SHA1.
- CurseForge lookup by fingerprint (batch request).
- Metadata detection from `fabric.mod.json`, `META-INF/mods.toml`, `mcmod.info`.
- Client-only classification + heuristics.
- Console summary and optional JSON report.
- English/Russian output.

## Requirements
- Runtime: Java 8 to 25.
- Build: JDK 17+ (Gradle 8.x requirement).

## Build
```bash
./gradlew build
```
Resulting fat-jar:
```
build/libs/modschecker-1.0.0.jar
```

## Run
```bash
java -jar modschecker-1.0.0.jar
```

## Example output
![Example output](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2e0211e7bde13aa39ef8b0e5eb706b6e347c055.png)

## Configuration file
On first run, a `modschecker.properties` file is created next to the jar (or in the working directory).

Example:
```properties
modsDir=./mods
curseforgeApiKey=
gameId=432
verbose=false
jsonOutput=
language=ru
pauseOnExit=true
```

## CLI options
- `--modsDir <path>`: Mods folder (default `./mods` next to the jar or cwd).
- `--curseforgeApiKey <key>`: API key (or env `CURSEFORGE_API_KEY`).
- `--gameId <int>`: Default `432` (Minecraft).
- `--jsonOutput <path>`: Save JSON report.
- `--verbose`: Print extra diagnostics.
- `--language <lang>`: `ru` or `en`.
- `--pause`: Wait for Enter before exit (default on Windows).
- `--noPause`: Do not wait for Enter.

## Classification rules
A mod is considered client-only if:
- Modrinth `client_side=required` and `server_side=unsupported` (client required), or
- Modrinth `client_side=required` and `server_side=optional` (client preferred).

If Modrinth data is not available, a heuristic is used based on keywords in mod names.

## Notes
- CurseForge is used for identification only (no explicit client/server flags).
- No infinite retries or loops; HTTP timeouts are used.

description: Increases world height to 1024 (-512 to 512) and replaces Bedrock with Reinforced Deepslate.
body:
![A house underneath the minecraft world, with text saying "1024" shown above.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a902abef22bda5a46366a262612b14d4412baa22.png)
This datapack allows you to build with even more room than ever before! Build height in the overworld is extended from the vanilla 384 (-64 to 320) to 1024 (-512 to 512). Not only this, but it also replaces bedrock with reinforced deepslate, allowing you to build underground!


<details>
<summary>SOME PACKS I RECOMMEND TO GO WITH THIS:</summary>
  
[Pickaxe Effective Reinforced Deepslate [PurpurPack]](https://modrinth.com/datapack/purpurpacks-pickaxe-effective-reinforced-deepslate) - Makes it a tad less miserable to get beneath the deepslate

[Silk Touch Reinforced Deepslate [PurpurPack]](https://modrinth.com/datapack/purpurpacks-silk-touch-reinforced-deepslate) - Lets you patch holes in the deepslate after you break them

</details>



Questions I know you'll ask:

<details>
<summary>Why no Nether and End?</summary>
man idk. i'll probably add them in another update?
</details>
<details>
<summary>Why not more blocks? e.g. 2048?</summary>
i would consider 2048, but I made this almost exclusively for a server i'm hosting, and said server is REALLY slow, more blocks = more stress, more stress = slower server :(
</details>
<details>
<summary>Why make it go under bedrock?</summary>
to be honest, i think being able to build under bedrock provides a lot of really fun build opportunities!! like, wanna make skyblock? boom. parkour with an additional amount of fear to it? boom. the opportunities are endless.... 
</details>
<details>
<summary>Why replace bedrock with reinforced deepslate?</summary>
i mean... you're meant to go down there for building reasons now, why would i keep it as impossible to break? i chose reinforced deepslate since i felt it was a good match, really hard block and still deepslate related. i was originally gonna try obsidian, but that felt really boring. 
</details>

title: SimplyPronouns
description: Allows you to see yours and others pronouns in Minecraft.
body:
# Simply Pronouns

I wanted to make a simple pronouns mod that wouldn't be dependent on local files or a minecraft server with a specific mod to be able to function. Finally I sat down and put Simply Pronouns together. Hopefully people will enjoy using this mod.


## Questions & Answers

### What does it do?
It displays a players pronouns under the nametag, in the game chat and in the player list.

### How does it work?
By using [PronounDB](https://pronoundb.org) it retrieves the pronouns to the client making it work on any server vanilla and modded. This however only works for players who have connected their Minecraft account to PronounDB.

### What is PronounDB?
[PronounDB](https://pronoundb.org) is an open source project available on [GitHub](https://github.com/cyyynthia/pronoundb.org).

### Can I trust PronounDB?
I trust PronounDB which is why I based this mod around it. It's however your choice whether or not you want to trust it. PronounDB has my seal of approval.

### Does the mod work without PronounDB?
As of right now the mod will only display pronouns of players who has their Minecraft account connected to PronounDB. This may or may not change in the future. 

### Can I use this mod in my modpack?
You can as long as the modpack is hosted on Modrinth or CurseForge.


## Credits
Thanks to Cynthia for creating PronounDB! Check it out at https://pronoundb.org

# Infinite Inventory Mod
Infinite Inventory mod provides a secondary inventory that allows the storing of any item in any quantity, while leaving the vanilla inventory intact. Works with Shulker Box content viewing mods.

title: Evol's 3D Lanterns and Chains Enhanced
description: Evol's 3D Chains & Lanterns, a resource pack designed to bring a new dimension to your Minecraft world! This pack enhances the visual experience of chains, lanterns, and soul lanterns by making them 3D and providing updated texture animations.
body:
![Soul lanterns and iron lanterns hang in space, around the title "Evol's 3D Lanterns and Chains".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8974060c68aa5dd334b72ead2356a07eb94b88aa_0.webp)
Evol's 3D Chains & Lanterns Resource Pack

Welcome to **Evol's 3D Chains & Lanterns**, a resource pack designed to bring a new dimension to your Minecraft world! This pack enhances the visual experience of chains, lanterns, and soul lanterns by making them completely 3D and providing updated texture animations, all in a crisp 32x32 resolution.

## Features

- **Fully 3D Chains:** 
  - Say goodbye to flat chains! Our pack transforms them into beautiful, three-dimensional models, adding depth and realism to your builds.
- **3D Lanterns & Soul Lanterns:** 
  - Experience your light sources like never before. Both regular lanterns and soul lanterns are now fully 3D fitting seamlessly into any environment.
- **Animated Textures:** 
  - Enjoy subtle yet captivating animated textures that breathe life into these common decorative blocks.
- **32x32 Resolution:** 
  - High-quality textures without being overly demanding, providing a perfect balance between performance and visual fidelity.
- **No Requirements:** 
  - This resource pack works with vanilla Minecraft, no mods or external loaders are necessary.
- **Shader Friendly:** 
  - While not required, **Evol's 3D Chains & Lanterns** includes PBR mapping for all textures, and truly shines when paired with your favorite shaders, further enhancing the dynamic lighting and visual effects.

## Installation

1. **Download** the resource pack file.
2. **Open Minecraft** and navigate to "Options" -> "Resource Packs" -> "Open Pack Folder".
3. **Drag and Drop** the downloaded `.zip` file into the resource packs folder.
4. **Activate** the resource pack from within Minecraft by moving it from the "Available Resource Packs" to the "Selected Resource Packs" column. Make sure it is above any other packs that might modify chains or lanterns.
5. **Enjoy!**

## Compatibility

This resource pack is compatible with Minecraft Java Edition 1.16.x and newer versions. As it only modifies models and textures for specific blocks, it should be compatible with most other resource packs, provided it is placed higher in the resource pack order.

## Feedback

If you encounter any bugs, have suggestions, or just want to share your amazing builds using this pack, please feel free to reach out through [mention your preferred contact method here, e.g., a specific forum thread, Discord, GitHub issues]. Your feedback helps make this pack even better!

## Changelog

### Version 1.0.0 

- Initial release of Evol's 3D Chains & Lanterns.
- Implemented full 3D models for all chain segments.
- Implemented full 3D models for regular lanterns.
- Implemented full 3D models for soul lanterns.
- Added animated textures for chains.
- Added animated textures for lanterns.
- Added animated textures for soul lanterns.
- All textures updated to 32x32 resolution.

## Version 1.01 (PBR Update)

- All textures include PBR Textures for use with shaders now.

---

Thank you for downloading and using **Evol's 3D Chains & Lanterns**! We hope you enjoy the enhanced visual experience in your Minecraft adventures.

title: Free Farming
description: I saw that swords instantly break bamboo, but still use twice the durability. So I made a mod that does everything but fix that.
body:
Free Farming is a small content mod that adds a couple of new crops to the game, a tool to harvest those crops, and other food-related items.

Tomatoes: Tomatoes can be grown on farmland, like any other crop. They have seven stages, and when fully grown, yield some tomatoes. The tomatoes can be crafted into tomato soup and used to make pizza.

Rice: Rice can also be grown on farmland, and when fully grown, yields a rice crop, similar to wheat. Rice can be made with cooked meat into various rice bowls, which give healing boosts when consumed. The duration depends on the type of meat.

Cheese: Cheese has a whole process to obtain it. First you must make the curds from milk, then use the curds for a cheese block. Placing the cheese block will allow it to age into cheese, which you can harvest for cheese slices. Cheese can be eaten or used for pizza.

Made using MCreator.

You may use this mod in any of your modpacks. If you want to make add-ons, ask me please.

body:
Moar Hoes

The datapack REQUIRES this Resource Pack.

The Moar Hoes datapack adds a ton of new hoe types to the game. These are a mix of uniquely designed hoes with special attributes and abilities… as well as a handful of hoes that are puns. They are intended to still mostly fit into the vanilla game in terms of art style and functionality.

So, what do the Hoes do? - **Replanting Hoe:** Right-Click to harvest and replant crops. - **Fortune Hoe:** Harvesting crops yeilds far more. - **Big Hoe:** Hoes in a 5x5 area around where it is used. - **Side Hoe:** A Weapon, and a joke 😀 - **Farmer’s Hoe:** Crops around you grow faster while held. - **Leaf Hoe:** Breaking leafs drops more saplings and apples, and also sometimes drops string.

Patron Exclusive Hoes ($1+)

- **Giant Replanting Hoe:** Right-Click to harvest and replant crops in a 3×3. - **Backhoe:** Mines a large area of dirt. - **Composting Hoe:** Harvesting drops yeilds bone meal. - **Dyeing Hoe:** Right-Click a flower to transmute it. - **Hoe Hoe Hoe:** Harvesting crops sometimes drops presents. - **Ida-Hoe:** Pulls down dangerous potatoes from the sky. - **Lucky Hoe:** Harvesting crops sometimes drop golden versions. - **Potat-Hoe:** Harvesting potatoes drops more poisonous ones. - **Tally Hoe:** Increase or decrease a tally. - **TobaccHoe:** Spew harmful smoke everywhere.

Learn more from this video:



NOTES TO YOUTUBERS: You may use this datapack in whatever video you like, free of charge. My only request: YOU MUST CREDIT ME for my work. Simply link to this page in your video’s description, pinned comment, or both AND verbally mention during the intro of your video that the pack can be downloaded using the link. “Download in the description” would suffice. To install, follow the instructions contained in the “instructions.txt” file included in the download. title: Reaper's Scythe
description: Introduce the legendary Reaper's Scythe, an end-game weapon with permanent combat buffs, a devastating right-click AoE attack (Wither II), and an on-kill speed boost. Highly configurable.
body:
# 💀 The Reaper's Scythe

**Unleash the power of death with the Reaper's Scythe!** This plugin introduces a powerful, end-game weapon that grants its wielder the passive and active abilities of the Grim Reaper. Crafted with rare materials like the Nether Star, this scythe provides continuous combat buffs and devastating area-of-effect attacks.

texture pack for custom scythe texture: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/codecrafter-plugin-pack

## ✨ Key Features

**1. Legendary Item & Crafting Limit**
The Reaper's Scythe is designed as a true legendary item. It uses the visual and physical stats of the **Mace** and is customized with a unique **CustomModelData**.
* **Configurable Recipe:** The recipe uses high-tier items like **Netherite Ingots** and the **Nether Star**.
* **Crafting Limit:** You can limit how many scythes can ever be crafted on your server via the `config.yml`.

**2. Continuous Passive Buffs**
As long as the player holds the scythe, they are blessed with dark power.
* **Haste:** Grants increased attack speed.
* **Strength:** Provides a permanent damage boost.
* *Both buffs are configurable in the `config.yml`.*

**3. Active Ability: Reaper's Whirlwind**
Activate the scythe's full potential with a simple right-click!
* **Mechanic:** Triggers a devastating Area-of-Effect (AoE) attack around the player.
* **Effects:** Deals configurable base damage to all nearby hostile entities.
* **Debuff:** All affected mobs are afflicted with **Wither II** for a short duration, weakening them further.
* **Cooldown:** Controlled by a configurable cooldown system.

**4. Passive On-Kill Effect: Death Speed**
The Scythe steals the speed of those it slays.
* **Mechanic:** Killing any hostile mob or player instantly grants the wielder a temporary **Speed II** boost.
* **Advantage:** Allows the player to quickly move to the next target or escape a dangerous situation.

## ⚙️ Configuration (Example)

All aspects of the Scythe are highly configurable, including:
* Display Name and Lore
* The Crafting Recipe (using materials like `NETHER_STAR`)
* Potion Effects (Haste, Strength, Speed) and their amplifiers/durations
* Whirlwind Damage, Radius, and Wither duration/level

```yaml
# --- ReaperScythe Plugin Configuration ---

# Default settings for the scythe.
default_scythe_name: "&5Scythe"

# --- Crafting Limits and Settings ---

# The number of times the scythe can be crafted on the server.
# A value of -1 means unlimited crafting.
max_crafts:
  reaper_scythe: 1

# --- Crafting Recipes ---

# Defines the shaped crafting recipe for the scythe.
# 'pattern' must have exactly 3 rows.
# 'ingredients' maps a single character in the pattern to a Material.
recipes:
  reaper_scythe:
    pattern:
      - "NNN"
      - "N S"
      - "  M"
    ingredients:
      M: MACE
      N: NETHERITE_INGOT
      S: NETHER_STAR

# --- Scythe Appearance Settings ---
scythe_settings:
  reaper_scythe:
    name: "&5&lScythe of the Reaper"

    # The description (lore) of the item. Color codes can be used with '&'.
    lore:
      - "&7The soul of every foe"
      - "&7belongs to the Reaper."
      - ""
      - "&eAbility: Reaper's Whirlwind (Right Click)"
      - "&ePassive: Death Speed"

# --- Active Potion Effects ---

title: MineCollapse
description: MineCollapse is a standalone port of the rock collapse and landslide mechanics from TerraFirmaCraft.
body:
# MineCollapse

MineCollapse is a standalone port of the rock collapse and landslide mechanics from [TerraFirmaCraft](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/terrafirmacraft).
Because TerraFirmaCraft is a total conversion mod that changes many aspects of the game, it's hard to integrate with other mods.
MineCollapse, on the other hand, is easier to integrate, since it is more limited in scope, and pairs nicely with mods like [Geolosys](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geolosys).
You can read more about the collapse mechanic in the [TFC Field Guide](https://terrafirmacraft.github.io/Field-Guide/en_us/mechanics/support_beams.html)
or watch [a YouTube video about it](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1KgwEexxGNI).

title: Scavenge
description: Apply a custom Rightclick behavior to any block!
body:
Scavenge is a mod that allows you to apply custom RightClick/LeftClick behaviors to any Block.     
On top of that you can add LootPools to these behaviors that are dropped when the conditions are met.      
These things are loaded from JsonFiles and act closely to a Scripting language.

On top of that you can add certain unque features/conditions when rightclicking these blocks.

For example:   
- Player has to sneak,
- Player has to have a Diamond in his hands
- The block is unbreakable
- The block disapears after 5 uses
- etc.


## Tutorial:
If you want a good example tutorial on how to write Scavenge Scripts,    
Xaikii made one, which can be found [Here](https://github.com/TinyModularThings/Scavenge/wiki/%281.16-%29-Getting-Started)


## Documentation
Documentation is now part of the mod.    
Which can be generated by setting the "printExamples" in the config section and start the game.    
Addons should be supporting this too.     
Said generated docs will be in the game folder and in the "scavenge_doc" folder.    
The documentation is sorted by Plugin -> TypeOfProperty -> PropertyName.

This is done to simplify the process of finding the documentation and keep it preserved.

## Dumping Scripts
Scavenge supports dumping ingame loaded scripts.      
Which can be done by setting the "dumpScripts" to true.    
This was done to make debugging easier, due to now being able to see what got loaded and what got discarded due to errors in the source script.    
Script dumping happens directly after scavenge scripts get reloaded.     
(So no game restart required)



## Datapacks
How to add a Scavenge Script:

Scavenge now works with Datapacks. It will automatically load all files that are in the "datapacks/DATAPACK_NAME/data/DOMAIN/scavenge_scripts" folder.
And will automatically reload them on resource packs reload. They will be automatically synced over to the client so no more "server->client" manual Syncing. Its done automatically.



Since the tool has a JEI plugin i had to install a JEI hack that reloads JEI 1 tick after scripts got reloaded because JEI does not support any mod that has recipe/data autosyncing. (This can get fast into the 2-3 digit reload range if jei does not fix this problem)



What has Changed outside of ResourcePacks now:
- Effects are now only executed on server, while conditions are tested both on server & client. So there can be desyncs if you store data unsynchronized.
- Math Operations/Conditions are now a lot more enforced then before because more flexibility even if  the code is bigger.
- Error Messages can now be directly added into Conditions so no longer the separate section with messages. And for effects there is a Message Effect.
- Conditions can by default now be inverted. (Addons can not be guaranteed to support that)
- Scavenge now uses Vanilla LootPools and you can just link them to the lootpool. It will try to show them in JEI but accuracy for more random/complex loot may not look as good.
- Math Operations/Conditions have now bit support.
- Examples for everything are generated. (Again Addons can not guaranteed to support that)

title: Create-Aeronautics:Compatibility + Bug fixes
description: A fix mod targeting Sable and its related issues
body: # F**kSable > 一个专门修 Sable 的 mod / A mod that fixes Sable > 因为 Sable 的作者挖坑不填，我来填 / Because Sable's author left holes, I'm filling them Sable 是个让 Minecraft 方块物理化的 mod，想法很酷。但 Rust + Java 的缝合架构嘛……你懂的。这个 mod 的存在就是为了补那些能让服务器血压直接拉满的洞。 Sable is a Minecraft mod that adds physics to blocks — a cool concept. But the Rust + Java hybrid architecture... you know the drill. This mod exists to patch the holes that'll send your server's blood pressure through the roof. --- ## 前置 / Dependency - **Sable** — 不是可选，毕竟我存在的意义就是擦它的屁股 / Not optional, after all, my whole reason for existing is to clean up its mess ## 社区 / Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/6cZAm2zYNn) --- ## 版本说明 / Version Notes 当你发现某个版本标记为 **Alpha**（例如 `v1.0.0-alpha.1`），那大概是一个存在已知问题但未被下架的版本。Alpha 版本可能包含未完成的功能、已知的崩溃风险或性能问题，主要用于早期测试和反馈收集。 **但请注意**：Alpha 也包含 Beta 版本 —— 实际上某些 Beta 反而比 Alpha 更稳定。版本号只是个标签，不代表一切。 **详细信息以 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/XSY-HYH/fuck-sable/releases) 为准** —— 每个版本的发布说明都会清楚列出已知问题、适用范围和建议。不要只看版本号，**看发布说明**。 生产环境请优先选择经过充分测试的版本。如果你在 Alpha/Beta 版本中遇到了问题，欢迎到 [Discord](https://discord.gg/6cZAm2zYNn) 反馈，但请理解——**测试版就是测试版**，崩了别意外。 --- When you see a version marked as **Alpha** (e.g., `v1.0.0-alpha.1`), it's probably a version with known issues that hasn't been taken down yet. Alpha releases may contain incomplete features, known crash risks, or performance problems — they're intended for early testing and feedback collection. **But note**: Alpha includes Beta releases — in fact, some Betas are actually more stable than certain Alphas. Version numbers are just labels, they don't tell the whole story. **For detailed information, refer to [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/XSY-HYH/fuck-sable/releases)** — each release's notes clearly list known issues, scope, and recommendations. Don't just look at the version number, **read the release notes**. For production environments, choose thoroughly tested releases. If you encounter issues in an Alpha/Beta version, feel free to report them on [Discord](https://discord.gg/6cZAm2zYNn), but please understand — **a test version is a test version**, don't be surprised if it breaks. --- ## 修复项 / Fixes 默认全开，可通过配置文件单独关闭。依赖其他 mod 的修复项，缺 mod 会自动禁用。 Enabled by default, can be disabled individually via config. Fixes that depend on other mods auto-disable if the mod is missing. ### Sable 核心修复 / Core Fixes | 修复项 / Fix | 描述 / Description | |--------------|---------------------| | `async-save` | SubLevel 保存操作重定向到异步 I/O 线程，防止保存时服务器冻结。Sable 的 Rust 原生层在主线程做同步 I/O —— 稍微大点的物理结构就能把整个服务器卡死。/ Redirects SubLevel saving to async I/O thread, preventing server freeze during save. Sable's Rust native layer does sync I/O on main thread — one slightly large physics structure can freeze the entire server. | | `panic-guard` | 调用 Rust 原生代码前加安全检查，防止 Rust 侧 panic 把整个 JVM 带走。是的，Rust panic 会直接弄死 Java 进程，没有任何优雅处理。/ Adds safety checks before calling Rust native code, preventing Rust-side panic from taking down the entire JVM. Yes, Rust panic will kill the Java process directly, no graceful handling whatsoever. | | `write-flush` | 更新存储文件头之前先刷盘，防止崩溃时数据变垃圾。Sable 的存储格式在异常退出后基本就是不可读的废数据。/ Ensures data is flushed to disk before updating storage file header, preventing data corruption on crashes. Sable's storage format becomes unreadable garbage after abnormal exit. | | `plot-holder-guard` | plot 区块的 holder 不存在时安全跳过方块更新，而不是直接崩溃。竹子长在物理结构旁边？服务器炸。/ Safely skips block updates when plot chunk's holder doesn't exist, instead of crashing. Bamboo growing next to a physics structure? Server dies. | | `sublevel-entity-guard` | 防止 `SubLevelInclusiveLevelEntityGetter` 遍历异常 AABB 时服务器卡死。`EntitySectionStorage` 内部数据被并发修改损坏后，实体碰撞检测可能陷入无限循环 —— 一只蝙蝠的碰撞查询就能卡死服务器 60 秒以上。/ Prevents server freeze when `SubLevelInclusiveLevelEntityGetter` iterates over abnormal AABBs. After `EntitySectionStorage` internal data gets corrupted by concurrent modification, entity collision checks can enter infinite loops — a single bat's collision query can lock up the server for 60+ seconds. | | `command-block-sublevel-fix` | 禁止命令方块（及其变体）被放到物理化结构上。原版只禁止直接物理化命令方块，但你可以先放方块再物理化 —— 显然不是预期行为。/ Prevents command blocks (and variants) from being placed on physics-enabled structures. Vanilla only prevents directly physics-enabling command blocks, but you can place first then enable — clearly not intended. | | `player-position-guard` | 玩家坐标超出世界边界时自动拉回，防止 SubLevel 物理把玩家扔出世界导致崩溃。Y 轴上限扩展至原版 +1000 格。/ Clamps player position to world border when coordinates exceed boundaries, preventing server crashes from SubLevel physics. Y-axis limit extended to vanilla +1000. | | `light-engine-bounds-guard` | 防止 SubLevel 区段超出世界高度限制时光照引擎崩溃。/ Prevents light engine crashes when SubLevel sections exceed world height limits during light propagation. | | `physics-ticket-guard` | 防止 PhysicsChunkTicketManager 导致 DistanceManager 内部状态损坏（ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException）。/ Prevents server crash when PhysicsChunkTicketManager triggers DistanceManager internal state corruption. | | `sublevel-volume-limit` | 限制单个物理结构最大方块数量（8192，约 16x16x32 体积），防止过大的碰撞体导致 Rapier 原生崩溃。/ Limits maximum block count of a single physics structure (8192, approx 16x16x32), preventing Rapier native crashes from oversized collision bodies. | ### 兼容性修复 / Compatibility Fixes | 修复项 / Fix | 依赖 / Dependency | 描述 / Description | |--------------|-------------------|---------------------| | `carryon-compat` | CarryOn | 修 CarryOn 把玩家放到物理化 sub-level 时传送到错误维度并崩溃。Sable 的射线检测返回局部坐标，CarryOn 当全局坐标用，玩家直接被扔进虚空。/ Fixes CarryOn teleporting players to wrong dimension and crashing when placing onto physics sub-level. Sable's raycasting returns local coordinates, CarryOn treats them as global — players get thrown into the void. | | `typewriter-server-fix` | Simulated | 修 Simulated 打字机在专用服务器上崩溃。服务端代码里出现了 `net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen` —— 这玩意儿在专用服务器上根本不存在。客户端/服务端不分，离谱。/ Fixes Simulated typewriter crash on dedicated servers. Server code references `net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen` — a class that doesn't exist on dedicated servers. Basic client/server separation failure, truly baffling. | | `aeronautics-server-fix` | Aeronautics | 修航空学 SteamVentBlockEntity 在专用服务器上崩溃。又是客户端类引用，这次是 `Minecraft.getInstance()`。同一个坑踩两次，真有你的。/ Fixes Aeronautics SteamVentBlockEntity crash on dedicated servers. Another client class reference, this time `Minecraft.getInstance()`. Falling into the same pit twice, nice one. | | `aeronautics-slime-bearfix` | Aeronautics | 修粘液球粘连结构时可以粘连旋转轴承导致其分离并产生穿模效应。**默认关闭** —— 因为很多玩法基于这个 bug。/ Fixes slime blocks sticking to bearing structures causing them to separate and clip through blocks. **Disabled by default** — because many builds rely on this bug. | | `physics-staff-drag-clipfix` | Simulated | 修物理手杖高速拖动物理结构时穿模和飞出世界边界。在 `updatePose` 中钳制 SubLevel 位置到世界边界内，超出则清零速度。Y 轴上限扩展至原版 +1000 格。**默认开启**。/ Fixes physics structures clipping through blocks and flying out of world bounds when dragged at high speed. Clamps SubLevel position to world bounds in `updatePose`, zeroes velocity if out of bounds. Y-axis limit extended to vanilla +1000. **Enabled by default**. | | `cna-path-optimization` | Create New Age | 优化 CNA 电网寻路性能。原实现用 `ArrayList.contains()` 做 BFS visited 检查 —— O(n) 查找，大电网上直接吃掉 18% 的 tick 时间。换 `HashSet`，O(1)。/ Optimizes CNA power grid pathfinding. Original uses `ArrayList.contains()` for BFS visited checks — O(n) lookups eating 18% of tick time on large grids. Swap to `HashSet`, O(1). | | `cna-insert-optimization` | Create New Age | 优化 CNA 能量插入逻辑，减少冗余寻路和消费者满时的提前退出。/ Optimizes CNA power insertion logic, reducing redundant pathfinding and early exits when consumers are full. | | `ctt-concurrent-fix` | Create ThreadedTrains | 修 CTT 和机械动力的并发问题。CTT 把火车 tick 移到工作线程，但只把 `manageEntities` 调度回主线程，`updateContraptionAnchors` 还在工作线程跑 —— 主线程读到不一致状态，`EntitySectionStorage` 里的 AVL 树被搞坏，轻则 NPE，重则整个服务器死循环卡死。/ Fixes concurrency issue between CTT and Create. CTT moves train ticking to worker threads but only schedules `manageEntities` back to main thread — `updateContraptionAnchors` still runs on workers. Main thread reads inconsistent state, corrupts AVL tree in `EntitySectionStorage`, resulting in NPE or entire server locking up in infinite loop. | | `effortless-particle-fix` | Effortless, Sable | 修 Effortless 对着 Sable 物理结构操作时客户端崩溃。Sable 射线检测返回 Plot 存储区域的远端坐标，Effortless 用该坐标生成粒子时客户端未加载该区块导致崩溃。修复方式：跳过未加载区块的粒子生成。/ Fixes Effortless client crash when interacting with Sable physics structures. Sable raycasting returns Plot storage area coordinates (distant chunks), Effortless uses these to generate particles but the client hasn't loaded those chunks. Fix: skip particle generation for unloaded chunks. | ### 性能优化 / Performance Optimizations 普通优化默认启用，安全无副作用。激进优化默认禁用，效果显著但可能带来行为异常。 Normal optimizations are enabled by default, safe with no side effects. Aggressive optimizations are disabled by default — significant gains but may cause behavioral anomalies. #### 普通优化 / Normal Optimizations | 修复项 / Fix | 描述 / Description | |--------------|---------------------| | `spatial-index-query` | queryIntersecting 从线性扫描改为基于区块的空间索引查询，O(n)→O(1)。/ Replaces linear scan with section-based spatial index for queryIntersecting, O(n)→O(1). | | `bbox-object-reuse` | 热路径 BoundingBox3d 对象通过 ThreadLocal 池复用，减少 GC 压力。/ Reuses BoundingBox3d objects in hot paths via ThreadLocal pools, reducing GC pressure. | | `inblock-state-cache` | 缓存实体所在方块状态查询结果，避免每 tick 重复遍历。/ Caches entity in-block state query results, avoiding repeated traversal every tick. | | `level-accelerator-cache` | 启用 LevelAccelerator 的 Long2ObjectMap 区块缓存（原版硬编码关闭），提升碰撞检测区块查找命中率。/ Enables LevelAccelerator's Long2ObjectMap chunk cache (hardcoded off in vanilla), improving chunk lookup hit rate during collision detection. | | `collision-aabb-prefilter` | SAT 碰撞检测前添加 AABB 预筛，跳过不相交方块的 15 轴 SAT 计算。/ Adds AABB pre-filter before SAT collision detection, skipping 15-axis SAT computation for non-intersecting blocks. | | `collision-skip-air` | 碰撞检测中空气方块直接返回空 VoxelShape，避免无意义的碰撞形状计算。/ Returns empty VoxelShape for air blocks in collision detection, avoiding pointless collision shape computation. | | `fastutil-sublevel-maps` | SubLevel 内部 HashMap 替换为 fastutil 原始类型 Map，减少 Map.Entry 对象分配。/ Replaces SubLevel internal HashMaps with fastutil primitive maps, reducing Map.Entry allocations. | | `physics-traversal-merge` | 物理管线 tick 中多次 SubLevel 遍历合并为单次遍历，减少迭代开销。/ Merges multiple SubLevel traversals in physics tick into a single pass, reducing iteration overhead. | | `network-sync-batch` | 网络同步标记优化（原版已有批处理机制，此为补充标记）。/ Network sync marking optimization (vanilla already has batching, this adds supplementary marks). | #### 激进优化 / Aggressive Optimizations | 修复项 / Fix | 风险 / Risk | 描述 / Description | |--------------|-------------|---------------------| | `dynamic-collision-substep` | 高速实体穿模 | 服务器 TPS 低时动态降低碰撞子步数。/ Dynamically reduces collision substeps when server TPS is low. | | `skip-far-entity-collision` | 远处实体穿模 | 跳过超出阈值的远距离实体碰撞检测。/ Skips collision detection for entities beyond distance threshold. | | `collision-volume-threshold` | 大型结构边缘碰撞失效 | 降低小体积方块的碰撞检测精度。/ Reduces collision detection precision for small-volume blocks. | | `dynamic-physics-substep` | 物理精度下降 | TPS 低时动态降低物理模拟子步数。/ Dynamically reduces physics simulation substeps when TPS is low. | | `reduced-network-sync` | 客户端位置不同步 | 降低 SubLevel 状态网络同步频率。/ Reduces SubLevel state network sync frequency. | | `skip-noncritical-collision` | 掉落物/经验球穿模 | 跳过非关键实体（掉落物等）的碰撞检测。/ Skips collision detection for non-critical entities (dropped items, etc.). | ### Create mod 优化 / Create Mod Optimizations | 修复项 / Fix | 描述 / Description | |--------------|---------------------| | `create-kinetic-cache` | 缓存 KineticNetwork 应力计算结果，脏标记机制避免重复计算。/ Caches KineticNetwork stress calculation results with dirty flag to avoid redundant computation. | | `create-contraption-collision-radius` | 缩减装置实体碰撞检测半径，减少远距离碰撞计算。/ Reduces contraption entity collision detection radius, reducing far-distance collision computation. | --- ## 调试命令 / Debug Commands | 命令 / Command | 作用 / Purpose | |----------------|----------------| | `/fucksable` | 查看所有修复项状态 / View status of all fixes | | `/fucksable <修复项/fix> on/off` | 启用/禁用某个修复项 / Enable/disable a fix | | `/fucksable all on/off` | 启用/禁用全部修复项 / Enable/disable all fixes | | `/fucksable default` | 恢复所有修复项为默认配置 / Reset all fixes to defaults | | `/fucksable fstemp <方块ID/block ID>` | 遍历已加载区块查找指定方块（包含物理结构上的）—— 其实没啥用，你看命令名也猜得到吧？/ Scan loaded chunks for a specific block (includes blocks on physics structures) — pretty useless, you can tell from the command name, right? | | `/fucksable fs2temp on <坐标/coords>` | 监控指定位置的方块更新，显示完整调用链（点击可复制）—— 和上面那个一样，临时的，没啥大用 / Monitor block updates at a location, show full call chain (click to copy) — same as above, temporary, not very useful | | `/fucksable fs2temp off` | 停止监控 / Stop monitoring | --- ## 国际化 / Internationalization (i18n) FuckSable 支持自定义语言包。所有可打印信息（命令反馈、日志等）都可以通过语言文件覆盖。 FuckSable supports custom language packs. All printable messages (command feedback, logs, etc.) can be overridden via language files. ### 使用方法 / Usage ``` /fucksablelang <语言文件名> ``` - `<语言文件名>`: 语言文件的名称（不含路径，不含扩展名）/ Language file name (without path, without extension) 语言文件位于 `.minecraft/config/fucksable/lang/`（服务端则为 `config/fucksable/lang/`）。 Language files are located in `.minecraft/config/fucksable/lang/` (or `config/fucksable/lang/` for servers). ### 默认语言包 / Default Language Packs | 文件名 / File Name | 语言 / Language | |--------------------|-----------------| | `zh.yml` | 简体中文 / Simplified Chinese | | `en.yml` | 英文 / English | ### 创建自定义语言包 / Creating Custom Language Packs 1. 进入 `config/fucksable/lang/` 目录 2. 复制 `en.yml` 或 `zh.yml` 作为模板 3. 重命名为你想要的语言文件名（例如 `ja.yml`、`es.yml`、`fr.yml`） 4. 翻译 YAML 文件中的值（键名不要改） 5. 在游戏中执行 `/fucksablelang <文件名>` 切换 ``` 1. Navigate to `config/fucksable/lang/` 2. Copy `en.yml` or `zh.yml` as a template 3. Rename it to your desired language file name (e.g., `ja.yml`, `es.yml`, `fr.yml`) 4. Translate the values in the YAML file (don't change the keys) 5. Run `/fucksablelang ` in-game to switch ``` ### 注意事项 / Notes - FuckSable 的可打印信息**不是很多**，所有文本加起来也就几十行 - 你完全可以**直接丢给 GPT** 去翻译，几秒钟搞定 - 切换语言后立即生效，不需要重启服务器 - 如果语言文件格式错误（无效 YAML），会自动回退到默认语言（英文） - FuckSable's printable messages are **not that many** — all text combined is only a few dozen lines - You can **just throw it at GPT** for translation, takes a few seconds - Language switching takes effect immediately, no server restart required - If a language file has invalid YAML, it will automatically fall back to default language (English) ### 示例：自定义语言文件结构 / Example: Custom Language File Structure ```yaml # zh.yml - 简体中文示例 / Simplified Chinese example command: fucksable: title: "=== FuckSable 修复状态 ===" fix: enabled: "✓ %s 已启用" disabled: "✗ %s 已禁用" missing_dep: "⚠ %s 已禁用 (缺少依赖: %s)" invalid_fix: "无效的修复项: %s" set: enabled: "已将 %s 设置为 %s" lang: switched: "语言已切换至: %s" file_not_found: "语言文件不存在: %s" invalid_yml: "语言文件格式错误，已回退至默认语言" ``` ```yaml # en.yml - 英文示例 / English example command: fucksable: title: "=== FuckSable Fix Status ===" fix: enabled: "✓ %s is enabled" disabled: "✗ %s is disabled" missing_dep: "⚠ %s is disabled (missing dependency: %s)" invalid_fix: "Invalid fix: %s" set: enabled: "Set %s to %s" lang: switched: "Language switched to: %s" file_not_found: "Language file not found: %s" invalid_yml: "Invalid YAML format, falling back to default language" ``` --- ## 为什么是 All-in-One？/ Why All-in-One? **Q: 为什么不写单独的 mod 逐个修复，而是全部打包在一起？** **A:** 因为我讨厌为了修复几个问题还要到处找补丁、一个个安装、反复排查冲突。 **Q: Why not write separate mods for each fix?** **A:** Because I'm tired of hunting down patches, installing them one by one, and debugging conflicts just to fix a few issues. **FuckSable 是全部打包：** - 一个 mod，一次安装，所有修复同时生效 - 每一个修复都在真实服务端环境测试过，不是纸上谈兵 - 配置文件可以单独开关，不需要就不开 - 不用记这个 bug 归哪个 mod 管，一个命令全看见 **FuckSable is all-in-one:** - One mod, one installation, all fixes work together - Every fix has been tested on a real server environment, not just theory - Config file lets you toggle individual fixes on/off - No need to remember which bug belongs to which mod — one command shows everything 简单说就是：**省事**。 Simply put: **Less hassle**. --- ## 吐槽 / Rant Sable 的 Rust + Java 架构本身不是问题。问题在于两边几乎都没有错误处理： Sable's Rust + Java architecture isn't the problem. The problem is the near-total lack of error handling on both sides: - Rust 侧 panic → 直接带走 JVM / Rust-side panic → directly takes down JVM - Java 侧对 Rust 返回值校验 ≈ 不存在 / Java-side validation of Rust return values ≈ nonexistent - 服务端引用客户端类？这不是边缘 case，是专用服务器一启动就崩的程度 / Server referencing client classes? Not edge cases, they crash dedicated servers at startup 依赖管理也是一坨屎：API 类散落在各种包路径下 —— `SubLevelContainerHolder` 在 `mixinterface.plot` 而不是 `api.sublevel`，`JOMLConversion` 在 `companion.math`。你永远猜不到下一个类在哪个包里。 Dependency management is also a mess: API classes scattered across random package paths — `SubLevelContainerHolder` in `mixinterface.plot` instead of `api.sublevel`, `JOMLConversion` in `companion.math`. You never know where the next class will be hiding. **但话说回来**，方块物理化这个想法确实很酷。只是希望作者能多花点时间在稳定性上，而不是只追求功能。 **But that said**, the idea of block physics is indeed really cool. I just wish the author would spend more time on stability instead of just chasing features. --- ## 附加说明 / Additional Note 自动更新走的是**中国 IP**，而且**没有 SSL 保护**。 Auto-updates come from a **Chinese IP** with **no SSL protection**. 默认是关闭的（除非你自己改了配置）。**不要开**。需要更新就去 Modrinth 下，防止供应链攻击。 It's disabled by default (unless you changed the config). **DON'T enable it**. If you need an update, download from Modrinth to prevent supply chain attacks. > ~~"我暂时没想把它开源，但你们大可信任安全性 —— 毕竟 Modrinth 审核过了对吧？"~~ > ~~"I'm not planning to open-source it for now, but you can trust its security — after all, Modrinth reviewed it, right?"~~ 现在开源了。 Now it's open source. --- ## 许可证 / License MIT License - 详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 文件。 MIT License - see [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.
