I already explained them :P

- Decreases maximum health by -10% (used to be -8%)
- Stays for up to 4.6 hours (276 minutes)
- Spreads to all living entities within 1.5 Blocks from any affected entity
- Bats have drops now which you can use to brew the Floo potion (with Nether Warts); Combine with Redstone or Glowstone
- Every 20th witch might have the effect on her; Get too close to her and you will be infected
- After it runs out you will be immune to The Floo for quite a long time
- Buy a very short (but strong) version from a Journeyman Cleric villager to build up immunity quickly

![](https://i.imgur.com/JvFt20v.png "")

## Seriously Infectious!

It really turned out highly infectious! In the testing world I accidentally infected an actual bat with it which just flew around in the spawn area, infecting many more animals, which also infected many more etc..

title: SimpleItemGenerator
description: Featureful custom items plugin for any version. Supports custom NBT, ItemsAdder, HeadDatabase, PlaceholderAPI and more!
body:
# Description
SimpleItemGenerator(SIG) is an open-source plugin with easy config, but powerful features.

# Wiki
More information about the plugin you can find [here](https://github.com/ValeraShimchuck/SimpleItemGenerator/wiki/Configuration).

# Important
Simple item generator is still in its early stages, it means that any feedback would be appreciated.

Also if you are unsatisfied with the plugin. Please tell me what were you expecting from the plugin or how I could adjust it.

## If you are encountering issues with the latest version, please let me know about it [here](https://discord.gg/ksXEuxCqdC), instead of downloading the older versions of the plugin! 

# Plugin overview
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/g819Zsg5id4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# Commands and permissions



To be able to see `/simpleitemgenerator` command, you need to have the permission `simpleitemgenerator.commands.general`

`/simpleitemgenerator reload` - reloads the plugin. Requires `simpleitemgenerator.commands.reload` permission

`/simpleitemgenerator give <item> [player] [amount]` - item is your key of the item that you configured earlier, player and amount are optional.  Requires `simpleitemgenerator.commands.give` permission

`/simpleitemgenerator set_slot <item> <slot> [player] [amount]` - sets the custom item to a specific slot. Player and amount are optional
Requires `simpleitemgenerator.commands.set_slot` permission



# Features
## DeluxeMenus support
Since DeluxeMenus 1.14.1 you can use SimpleItemGenerator in DM menu configurations. Check [wiki](https://github.com/ValeraShimchuck/SimpleItemGenerator/wiki/DeluxeMenus-support). Example:

<details>
  <summary>DeluxeMenus config</summary>
  
```yaml
open_command: basicsmenu
size: 9
menu_title: 'Basics Menu'
items:
  'teststone':
    material: STONE
    slot: 0
    display_name: "&aThis is a special stone"
    lore:
      - "&aTest1"
      - "&cTest2"
      - "&eTest3"
  'sig-item':
    material: simpleitemgenerator-item0 
    slot: 1
    lore_append_mode: BOTTOM # Appends lore to the end of original item's lore. Optional
    lore: 
      - "&aTest4"

```

</details>

<details>
  <summary>SimpleItemGenerator's config</summary>
  
```yaml
items:
  item0:
    item:
      material: IRON_INGOT
      name: '<gold>I am a SIG item'
      lore:
      - '<gold>Sig lore'

```

</details>

## MiniMessage support
![1.20.1 item text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c22473f07c5cb803bdd2de6b09ed74b39c0949bc.png)

<details>
<summary>Configuration of the item</summary>
  MC: 1.20.1
  
  ```yaml
  items:
    loreitem0:
      item:
        material: BLAZE_ROD
        name: <red><bold>Your custom item
        lore:
        - <rainbow>Your imagination is your limitation</rainbow>
        - '<gradient:red:blue>when you are using minimessage' 
  ```
</details>

## PlaceholderAPI auto-update
![PAPI auto update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/940817673ca23b556b8e3dbcd1e060276aaf7a70.gif)


<details>
<summary>Configuration of the item</summary>
  MC: 1.20.1

  ```yaml
  items:
    loreitem2:
      item:
        material: BLAZE_ROD

        lore:
        - '<light_purple>For instance:'
  ```

```yaml

    item:
```

title: FARWORLD
description: a mod aiming at expanding and padding out vanilla's content to give a truly full adventuring experience!
body:
![FARWORLD Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/44b63375a332205f812b685dd73784d284c3b300.png)

a mod aiming at expanding and padding out vanilla's content to give a truly full adventuring experience without subtracting from vanilla design principles.

made with love by ENNWAY!

 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
## presently, FARWORLD adds a few things, listed below:

**accessories!** items that can be applied to your armor by right-clicking. some armor types have more accessory slots than others, which can be controlled using item tags!

**the Bystone!** a new dimension accessible pre-Nether which contains various fun goodies, friends and foes to meet.

**an extended tool progression**, with bow and crossbow upgrades, new armor, tools, weapons and repair options!

 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
FARWORLD also makes a few miscellaneous noteworthy additions that don't require as much explanation:

the Bloomed, a new passive spider variant with a flower on its abdomen that can be tamed using potatoes. taming one will earn you the trust of other arthropods, making them neutral!

the Allsaw, a multitool found in the depths of the stronghold - unable to mine most ores but capable of excavating most fodder blocks. right clicking using the Allsaw will switch to precision mode, which enables silk touch at the cost of losing some mining speed.

the Wishbone, a fragile new trinket you can find in various overworld structures. it can be used to teleport to your spawn point - but beware, once you have used it, it will break!
it can be repaired using an experience bottle, or enchanted with Mending.

birch trees will now drop pears, which can be made into Mystic Pears using lapis lazuli, granting you with increased haste and speed.

cherry trees will drop cherries, a quick snack which can be eaten even at full hunger and grants healing, but only stacks up to 16.

a new mushroom has been added to dark oak forests, the Gloomcap - which drops Gloomspores to be used at a brewing stand to make potions of paralysis! these potions contain fast-acting venom that renders you (or enemies splashed with it) immobile for a very short period.

late-game materials such as netherite will now have new particle and sound effects when landing critical strikes.

![grand central 221](https://i.imgur.com/XOy4WTZ.png)
The British Rail Class 221 Super Voyager is a class of tilting diesel-electric multiple unit express passenger trains built in Bruges, Belgium and Wakefield, by Bombardier Transportation in 2001–02.

The class is similar to the Class 220 Voyager, but was built with a tilting mechanism enabling up to six degrees of tilt to allow higher speeds on curved tracks. Additionally, most have five coaches, and they have a different bogie design. They have a maximum speed of 125 mph (200 km/h).

title: Searchable Containers: Retraversal
description: Searchable Containers mod ported to 1.19 and Architectury.
body:
# Searchable Containers: Retraversal

*The icon has used [Fluent UI System Icons](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons) by Microsoft, licensed under MIT.*

This is an unofficial fork of the original Searchable Containers mod for Minecraft 1.19 targeting Forge and Fabric.

Any issues go to this place.

### Introduction

_Features marked **bold** are new features this fork provides._

Searchable Containers is small client side GUI mod that adds a search bar just above the players open container.

![](https://i.imgur.com/Uo3tLvZ.png)

While in a container, players can use the search bar to filter certain items.

![](https://i.imgur.com/XWR3VHc.png)

Right-clicking the search bar will clear it and select it for searching.

Player's can quickly move "selected" items between inventories using the arrow buttons to the right of the search bar.

By default, button tooltips are enabled, but can be disabled in the config.

Searching by default, will only search the item's display name. Changing the config option "searchTooltips" to true, will also search the items tooltips.

The search bar can be hidden by pressing Ctrl + H **and can be focused on by pressing Ctrl + F** while in a container. The keys can be changed in options, but Ctrl will still need to be pressed.

The padding between the search bar, and the GUI can be changed by editing "verticalPadding" in the config.

title: Dynamic Crafting
description: Interactive & visual crafting in vanilla Minecraft!
body:
# Dynamic Crafting - Youly

![Dynamic Crafting - Presentation Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/665b9c09ba5d1b259085c7601d9c338caac0fb63.png)

<iframe width="512" height="288" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/2OulkvppUFQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 📇 PRESENTATION

Dynamic Crafting is a datapack giving the ability to craft everything in a visual and immersive way through dynamic slots.

Instead of opening the crafting GUI, players can place the required items in the crafting grid of the upper face of the crafting table (crafting table GUI can still be opened depending on config settings)

Every recipe is supported, even modded recipes and recipes with remainders items.

This datapack can be configured through a dialog which can be opened in the pause menu.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ✨ FEATURES

## An immersive/visual crafting:

![Dynamic Crafting - Crafting a diamond sword on a crafting table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1653dd45101c2520434ff50b17fa4e2a3f1819f.gif)

Custom/Modded recipes and recipes with remainders are supported.

## A glow is visible around the result, its color depends on result rarity:

![Dynamic Crafting - Result glow color based on item rarities](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f07a29fd74c9f3fb726f0de5b11a0f60223e61ac.png)

## When a crafting table containing items is broken, every ingredients are dropped:

![Dynamic Crafting - Breaking a crafting table, causing it to drop its ingredients](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8683945bba0bc865b52d05448de74238139b1e6b.gif)

## Common crafting: craft together in multiplayer

![Dynamic Crafting - Two players crafting a piston on a crafting table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3577e99e98f9126e75a46fec3e081bbd7d981f43_0.webp)

## Other aspects:
- New survival experience
- Display rare items on your crafting table
- Supports recent versions (1.21.9-11 & 26.1.x)
- Server-side datapack
- And more!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 📜 INSTRUCTIONS

- **Interact** an **empty slot** to add an item, same items can be stacked in the same slot while respecting max stack size.
- **Sneak + Interact** an **empty slot** to add the whole item stack to the slot.
- **Sneak + Interact** an **non-empty slot** to swap its content with your selected item stack.
- **Attack** an **non-empty slot** to drop one item from it.
- **Sneak + Attack** an **non-empty slot** to drop all its content.
- **Attack** a **result slot** to make it spin.
- **Interact** a **result slot** to craft the item.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ⚙️ CONFIGURATION

The configuration menu lets you edit datapack settings, including visuals, sound effects, performance, and more.

It can be opened from the pause menu by clicking _"Dynamic Crafting"_ → _"Open Config"_.
![Dynamic Crafting - Click on "Dynamic Crafting" then "Open Config"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84d8824d53764d6bb06cddb89d3ed2f4fedf048c.png)

/!\ Operators can edit the config, but non-operator players can only see it.

## Config Settings:

| Setting Name                    | Description                                                                                                          | Default Value |
|---------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| Block Conversion                | Crafting tables are automatically converted when placed or interacted by players                                     | ON            |
| Cubic Chunk Max Crafting Tables | Limits the number of crafting tables per cubic chunk. A cubic chunk is a 16x16x16 blocks area (use F3+g to see it)   | 16            |
| Crafting Table Tick Distance    | Each crafting table checks if players are within this radius to tick (lower values cause less lag but shorter range) | 32            |
| Crafting Table GUI              | Allows players to open crafting table GUI                                                                            | Disabled      |
| Crafter GUI                     | Allows players to open crafter GUI                                                                                   | Disabled      |
| Crafting Orientation Indicator  | Displays an arrow on top face to indicate crafting orientation                                                       | Visible       |
| Items Sounds Effects            | Plays sounds effects when slots or results are interacted                                                            | ON            |
| Display Items Count             | Displays item count of slots and results                                                                             | ON            |
| Items Animations                | Slots and results play a pop-in animation when spawning                                                              | ON            |
| Result Glow                     | Results have a glow (colored by rarity)                                                                              | Visible       |
| Result Flick Interaction        | Allows players to tap result to make it spin                                                                         | Enabled       |

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ⚠️ WARNING

Some issues may occur (unable to load world, crashes) if the datapack is removed.
You can do those steps before removing it to ensure safety:
- Break all dynamic crafting tables (it can cause floating items slots if you don't do  it).
- Delete the custom dimension file named "crafters" in the "dimensions/dynamic_crafting" folder of your world (it can make world unjoinable or cause crashes if you don't do it).

title: Nutrition Unofficial Extended Life
description: An unoffical fork of Nutrition(A Minecraft mod that ensures you eat healthy.)!
body:
Nutrition Unofficial Extended Life allows you to create custom health systems in Minecraft by defining nutrient types and effects. It does this through a JSON-driven system of Nutrients and Effects, which define unique food groups and programmable status effects. This customization allows modpack authors to create entirely unique experiences just by editing the config files.

![Nutritioin GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f604818dccc1ca765475aeb173978ea8204eb3a_0.webp)

# What's New:

## New API: INutritionFood

This is an interface for items not extending ItemFood.
To be compatible with Nutrition UEL, your mod items must extend this and implement methods.

## New Command: nutrition-food

This command can modify nutrient configs.
- /nutrient-food -> Show the nutrient info of the held food.
- /nutrient-food add <nutrient> [<scale>] -> Add the nutrient (and scale) to the held food.
- /nutrient-food remove <nutrient> -> Remove the nutrient from the held food.

# Credit:
Original mod is [Nutrition](https://github.com/WesCook/Nutrition).

(Icon based on Adrenaline's)
body:
## About
This is a **small** QoL modpack based on Adrenaline. This modpack is multiplayer friendly, and should not get you banned (not guaranteed). This mod pack has 4 goals:

1. Be performant.
2. Be fast to update.
3. Improve QoL without changing the feel too much.
4. Consist of libre* mods only.


## Disclaimer
By using this modpack, [you agree to these disclaimers](https://rentry.co/epinephrine-mc-disclaimers).

## Multiplayer
"Toggle Accurate Placement" is bound to APOSTROPHE. Do NOT use Accurate Block Placement Reborn/SmartPlacement on competitive servers, or you will risk a ban! (Disable it with APOSTROPHE)

## Versioning
  - X is a mod list revision (addition/removal of a mod)
  - Y is the config revision (incremented every time a config tweak is added or changed)
  - Z is incremented when there's a version with only mod updates and little to no changes otherwise.

X.Y.Z is reset to 1.0.0 for every new MC release as different MC versions are very likely to have different mod sets available for them. (Taken from Simply Optimized's page)

## Appendix
I know there are way too many optimization + QoL modpacks, but I (a nobody) end up doing something like this when I install Adrenaline for the 1e7th time. Hopefully you enjoy it.

*Barring Sodium, which is under the PolyForm Shield License 1.0.0. The license allows you to do anything you want to the mod except to make a fork that "competes" with the original. I am not a fan of this and think it should be illegal because it is monopolistic in nature (see below for reasoning), but I must include it because otherwise the modpack would be very slow.

If you were looking for the section on the Sodium and Embeddium drama, [that has been moved elsewhere](https://rentry.co/regarding-sodium-embeddium).

title: Weaver's Cosmetics
description: Adds many unique cosmetic headgear and torso items to the game (with most including dyeable recolours, taking the total to 149!), with designs inspired by the armours from various media, along with Minecraft Dungeons, and other games.
body:
![Mod Logo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/509/416/weavers_cosmetics-group-shot.png) 

**Summary:**

Weaver's Cosmetics is a Forge mod for Minecraft 1.19.2 that adds in many unique cosmetic headgear and torso items to the game (with most including dyeable recolours, taking the total to 149!), with designs inspired by the armours from various media, along with Minecraft Dungeons, and other games. They are designed to be used as a server resource and aren't available in Survival mode (though server hosts could use other mods to make them available to players, as we do). The mod is designed to be used alongside mods that allow layered cosmetic armours.

**Latest Update: v1.16** - Ported over the latest update from Curseforge, which supports Neoforge 1.21.1 now.

![Assorted mod items](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/605/713/weaverscosmetics_v1.png)

![cosmetic list](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/737/161/hatslist.png)



**How to Obtain:**

The cosmetic items are unobtainable in survival, and can only be spawned in with Creative mode or /give command. This is to allow server hosts and modpack makers to implement them however they wish. We suggest using secondary mods like Shoppy by Thethonk or Apple Crates by AbsolemJackdaw to make them available to your player base if you want them to be purchasable within your game world. 

If you want to have a survival-friendly option out of the box, I am currently porting the entire mod's content over to work with Farcr's "Vanity" mod. Check it out at [Weaver's Cosmetics: Vanity Compat](https://modrinth.com/mod/weavers-cosmetics-vanity-compat)



 

**Modpacks & Mod Edits:**

I give permission to use the above described mod in any Curseforge or Modrinth modpacks that do not charge users for their use (though optional donations or Patreon, etc towards upkeep of modpack/server is acceptable). Please credit appropiately with at least a name, and link back to this page where/if possible.  If you would like to edit the mod, please contact me either by comment or by private message to discuss, as I don't give any permission to modify the above described mod unless you have asked directly, and even then permission is only be granted on a case-by-case basis. If permission is granted, then you would need to inform your players of the changes and notify them that these are your own modifications and not mine.

description: The mod that makes fire mechanics more believable!
body:
# Burning Block

**Burning Block** is a mod that makes fire leave a mark on the world, making it quite obvious where there was a fire. It also means that you might have to clean up after a fire!

![Two trees on the edge of a forest has been burned down.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d275746479836e63a2d4ea85f13487a90f8e0a78_0.webp)
The mod can convert blocks from one to another, and damage/convert adjacent blocks.

Currently the ash block has no uses.

**Burning Block** is made with modpack and datapack devs in mind: featuring datapack support. Many of the mod's block conversions are controlled by block tags and Neoforge data maps. There is a basic [Wiki](https://github.com/Gourmandd/Burning-Block/wiki).

# Compatibility
This mod probably doesn't mix with with Burnt, havn't tested it. Burning Block is fully configurable meaning modpack (or datapack) and mod developers can hopefully make whatever blocks/items they are missing out on.

This mod's ash is a decorative block, if you have Supplementaries it will probably spawn both types of ash during a fire. If supplementaries supports the proper item tags both mod's ash should be able to be used in recipes.

- For server side, the RAM requirement can vary due to amount of players, as well as server settings such as render distance. As a guideline, minimum is 4GB (4096MB), suggested is 6-8GB (6144-8192MB)
- For client side, minimum is 4GB (4096MB), suggested is 8GB (8192)

Notes for server hosting:
- This modpack included "chunky", which allows server to pre-generate chunks.
- Server hosters are recommended to pre-generate chunks around spawn to reduce lag when multiple players start loading chunks at the start of the server.
- However, please note that server file side will increase rapidly when chunks are loaded
- Although this modpack does not include any mods from the FTB series, feel free to add any that suits your gameplay. FTB mods are not inculded due to Modrinth policy.

If you have any problems or found bugs in the modpack, report it to the discord server by the invite link (Under "external resource").

title: Blunderbombs
description:
Bring the chaos of Blunderbombs from Sea of Thieves into Minecraft

Comes in both damaging and non-damaging variants!
body:
# Blunderbombs, in Minecraft!

Have your ever wanted to Blunderbomb your crewmates beyond the Shroud?

The **_Blunderbombs_** mod adds Sea-of-Thieves-inspired chaotic throwables to Minecraft. Upon hitting something, they emit a painful shockwave that sends nearby players and mobs flying!

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/LoVmCCU4KgU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Description

The mod provides two craftable items: a "Blunderbomb" (painful shockwave) and "Blunderwhiff" (harmless shockwave). The knockback from both can be countered effectively with Blast Protection.

### The Blunderbomb

A _Blunderbomb_ deals 1-3 hearts of explosive damage to all nearby players and mobs, depending on how close they are to the blast. On a direct hit, up to 5 total hearts of damage will be dealt (the remainder is dealt as projectile damage).

A modest shockwave will also send players, mobs, and other entities flying! You may find some unexpected uses for this, perhaps?

![Blunderbomb Crafting Recipe consisting of 3 Gunpowder along the bottom, and then alternating iron nugget, glass bottle, iron nugget above that line](https://i.imgur.com/zzrWjMU.png)

### The Blunderwhiff (Harmless Blunderbomb)

The _Blunderwhiff_ deals no damage, but will still knock back entities with a modest shockwave. Unlike a _Blunderbomb_ through, the knockback will not apply to the player that throws it.

On friendly community servers, you may wish to disable the _Blunderbomb_ recipe and leave only _Blunderwhiff_ as craftable — this is still plenty of fun, but remember fall damage still exists!

![Blunderbomb Crafting Recipe consisting of 3 Gunpowder along the bottom, and then alternating feather, glass bottle, feather above that line](https://i.imgur.com/0CueMi0.png)

## Installation

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) is required
- Install like any other Fabric mod

## Roadmap & Help Needed

- [Translations](https://github.com/loonietoque/blunderbombs-mod/issues/1) (I need help with this! Please see [here](https://github.com/loonietoque/blunderbombs-mod/issues/1) if you'd like to help!)
- Ability to launch Blunderbombs from Dispensers
- Better, more immersive sounds
- Better custom particles
- Act as dynamic light source

## FAQ

**_Will you add Firebombs?_**

I'm undecided! [Express your interest](https://github.com/loonietoque/blunderbombs-mod/issues/2) in this issue on GitHub if you'd like to see this, or join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/5Wxr2bjAVH) and let us know there!

**_Can I use this in my modpack?_**

Currently, no. However, open-source versions of this mod will be permitted in modpacks! This project aims to be open-sourced by the end of 2023.

**_Can you add Dispenser functionality for traps?_**

Absolutely! This is a planned feature for the open-source release by the end of 2023.

**_Can you backport to <Minecraft version>?_**

While I aim to support future Minecraft versions, it's hard to justify supporting much older ones. I can be convinced but there's no promises, sorry.


## Disclaimers

This fan project was made with love by LoonieToque, but not in affiliation with _Sea of Thieves_, _Rare Ltd._, or _Microsoft_. The _Sea of Thieves_ and _Blunderbomb_ names belong to _Rare Ltd._

Implementation & Artwork of the Blunderbombs Mod © LoonieToque 2023. All Rights Reserved.

title: Solar Village
description: A basic solar panel for Tesla
body:
What is it?

Solar Village is a standard solar panel mod for the TESLA power API. The goal of this mod is to provide a basic solar panel that can be configured by players and modpacks to suit very specific needs. This mod also doubles as a testing tool that can be used by others to confirm that TESLA power support is working. 

How does it work?

When the solar panel is in direct contact with the sky and it is day time, the panel will produce a small amount of power every tick. (20 times a second). The power generated is stored in an internal buffer which can be accessed by wires and other machines. The panel power can only be accessed from the bottom face. The amount of power generated, the size of the internal buffer, and the rate at which power can be extracted from the buffer can all be configured.

How to craft?

What's with the name?

Some were joking about the name Tesla being similar to the name Tesla Motors, which is a company ran by Elon Musk. Despite the name Tesla being a reference to Nikola Tesla the comparison between Tesla and Tesla Motors became somewhat of a joke. Solar City is another company owned by Elon Musk, so the name Solar Village directly plays into that.

title: PlayerSync
description: A server side mod that allows synchronising player data (inventory, health, xp, ...) across different Forge or NeoForge servers.
body:
# PlayerSync

**PlayerSync** is a Minecraft mod that keeps your player data synchronized across multiple servers. Seamlessly move between servers in your network without losing your inventory, experience, advancements, or modded items.

---

## Features

- **Inventory Sync:** Your main inventory, armor, ender chest, and offhand items are always up to date on every server.
- **Experience & Stats:** XP, health, food, and score are preserved as you travel between servers.
- **Advancement Sync:** Your achievements and advancements follow you everywhere.
- **Potion Effects:** Active potion effects are restored when you join a new server.
- **Mod Support:**
  - [Curios API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios): Curios slots and items are synchronized.
  - [Sophisticated Backpacks](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sophisticated-backpacks): Backpack contents are kept in sync.
  - [Cobblemon](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cobblemon):
Party, PC and Podex are supported(Only 1.21.1).
  - [Aether,Cosmetic-armor-reworked,Apotheosis,Aether,Refined-storage,Extra-disks,etc](Only 1.21.1)
  - [Any Mods using NeoForge AttachmentTypes]
- **Placeholder Items:** If a modded item is missing on a server, a placeholder is created so nothing is lost.
- **Chat Sync (Optional):** Synchronize chat messages between servers (can be enabled in config).

---

## How It Works

PlayerSync uses a central MySQL or MariaDB database to store your player data. When you join a server, your data is loaded from the database. When you leave or your data is saved, it is updated in the database. This ensures your progress is always up to date, no matter which server you play on.

---

## Getting Started

1. **Install the Mod:**
   Download the PlayerSync mod and place it in the `mods` folder of each server you want to synchronize.

2. **Configure the Database:**
   Generate config file by starting server at first.Edit the `playersync.toml` config file in the `config` folder to set your database connection details.
   Each server should have a unique `Server_id`.

3. **Start Your Servers:**
   PlayerSync will automatically create the necessary tables and keep your data in sync.

4. **(Optional) Enable Chat Sync:**
   Enable chat synchronization in the config if you want messages to be shared between servers.

---


## Configuration Options

All options are found in the `playersync.toml` file in your server’s `config` folder.

### Database Settings

- **host**
  The address of your MySQL/MariaDB database server.
  *Default:* `"localhost"`

- **db_port**
  The port for your database server.
  *Default:* `3306`

- **use_ssl**
  Whether to use SSL for the database connection.
  *Default:* `false`

- **user_name**
  The username for your database.
  *Default:* `"playersync"`

- **password**
  The password for your database.

- **db_name**
  The name of the database to use.
  *Default:* `"playersync"`

- **Server_id**
  This value distinguishes each server in your network. **Each server must have a unique integer here!**
  *Default:* Randomly generated.

### Synchronization Options

- **sync_advancements**
  Whether to synchronize advancements (achievements) between servers.
  *Default:* `true`


### Serialization Options

- **use_legacy_serialization**
  Use the old (pre-Base64) serialization format for writing data to the database.
  *Set to `true` ONLY if you have mod versions older than 1.35 reading the same database.*
  *Default:* `false`

### Placeholder Item Options

- **item_placeholder_title_override**
  Override the title of placeholder items (for missing modded items).
  *Default:* `""` (uses default translation)

- **item_placeholder_description_override**
  Override the description of placeholder items.
  *Default:* `""` (uses default translation)

---

## FAQ

**Q: What happens if I have modded items and join a server without that mod?**
A: PlayerSync will create a placeholder item so your original item is not lost. When you return to a server with the mod, your item will be restored.

**Q: Is my data safe?**
A: Yes! All data is stored in a central database and is not lost when switching servers.

**Q: Does this work for singleplayer?**
A: PlayerSync is designed for multi-server networks. It is not needed for singleplayer.

**Q: What mods are supported?**
A: Curios API and Sophisticated Backpacks are supported out of the box. More mod support may be added in the future.

---

## Support

If you have questions or need help, please contact us via Github or Discord.

---

**Enjoy seamless play across all your servers with PlayerSync!**

title: Block Physics
description: A block physics system not unlike Enviromine's or the functionality of scaffolding blocks.
body:
# FOR 1.18.2 AND BEYOND, Block Physics IS SUPERSEDED BY DISRUPTION: ## Modrinth (Awaiting aproval): https://modrinth.com/mod/disruption ## Github: https://github.com/stormdirus2/disruption


### A block physics system not unlike Enviromine's or the functionality of scaffolding blocks. Blocks have a max reach distance based on their blast resistance. They can only reach out so far from a 'support' (a column of block(s) that are connected to a highly-surrounded block or a high blast resistance block) Blocks that are not near a support will fall when 'updated'. # There is also a reinforcement mechanic, its easier to learn this firsthand than to learn it from ye old bad explainer. But basically: As a block is searching along their 8 vectors on the x-z plane, it will upgrade it's reach to a block of higher reach as long as that block is within it's own reach, specifically in that direction. This makes skylights easier and rewards the player for making shapes found in real architecture, like frames for glass. # Some blocks also search for supports upwards rather than downwards. The main reasoning for this is to prevent all of the nether crashing down, as well as the end islands. Blocks with the [sticky_blocks] tag will have this behavior, in this tag there are also fences, walls, chains, iron bars, and GlassSoundGroup blocks. # Blocks with the [protected_blocks] tag will have a minimum of 3 block extension capability. This is to prevent trees from getting pruned completely from a single block update. # Additionally blocks that have a slipperiness value higher than 0.6, or that are in the [floats] tag will float on liquids (such as lava or water). # Confused on when/where the physics system updates the blocks? It checks the neighbors of a position during these events: * Player breaks a block. * Player places a block. * Fire destroys a block. * Explosion destroys a block.

title: EinsZwanzigEins
description:
Create modpack for explorers and builders. Many QoL mods. Needs slightly > 4GB Ram in Java Memory.

1.20.1 is the most recent MC version which supports the Create mod. This modpack has Create and some follow-up mods.

The pack can be installed on a server.
body:
```
Project discontinued. Impossible to update.
```


## Fun with Create

This is a modpack for the CREATE mod. It is a little bit - but not too much - overpowered. And it has some Create-related-follow-up-mods and some low-level storage mods and AE2. The "Applied Energistics 2" machines will be powered by steam engines and alternators from the Create Crafts & Additions mod. There are multiple ways to fly, glide and teleport with devices. But there is no more teleporting  with commands like "tp" or "home".  Boats are unseaworthy but you have ships and planes to cross an ocean. A lot of new structures with Create-stuff and loot inside wait to become visited by you.

You will be able to make redstone dust from netherrack but ultimatively you will build a train and harvest it from your ore excavation redstone drill in the far distance.

## Which Create mods are inside?

- [Create Contraption Terminals](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-contraption-terminals)
- [Create Crafts & Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/createaddition)
- [Create Deco ](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-deco)
- [Create Enchantment Industry Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-enchantment-industry-fabric)
- [Create Fabric Sodium Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric-sodium-fix)
- [Create Goggles](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-goggles)
- [Create Man of Many Planes](https://modrinth.com/datapack/create-man-of-many-planes)
- [Create Ore Excavation](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-ore-excavation)
- [Create Railways Navigator](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-railways-navigator)
- [Create Slice & Dice](https://modrinth.com/mod/slice-and-dice)
- [Create Utilities](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-utilities)
- [Create: Big Contraptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/big-contraptions)
- [Create: Bitterballen](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-bitterballen)
- [Create: Copycats+](https://modrinth.com/mod/copycats)
- [Create: Deepslate Processing](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-deepslate-processing)
- [Create: Dreams & Desires](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-dreams-and-desires)
- [Create: Enchantable Machinery](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-enchantable-machinery)
- [Create: Garnished](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-garnished)
- [Create: Let The Adventure Begin](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-let-the-adventure-begin)
- [Create: Power Loader (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-power-loader-fabric)
- [Create: Steam 'n' Rails](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails)
- [Create: Structures](https://modrinth.com/datapack/create-structures)
- [Create: Ultimate Factory](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-ultimate-factory)

In the 1.0.34 update "Create: Dreams and Desires" and also "Create: Garnished" were added. Existing worlds need to be explored on their boundaries to find tin ore and nut trees. Or you start over again with a new world. The test server world (45.89.143.193:20486) is freshly set up with a new world.

## Inventory boosters

Have a backpack and use the "bank" (successor to "dank"???) to free your precious inventory slots. Chest sorting included.

## Storage and Autocrafting

When starting you will chose which storage system to take to begin with. There are "Only need 1 chest" and "Tom's simple storage system". Later you have enough resources to go pro and use "Applied Energistics 2" to automate. "Extended Drawers" and "Sophisticated Storage" support your storage efforts.

## Magic

Find fantastic rings and charms and craft some minor ones. Explore the world. The rings that can be found are worth a raid on some Husk or Skeleton - infested structures. Enchant those drills or crushing wheels for more efficiency and deal with xp fluid from your automated xp farm.

## Waystones and Map Teleporting

Find or craft waystones to go to points of interest. Waystones are scattered all over the map and you will find them in the field, in villages and mostly on top of abandoned towers. Harvest and replace a waystone to give it a name.

Teleport to what you see on the map on your own risk. Have the pickaxe in hand to prevent suffocating. Be prepared to fall through blocks. Teleporting via journeymap is allowed as you cannot escape from a tough situation by just pressing a key. Yes: no homes-mod anymore. This is still a little "cheaty" as in single player the game pauses when you call the waypoint-GUI to pick a destination. In multi player there is no pause. You have to allow map teleporting in the journeymap config because at first start this option is disabled. On a server you have to "op" yourself to be allowed to change admin options in the journeymap mod.

## Backup and Restore

After losing a world due to a "minecart contraption" obtained by the simple uncrafting table * I decided to introduce a backup mod. The backup mod is for single player worlds. If you have a server it normally comes with a backup solution already builtin. The additional backup from this modpack will eat up your payed storage space rather quickly. Stay with the host's backup solution if you have a server. Delete the backup mod from the server's mods folder.

* _The simple uncrafting table has been replaced with another uncrafter mod which does not allow that deep uncrafting and is less OP and too expensive to have it in early game._

## Memory > 4 Gigabyte

The memory usage for the client side (player) goes slightly over 4 Gigabyte. Setting the "Java Memory" in the options of this modpack to about 5000 should be safe. 
My online server used between 7 and 8 GB of RAM before FerriteCore was put into the mods folder. Now it is between 4 and 6 GB of RAM.

## How to install your own Fabric online server

To install a Fabric online server you first install an empty Fabric environment on your Server. Make sure to have the version with the correct Fabric Loader for that modpack installed. Then start it up to create the folders. After shutting down you simply upload the content of your mods folder to the server's mods folder. Then you delete 5 mod files from the server's mod folder:

Distant horizons, sodium, indium, iris and "early loading screen".

Then you think about it: Do you really want a 2nd backup system which will fill up your payed storage space? If the answer is "Noooh" then you also delete the "advanced backup" file from your server's mods folder.

Restart your server.

Maybe you want to protect your server's buildings against one-click harvesting with the VeinDigging mod which is in this modpack. Just put the [VeinDigging Global Blacklist datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/veindigger-global-blacklist) into the datapack folder of your world and restart the server. Works also for single player worlds on your computer.
The global blacklist datapack is a ZIP-file in your local mods folder **where it will not work**. To have it work it has to be copied into a world's datapack folder.

## Summary

This modpack shall keep up interest in playing as things are not too easy but still fun to play with. For each resource you need yet another contraption to be build. You will probably always have an idea about what to build next. And what to go out and explore for next.

title: NoSpears
description: Removes all spears from your server by blocking crafting and instantly deleting any spear item found in inventories, chests, or the world.
body:
## Need a custom plugin or edits?

I make **custom Paper plugins** and can modify this plugin or build something similar for your server.

- Add features to this plugin  
- Custom mechanics / gameplay changes  
- Discord integrations (webhook-based, no bot)  
- Fix or modify existing plugins  

**Fast, optimized, and built for real servers.**

Small requests: **~$5–$10** USD

**Discord:** `real_ginga`

---

## NoSpears

### Removes all vanilla spears from your Minecraft server.

---

**NoSpears** is a lightweight Paper plugin that completely removes every vanilla spear tier from the game.

Spears cannot be crafted, looted, picked up, stored, or used. They are instantly deleted anywhere they appear.

Designed for server owners who want to disable spears entirely while keeping everything else vanilla.

---

### Complete Spear Removal

NoSpears automatically removes:

- Wooden Spear
- Stone Spear
- Iron Spear
- Golden Spear
- Diamond Spear
- Netherite Spear

All tiers are detected using their official vanilla item IDs.

---

### Crafting Disabled

If a player attempts to craft a spear:

- The crafting result never appears
- The craft is fully blocked
- No duplication or unintended behavior

---

### Loot & Container Protection

Spears are removed from:

- Structure loot chests
- Village chests
- Trial chambers
- Generated loot
- Player inventories
- Ender chests
- Hoppers and droppers
- Item entities on the ground

If a chest generates with spears, they disappear the moment it is opened.

---

### Mob Spawn Protection

If mobs spawn holding spears:

- Spears are stripped from their hands
- Prevents unintended drops or combat imbalance

---

### Lightweight & Safe

- No commands required to function
- No config required for basic usage
- Fully event-driven
- No repeating tasks
- No performance impact

Install and restart.

title: Tornado Disasters
description: Summon destructive, multi-tiered tornadoes (F1-F5) that tear up terrain, lift entities into the air, and roam the world.
body:
# Tornado Disasters

**Bring the destruction.**
I wanted to add weather that actually feels dangerous, so I made **Tornado Disasters**. This isn't just a visual effect—these tornadoes actually rip blocks out of the ground and throw them around.

### What it actually does
The main focus here is physics. When the tornado hits, it interacts with the world:
* **Real Damage:** It picks up blocks (dirt, wood, leaves) and turns them into spinning debris entities.
* **The Vortex:** If you (or a cow) get too close, you get sucked in and thrown out the top.
* **5 Tiers:** Ranging from **F1** (kinda cute, moves some leaves) to **F5** (massive, eats everything, breaks the terrain).

### How to use it (Read this!)
**Right now, tornadoes do not spawn naturally.**
This version is fully controlled by commands, which makes it perfect for server admins who want to host an event (or just troll their friends).

**Commands:**
* `/tornado f1` - Spawns a small one. Good for testing.
* `/tornado f3` - The standard "mess up your house" storm.
* `/tornado f5` - **Warning:** This is huge and will destroy a lot of the map.

### A Quick Note
This is built for **NeoForge 1.21.1**.
Since it involves turning hundreds of blocks into flying entities, an F5 tornado might cause some lag on weaker servers. Use it responsibly!

Have fun destroying your worlds!

title: UHC Ready
description: Easily create a UHC using an existing world
body:
# UHC Ready
With UHC Ready you can setup a UHC in a few minutes using a existing world

## Usage
1. Use `/reload` to reload all datapacks
2. Follow the chat prompts, if you can't use the chat use `/function uhcr:start`
3. Wait for all the players to join then click [​START] in the chat or use `/function uhcr:ready`

## Configuration
### Show Players' HP on player list (TAB Menu)
To enable this feature you need to install the [Show Player Health](https://modrinth.com/datapack/show-player-health/version/1.4.0) dependency datapack

### Time until the border shrinks
At the moment the only way to change the border shrink time is to manually edit some datapack files

By default the border will start to shrink after 10 minutes, but you can change this
1. Open the folder of the datapack and navigate to `/uhcready/data/uhcr/functions`
2. Open game_loop.mcfunction with your favorite text editor
![game_loop.mcfunction in a text editor](https://i.imgur.com/dmKPJME.png)
3. Go to the 4th line and change 12000 with the amount of time that you want to set in Minecraft ticks (20t = 1s)

title: StickerBomb!
description: Add an *explosive* splash of colour to your Minecraft world with stickers! decorate your builds or graffiti your friends' with these sticky crowd favorites!
body: A mod that adds stickers! (but no bombs) Stickers are small textures that you can place in the world to add more life, decor, and character to your builds. You can also play games like tic-tac-toe with stickers! # Content ### Stickers! (obviously) Stickers can be crafted at the Sticker Printer. When holding a sticker, you'll get a preview of how the sticker will look in-world before you place it. For server admins, you can use the /give command with the component `sticker_data={isAdmin=true}` to make *admin stickers*, which can't be removed unless you're in creative mode. There's also *temporary stickers*, which only last for 30 seconds, and do not drop as items when removed (either by a scraper or by timing out) ### Sticker Scraper This item simply alows you to remove stickers. Right-clicking the face of a block with the scraper will remove all stickers attached to that face of the block. The sticker scraper currently has no recipe. ### Sticker Printer Lets you turn blank stickers into printed stickers. Place any dye into the top slot, and a blank sticker (crafted with paper and a slime ball) into the bottom slot. Then, type the ID of the sticker in the middle, and congratz! You have yourself a brand new sticker. For server admins, you can make a Temporary Sticker Printer, which only prints temporary stickers. Using the /give command, add the component `custom_data={"temp"=true}` to the sticker printer, and then place it. Any stickers made from that printer will be temporary. Sticker printers currently have no recipe.

title: Advanced Mobility Mechanics
description: Advanced mobility like crawling, climbing, and double jumping
body:
Advanced Mobility Mechanics adds new mobility mechanics to minecraft.
These include:
- Climbing fences, bamboo, chains, rods, and more!
- Double jumping
- Crawling

To Double jump, jump into the air and sneak and jump again. (JUMP -> SNEAK -> JUMP)
Double jumping will also negate fall damage as long as you land of the same Y-Level

To Crawl, look at a 1 block cavity (must be at your feet level and have a block above it) and then sneak and move forward.

You can also climb out of blocks such as sand and powder snow.

These features can be disabled by running `/trigger amm.disable_crawling` or `/trigger amm.disable_double_jump`.

title: MoreTotems
description: Some minor tweaks to Totems of Undying
body: # MoreTotems **MoreTotems** is a simple Paper plugin which adds some minor tweaks to Totems of Undying. ## 🚀 Quick Start ### 📥 Installation: > #### ⚠️ Warning! > > Please, do not download versions from range: > [0.1.0-data-1.20.5](https://modrinth.com/datapack/moretotems/version/0.1.0-data-1.20.5)..[0.1.0-1.20.5+mod](https://modrinth.com/datapack/moretotems/version/0.1.0-1.20.5+mod)! > They are not loading because of [#11](https://github.com/JustHm228/MoreTotems/issues/11) (Data pack is not loading on >=1.20.5) and > [#13](https://github.com/JustHm228/MoreTotems/issues/13) (Data pack never registers objectives). > > So, it is recommended not to use experimental data pack versions of the plugin. Please ensure that you have the following software installed: - [Java]() \(≥ 11 LTS\) - [Minecraft]() \(≥ 1.19.4\) - [Paper]() \(≥ 1.19.2 build [#191]()\) To install the plugin on your Minecraft server, you should: 1. Download the latest version. 2. Place it to the ``plugins`` directory in the root of the server. 3. Restart the server. ### ⚠️ Experimental versions: > #### ⚠️ Disclaimer: > > I am currently developing some experimental alpha versions of this plugin, > which can be loaded as vanilla data packs. I recommend not to use them because > of many bugs. So, if you download such experimental version and load it to > your world, please be ready for many serious errors. ### 💡 Features: - **"Unbreakable" Totems of Undying.** A Totem of Undying with the [``Unbreakable`` tag]() set will not disappear when used. To get such totem you can use one of the following commands: - ≤ 1.20.4: ``/minecraft:give @s minecraft:totem_of_undying{Unbreakable:1b} 1`` - ≥ 1.20.5: ``/minecraft:give @s minecraft:totem_of_undying[minecraft:unbreakable={}] 1`` - **Enchantments for Totems of Undying:** - **[Unbreaking](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Unbreaking).** Every Totem of Undying enchanted with Unbreaking of ``n``th level has a ``100/(n+1)``% chance that it will disappear when used. Otherwise, it will not. So, the Totem of Undying enchanted with Unbreaking of 3 level has a 75% chance that it will not disappear when used. ### 🔧 Configuration: Coming soon! ## 📭 Contact me: ## 📖 License This project and its sources are licensed under the [MIT License](https://github.com/JustHm228/MoreTotems/blob/main/LICENSE): ```text MIT License Copyright (c) 2025 JustHuman228 Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions: The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all copies or substantial portions of the Software. title: Vanilla Flavored 2.0
description: The second iteration of my Vanilla Flavored modpack. This time with more flavor than ever!
body:
# Vanilla Flavored Vanilla Flavored 2.0 is a modpack with a whole bunch of mods aimed at improving and adding to the vanilla feel and experience. This 2.0 release brings quite some quite substantial changes from the 1.0 version of the pack. It also deviates a bit more from the vanilla feel, mainly through the addition of the Ad Astra mod. This can however be ignored which will keep the vanilla feel a bit higher. ## Installation The modpack can easily be installed via any launcher supporting importing `.mrpack` files or where modpack search is integrated. I personally use the [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org/). ## Recommended resource packs and shader packs I highly recommend installing [Fresh Animations](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/fresh-animations) together with [Fresh Animations Extensions](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/fresh-animations-extensions). For shaders I like to use [Complimentary Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined), which will have additional setting thanks to the [Euphoria Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/euphoria-patches) mod. The [Bare Bones](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/bb) resource pack is also a personal favorite, As the mod pack has a lot of mods where the textures might align more with vanilla it is not as recommended as in earlier iterations. ## Server files I'm trying to upload a server-version of the pack where all the client-only mods have been removed. I don't know if this actually improves performance of the server in any way, but my experience is that it works ever-so-slightly better. Though that might just be imagined... Otherwise, you can just run a server using the mods folder and config folder from the pack itself. ## All mods Here is a list with all mods that are present in the pack. It will be filled out as I have time.
Thanks to all these mods!

description: A purely client-side vanilla modpack with 100+ vanilla mods alongside optimization.
body:
A purely client-side vanilla modpack with tons of optimization and many very unique QoL features.

## This Modpack Contains:
⚡Tons of optimization mods that cover many areas of optimization. ⚙ Many QOL mods. 🌎 [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) and [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) for easier navigation. 👁 Inbuilt Shaders using [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris). 📦 Many resource packs for enhanced textures and GUI. ✅ Most optifine features included. 🎥 Many mods to improve the camera and animations. 🔔 [NotifMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/notifmod) is an included mod that gives you notifications for all sorts of stuff like when it is time to sleep, the game is done loading, and when your gear is fully repaired with mending, etc. 💗 [Mob Plaques](https://modrinth.com/mod/mob-plaques) included so that you can see the health and armor of all mobs and make your pvp and pve experience better. ✈ [Do a Barrel Roll](https://modrinth.com/mod/do-a-barrel-roll) included for better elytra movement. 🧳 Various mods that improve inventory management. 🗽 [Armor Statues](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-statues) included so that you can easily edit armor stands using a GUI. Warning: You will need operator permissions to use this mod on a server in which it is not installed. 🎤 [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat) included.

## Installation: It is recommended to install the modpack using the Modrinth Launcher. While installing the pack using other launchers, you may get the option to choose optional mods. Be sure to select all of them as if you don't it may create problems.

https://curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/reminiscent-vl

You can join almost all popular servers with this modpack.

On some servers, some features of the modpack may not be allowed, so just make sure that while you have joined those servers you do not use the features of the modpack that are not allowed.

# item-hunt > Fabric/Quilt mod, which adds a game-like challenge to gather all items >> Goal: Collect all items in the game! :) ## Minecraft compatibility This project is not actively maintained by me anymore. Nevertheless, i will fix bugs and update to a specific version on request. For this simply join my discord linked below. ## Configuration The items contained in this challenge are configurable via the config file:
config/item-hunt/config.json ```json { "defaultExcludeConfig": { "excludeCreatives": true, "custom": [] } } ``` `defaultExcludeConfig` - object to define the default excluded items for new worlds
`excludeCreatives` - automatically remove all items, which are only available in creative
`custom` - exclude your own items (e.g. minecraft:stone)
Furthermore, the client settings can be changed via modmenu.
Make sure not to delete any files in the item-hunt folder as there are stored all the progress of the players. ### Other ⚠️ The development version is always the latest stable release of minecraft. Therefore, new features will only be available for the current and following minecraft versions. If you need help with any of my mods just join my [discord server](https://nyon.dev/discord).

title: Yggdrasil Alternative
description: An alternative version of Yggdrasil that is better suited for modpacks and plugin servers, adding different content and removing other content compared to the original version.
body:
# Yggdrasil Alternative
![Splash Art](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6cf786c2fd06fd8db9ca63c4026258129b99b99.webp)

![Delimeter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c57c204c55df0ce5357df6501f616f2c7b7c6df1.png)

# What is Yggdrasil Alternative?
Yggdrasil Alternative is a completely new variant of the original Yggdrasil pack. This version replaces problematic mechanics to provide a **lighter, more compatible experience** perfect for multiplayer servers. 
- Vaults are replaced by Copper Chests and related keys are removed.
- Custom Dimensions are deleted.

Since it adds less experimental Minecraft content, no Vaults, and doesn't integrate Minecraft commands, **it is better suited for Spigot/Bukkit/Paper, as well as large modpacks.**

This pack concretely adds the structures, their lore, difficulty, and interesting rewards.

> **Note:** Since Yggdrasil 6.0.0, the original pack no longer includes the Runic Dimension either. The main difference now is that Alternative replaces Vaults with Copper Chests. Starting from 1.26.1, the original Yggdrasil will reintroduce the Runic Dimension — this Alternative version will **not** include it.

![Delimeter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c57c204c55df0ce5357df6501f616f2c7b7c6df1.png)

# Original Yggdrasil
This pack **adds 20 structures included 5 mega structure** that take hours to explore. Magnificent structures that spawn all over the world, and gives unique rewards, and combined with NeoEnchant it gets even better!

Yggdrasil **offers structures, quests, and a developed narrative** with story fragments that can be found and read in any order, like the memories in Zelda Breath of the Wild.

*Click on the image to go to [Yggdrasil Original on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/yggdrasil-structure).*

[![Yggdrasil Original](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b4422c4bbd399fd4b0eb68f8a7634747aebee12.webp)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/yggdrasil-structure)

![Delimeter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c57c204c55df0ce5357df6501f616f2c7b7c6df1.png)

# Documentation
For detailed information about **Yggdrasil, NeoEnchant, Whisper of Ethers**, or the web tools offered by Voxel, please refer to the documentation.
It contains all the information about the new content in Voxel, Enchantment, Structure, and everything else.

*Click on the image below to access the complete wiki. [Wiki Links](https://hardels-organization.gitbook.io/voxel)*

[![Documentation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/baeded70d64657f66ab232f72a442e77cb4ce387_0.webp)](https://hardels-organization.gitbook.io/voxel)

![Delimeter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c57c204c55df0ce5357df6501f616f2c7b7c6df1.png)

# The Neo-Ecosystem
To further enhance the immersion, you can add one of the following packs, which are optional but work great with Yggdrasil.

- **[NeoEnchant+](https://modrinth.com/datapack/neoenchant)** — Over 40 unique, well-balanced enchantments. Each can be obtained in Yggdrasil structures or through vanilla methods.
- **[BeyondEnchant](https://modrinth.com/datapack/beyondenchant)** — Breaks the chains of vanilla limits. Enchantment levels are increased, making them more powerful.
- **[Yggdrasil Original](https://modrinth.com/datapack/yggdrasil-structure)** — The full experience with quests, narrative, Vaults, and the upcoming Runic Dimension.
- **[Whisper of Ether](https://modrinth.com/mod/whisper_of_ether)** — Adds forgemagic to equipment, explore powerful weapons and armor perfect for combat!

![Packs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4c5e44f01c1ba289bdf22caa4174b986f7e0a46.webp)

![Delimeter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c57c204c55df0ce5357df6501f616f2c7b7c6df1.png)

Join us on Patreon and help make Minecraft an even more amazing experience for everyone!
With more support, I can make tools for creators, players, and modders. I plan to create the **Hytale asset editor in Minecraft!**

title: Trickier Trials
description: Make Trial Chambers more challenging!
body:
**Trickier Trials is an innovative plugin designed to enhance your Minecraft gameplay by dynamically adjusting the difficulty and strength of spawned mobs in Trial Chambers based on players' equipment. This ensures a challenging and engaging experience tailored to the capabilities of your players.**

## Key Features


- **Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment:** The plugin analyzes the equipment of players in the vicinity and alters the strength and abilities of spawned mobs accordingly. This feature keeps the gameplay exciting and challenging, ensuring that no two encounters are the same.

- **Trial Chamber Protection:** Safeguard your Trial Chambers with built-in protective measures. The plugin regenerates existing blocks to maintain the integrity of the environment while decaying player-placed blocks over time. This creates a balanced and fair experience for all players.

- **Seamless Integration:** Designed to work effortlessly with your existing server setup, Trickier Trials requires minimal configuration to get started. Simply install the plugin, and it will begin enhancing your gameplay instantly.

- **Customizable Settings:** Tailor the difficulty adjustments and block regeneration rates to fit your server’s unique gameplay style. Fine-tune parameters to ensure the perfect balance of challenge and enjoyment for your players.

- **Since v1.2 - Refreshing Vaults:** Automatically remove players from Trial Vault's "already opened" list after a customizable amount of time, for scenarios where only a limited number of Trial Chambers are available

title: Spawner Craft
description: Craft spawn eggs and spawners.
body:
This datapack adds new recipes that make all of the spawn eggs craftable. Use the eggs to customize your mob spawner! the "Coins" are rotten flesh (part of my texture pack)

## Loaders

- [Bedrock](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft-bedrock/addons/spawner-craft)
- **Datapack**

## How to Use

- Craft a spawner
- Place spawner on the ground, Right-Click while holding
- Craft any spawn egg of your choice.
- While holding the spawn egg Right-Click on the spawner to make that spawner spawn that mob!
 
## Commands

gives info in-game about the datapack and where to find things
```
/trigger SpawnerCraftInfo
```

## FAQ

### How do I craft the custom spawn eggs?

In v1.12.0 the custom spawn eggs have been removed since Mojang has finally added the Iron and Snow Golem Spawn Eggs.

### How do I craft a Wither or Ender Dragon Spawn Egg?

Since these spawn eggs are only obtainable using commands I figured it would be unsafe to add them in as crafting recipes and I removed them from the custom drop crafting.

### My Spawner is not spawning any mobs even though I can see the mob spinning inside.

To spawn a certain mob it needs to match a few conditions that are different for most mobs. For example; a zombie spawner needs to be dark (light level 0) while for pigs you need to have grass around the spawner or water for a fish to spawn. You can probably Google and figure out which conditions are needed to spawn said mob.

### Can I add this to my mod pack?

Sure, as long as you give proper credit and follow the license.

title: Simple Hand Missile
description: Add simple hand-thrown missiles that do not require complex weaponry.
body:
**Simple Hand Missile** is a mod that makes it easy to use missile weapons.

Attack distant targets with hand-thrown missiles that can be created on the Crafting Table.

English and Japanese are available.


## **🚀Missiles**

Currently there are only a few types of missiles, but more variations will be added in the future.

**Hand Missile**

![Hand Missile Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/cwZZ0ud.png)

It is a basic missile that can be held in the hand and fired.

It moves straight in the direction of the player's viewpoint, and if it hits something or 5 seconds pass, it will cause an explosion equivalent to TNT.

**Homing Hand Missile**

![Homing Hand Missile Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/987IjFD.png)

Detects entities within a certain range ahead of the missile and heads for the nearest target.

Hard to hit if the target is moving at high speed.

**Small Hand Missile**

![Small Hand Missile Recipe ](https://i.imgur.com/oDT9XtL.png)

Low explosive power but easy to mass produce.

Maximum stack count is 16 and the charge time required to fire is short.

**ND Hand Missile**

![ND Hand Missile Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/TFpNNFM.png)

This type of missile does not destroy blocks.

Basic performance remains the same.

**ND Homing Hand Missile**

![ND Homing Hand Missile Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/Dxmq1tc.png)

This type of homing missile does not destroy blocks.

ND stands for non destructive.

## Finally

Thank you for reading this far. If you have any problems or requests, please feel free to contact us.

Now, enjoy Simple Hand Missile!

title: Fear of Sound
description: A Forge mod that makes mobs react in fear to nearby sounds, using custom AI to detect, pathfind, and flee from sound sources dynamically
body:
*** # Fear of Sound **Fear of Sound** is a Forge mod that brings your world to life by making mobs dynamically react to nearby noises. Instead of just running away, creatures now have distinct personalities: some will flee in terror, while others will play dead and freeze in place! This adds a new layer of immersion and stealth gameplay, as your actions can startle creatures and influence their behavior in unique ways. This is the opposite of [Attract To Sound Mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/attract-to-sound). ## Features * **Dynamic Fear System** Mobs listen for sounds like footsteps, block breaks, and explosions. They calculate a “fear radius” based on the noise intensity and decide how to react. * **Two Unique Reactions: Flee or Freeze!** Not all mobs just run! Configure which creatures flee from danger and which ones play dead, like a fainting goat. * **Powerful Bypass System** Want to keep your pets or special mobs safe? Bypass any mob using a Custom Name or specific NBT data. A mob named "Pet" or one that is `{Silent:1b}` can be configured to ignore all sounds! * **Highly Configurable** Nearly every aspect is adjustable via the `.toml` config file. Tweak sound properties, block muffling values, player step sounds, and entity lists to tailor the experience to your exact liking. * **Built-in Mod Support** Out-of-the-box integration for [Simple Voice Chat](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/simple-voice-chat) and [Tacz](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/timeless-and-classics-zero) is included, with easy ways to add sounds from any other mod. ## Installation 1. Ensure you have Minecraft Forge for **1.20.1** installed. 2. Download the latest **Fear of Sound** mod `.jar` file. 3. Place the `.jar` file into your `mods/` directory. 4. Launch Minecraft with the Forge profile. ## Configuration Once installed, a detailed configuration file will be generated at `config/fear_of_sound-common.toml`. You can also use the in-game Mod Options menu. You can configure: * **Bypassed Mobs**: Define which mobs to ignore based on their **custom name** or **NBT tags**. * **Fleeing & Playing Dead**: Assign mobs to either the `affectedEntities` (flee) list or the `playDeadEntities` list. * **Sound Properties**: Add custom sounds from other mods and define their scare **range** and **weight**. * **Block Muffling**: Change how much sound is blocked by wool, solid, and thin blocks. ## Compatibility * Designed for Forge **1.20.1** (tested with 47.4.0). * Should work alongside most sound or AI mods, provided they do not add conflicting high-priority AI goals. * Requires no additional libraries beyond Forge and Minecraft.

title: akkamaddi's Simple Tungsten
description: Add-on for Simple Ores Fusion that adds the overworld ore Tungsten, and four alloys.
body:
This is a port to 1.14.4 and later, of the Sterling and Black module of akkamaddi's Additions from 1.7.10. See that article for original permissions and Minecraft Forum thread links. The mod (an add-on for Simple Ores) was originally written by akkamaddi, and then abandoned; I took up maintenance of the mod after that. 

Simple Tungsten for **Minecraft 1.14.4 to 1.16.1** requires SimpleOres and Fusion.

Simple Tungsten for **Minecraft 1.16.3** and later requires SimpleCoreLib and Fusion, and optionally SimpleOres (or some other mod that provides adamantium ingots). 

Tungsten is a very dense metal that is somewhat comparable to Adamantium. Due to its hardness, it is very difficult to work into passable tools. While its durability is higher than Adamantium, the tools are less functional than Iron. Its value is in the alloys. The "ceramic" alloys have only a smal boost in durability, but have a much higher mining speed and enchantability, and the armors have special powers. The "metallic" alloys have a very high boost to durability, while still having good stats.

 Tungsten Ore requires a pickaxe with a "level 2" rating (iron, bronze) or higher to mine. It only appears very deep in the ground, around the same level as Diamond.

Tungsten Carbide is a Tungsten ceramic. The durability is a little higher than Tungsten, but it can be more easily worked into a very sharp edge. Tungsten is fused with baked bricks using bone meal, coal / charcoal, or gunpowder (S/M/L). Tungsten Carbide will distribute impact and pressure. A full suit of Tungsten Carbide will protect the wearer from falling blocks and anvils, and prevents damage from being buried.

Valfram is a powerful ceramic made with a Netherrack base. Tungsten is fused with a baked Netherrack brick using gunpowder, glowstone, or a lava bucket. (S/M/L). Valfram is naturally heat resistant. When a full suit of Valfram armor is worn, damage from fire and lava is negated.

 Tungsten Steel is an alloy made with Tungsten and Iron, using Tin as a catalyst (L only). It is comparable to diamond, though with a mining level of two.

 Prasinos, the green alloy, is Tungsten fused with Adamantium, using glowstone dust, magma cream, or blaze powder (S/M/L). It has a a very high durability, and the tools have a high harvest level.

 
Full documentation on the Wiki (link up above). Original 1.6.4 version and all textures, descriptions, designs by akkamaddi.

title: GravityVS
description: A fork of GravityAPI that allows for changing an entity's gravity direction, with Valkyrien Skies support!
body:
# GravityVS

### ⚠️ Fork Information
This is an unofficial fork of Gravity API designed to add **Valkyrien Skies** support.
* **Direct Parent:** [Gravity API (Forge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/gravity-api-forge)
* **Intermediate Fork:** [Gravity API (Fork)](https://modrinth.com/mod/gravity-api-fork)
* **Original Project:** [Gravity API](https://modrinth.com/mod/gravity-api)

**License:** Created under the terms of the original project's license.

---

### 📖 About GravityVS
The original Gravity API is restricted to static world coordinates and does not function correctly on moving physics entities. **GravityVS** solves this by allowing **Gravity Plating** and gravity changes to function properly on moving **Valkyrien Skies** ships.

While currently in Alpha (Cardinal directions only), the internal logic has been rewritten to eventually support **free rotation** on any axis, allowing you to walk seamlessly on the walls and ceilings of angled airships.

---

### Key Features
* **Ship Compatibility:** Gravity Plating now affects entities when placed on VS ships.

---

### 🚧 Alpha Status & Known Issues
> **⚠️ Early Alpha:** This mod is a work in progress.

1.  **Cardinal Directions Only (Current):** Free rotation is the end goal, but the mod is currently restricted to N, S, E, W, Up, Down while I stabilize the physics.
2.  **Sliding Bug:** You may experience sliding when a ship is at an angle. I am actively working on a fix for this friction issue.

---

### Requirements
* **Minecraft 1.20.1** (Forge)
* **[Valkyrien Skies](https://modrinth.com/mod/valkyrien-skies)** (Required)
