title: Simple Portals Replugined
description: ⍟ Simple Portals ⍟ - Effective Regional Portals (BungeeCord Compatible) - Patched for 1.21+
body:
## **Important Notice**
This plugin is an replugined version of a plugin that reached the end of support. The original Creator is XZot1K & AlessioGR contributated. [Link to the Original](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/%E2%8D%9F-simple-portals-%E2%8D%9F-effective-regional-portals-bungeecord-compatible.56772/). This plugin is the majority of their work & only minor changes have been added to so far from the_n1n

# Simple Portals

Simple Portals is the simplest, yet effective way to create region-based portals. The plugin was heavily tested on many large live servers and put under stress to ensure performance was optimal. Simple Portals also allows the teleporting of players across your bungee cord server without even using the bungee cord API!​

##  Features ​
- **Cross-Server Portals** - transfer players to other server even at specific locations with the help of MySQL​
- **Fancy Visuals** - selections and region display are highlighted with particles​
- **No Dependencies** - the plugin is standalone​
- **Per-Portal Permissions** - control which portals players can access​
- **Command Sympathy** - abbreviations are available for easier use​
- **Flow Control** - Fluids are frozen in the portal regions​
- **Lightweight Update Checker** - your configs will always be up-to-date​
- **Powerful Developer API** - full control over the plugin at your finger tips​
- **Simple To Manipulate** - all commands and features are made to be used with ease​
- **Entity Portal Transfer** - entities like items or vehicles can all teleport through portals maintaining velocity
- **Nether/End Portal Destination Replacement** - Ability to replace the destination of all nether/end portals in any world
- **Force Join** - Ability to force a player to return to spawn of a specified world upon joining the server

​

## Commands 
(Note: By typing an invalid command, a usage message will be displayed.)​
- `/simpleportals selectionmode` (or sm) - Toggles the player in and out of selection mode which allows them to create a region.
- `/simpleportals reload` - reloads all configurations.
- `/simpleportals info` - provides information about the plugin.
- `/simpleportals create <name>` - creates a new portal if the player's region is full created.
- `/simpleportals delete <name>` - deletes a existing portal.
- `/simpleportals fill <name> <material>` - attempts to fill the portal with the defined material (directional support is partial, meaning some materials may be better placed or created before portal creation).
- `/simpleportals setlocation <name>` (or sl) - sets the teleport location of the specified portal to the sender's location.
- `/simpleportals setlocation <name> <name>` (or sl)- sets the teleport location of the specified portal to the center of the other entered portal.
- `/simpleportals <showregion/sr> <name>` (or sr)- displays the specified portal's region.
- `/simpleportals <enable/disable> <name>` - enables/disabled the portal entirely untiled toggled again
- `/simpleportals switchserver <name> <server>` (or ss) - sets the server the portal will teleport a player to.
Please note that to remove a server from a portal you must set it to 'none'.
- `/simpleportals setswitchlocation <portal> <world> <x> <y> <z> <yaw> <pitch>` (or ssl) - sets the destination of the portal when transferring to another server
- `/simpleportals addcommand <name> <command>` (or addcmd) - this command adds a command line that will be run when a player enters the portal (You are able to add a colon followed by PLAYER or CONSOLE to the end of the command to determine how the command is run).
- `/simpleportals clearcommands <name>` (or clearcmds) - this command simply clears the commands in the list.
- `/simpleportals togglecommandonly <name>` (or tco) - this command toggles command only mode for a portal.
- `/simpleportals commands <name>` (or cmds) - provides a list of all commands on the defined warp in the order they were added.
- `/simpleportals message <name> <text>` - sets the message of the specified portal to the specified text (A colon followed by NORMAL, BAR, TITLE, or SUBTITLE can be used to define the type of message to be set).
- `/simpleportals disablemessages <name>` (or dm) - disables all messages associated with the defined portal.
- `/simpleportals cooldown <name> <cooldown>` - sets the cooldown for the specified portal, in seconds.
- `/simpleportals delay <name> <delay>` - sets the delay for the specified portal, in seconds.
- `/simpleportals find <range>` - finds 3 nearby portals within the specified range.
## Permissions 
- `simpleportals.showregion` - Allows the player to view a portal's region.
- `simpleportals.setlocation` - Allows the player to set a portal's teleport location.
- `simpleportals.info` - Allows the player to view the plugin's information.
- `simpleportals.reload` - Allows the player to reload the configuration files.
- `simpleportals.create` - Allows the player to create a portal.
- `simpleportals.delete` - Allows the player to delete a portal.
- `simpleportals.list` - Allows the player to list all portals.
- `simpleportals.switchserver` - Allows the player to change the server a portal can teleport a player to using BungeeCord.
- `simpleportals.setswitchlocation` - Allows the player to set a portal's switch server location.
- `simpleportals.selectionmode` - Allows the player to enter/exit selection mode.
- `simpleportals.portal.*` - Allows the player to use all portals.
- `simpleportals.portal.<name>` - Allows the player to use the specified portal.
- `simpleportals.addcommand` - Allows the player to add a command to the specified portal.
- `simpleportals.clearcommands` - Allows the player to clear all commands from the specified portal.
- `simpleportals.togglecommandonly` - Allows the player to toggle command only mode for a portal.
- `simpleportals.viewcommands` - Allows the player to view the commands of a portal.
- `simpleportals.toggle` - Allows the player to toggle a portal entirely.
- `simpleportals.message` - Allows the sender to use the message command for portals.
- `simpleportals.dm` - Allows the sender to use the disable messages command for portals.
- `simpleportals.fill` - Grants access to the portal fill commands.
- `simpleportals.cooldown` - Allows the sender to use the /simpleportals cooldown command.
- `simpleportals.delay` - Allows the sender to use the /simpleportals delay command.
- `simpleportals.find` - Allows the sender to use the /simpleportals find command.
- `simpleportals.admin` - Gives the player permission to everything in the plugin.
- `simpleportals.cdbypass` - Allows the player to bypass the portal cooldowns.
- `simpleportals.use` - Allows the sender to use the basic /simpleportals command.

### Servers Using SimplePortals:
** [Skade Gaming](https://skadegaming.com/) | This server has over 2500 Portals!**


Below is a very brief look at the region visual display during the portal create process:
![Example of Portal Region visibility. Outdated](https://proxy.spigotmc.org/a5985e7ddf6e6b1e9122327b8af38d4ef9bdc7fc/68747470733a2f2f696d6775722e636f6d2f624d6e597967362e676966)

## Plugin Usage ​

SimplePortals is made to be, well... simple! Therefore the portal creation process is quite straightforward. Please find instruction below:​

[NOTE] - The "Selection Mode" command is a toggle, meaning when ran once it will enable and twice it will disable.​

1. In order to create a portal, you must first enter "selection mode" by using the command "/portals selectionmode" or "/portals sm".

2. The next step is to "left-click" the lowest block at the end of a cuboid or rectangular region and then "right-click" the highest block in the opposite corner of the region. This will set your current selection for any portals you wish to create soon.

3. To finish off the portal creation process you must use the command "/portals create <portal name>" to create the portal using your WorldEdit-Like selection.

4. From this point, you have a created portal. Now by default the destination, the portal will teleport the user to will always be set to the lowest-block or Point-1. To change the portal's destination, use the command "/portals setlocation" or "/portals sl" at the location you wish your portal to take you to.

Below is some extra information:​
You can fill a portal's region with a specific material by using the "/portals fill <portal>" command (Don't worry all liquid-based materials will not flow out of the region).

You can relocate the portal's region by using the "/portals relocate <portal>" command after making another selection in "selection mode".

For commands and some other features in the plugin, use {player} as the placeholder to obtain the player's name.

To make a portal teleport the player to another server via Bungee simply set the server name using the command "/portals ss <portal> <server>". You can set this value to "none" to disable the feature for a portal.

Don't forget to set the destination coordinates with "/simpleportals <setswitchlocation|ssl> <portal> <world> <x> <y> <z> <yaw> <pitch>".

You may also send commands with the player to execute when they join the server by adding commands to the origin portal.

As for adding commands to be run by the portal when entered you can add them using the "/portals addcmd <portal name> <command>:<type>" command, where <type> is PLAYER, CONSOLE or CHAT.

To remove the commands you may use the "/portals clearcommands <portal>" 
**Command Examples**:
```:
"/portals addcmd example-portal rtp:PLAYER"
This command will run /rtp as if the player sent the command.

"/portals addcmd example-portal rtp {player}:CONSOLE"
This command will run /rtp as if the player sent the command.

"/portals addcmd example-portal rtp:CHAT"
This command will run /rtp as if the player typed it AS IS into chat.

No, /rtp is not a feature of SimplePortals.
```
When adding a command ensure NOT to use a slash.

Always END IT WITH A COLON followed by either PLAYER or CONSOLE. Another that can be used since v1.3.6 is CHAT which sends the command into chat for other plugins to use as fake commands!
​
Similar to command adding, setting a portal's message requires a type. Behind the entered text, simply add either :NORMAL, ':BAR, :TITLE, or :SUBTITLE to indicate which message should be set (INCLUDE THE COLONS). This is the same concept as adding commands.

### Developer API ⍟​

Currently, everything in the API can be found in the API package inside the plugin which can be found on the GitHub page. However, below you can find the API class names and their purpose.​
- Manager (Class) - this stores all general methods, calculations, and storage lists or maps.
- PointType (Enum) - this is used inside the listener for the region selection.
- Portal (Class Object) - this is an entire object that stores all information about a single portal.
- Region (Class Object) - this is an entire object that stores all information about a region (Coordinates and Locations).
- SerializableLocation (Class Object) - this is used to serialize a location and prevent future changes to the same location.
- TaskHolder (Class Object) - this is used to store the visual effect tasks for each player. This class also manages them to make sure not too many are shown at once.
- PortalEnterEvent (Event Object) - this event is called when a player enters a portal's region.
## FAQ 

(Q) Users are teleported to the nether/end when using a dedicated portal material for a simple portal.

(A) This issue has been reported before, a majority of the time this is due to world manipulation plugins such as Multiverse or MultiWorld. Please ensure you test without the world plugin and also use their latest build (dev build) to ensure it was not something that was resolved.​ You can also increase the time for vanilla portals with the vanilla gamerule command!

(Q) I'm getting an error/message involving the "simpleportals.cdbypass" permission node. How can I resolve this?

(A) This is not actually an issue, the message is to notify the user who is either OP or has the permission that they have bypassed the cooldown for the feature. This message can be disabled by setting it to "" in the lang.yml.

(Q) I'm getting an error in the console and I'm unable to teleport or use portals in general. How can I resolve this?

(A) The plugin is native to the latest version of Minecraft; therefore, older versions may need tweaking within the configuration. Normally in this case setting the particle options in the config.yml will resolve this issue for you.

(Q) How can I disable the portal titles, action bar, or subtitle messages?

(A) If the portal has not been created yet, setting the default messages in the lang.yml will disable them for all newly created portals. For already made portals you must either disable the plugin and set the messages to "" in the portals.yml or use the "/portals message <name> :NORMAL", "/portals message <name> :BAR", "/portals message <name> :TITLE", or "/portals message <name> :SUB-TITLE" commands to simply disable each one individually. As of v1.5.1, the command "/portals dm <name>" can be used to disable messages.​

title: Igneo's Combat Revamp
description: A complete overhaul of the vanilla enchantment system and (eventually) armor system! This will change the boring stat increase system into a skillfull and interesting ability system!
body:
Large portions of artwork done by Radi and Hadopalegic Rainbow, thank y'all!!



THIS MOD IS HEAVILY HEAVILY RECOMMENDED TO BE PLAYED WITH THE FOLLOWING MODS:
Parcool
Better combat
Weaponworks

IT IS NOT PLUG AND PLAY, YOU MUST ADD WAYS TO GET THE ENCHANTMENTS YOURSELF

The vision is to completely upturn the basis of Minecraft's combat system. As it stands, Minecraft's combat is at a severe loss when it comes to depth and complexity. My mod aims to fix that, by killing two birds with one stone. Enchantments are also a very poor system so by completely changing what enchantments are available and how you obtain them, I can turn Minecraft into a unique, and interesting flavor of combat, not seen in many other games.



First off, enchantments are now one-per-piece, no more stupid god armor like in the base game, but instead a system where you have to think carefully and make a build suitable for your playstyle.

The enchantment table has also been reworked. Now instead of in the base chance based xp system, all enchants now have a static cost, and you unlock what enchants you can enchant your items with by placing enchanted books in chiseled bookshelves where the normal bookshelves would be. This is not compatible with modded enchants

Nearly all vanilla enchants have been removed besides silk touch and riptide. Effeciency has been replaced with brute touch, which is efficiency 7, except it doesnt drop blocks. This may raise a huge question in your mind considering durability, and although not removed, the increasing cost in anvils has been, as well as your ability to enchant via enchanted books on it, in order for you to not make the mistake of not putting it in your collection.

After testing this thousands of times on the testing server, the same very server this mod is designed for, we have concluded it makes combat so much better. I hope you enjoy it as much as we do. If you want to see it in action, then feel free to [join us!](https://discord.gg/9znQuP3ewn)

body:
JEI can be used for recipes.

 

There are some items/blocks added in the mod:

- Chess Tables (With several materials, used to play chess on)

- Chess Containers, used to store and access stones

- Glass Sprays, used to recolour stuff

- Prototypes, just some casual core crafting materials for tables and containers

- Stone Bags, a bag contains loads of stones, can be right - click to get the stones out or fill the stone containers

- Stones, stones you play.

 

These are added in V2.0:

- Classic Chess Tables

- Classic Chess Pieces (King, Queen, Rook, Bishop, Knight, Pawn)

- Classic Chess Set

 

 

 

 

Classic Chess (Added after V2.0)

 

 

 

Different (simpler) stone models can be used by alternating the value in the client config (0 ~ 3 both inclusive, from worst to best)

0 uses 1 cube per stone

1 uses 15 cubes per stone

2 uses 30 cubes per stone

3 uses 45 cubes per stone

 

Different (simpler) piece models can be used by alternating the value in the client config (0 ~ 2 both inclusive, from worst to best)

 

Using lower values/qualities can greatly increases the FPS

 

 

How to craft

You first need to craft empty stones bag or empty chess set depend on what you want, and then hold it in the main hand, ingredient on the off hand, then right click to merge.

title: UnifiedOptions
description: Modrinth version of https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/unifiedkeybinds-unifedoptions
body:
![](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/versions/822208.svg) # UnifiedKeybinds/UnifiedOptions If you're reading this, I bothered to publish it (and document it) # What does it do 🤔 Unifies `options.txt` and keybinds for all minecraft instances with the mod installed into a single file that is used by all versions. ## Put simply, in a diagram ### Without the mod installed ![](https://cdn-raw.modrinth.com/data/GGd1161d/images/b7bf08dc12e81b08fba79d6e6d17c7de1c11dc87.png) ### With the mod installed ![](https://cdn-raw.modrinth.com/data/GGd1161d/images/0fb3e993070cc511d3555e35baf7c16346c3ac79.png) # How to use it 🤔🤔 The mod should function out of the box. When the mod is installed, it will move most `options.txt` options into `universal.txt` which can be found in your home directory: - Windows users: `%userprofile%/MinecraftOptions` - Linux users (and I assume macos, never used it): `~/MinecraftOptions` ## Default options? YOSBR?? 🤨 The mod also has a feature kinda like YOSBR and default options, but instead of copying configs from a folder within the modpack directory, it copies from `MinecraftOptions//extras`. You could use this, for example to automatically copy your journeymap config into all your modpacks so that your map always looks the same, or disable immersive engineering's cluttery tag tooltips. ## Configuring it 🤔🥱🙄 The mod should function out of the box, but you can configure what options are synchronized, move where options are stored and completely disable the mod. The config file is found at `MinecraftOptions/config.toml`. It explains what each option does. **If you want to reset your config, just delete `config.toml` and the mod will generate a new one.** By default, the following options are **not** synchronized: - tutorialStep - This mod disables the tutorial. - overrideWidth - overrideHeight - resourcePacks - incompatibleResourcePacks - renderDistance - simulationDistance - fullscreen - fullscreenResolution You can add or remove options (*or keybinds*) to/from the blacklist. Blacklisted options will be stored in the vanilla `options.txt`. You can change where `universal.txt` and extras are read from by changing `directory`, under `synchronization`. **`config.toml` cannot be moved**. ## 1.12 If you open a 1.12 options.txt, you will see your controls formatted with numbers, like this: ``` key_key.jump:57 key_key.sneak:42 key_key.sprint:16 key_key.drop:211 key_key.inventory:20 key_key.chat:28 key_key.playerlist:0 ``` And if you open a 1.16 options.txt, you will see your controls formatted with named keys, like this: ``` key_key.jump:key.keyboard.space key_key.sneak:key.keyboard.left.shift key_key.sprint:key.keyboard.left.control key_key.drop:key.keyboard.q key_key.inventory:key.keyboard.e key_key.chat:key.keyboard.t key_key.playerlist:key.keyboard.tab ``` The 1.12 version of this mod converts any numerical values into the modern named keys automatically. Note that 1.16 and higher versions do not support this, so if you want to convert a 1.12 options.txt, load it with the 1.12 version of this mod. # Use in modpacks? yes

Maven packages for use in a developer environment

Add this to your repositories ```groovy repositories { maven { url "https://codeberg.org/api/packages/PORTB/maven" } } ``` And add this to your dependencies ```groovy dependencies { //example: portb:unifiedoptions:1.19.4-1.1 runtimeOnly fg.deobf("portb:unifiedoptions:-") } ``` List of versions: https://codeberg.org/PORTB/-/packages/maven/portb-unifiedoptions/versions

# **IMPORTANT** - I (AverageTaTeMan) only share my content on [Planet Minecraft](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/averagetateman/), [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/user/AverageTaTeMan), and [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/members/averagetateman/projects) - If you see this project on any other site, IT IS NOT ME AND SHOULD NOT BE TRUSTED!

Ever wished you could display the creatures of Minecraft in the form of harmless toys? This pack makes that wish come true! Toys can be made in the Crafting Table using an Armor Stand, Sculk Catalyst, and two mob appropriate items!

<details>
<summary>Manual (Can also be found in pack folder and in-game)</summary>
  
**In-Game Manual:**
-   To get help in-game, you can craft a book that has many of these instructions using a Book and Quill, a Sculk Catalyst, and an Armor Stand.

**Creation:**
- 	Craft a toy using an Armor Stand, Sculk Catalyst and 2 mob specific items.
- 	Place it down, and the mob toy will soon appear!

**Deletion:**
- 	Craft a Recall Hammer using Copper Ingots, Blaze Rods, and a Sculk Catalyst.
- 	Hit the toy you wish to remove, then you will get the toy item back.

**Equipment:**
- 	Many toys can be equipped with armor and other listed items by hitting them with the item.
- 	To remove any equipment, hit it with Shears/use Shears on it.

**Age Control:**
- 	A toy can be turned into its baby variant (if it has one) by hitting it with a Clock.
- 	Hit it again to grow it back up.

**Sound Control:**
- 	A toy can be silenced by hitting it with a Sculk Sensor.
- 	Hit it again to unsilence it.

**Hand Control:**
- 	A toy can be set to be left-handed by hitting it with a Crimson/Warped Fungus.
- 	Hit it again to make it right-handed.

**Rotation Control:**
- 	Change a toy's horizontal rotation (yaw) by hitting it with Magenta Glazed Terracotta.
- 	Change a toy's vertical rotation (pitch) by hitting it with Ladders.

**Fire Control:**
- 	A toy can be set on fire (if not resistant to it) by hitting it with a Lava Bucket.
- 	Hit it again to put out the fire.

**Freeze Control:**
- 	A toy can be made to freeze (if not resistant to it) by hitting it with a Powder Snow Bucket.
- 	Hit it again to make it stop freezing.

**Invisibility Control:**
- 	A toy can be made invisible by hitting it with clear Glass/Glass Panes.
- 	Hit it again to make it visible.

**Glowing Control:**
- 	A toy can be set to glow by hitting it with a Spectral Arrow.
- 	Hit it again to make it stop glowing.

**Watcher Control:**
- 	A toy can be set to watch the nearest player in a certain range by hitting it with an Eye of Ender.
- 	Hit it again to make it stop watching.

**Invulnerability Control:**
- 	A toy can be made invulnerable by hitting it with a Heavy Core.
- 	Hit it again to make it vulnerable.

**Scale Control:**
- 	A toy's scale can be changed by hitting it with an Armor Stand.
- 	Scales: Atom (0.0625), Ant (0.125), Mini (0.25, Default), Half (0.5), Normal (1), Double (2), Large (4), Jumbo (8), Titan (16)

**Waypoint Control:**
- 	A toy can be made into a waypoint by hitting it with a Beacon.
- 	Hit it again to remove the waypoint.

**Color Control:**
- 	A toy's color can be changed by hitting it with Tinted Glass, affecting its name, waypoint, and outline when glowing.
- 	List of Colors: White, Aqua, Black, Blue, Dark Aqua, Dark Blue, Dark Gray, Dark Green, Dark Purple, Dark Red, Gold, Gray, Green, Light Purple, Red, Yellow

**Mount Control:**
- 	A toy can be set to be a passenger by hitting it with a Saddle while not sneaking.
- 	Hit it again while not sneaking to remove its status as a passenger.
- 	A toy can be set to be a vehicle by hitting it with a Saddle while sneaking.
- 	Hit it again while sneaking to remove its status as a vehicle.

**Mob Specific Help:**
- 	Hit a toy with the Manual to see its information and instructions.
- 	Unless a default interaction exists or specified otherwise, the way to change toys is by hitting it with the specified items.

**Installation Instructions to Get the Data AND Resource Packs:**
1) Click "Versions"
![Click "Versions"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0fa5986659f549bce8d54fc7fa0182ce7c9cee0f.png)

2) Select a Version
![Select a Version](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/786593f6790747dfe34d64f1f31ba6fe90646678.png)

3) Under "Files", click "Download" on both the 'Primary' file (data pack) and 'Required resource pack' file (resource pack)
![Under "Files", click "Download" on both the 'Primary' file (data pack) and 'Required resource pack' file (resource pack)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9dbfcbe10de4a5520daa540e68d03397f930291f.png)

4) Unzip the files (optional, but recommended as that's how I use/test them). 

5) Add the resource pack to your Selected Packs (ideally at the top) in your Resource Packs menu. 

6) Add the data pack to either your Selected Packs in the Data Packs menu (if adding at world creation) OR put it in your world's 'datapacks' folder (if adding afterwards.  Recommended to either not have world open at the time or to close and reopen it afterwards).

7) You may get a prompt about experimental settings not being supported when opening the world.  This can safely be ignored, but it's also never a bad idea to make a backup if it's a world you care about.

title: Fussy Azaleas
description: Azalea bushes only generate from bone-mealed moss in specific biomes.
body:
## Overview

This is an incredibly niche mod with one feature: azalea bushes do not spawn from bone-mealed moss blocks, unless the bone-mealing takes place in a certain biome tag.

This mod came about because I wanted to use moss in worldgen without having it guarantee access to azalea trees. While less significant in vanilla, azalea trees get a specialized wood type with mods such as [Caverns and Chasms](https://modrinth.com/mod/caverns-and-chasms), adding further value to their discovery. Thus, I wanted to let the Lush Caves retain that value while keeping moss flexible.


## Config

While there is no config, you can edit the biome tag `fussy_azaleas:moss_grows_azaleas` to add more biomes where azaleas should be available. By default, this only includes vanilla's Lush Caves.

---
Requires [Blueprint](https://modrinth.com/mod/blueprint). Feel free to direct any compat suggestions and bugs to the [issue tracker](https://github.com/davidjjung/fussyazaleas/issues)!

title: A* Pathfinding
description: Minecraft Pathfinder for Entities
body:
Please also contribute to this project. I don't have infinite time on my hands 🥺

## ✅ Features
- Function to find the path to a destination

## 📖 Usage
Call the `astar:_` function and use the remaining markers tagged `astar` to guide anything\
The starting position of the path will be located at the current entity, with the end position being the current position in the context\
E.g. `execute as @s at @p[distance=1..] run function astar:_`\
Note that floating destinations & unreached targets will result in failure

I recommend setting the `maxCommandChainLength` gamerule high enough for your terrain, or restrict the path to a maximum of ~10 blocks — otherwise, temporary markers may stay once the limit is reached

### Config
The configuration is stored in the `astar.config` scoreboard objective.\
`scoreboard players set maxDistance astar.config <maxDistance>` — **default: 100 (10 blocks)** — max distance the pathfinder may travel till finalizing the path.\
`scoreboard players set maxStepHeight astar.config <maxStepHeight>` — **default: 1** — how many blocks it may walk up at once.\
`scoreboard players set maxFallDistance astar.config -<maxFallDistance>` — **default: -3** — **negative value**, how many blocks it may fall each step.\
To avoid conflicts with others' usage, run `function astar:default_config` or `scoreboard players reset * astar.config` before your logic
### Block Tags
`#astar:climbable` — climbable\
`#astar:obstructs_floor` — traversable, no descent\
`#astar:impassable_floor` — impassable floor\
`#astar:impassable_wall` — impassable wall

### Penalty Block Tags
`#astar:penalty/damage` 160 — nearby\
`#astar:penalty/danger` 80 — nearby\
`#astar:penalty/disliked` 80

You may add a function to the `#astar:eval_node` tag to modify costs — `return <any>` results in only `impassable` being effective\
— impassable via `kill @s` — add/remove cost via `scoreboard players add/remove @s astar.f <amount>`
#### Penalties increase the cost of a path segment, so the algorithm prefers other routes.

### Example code
```
#code:loop.mcfunction:

data modify storage code:pathfinding points append from entity @s Pos
kill @s
execute as @n[type=marker,tag=astar] at @s run function code:loop


#code:main.mcfunction:

execute store success score found my_score at @n[tag=target] if function astar:_ as @n[type=marker,tag=astar,sort=furthest] at @s run function code:loop
execute unless score found my_score matches 1 run function code:set_direct_target # Walk directly towards target if no path is found
```

A fabric mod that switches your transportation-method in regards of networking to achieve faster results on certain systems.

title: DeltaLogger
description: A block, container and entity logging tool for the fabric mod loader
body:
Block and chest/container inventory tracking tool for fabric that can be configured to use MySQL or SQLite.

## Setup

DeltaLogger supports two types of database: MySQL and SQLite
Place the mod jar in the mods folder of your server directory and launch your fabric server once to make it generate a `config/deltalogger.properties`. Or make a file called `deltalogger.properties` in the `config` folder of your server directory. Put the following as the file content:

```
# DeltaLogger configuration

# Whether you want to use an SQLite database. Put false for MySQL.
use_sqlite=true

##! MYSQL ONLY BELOW. If you are using SQLite these  are safe to ignore. !##

# Name of the MySQL database to use. If you do not have one, then do
# "CREATE DATABASE yourdbname" from a MySQL client first.
database=

# MySQL port
port=
# MySQL host/url
host=
# MySQL username
username=
# MySQL password
password=

# MySQL SSL configuration. You can leave this as false but the database
# connection will not be encrypted. If you are using MySQL across the open internet
# then you should strongly consider properly enabling SSL
useSSL=false
requireSSL=false
```
By default, SQLite is enabled. This means that your logs will be saved to a database found in `world/deltalogger.sqlite`. If you want to use MySQL, fill out the additional properties with the relevant information to access your database and set `use_sqlite` to `false`.

This mod also requires the fabric api mod, which you can find [here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api).

## In Game Commands

- `/dl resetpass` get a temporary password for the web interface.
- `/dl inspect` Whack a block or container to see recent interactions with the target.
- `/dl inspect <pos>` Shows database records for the block position provided.
- `/dl search <args>` Builds a database query with the parameters specified
- `/dl sql (block|transaction) <query>` Runs a query on the database with the SQL specified

## Support

Support can be obtained on the discord found [here](https://discord.gg/UxHnDWr)

## License

Licensed under AGPL with additional linking permission. See the license file.

## Issues

If you find a bug, please open an issue on the [issues page](https://github.com/fabricservertools/DeltaLogger/issues). Please ask on the discord if you have a support issue which is not a bug

title: Inventory-Sync
description:
Inventory Sync - Inv Sync - Sync inventories, armor, and XP in real-time! The ultimate group item-sharing plugin for seamless cooperative survival.
similar used in (GamerFleet) video.
body:
# Inventory Sync

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.4-blue.svg) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/minecraft-(1.8)--(1.21.11)-green.svg)

**InventorySync** revolutionizes multiplayer gameplay by allowing players to share inventories, armor, and experience in real-time. Whether you're exploring with friends, working as a concerted team, or running a cooperative event, this plugin ensures everyone stays perfectly in sync.

---
## TESTED MINECRAFT VERSION (1.18.x-1.21.11)
## NOT FULLY TESTED ON OTHER MINECRAFT VERSIONS

## 🌟 Key Features

### 👥 Smart Group System
*   **Create & Control**: Easily create your own inventory groups and manage them with full ownership controls.
*   **Invite-Only Access**: Secure your group with a robust invite system. Send clickable invite messages to friends.
*   **Visual Management**: Use the `/invsync gui` command to open a beautiful in-game GUI where you can view members and kick unwanted players (Owner only).
*   **Offline Protection**: Configurable auto-kick for members who stay offline too long, ensuring the group's progress isn't stalled.
### 🌍 World Management
*   **Restrict Worlds**: Choose exactly where inventory syncing is allowed using `WHITELIST` or `BLACKLIST` modes.
*   **Smart Pause**: When a player enters a restricted world, their group inventory is safely "frozen" and cleared. It is restored instantly when they return to an enabled world.
*   **Strict Kick**: Enable "Kick Mode" to automatically remove players from their group if they enter an unauthorized world.
*   **Zero Leaking**: Guaranteed protection against moving items from Creative/Hub worlds into Survival groups.

### 🔄 Secure & Real-Time Syncing
*   **Complete Synchronization**: Syncs **Inventory**, **Armor**, **Off-hand**, and **Experience** instantly.
*   **Safety First**: Includes configurable safeguards like "Wipe on Join/Leave" and empty inventory requirements to prevent duplication exploits.
*   **Death Handling**: Choose whether to keep inventories on death or wipe them for the whole group.
*   **Legacy Linking**: Still supports simple 1-to-1 player linking for quick duo sessions.

### ⚡ User-Friendly Experience
*   **Interactive Chat**: Click [ACCEPT] or [DENY] directly in chat for invitations.
*   **Feedback**: Clear, color-coded messages keep you informed of every action.
*   **Message Control**: Suppress join/leave, offline, or world transition notifications for a cleaner chat experience.
*   **Cross-Version Support**: Seamlessly works on Minecraft versions from **1.8 to Latest**.

---

## 🛠 Commands

### Group Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/invsync create <name>` | Create a new inventory group. | `inventorysync.group` |
| `/invsync invite <player>` | Invite a player to your group (Owner only). | `inventorysync.group` |
| `/invsync join <group>` | Join a group you have been invited to. | `inventorysync.group` |
| `/invsync leave` | Leave your current group (⚠️ Clears Inventory). | `inventorysync.group` |
| `/invsync gui` | Open the Group Management GUI. | `inventorysync.group` |
| `/invsync info <group>` | View information about a group. | `inventorysync.group` |
| `/invsync deny <group>` | Deny a pending group invitation. | `inventorysync.group` |
| `/invsync delete <group>` | Delete your group (Owner only). | `inventorysync.group` |

### Direct Link Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/invsync link <player>` | Request a 1-to-1 link with another player. | `inventorysync.link` |
| `/invsync accept <player>` | Accept a link request. | `inventorysync.link` |
| `/invsync unlink` | Unlink yourself from a direct link. | `inventorysync.link` |

### Admin Commands (Alias: `/isadmin`)
| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/invsyncadmin groups` | List all active groups. | `inventorysync.admin` |
| `/invsyncadmin info <group>` | View detailed info about a group. | `inventorysync.admin` |
| `/invsyncadmin deletegroup <group>` | Force delete a specific group. | `inventorysync.admin` |
| `/invsyncadmin cleargroup <group>` | Clear inventories of all members in a group. | `inventorysync.admin` |
| `/invsyncadmin transfer <group> <player>` | Transfer group ownership. | `inventorysync.admin` |
| `/invsyncadmin list` | List all direct 1-to-1 links. | `inventorysync.admin` |
| `/invsyncadmin clear` | Clear ALL direct links. | `inventorysync.admin` |
| `/invsyncadmin forcelink <p1> <p2>` | Force link two players directly. | `inventorysync.admin` |
| `/invsyncadmin forceunlink <player>` | Force unlink a player. | `inventorysync.admin` |
| `/invsyncadmin reload` | Reload the plugin configuration. | `inventorysync.admin` |
| `/invsyncadmin reset <player>` | Reset a player's group creation status. | `inventorysync.admin` |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

*   `inventorysync.use`: Basic access to the plugin (Default: true).
*   `inventorysync.group`: Access to all Group-related commands (Default: true).
*   `inventorysync.link`: Access to Direct Link commands (Default: true).
*   `inventorysync.admin`: Access to Admin commands (Default: OP).

---

## ⚙️ Configuration
The plugin is highly configurable! Check `config.yml` to tweak:
*   Max group size.
*   Sync settings (armor, experience, offhand).
*   Inventory wipe rules (on create, join, leave).
*   Death handling behaviors.
*   World Management (Pause/Kick modes, restricted worlds).
*   Offline auto-kick timers.
*   Message suppression (Join/Leave, Death, Offline, World Changes).

---

## 🎮 Enhance Your Experience
Want to take the challenge to the next level? Pair **InventorySync** with **[Health-Sync](https://modrinth.com/plugin/health-sync)**!

*   **❤️ Sync Health**: When one friend takes damage, everyone feels the pain!
*   **🍖 Sync Hunger**: Starve together or feast together.
*   **🧪 Sync Effects**: Share potion effects across the entire group.

**Combining both plugins creates the ultimate cooperative survival challenge!**

## 🤝 Support

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Join our support community [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/krcaTEK5VD).

title: Downloading Discs
description: Adds the Disc Writer block, which can download audio from a variety of sources and attach the downloaded audio to any Music Disc.  Requires the AudioPlayer mod to be installed.
body:
## Description
11/19/2025
*Due to changes with certain websites and YT-DLP, some media links will fail to download*

*Downloading Discs* adds a powerful new way to customize music in Minecraft. With the Disc Writer block, you can download audio from supported media links, convert it into `.mp3` files, and apply it to Music Discs—all without leaving your world.

This functionality is powered by the [AudioPlayer](https://modrinth.com/mod/audioplayer) mod, which is required to be installed.

### Features (as of version 1.21.8-1.0.1):
- Adds the Disc Writer, a new block with a GUI that allows a player to specify a media link for download, validate the downloaded file with AudioPlayer, and apply the audio to any Music Disc
![An empty Disc Writer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e3bea8a01ad2713ffc43fd6db705d9843309e5f.png)
- The Disc Writer allows specifying a target URL and a title for the Music Disc
![The Disc Writer's GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e844dd6cd62251047bf7d2232eb4dca80be166cc_0.webp)
- If a disc already has a URL attached to it, you can leave the URL blank in the GUI to reset the disc to its original state
- Config option for specifying the [permission level](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Permission_level) required to interact with the Disc Writer block
- Config option for adjusting the bitrate of the downloaded `.mp3` file, ranging from `64` (worst quality) to `320` (best quality)
- Compatible with Music Discs added by other mods, including [AudioPlayer Blanks](https://modrinth.com/mod/audioplayer-blanks)
- In-game configuration is available via [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) if installed

## Important Information
3 external programs will be downloaded to Minecraft's run directory under the `apps` folder:
- YT-DLP, which downloads audio and video files from various [supported websites](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/supportedsites.md)
- FFmpeg, which processes audio and video files
- FFprobe, a command-line tool to display media information

Use of this mod implies agreeing to the automatic download and use of these programs.

This software is intended solely for personal use to get audio content from sources that you own or have the rights to access and use.  The developer of this software is not responsible for any misuse of this tool by users. **Each user is solely responsible for ensuring their use of this mod complies with all applicable copyright laws and the terms of service of any content provider. Use responsibly.**

- A Disc Writer's GUI can only be opened if no other players are using that Disc Writer.
- Downloads are temporarily saved in `<worldfolder>/downloading_discs_downloads/` before being copied to `<world folder>/audio_player_data/`.

### Config:
These options can be changed:
- Disc Writer chat output
- Disc Writer minimum permission level for use
- Downloaded audio bitrate
- Connection attempt timeout length
- Download attempt timeout length
- URL input character limit
- Title input character limit

Default `.minecraft/config/downloadingdiscs.json`:
```
{
  "discWriterOutput": "ON_COMPLETE",
  "discWriterMinimumPermissionLevel": 0,
  "downloadedAudioBitrateKbps": 192,
  "connectionAttemptTimeoutSeconds": 10,
  "downloadTimeoutMinutes": 5,
  "discWriterUrlCharacterLimit": 200,
  "discWriterTitleCharacterLimit": 50
}
```

Music Disc maximum duration and maximum file size are handled by AudioPlayer's config, `.minecraft/config/audioplayer/audioplayer-server.properties`:

## Support
Mod versions prior to 1.21.8-1.0.1 are no longer supported.

If you have a bug report, feature request, or any other type of issue, please post on our GitHub [issues page](https://github.com/DentedLeft/Dented-Modding/issues).  This is an issues page for all of our mods, so be sure to include the mod's name and version in your post.  We appreciate all feedback!

If you'd like to support development, you can leave a tip at our [BuyMeACoffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/dentedleft).  Only if it's within your means- otherwise, using, sharing, and enjoying the mod is support enough.  Thank you!

## Credits
*YT-DLP program maintained by [various users](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) and released under the Unlicense license.*

*FFmpeg and FFprobe programs maintained by [the FFmpeg team](https://github.com/eugeneware/ffmpeg-static) and released under the GPL-3.0 license.*

*This project would not be possible without [AudioPlayer](https://modrinth.com/mod/audioplayer), created by henkelmax*

*Inspired by [VinURL Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/vinurl) by Plompii, which is a fork of [URL Music Discs](https://modrinth.com/mod/url-music-discs) by Hoofer.*

title: The Backrooms - Cubliminal
description: Infinitely generated dimensions, noclip, custom entities, blocks, items and more!
body:
# Cubliminal
This mod aims to be a faithful representation of backrooms lore! It adds a bunch of dimensions, structures and features that make up a story with a logical progress inside of the parallel reality of the backrooms.
## Is the mod going to be continued?
Yes. I will update it periodically and add new content as long as it is possible for me. For more information, **join the [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/EnzupkrK7m)**.
## Video
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ModUvJthPOg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Recommendations and tips
Personally, I would suggest setting the brightness to 'moody'. On top of that, [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) shaders can be used, however some renderers won't work well: use them under your own responsability, I recommend testing them before all. Most optimization mods are guaranteed to work, feel free to use them.
## So, what does this mod add?
- Custom blocks such as wallpapers and its variants, miscellaneous decorations, a gateway block...
- Custom items: weapons, almond water, etc.
- Effects, paranoia being currently the only one.
- Backrooms level(s): Level 0, the Redrooms, the Manila Room, and many more yet to come.
- Mechanics: a sanity bar to make it more exciting and a noclip engine.
- As well as many subtle details that enhance this mod! Overlays, shaders, reverb effects, renderers...
## How to _actually_ play the mod (mere suggestion)
Cubliminal adds some weird stuff that might be painful to figure out on your own how they work.
### Flux capacitor: your ticket to the Backrooms
The flux capacitor block comes from the film [Back to the Future](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Back_to_the_Future), in which appears as the main component of the time machine from the DeLorean. This bad boy accumulates immense amounts of energy provided by an outer source and releases all into the ground, effectively weakening the fabric of reality for a few seconds and making you no-clip through the ground. **The way you use it is by placing it on the ground with a lightning rod on top and waiting for a lightning bolt to strike it.** The lightning is a very powerful source of energy, as it could be seen in [Back to the Future](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Back_to_the_Future). **The flux capacitor is crafted by combining silver and iron ingots, glass and a redstone block:**

![Crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ed24ab39ad319a3fbb0639a8fc17d3823a50a30.png)

**At the same time, silver ingots can be found inside buried treasure chests.**
### Sanity
Right after your arrival to the backrooms, your sanity will start draining. If your sanity gets too low, you'll get the paranoia status effect, which makes your vision confusing and eventually damages you. Sanity will decrease anyways, but several reasons make it happen faster:
- Staying still
- Being inside dark areas
- Not sleeping for several days
- Difficulty
- The area/level itself (the Redrooms for example drains sanity way faster)

**In order to increase your sanity, stay inside of the Manila Room or certain levels, OR drink almond water. Dying will reset your sanity.** Or well, you can use the ```/sanity```
command.
### No-clipping
**After visiting the Manila Room (more on that later) you sould run enough time until you experience glitch effects when running against a wall.** This means you're ready to no-clip by running against a wall for a couple seconds. After you no-clip, you will fall down to the correct dimension and the 'no-clip timer' will reset. Beware not to die, or else it will as well reset. **If you don't wanna go through this whole tedious process, use the builtin** ```/noclip``` **command.**
### Entering the Manila Room
The Manila Room is always at a certain coordinate within Level 0, but **it can be entered from any exit door found among the corridors of said level**. After entering through the red emergency door, you will notice at the very end of the passage what appears to be a room. This is what you're looking for. Walk towards the room and you'll teleport to the Manila Room. **There you can regain the sanity you had lost and learn a few useful tips to survive.**

![Emergency exit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8935fee8f17fdc9dd0633b54b4856e453a998164_0.webp)
### The Redrooms
After walking an indefinite distance in Level 0, you might come across an area with crimson wallpapers instead of the usual yellow ones. **You shouldn't walk into this areas under any circumstances.**
### The Pillar zone
Found similarly to the Redrooms, **this area won't be hostile towards wanderers, so they can be safely approached and explored**. With enough luck, you'll be able to spot an outpost that contains loot of vital importance if you want to make it in this alternate reality.

title: Cell⁴
description: One cell. Infinite resources. Any filter you need.
body:
---
# Cell⁴ **Infinite ME Storage Cells for Applied Energistics 2**
--- Cell⁴ is an AE2 addon designed for modpack development. It adds three types of **Infinity Cells** that can be bound to specific items via NBT or data components, allowing infinite extraction from the ME network. Inserted matching items are silently discarded, consuming no actual storage. **Supported versions:** 1.20.1 (Forge), 1.21.1 (NeoForge), 26.1.2 (NeoForge) ## Infinity Cell Types - **Infinity Item Cell** — bind specific items/fluids - **Infinity Tag Cell** — bind all items matching tags and/or from specified mods - **Infinity ModID Cell** — bind all items from a mod ## Cell Configurator The **Cell Configurator** is an in-game tool for editing cell data visually. Right-click while holding it to open the configuration GUI, then place a cell into the slot. ![1.0.3+ ConfiguratorUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d06fffaa6f4b23a690ac1c8dc26957c6308d6145.png) - Editable fields change based on the cell type placed in the slot. - Inactive fields are shown in gray and cannot be edited. - Separate multiple values with commas (e.g. `minecraft:diamond,minecraft:oak_log`). - In the blacklist field, prefix tags with `#` (e.g. `#minecraft:birch_logs`) and mod IDs with `@` (e.g. `@mekanism`). - Press **Tab** to cycle between editable fields. - Press **Enter** to save changes. - Click **Save** to apply changes, **Reset** to revert, or **Clear** to erase all fields. | Cell Type | Editable Fields | |-----------|----------------| | Item Cell | `cell4item`, `cell4blacklist` | | Tag Cell | `cell4tag`, `cell4modid`, `cell4blacklist` | | ModID Cell | `cell4modid`, `cell4blacklist` | ### Preview The right side of the GUI displays a **Preview** panel showing the cell's tooltip as it would appear in your inventory. If a custom name is set in the name field, the preview updates in real time with the new name shown in italic style. ## Data Keys | Key | Target | Example | |-----|--------|---------| | `cell4item` | Specific items/fluids | `"minecraft:diamond"` | | `cell4tag` | Tag | `"minecraft:logs"` | | `cell4modid` | Mod ID (Tag Cell also supports this) | `"mekanism"` | | `cell4blacklist` | Exclude items/tags/mods (optional) | See below | | `cell4name` | Custom display name (optional) | `"My Diamond Cell"` | > **1.20.1** stores these keys as raw NBT (`{...}`). **1.21.1 & 26.1.2** store them inside data components (`[custom_data={...}]`). ## Command Examples **1.21.1 & 26.1.2** use `[custom_data={...}]` syntax; **1.20.1** uses `{...}` syntax. Tag namespace: `c:` in 1.21.1/26.1.2, `forge:` in 1.20.1. ### Single Value ``` # 1.21.1 / 26.1.2 /give @p cell4:infinity_item_cell[custom_data={cell4item:"minecraft:diamond"}] /give @p cell4:infinity_tag_cell[custom_data={cell4tag:"minecraft:logs"}] /give @p cell4:infinity_modid_cell[custom_data={cell4modid:"mekanism"}] # 1.20.1 /give @p cell4:infinity_item_cell{cell4item:"minecraft:diamond"} /give @p cell4:infinity_tag_cell{cell4tag:"minecraft:logs"} /give @p cell4:infinity_modid_cell{cell4modid:"mekanism"} ``` ### Multiple Values ``` # 1.21.1 / 26.1.2 /give @p cell4:infinity_item_cell[custom_data={cell4item:["minecraft:diamond","minecraft:oak_log"]}] /give @p cell4:infinity_tag_cell[custom_data={cell4tag:["minecraft:logs","c:ingots/iron"]}] /give @p cell4:infinity_modid_cell[custom_data={cell4modid:["mekanism","thermal"]}] # 1.20.1 /give @p cell4:infinity_item_cell{cell4item:["minecraft:diamond","minecraft:oak_log"]} /give @p cell4:infinity_tag_cell{cell4tag:["minecraft:logs","forge:ingots/iron"]} /give @p cell4:infinity_modid_cell{cell4modid:["mekanism","thermal"]} ``` ### Tag Cell with Mod ID Filter The Infinity Tag Cell supports both `cell4tag` and `cell4modid` simultaneously: ``` # 1.21.1 / 26.1.2 /give @p cell4:infinity_tag_cell[custom_data={cell4tag:"minecraft:logs",cell4modid:"mekanism"}] /give @p cell4:infinity_tag_cell[custom_data={cell4tag:["minecraft:logs","c:ingots/iron"],cell4modid:["mekanism","thermal"]}] # 1.20.1 /give @p cell4:infinity_tag_cell{cell4tag:"minecraft:logs",cell4modid:"mekanism"} /give @p cell4:infinity_tag_cell{cell4tag:["minecraft:logs","forge:ingots/iron"],cell4modid:["mekanism","thermal"]} ``` ### Blacklist Blacklist entries support three types: - **Item** — plain identifier (e.g. `minecraft:birch_log`) - **Tag** — prefixed with `#` (e.g. `#minecraft:birch_logs`) - **Mod ID** — prefixed with `@` (e.g. `@mekanism`) ``` # 1.21.1 / 26.1.2 /give @p cell4:infinity_tag_cell[custom_data={cell4tag:"minecraft:logs",cell4blacklist:"minecraft:birch_log"}] /give @p cell4:infinity_modid_cell[custom_data={cell4modid:"mekanism",cell4blacklist:["mekanism:steel_ingot","#c:ingots/steel","@thermal"]}] # 1.20.1 /give @p cell4:infinity_tag_cell{cell4tag:"minecraft:logs",cell4blacklist:"minecraft:birch_log"} /give @p cell4:infinity_modid_cell{cell4modid:"mekanism",cell4blacklist:["mekanism:steel_ingot","#forge:ingots/steel","@thermal"]} ``` Blacklisted items are shown in the cell tooltip with a ✖ marker. ---

# ✨ Simple FPS Overlay ✨
### *Minimalist • Customizable • Lightweight*

A clean and elegant FPS display mod for **Minecraft 1.21 (Fabric)**. Designed for players who want to keep track of their performance without cluttering their screen.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

### 🖱️ **Interactive Position Editor**
Forget manual coordinates. Press **'U'**, click **Edit Position**, and simply **drag and drop** the overlay anywhere on your screen. It features smart-snapping to corners for a perfect fit!

### 🎨 **Total Visual Control**
*   **Dual Color System**: Choose from high-visibility **Presets** (Red, Green, Blue, etc.) or type any **Hex Code** for infinite color possibilities.
*   **Dynamic FPS Color**: Let the mod speak to you. Text color shifts automatically from **Green** (60+) to **Yellow** (30+) to **Red** (<30) based on your performance.
*   **Background Styling**: Toggle a sleek background box with a dedicated **Opacity Slider** (0-100%) to match your HUD's aesthetic.

### 📐 **Flexible Layouts**
*   **Display Styles**: Switch between a clean **Normal** look or a professional **Brackets** style `[ FPS: 144 ]`.
*   **Text Scaling**: A smooth slider allows you to scale the text from **50% to 500%** of its original size.
*   **Advanced Stats**: Optional toggle to show your **Min/Avg/Max** FPS alongside the current counter.

---

## 🎮 Controls
| Keybind | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`U`** | Open Settings Menu |
| **`Mouse Drag`** | Move Overlay (in Editor Mode) |

body:
![](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Simple_Spikes/BH_NU_HEADER.webp)

[![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/662608?label=CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/simple-spikes) [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/O7nYnkoe?label=Modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-spikes)

![](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Simple_Spikes/BH_NU_BANNER1.webp)

 **Simple Spikes** is a Minecraft mod introducing a variety of new spike blocks, each causing unique types of damage or effects upon contact. Enhance your base defenses, mob farms, or simply add a strategic new element to your survival world.

The mod utilizes **Balm** for seamless multi-loader support across Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge.

![](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Simple_Spikes/BH_NU_BANNER2.webp)

*   🪵 **Variety of Spike Types**  
    Includes wooden spikes (oak, dark oak, birch, jungle, acacia, spruce, warped, crimson, cherry, mangrove, pale oak), stone spikes, cobblestone spikes, slime spikes, copper spikes, iron spikes, gold spikes, diamond spikes, and netherite spikes.
    
*   🛡️ **Unique Damage Mechanics**  
    Different spike variants have unique properties:
    
    *   **Wooden Spikes:** Moderate damage, effective for passive defense.
    *   **Stone and Cobblestone Spikes:** Higher durability and damage compared to wood.
    *   **Metal Spikes (Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite):** Higher damage output, durability, and special properties (e.g., ignoring armor).
    *   **Slime Spikes:** Special knockback properties, bouncing entities upon contact.

    Carefully designed to integrate seamlessly with vanilla aesthetics and other popular resource packs.
    
*   🛡️ **Shields Integration**  
    Shields now interact uniquely with spikes, offering enhanced strategic depth when defending against mobs or other players.
    

## 🛠️ Compatibility

Simple Spikes is carefully crafted for optimal compatibility with other mods, particularly those that:

*   🔗 **Use Balm** as a foundational library for multi-loader functionality.
*   ⚔️ **Adjust entity or player damage mechanics**: Spikes leverage vanilla and Balm-compatible systems.
*   🏰 **Modify world generation or mob behavior**: Spikes behave consistently across dimensions and interactions.

Encountered a compatibility issue? Please let us know via our issue tracker.

title: SmoothPvP
description: support for smp, pratice pvp and fix lag
body:
⚔️ What is SmoothPvP ?

SmoothPvP is a highly optimized, lightweight, and fully client-side modpack built for Minecraft 1.21.1. This modpack is designed with the core philosophy of enhancing your Minecraft experience by focusing on performance optimization, PvP readiness, and multiplayer compatibility while keeping the vanilla gameplay intact.

Whether you are a competitive PvP player, an SMP survivor, or a player looking to improve your combat skills, SmoothPvP offers the perfect blend of tools and tweaks to give you an edge in gameplay. With no server-side requirements, this pack guarantees seamless integration on virtually any server, making it an excellent choice for anyone seeking smoother, faster, and more responsive Minecraft play.

🧠 The Philosophy Behind SmoothPvP Pack

Many modpacks today are bloated with unnecessary content and heavy mods that can negatively impact performance and create confusing gameplay experiences. SmoothPvP is different — it embraces a clean, efficient approach by focusing on essential client-side mods and optimizations that improve:

Performance: Drastically reduce lag and improve FPS stability to provide smoother gameplay, especially during intense PvP battles or busy SMP sessions.

User Interface: Simplify and declutter the HUD, minimizing distractions and enabling players to focus on core gameplay mechanics with clearer visuals.

PvP Enhancement: Offer a tailored environment for PvP enthusiasts, providing better visual feedback, faster reaction times, and improved control responsiveness.

Skill Development: Create an ideal platform for practicing and refining PvP techniques such as strafing, aiming, combo timing, and strategic movement.

Multiplayer Compatibility: Guarantee full compatibility with any vanilla or plugin-based server due to the pack’s 100% client-side nature.

Accessibility: Support a wide range of hardware setups, from modest laptops to high-performance gaming PCs, ensuring the best possible experience for all players.

🎮 Who Is SmoothPvP For?

SmoothPvP was designed to meet the needs of a variety of players, including but not limited to:

Competitive PvP Players: Those who seek every advantage in combat by maximizing FPS and minimizing distractions through an optimized UI.

PvP Trainees and Enthusiasts: Players who want to practice combat mechanics in a stable and clear environment to boost their skills.

SMP Survivors: Users who enjoy survival multiplayer and want to reduce lag and performance issues on populated servers.

Players with Limited Hardware: Those running Minecraft on low or mid-range systems who desire better performance without sacrificing quality.

Vanilla Lovers: Players who appreciate Minecraft’s original gameplay but want a smoother, cleaner, and more responsive gaming experience.

🚀 Key Features & Benefits Enhanced Performance and Stability

SmoothPvP includes client-side mods and optimizations that boost frame rates, minimize stuttering, and speed up chunk loading. These enhancements reduce frustrating lag spikes and help maintain consistent, smooth gameplay during critical moments.

PvP-Focused Visual Improvements

The pack’s user interface has been refined to reduce clutter and provide essential combat information in an easily digestible format. By removing unnecessary visual noise and simplifying HUD elements, players can maintain better focus and faster reaction times in PvP fights.

Multiplayer Compatibility Without Server-Side Mods

Because all modifications are strictly client-side, you can join any vanilla, Paper, Spigot, or plugin-supported server without worrying about compatibility or bans. This makes SmoothPvP highly flexible for any multiplayer setting.

Ideal for PvP Training and Skill Refinement

The modpack creates a perfect environment for practicing PvP techniques, including strafing, aiming, combo execution, and movement strategies. With consistent performance and clear visuals, players can focus on honing their skills to achieve better results in combat.

Lightweight and Easy to Install

The modpack has a small footprint and fast load times, making installation quick and hassle-free. Players can jump into Minecraft faster and spend more time enjoying the game without complicated setups or long waits.

title: McDiscordWebhook
description: McDiscordWebhook integrates your discord server into your minecraft server without using a bot!
body:
# What This Mod Does

McDiscordWebhook intergrates your discord server with your minecraft server using a discord webhook. This mod sends configurable information including player join/leave messages, server start/stop messages and in game messages. This mod is meant for smaller servers that don't need all the features from a mod that uses a discord bot would provide. As it doesn't use a discord bot, it makes it a more lightweight alternative. There is currently 2 modes to choose from, default and embed.

## Disclaimer

**Messages sent in the channel where the webhook was created or other channels will not be sent in game. This is because this mod doesn't use a discord bot and purely relies on discord webhooks to function. This makes it impossible to read any message sent in any discord server. For this feature you will have to find a mod that makes use of a discord bot.**

## Setting up the mod

1. View [this](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/228383668-Intro-to-Webhooks) discord support article for information about creating a webhook
2. After creating the webhook make sure the game has already been run with the mod so it can generate the config
3. Copy the webhook url and paste it after the `webhook-uri=` in the `mcdiscwbhk.properties` file
4. Adjust any other config settings you want and run the game, messages should be sent in the channel where the webhook was created

<details>
<summary>Not Working?</summary>
Verify that the webhook url is correct. The log file will output Invalid Webhook url after world load if it isn't. The log will also contain Webhook Url: ... which outputs the webhook url specified in the config. If this doesn't match what's in the config then you have done something wrong and it is best to delete the config and refollow instructions begginning at the 2nd one.
</details>

body:
![Mush](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9541545e43a8499937e4daec9749bd88ccbc9d62.png)

3D Mushrooms & Fungi transforms the appearance of mushrooms and fungi in Minecraft, making them three-dimensional and more immersive. This texture pack not only enhances the blocks' visual appeal but also includes them in the GUI for a consistent and improved experience.

Description
3D Mushrooms & Fungi is a texture pack designed to bring a new level of detail to your Minecraft world. By turning the flat, 2D mushrooms and fungi into stunning 3D models, this pack makes these blocks more visually appealing and lifelike.

Features:
- 3D Models: Transforms all types of mushrooms and fungi into 3D models, giving them a more realistic look.
- Enhanced GUI: Includes the 3D mushrooms and fungi in the GUI, ensuring a consistent and immersive visual experience.
- Improved Immersion: The 3D textures make the environment feel more dynamic and engaging.
- Easy Installation: Compatible with other texture packs and mods, making it easy to integrate into your existing setup.

Changes:
- Brown Mushrooms and Red Mushrooms now appear as detailed 3D models.
- Nether Fungi (Warped and Crimson) are given a 3D makeover, enhancing their otherworldly appearance.
- The updated GUI includes the new 3D models, providing a seamless visual transition from inventory to gameplay.

3D Mushrooms & Fungi is perfect for players looking to enhance the visual depth of their Minecraft worlds without altering the core gameplay. Whether you're exploring the Overworld or the Nether, these revamped blocks will add a touch of realism and beauty to your adventures. Download now and experience Minecraft in a whole new dimension

title: MultiHuD
description: MultiHUD is a highly customizable HUD mod for Minecraft Fabric, featuring Armor, Inventory, Potion Effects, FPS, CPS, Keystrokes, Coordinates, and many more configurable HUD elements. Inspired by modern PvP clients, it provides a clean, lightweight, and fl
body:
# MultiHUD

MultiHUD is a modern, lightweight, and highly customizable HUD mod for Minecraft Fabric.

Designed to provide a client-quality interface without the overhead of a full custom client, MultiHUD allows players to build a personalized HUD experience through a growing collection of configurable modules.

From performance statistics and player information to utility-focused elements and gameplay tracking, MultiHUD offers a wide range of HUD components that can be freely moved, scaled, and customized to fit any playstyle.

## Features

* 10+ customizable HUD modules
* Fully draggable interface
* Independent scaling for every element
* Modern client-inspired design
* Custom keybind support
* Persistent configuration saving
* Lightweight and performance-focused
* Seamless Fabric integration

## Customization

Every module can be positioned anywhere on the screen and adjusted independently, giving you complete control over your layout. Whether you prefer a minimal interface or an information-rich setup, MultiHUD adapts to your needs.

## Performance

Built specifically for Fabric, MultiHUD is designed to remain lightweight while providing a polished and responsive experience with minimal impact on gameplay performance.

## Supported Versions

* **Minecraft 1.26.x** *(actively supported)*
* ~~Minecraft 1.20.x~~ *(no longer actively supported)*
* ~~Minecraft 1.21.x~~ *(no longer actively supported)*
* Fabric Loader

> **Note:** Development now focuses exclusively on the latest Minecraft version. Older versions will not receive further updates or bug fixes.

## Why MultiHUD?

MultiHUD focuses on delivering the customization and usability players expect from modern clients while remaining a standalone Fabric mod. No unnecessary features, no client lock-in, just a flexible HUD system built around choice and performance.

# Description
A simple registration mod for protecting the server and player accounts. It is possible to set up a waiting point and other commands for administrators. Below are all the commands:


# How to use
## Players
/register [password] [password] - registration

/login [password] - log in

## Admins
/set_idle_point [block coordinates] - Sets a waiting point for logining

/forcelogin [player] - Forcibly allows entry to the player

/unregister [player] - Deletes the player's password, allowing them to create a new one on the next login

title: Silverwood Trees
description: Silverwood Trees adds four unique, real-world inspired trees to Minecraft: Silverberry, Staghorn Sumac, Walnut, and Silver Maple. These trees bring new wood types, planks, and saplings, enhancing the game's world with realistic and immersive details.
body:
**Silverwood Trees** is a mod that adds four new, realistic, and beautifully crafted trees to Minecraft, each inspired by real-world species. The mod focuses on trees that are both aesthetically pleasing and immersive, providing new wood types, leaves, and saplings to enhance the vanilla experience.

![Mod Cover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4cfc5e3f03607a355fff156d8997818aa6fe3f50.png)

[![Ko-fi link](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd32bda2dbe27a0b4100056a8e7f54e83e98f7fc.png)](https://ko-fi.com/almiris) [![Patreon link](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e95a1a4d85b20de6b1f942286f9b43793d1c6dc.png)](https://www.patreon.com/c/Almiris)

## Trees Added:
### Silverberry
A unique tree known for its silvery wood with pale golden and grayish hues. It grows rarely in Taiga biomes. This tree adds a light, almost ethereal feel to your forests.

![Silverberry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/572f2870629b2ea4b865f18f3dfc56f90fd35c54_0.webp)

### Staghorn Sumac
With striking red-tinged wood and bold leaves, this tree thrives in warm, dry climates, making it perfect for the Savanna Plateau biome. The Staghorn Sumac brings vibrant color and a new texture to your world.

![Staghorn Sumac](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8d9edaf2cc5c8307caa50cf9a0655ba98452742_0.webp)

### Walnut
A large and stately tree, the Walnut adds a darker, rich brown to your world, with its wood resembling real-world walnut trees. Found in Forests, its wood offers a natural and grounded look.

![Walnut](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fefba745d4b12a7149bc4840e7115d2b42193a5_0.webp)

### Silver Maple
Known for its silvery leaves and soft, light wood, the Silver Maple thrives near Flower Forests. The tree offers a beautiful contrast with its smooth bark and subtle, gentle aesthetic.

![Silver Maple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a218988b382005ac377bf016c66b3cb063428709_0.webp)

## Features:
- New Wood Types: Each tree introduces new wood blocks and planks, offering a variety of colors ranging from light silver to deep reddish hues.
- Unique Leaves and Saplings: Silverwood Trees features distinctive leaf textures and saplings that can be planted and cultivated in Minecraft.
- Realistic and Immersive: All four trees are inspired by real-world species, making them a perfect addition for players who want a more natural feel in their Minecraft world.

## Why You’ll Love It:
- Immersion: The trees are designed to blend seamlessly with the vanilla Minecraft world, making the experience feel more diverse and rich without changing the core mechanics.

## Aesthetic Variety: 
- Whether you’re looking for a vibrant pop of red from the Staghorn Sumac or the subtle elegance of the Silver Maple, these trees will bring variety to your builds.

## Customization: 
- With new planks, wood types, and unique textures, these trees provide plenty of options for builders and crafters looking to add a new dimension to their creations.

title: Radiated Infection
description: Infection, radiation and more new mechanics and features!
body:
## EN: Welcome to Radiated Infection!
## RU: Добро пожаловать в Радиационную Инфекцию!
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b52293999606ac64b8b9d2f56660970a403de8d2_0.webp)

**EN:**


This is my first mod for Minecraft. It adds a new HUD index - Infection (or Radiation) Level, which will increase when a player is hit by Monsters. (**MultiPlayer Compatable!**) If you have high level of infection from radiation, it will be slowly increasing when you have 70% and faster when 85% more. Also, you will get negative effects, such as poison, mining fatigue and after 97% instant damage . It can be clear ONLY by reducing of infection level.

**RU:**

Это мой первый мод для Майнкрафт. Он добавляет новый показатель на интерфейсе - Уровень Инфекции (Радиации), который будет повышаться, когда игрока бьют монстры. (**Работает в Мультиплеере!**) Если у вас высокий уровень инфекции от радиации, он будет медленно повышаться от 70% и быстрее от 85%. Кроме того, вы будете получать отрицательные эффекты, такие как отравление, усталость и после 97% моментальный урон. Снять это можно ТОЛЬКО уменьшив уровень инфекции.

Gameplay Trailer / Геймплей Трейлер:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/5frVomW55GE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


<details>
<summary>EN: New Recipes RU: Новые Рецепты</summary>
 EN:
There are 10+ new recipes (include an armor that loses its damage when player has a radiation but protects him from debuffs and can be repaired with cloth that drops from new mobs!) that can be found in recipe book!
New crafting Machine - Chemical Station! For craft you must have 2 fixed items and 1 from the following in the lowest slot:
- Blaze Powder > Morphine
- Infected Slime > Vaccine
- Honey Bottle > Adrenaline

Also you can right click with Syringe in hand and get Syringe with Blood!


RU:
Есть 10+ новых рецептов (включая броню, которая теряет прочность, если у игрока радиация, но защищает таким образом от дебафов и чинится с помощью ткани, выпадающей с новых мобов!), которые можно найти в книге рецептов!
Новая крафтовая машина - Химическая Станция! Для крафта вам нужно 2 фиксированных предмета и 1 из списка в нижний слот:
- Порошок Ифрита > Морфин
- Зараженная Слизь > Вакцина
- Бутылка Мёда > Адреналин

Кроме того, вы можете нажать ПКМ Шприцом в руке и получить Шприц с Кровью!
</details>

<details>
<summary>EN: New Mobs RU: Новые Мобы:</summary>
EN:

1) Infected Zombie. Can give you poison, increase Infection Level when you get really close to him and spawn zombies with 7% change after being hit. Keep distance! If you kill him, you can get Vitamins, Vaccine (reduce infection level for 50-70%) and more!
  
2) Toxic Zombie. At now he can spawn slimes after death with a random chance and have a good drop!

3) Radiated Zombie. Has good drop and gain speed or strength buff when attacked.

4) Scientist Zombie. Gain regeneration when attacked.

5) Prisoner Zombie. Has high armor and health. Both zombies spawns ONLY in new bunker structure!

6) Worker Zombie. Has tools drops and can be found everywhere.

RU:

1) Заражённый Зомби. Он может наложить на вас отравление, повысить Уровень Инфекции, когда вы слишком близко к нему, и спавнить зомби с 7% шансом после получения урона по себе. Держите дистанцию! Усли убьёте его, можете получить Витамины, Вакцину (снижает инфекцию на 50-70%)

2) Токсичный Зомби. Сейчас он может спавнить слизней после смерти и имеет хороший лут!

3) Радиоактивный Зомби. Имеет неплохой лут и получает бафы скорости или силы после атаки.

4) Ученый Зомби. Получает регенерацию когда атакован.

5) Заключенный Зомби. У него высокая броня и много здоровья. Оба зомби спавнятся ТОЛЬКО в новой бункерной структуре!

6) Рабочий Зомби. С него выпадают инструменты и его можно найти везде.
</details>
<details>
<summary>EN: New mechanics! RU: Новые механики!</summary>
EN:

1) If you go to bed, there is a chance to reduce infection level for 6-14%.

2) There is a debug command /infect (number) to set infection lvl.

3) In the creative mod tab you can see syringe, that can be turned to syringe with blood with right click.

4) You can sit on the chairs from mod.

5) You can turn on Hardcore mod in config file that do 2x infection growth from all sources and add difficulty for reducing infection.

RU:

1) Если вы пойдёте спать, есть шанс снизить инфекцию на 3-12%.

2) Есть дебаг команда /infect (число) чтобы поставить значение инфекции.

3) В креативе мод таблицы есть шприц, который можно наполнить кровью ткнув ПКМ.

4) Вы можете сесть на стулья из мода.

5) Вы можете включить режим Хардкора в файле конфига, который сделает 2х прирост заражения от всех источников и усложнит уменьшение уровня инфекции.
</details>

<details>
<summary>EN: Future plans! RU: Будущие планы!</summary>
EN:
I've accidentally lost my source MCreator code files, so.. That's the last version, i think

Я случайно потерял мои исходники файлов кода MCreator, поэтому... Думаю, это последняя версия
