title: Food Motivated
description: Motivate farming/food-based progression with a vanilla flavor!
body:
### Summary
Food Motivated is a mod designed to motivate farming as a means of progression. At the moment the mod adds the _Selling Bin_ block, inspired by the Shipping Bin in Stardew Valley. Each in-game day, a list of 15 items are chosen from every food item in the game that can be sold that day. At midnight any items in the Selling Bin that can be sold are converted to a number of emerald nuggets proportional to the amount of hunger each item restores. 
### Goal
The goal of this mod is to encourage a different style of gameplay. It can be used together with mods that add new food items, villager types/trades, and automation to scale up your food production and gain resources through villager trades while you build out your town. 
### Plans
More features are planned to make this mod more general and motivate farming-focused gameplay. One planned feature is to introduce a villager hunger mechanic such that if villagers aren't adequately fed, they'll lock their best trades. Additional plans are _improved raids_, _settlements_ to establish your own village and keep the villagers happy, _and more!_
### Thanks for downloading!
Feedback and suggestions are encouraged!

title: Better With Everything
description: A fork of BWM that includes BWA and FIXES the broken guide. Maybe something more.
body:
Join our Discord for support

### What is Better With Everything Better With Everything (BWE) is a fork of Better With Mods (BWM) that removes the broken guidebook that was dependent on an external repository that is no longer online; it also includes the totality of Better With Addons (BWA) minus its guidebook. Finally, it has a few features that were left out of BWA.
BWA Changes - Fixed "boss" potion effect - Fixed Greatbow not affected by infinity - Fixed lure tree Craft Tweaker methods - Improved Greatbow configuration (damage, damage to dragons, lightning color, etc) - Added Napalm Greatarrows - Added Configuration to change the color of ancestral spirits - Added HC beacon Craft Tweaker support
For now, only the **file name** will change, with the IDs of both mods contained within still the same to remain fully compatible with existing modpacks if they choose to switch to this fork. Plans for the future include possibly finishing some missing features and remaking some textures. The release version, except for BWA's additional features and the lack of guidebook is virtually identical to the previous two versions of the BWM and BWA ### Original description > What is Better With Mods? Better With Mods(BWM) is a mod based around extending and enhancing vanilla Minecraft. BWM focuses on improving the core aspects of Minecraft through its three core modules. First is the Gameplay module which directly extends the gameplay of Minecraft through additional blocks, items, foods, and more. Next is the Tweak module which adds small quality of life and balance changes. Finally is the Hardcore module which directly changes the core balance of Minecraft. Together these three modules massively overhaul the vanilla experience. > > BetterWithMods is largely inspired by BetterThanWolves by FlowerChild. While the core ideas may be the same, many things are different between the two mods. > > Configuration > With the same philosophy found in mods such as Quark, Better With Mods is extremely configurable. Every recipe, tweak, hardcore mechanic, etc. is configurable. Better With Mods puts the control over gameplay in you, the player's hands, instead of being forced into a specific playstyle. > > Both the Tweak and Hardcore modules can be enabled or disabled through the config while the Gameplay module is configurable through Modtweaker compatibility. > > Module: Gameplay > The gameplay module is the base module of BWM. It provides all the core blocks, items, and foods used > > throughout the mod. For a brief overview of the content included watch the following series by Mischief of Mice: > > Module: Tweaks > The tweak module is based around improving the quality of life and gameplay of Minecraft through a variety of small changes. > > A sample of a few tweaks: > > * Mobs always dropping equipment > * Mobs dropping heads > * Animals Fleeing > * Renewable Endstone > * Creeper Sheering > * ...And More! > * Module: Hardcore > * The hardcore module is focused on rebalancing the base Minecraft experience to be more challenging and thought-provoking. This is through expanding gameplay decisions instead of the microcrafting that you would find in other mods. Many of these features encourage automation and utilizing vanilla tools, such as water streams, to progress. > > A sample of a few hardcore changes: > > * HCBuckets - Buckets can not place down source blocks > * HCHunger (Requires Applecore) - Replaces saturation with fat that will cause negative effects if too much is gained > * HCMovement - Different materials slow or speed up the player's movement > * HCBeacons - Override the beacon system to encourage multiple beacons > * HCSpawn - The player will spawn within a couple thousand blocks of world spawn > * HCStrata (Best with CTM)- Divide the world into 3 stone layers ...And More!

title: Simple Hollow Logs
description: Adds the hollow logs from the birch concept art of Minecraft Live 2021!
body: # Hi there! Thank you for checking out Simple Hollow Logs! Simple Hollow Logs is a client and server-side [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net) mod which attempts to add the hollow logs from the Minecraft Live 2021 Birch Forest concept art! They generate naturally in some forest-like biomes across the overworld, and they can be crafted using 8 of their regular log counterparts. They also have a unique collision box, allowing you to crawl inside! ![](https://github.com/axialeaa/SimpleHollowLogs/assets/116074698/e9385a02-b429-45d7-88e7-7c9d2ead2bc0) > A player crawling inside a hollow log. Unlike normal logs, they can be filled with water. When this happens, they will hold it in on their 4 solid faces, but will let it spill out the holes. Hollow logs may also be stripped using an axe. *** ### Getting Started Due to the use of `FlammableBlockRegistry`, `FabricItemSettings`, `ItemGroupEvents`, `BiomeModifications` and `BiomeSelectors`, you will need to download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) in order to use this mod. Once you have, simply drag both Fabric API and Simple Hollow Logs in your mods folder. If you're playing on a multiplayer server, you'll need to have these mods installed on both the server and client sides. *** ### Mod Compatibility Currently, this mod features hollow log variants of every vanilla log type, some of which may generate naturally in overworld biomes. Logs and biome types from other mods may be supported in the future, but it's not on the roadmap.

title: Bottle of Gender
description: Adds a Bottle of Gender to the Minecraft 23w13a_or_b April Fools' snapshot, along with data-drivable genders.
body:
Bottle of Gender is a mod created for the FlashFest 23w13a_or_b modding challenge, and adds exactly what it says on the tin: a Bottle of Gender, which changes your gender when drunk. What will it change into? There's only one way to find out...

Bottles of Gender are crafted by brewing light blue dye into bottles of dragon's breath, and more genders can be added via datapacks. They can affect your skin, gender term, name color, size, and possibly more in the future!

FlashFest was a really fun challenge and I super enjoyed diving through the snapshot code to figure out how to do everything I want. I can't wait for next year's, and I hope you all enjoy what I've made!

title: S-Economy
description: Just a simple and lightweight economy system.
body:
## Overview S-Economy is a simple and lightweight economy plugin, utilizing Vault as the backend. S-Economy requires the plugin **Vault**. ## Features - Reload the plugin directly in-game - Customizable messages - Update-Checker (Automatically checks for updates on startup and when an admin joins.) - Option to toggle/configure the commands in `commands.yml` - Balance command (Aliases: /balance, /bal, /money, /coins) - Economy command (Manage player balances) - Pay command (Transfer money to other players) - More features in development ... ## Commands - /s-economy about - Displays information about the plugin - /s-economy reload - Reloads the plugin in-game - /balance - Shows the own balance - /balance - Shows the balance the given player has - /economy give - Gives a player money - /economy take - Takes a player money - /economy set - Sets the money of a player to the given amount - /economy reset - Resets a player's money - /economy check - Checks a player money (Same as /balance) - /pay - Sends the given amount of money to the other player - /pay * - Sends the given amount of money to all online players - /balancetop - Check top 10 players by balance ## Permissions - sEconomy.admin - sEconomy.command.balance.self - sEconomy.command.balance.other - sEconomy.command.eco.give - sEconomy.command.eco.take - sEconomy.command.eco.set - sEconomy.command.eco.reset - sEconomy.command.eco.check - sEconomy.command.pay - sEconomy.command.pay.all - sEconomy.command.balancetop - sEconomy.exempt.balancetop ## Configs

This mod re-adds the pre-1.3 smooth mob movement to singleplayer, without any latency. Also reintroduces client-side mob movement.

title: BladeBind
description: Swords thrown into the ground become temporary territorial markers that damage enemies who enter their radius.
body:
# BladeBind

BladeBind introduces a tactical PvP mechanic where players can throw their sword by dropping it while sneaking. The sword plants into the ground and creates a small territorial zone.

## Mechanics

**Planted Blade Zone**
- Affects all players not on the same team
- 5-block radius of effect
- Continuous damage based on sword material:
  - Wooden sword: 0.5 hearts per second
  - Netherite sword: 2 hearts per second
  - Other materials scale between these values
- Duration: 60 seconds before despawning
- Sword returns to owner's inventory if space is available
- Only one active blade per player at a time
- Subtle redstone particles mark the blade's range

## Usage

- Sneak and drop your sword to activate
- No commands required
- No permissions required
- Works with vanilla teams

## Technical Details

Uses scoreboard tracking for ownership and team detection. Execute commands handle damage pulses. Server operators can adjust duration by modifying the `bladebind.duration` scoreboard objective.

title: Re: Translator
description: Automatically translates all missing language keys to current language
body:
This mod is created for people all around the globe to allow them understand any in-game text, may it be block names, item descriptions, and even manual books.  
  
For now it uses only Google Translate API, with more APIs to select from coming in the future.  
  
All translations are cached, sorted by language, and stored in game's root folder under ReTranslatorCache directory, so if you got unlucky with any automatic translation, you can manually adjust it to your fit.  
  
Warning: you may experience a long game load when trying to start your modpack at first time with uncached language selected - this is due to a lot of objects being translated at once. Just wait and observe progress being printed to logs, it can take several minutes, depending on your internet connection, hardware, and size of modpack.  
  
Also, a relaunch is required if you want to select new game language - translations are being done during pre-initialization state.  
  
Sometimes a mod will have not en_US lang as a main lang file - in that case you can specify main lang file in mod's config.  
  
There are two more possible cases when something is not translated: selected API just can't translate provided text OR the mod uses localization method different from lang files (ex: TiC manuals).

title: Datapack Debugger
description: A fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21, which allows you to set breakpoints in datapacks
body:
# Datapack Breakpoint

## Introduce

This is a fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21, which allows you to set breakpoints in the game and "freeze" the game when 
the breakpoint is reached.

## Usage

* Set a breakpoint

In datapack, you can insert `#breakpoint` into .mcfunction file to set a breakpoint. For example:

```mcfunction
#test:test

say 1
say 2
#breakpoint
say 3
say 4
```

In this case, after the game executes `say 2`, the game will be "frozen" because it meets the breakpoint. 

When the game is "frozen", you can still move around, do whatever you want, just like execute the command `tick freeze`.
So you can check the game state, or do some debugging.

* Step

When the game is "frozen", you can use the command `/breakpoint step` to execute the next command. In above example, 
after the game meets the breakpoint, you can use `/breakpoint step` to execute `say 3`, and then use `/breakpoint step`
to execute `say 4`. When all commands are executed, the game will be unfrozen and continue running.

* Continue

When the game is "frozen", you can use the command `/breakpoint move` to unfreeze the game and continue running.

* Get Macro Arguments

By using `/breakpoint get <key>`, you can get the value of the macro argument if the game is executing a macro function.
For example:

```mcfunction
#test:test_macro

say start
#breakpoint
$say $(msg)
say end
```

After executing `function test:test_macro {"msg":"test"}`, we passed the value `test` to the macro argument `msg` and 
then the game will pause before `$say $(msg)`. At this time, you can use `/breakpoint get msg` to get the value `test`.

This modpack is built for EDGE community server, but you can use it for your own community too!

## What is the purpose of this pack?

The aim of this pack is to make a **chill, slow-life gameplay for casuals**, but can also be challenging during group plays.

To achieve that, we utilize Bare Bones and almost every mods out there that shifts Minecraft's design to look similar to the trailer. Then we add various mods that brings RPG-like gameplay such as Simply Skills, Spell Engine mods, MC Dungeons mods, and so on.

The wilderness' fauna is made more livelier using various animal mods.
Farming mods and decoration mods are added to lift the medieval atmosphere, making them brighter and colorful.

Emeralds are not really fun in the late game. Therefore, we added Numismatic Overhaul and Bountiful Boards. They implement currency system that you can get from trades, killing illagers, structure explorations, and from bounties.

## Do you have specific goals to be expected from players when playing this pack?

Yes! We hope players can play with their friends in server, find a place to settle, build very cozy medieval house with aesthetic farms. Expand the base further into towns, along with villagers. ## Recall potion

A recreation of recall potion from Terraria in Minecraft. You drink it, and you get teleported to your spawn point.
As simple as that!

## Illumination necklace

Both pretty and  functional - wear it to place luminous orbs automatically in dark spots wherever you go.
Compatible with Flan & Get Off My Lawn!

## Assortment pouch

Adventurers often face a problem that they encounter a lot of unique items in low quantities.
This pouch solves the problem - it has a lot of slots, but each slot can only hold a single item.

## Mysteries and Mystery arrows

Ever wondered what lives inside an NPC? The answer is a mystery. Unalive a couple dozen villagers, pillagers,
witches or other NPCs to get your mystery. The primary application of mysteries, apart from being pretty,
is making mystery arrows from plain arrows. Mystery arrows are really quite useful. Shoot one at a block, and it changes.
Shoot one at a creature, and it morphs.

### Ownerizer

Mystery arrows respect Flan / GOML claims by default. Among other things, it means that if you put them into 
a dispenser, they won't work inside *any* claim, even your own. (Sadly, that's just a Minecraft limitation)
\
\
BUT! There's a solution: Ownerizer! Just shift-click a dispenser (or any other functional block) with it
to mark it as your own property. It won't do anything on its own, but it will hint Mystery arrows that they can
unleash their power inside your claims (and maybe even more!?).

### How to configure Mystery arrows

Mystery arrows come opinionated. To configure them, you need to make a datapack.
Look here on what to put where [for blocks](https://github.com/falseresync/explorers-delight/tree/8724089bbcee75e4d8bbb1d07571399d7ead7ecc/src/main/resources/data/exdel/tags/blocks/mystery_arrow) and [for entities](https://github.com/falseresync/explorers-delight/tree/8724089bbcee75e4d8bbb1d07571399d7ead7ecc/src/main/resources/data/exdel/tags/entity_types/mystery_arrow).
Additionally, there's a config for the weights (that means relative chances) of some mystery arrow effects.
The config structure is self-explanatory, go check it out

title: SCP-610, Flesh that Hates
description: A grotesque flesh infection that spreads across the world, mutating victims into aggressive abominations and forming a hostile hive.
body:
The Flesh that Hates adds a new entity. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-610, also known as the Flesh that Hates.


SCP-610 is a large-scale infection system. The anomaly manifests as living flesh that spreads across terrain, infects entities, and evolves into numerous hostile lifeforms. SCP-610 slowly overtakes the environment, transforming blocks, creatures, and entire areas into a living hive. Living SCP-610 Instances are hostile, aggressive, twisted, flesh creatures that attack almost anything. Those Entities will also infect other targets to let the population of SCP-610 grow. Fire can slow its growth, but eliminating or containing the source of the infection is the only way to stop it permanently, before it overruns your world.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)

● Concept Designs made by xXYoLoDeXx

[https://youtube.com/@xxyolodeytxx?si=Js0S313UVTaCV36P](https://youtube.com/@xxyolodeytxx?si=Js0S313UVTaCV36P)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► How can I locate SCP-610 Instances?

You can locate SCP-610 Instances with the new Item called "Flesh Detector". This Item will locate SCP-610 Instances within 150 blocks, and displays a message if an Instance have been found or not.


► How can I turn off the Growth of Flesh Blocks?

You can turn off the growth of Flesh Blocks by setting the gamerule "enableFleshGrow" to false.

► How can I turn off the Call of the Hive effect?

You can turn off the Call of the Hive effect by setting the gamerule "disableCallOfTheHive" to false.

► Can I contain SCP-610?

Yes, you can contain SCP-610! Usually, the infection starts with Infected Pillagers that only spawn if there isn't an SCP-610-6 in the world. If they die, they have a 4% chance spawning a small SCP-610-6 Instance when killed by a player, and a 20% chance when killed by mobs.

The SCP-610-6 Instance will grow into a big SCP-610-6 Instance usually within two days. To contain it, build a 8x9x8 Box out of blocks that cannot be infected with SCP-610-6.

For example: Any concrete or stone block.

DO NOT build the box with too much space, since the SCP-610-6 instances will spawn other SCP-610 Instances nearby, if there is a flesh in a 6 block distance.

► Which Blocks can be infected by SCP-610?

Blocks can be infected by SCP-610. Those Blocks will rot if there isn't an SCP-610-6 instance within specific reach. You can use fire to burn the upper blocks, but the best way to get rid of them, is by letting them rot.

Blocks that can be infected by SCP-610:

>Any Grass Blocks
>Any Dirt Blocks
>Any Sand Blocks
>Clay
>Gravel
>Any Leave Blocks
>Any Log Blocks
>Any Wooden Blocks

► How can I get rid of the flesh Infection blocks?

To get rid of the flesh blocks, kill all SCP-610-6, especially the big ones. After killing them, flesh blocks will rot.

You can also use fire, but this only burns the upper layer.

► Why does my game starts to lag if there are a lot of flesh blocks?

The Flesh Blocks use ticks to infect other blocks, catch fire or rot if there isn't an SCP-610-6 Instance within specific reach. If there is a big area made out of Flesh blocks, the game could start to lag and it isn't recommended to just let the flesh infect your world.

► What does the Call of the Hive do?

Call of the Hive is a new effect given by SCP-610 Instances when they die or being too close to an SCP-610-6 Instance.

If an Entity has the Call of the Hive effect, all nearby SCP-610 Instances within 40 blocks will target the victim.

► What does the Flesh Infection do?

The Flesh Infection is a new effect given by SCP-610 Attacks.


Stage 1:

Take 1 Damage With 0.05%

Increase 1 Hunger With 0.05%


Stage 2:

Weakness I

Overlay starts getting Red

Removal of Saturation and Resistance

Sweat Particles

Take 1 Damage With 0.09%

Increase 1 Hunger With 0.08%


Stage 3:

Weakness I

Slowness II

Overlay increases getting Red

Removal of Saturation, Absorption, Speed, Haste and Resistance

Sweat Particles

Take 1 Damage With 0.5%

Increase 1 Hunger With 0.1%


Stage 4:

Weakness II

Slowness III

Overlay increases getting Red

Removal of Saturation, Absorption, Speed, Haste, Regeneration and Resistance

Sweat Particles

Take 1 Damage With 3%

Increase 1 Hunger With 0.5%


Stage 5:

Death

Die with Flesh Infection:
Humanoid Mobs / Players: SCP-610-1 Spawns
Animal Mobs: SCP-610-2 Spawns

► Where does SCP-610 Instances spawn?

SCP-610 Instances only spawn if a mob dies to the Flesh Infection or is killed by an SCP-610 Instance or Infected Pillager. SCP-610 Instances can also be summoned by SCP-610-6 Instances.

Infected Pillagers can spawn on the overworld surface like a normal monster after 3 days passed. However, there can only be a few instances of SCP-610 in one area.

</details>



![SCP-610](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68af59093fb5cf77c74a91973028cf15fb713293.png)

SCP-610 is a hostile infection that manifests as living flesh, capable of spreading across terrain and living beings alike. Once introduced into the world, it slowly overtakes its surroundings, corrupting blocks, creatures, and entire regions into a unified hive. Victims exposed to SCP-610 may suffer from Flesh Infection, a progressive condition that weakens and kills the host, transforming them into new SCP-610 Instance. Those Instances can also mutate into more brutal monsters. These manifestations range from fast, fragile hunters to massive, heavily armored brutes, all acting in coordination. At the core of SCP-610 infestations are Incubators, pulsating flesh growths that spread corruption, strengthen nearby entities, and give rise to new mutations. As long as Incubators remain active, the flesh continues to grow and adapt. Although SCP-610 is highly vulnerable to fire.

body:
## TortMod - A mod where cakes are more than just food.

**Tortmod 1.21.1 is here!**

This mod adds many new cakes to Minecraft. You can get them in two ways: by mining new cake ores that generate in the world, or by crafting them from vanilla items.

Each cake does something different when you eat it. Some give strong buffs, others have unique mechanics or trade-offs.

### A few examples:

*   **Ender Pearl Cake:** Gives you the "Void Anchor" effect. If you fall into the void, it teleports you back to safety. It's basically a life insurance.
*   **Redstone Cake:** Repairs the item in your off-hand by 5% durability. Useful if you don't have Mending.
*   **Chocolate Cake:** Gives Speed II and Haste II. Much stronger than vanilla potions.
*   **Lapis Cake:** Consumes your XP to give you powerful combat buffs.
*   **Winerr Cake:** Has a small chance to "glitch" the game - shuffle your hotbar, damage items, or give random effects. Eat at your own risk.
*   **TNT Cake:** When you eat it, a lit TNT block appears where you were standing.

### Features:

*   40 different edible cakes (and raw versions).
*   New ores that generate in the Overworld, Nether, and The End.
*   A crafting system for non-ore cakes. You make flour, then a dough cake, and use it as a base.
*   **Villager Trading:**
    *   **Farmers** sell delicious and buffing cakes.
    *   **Clerics** sell magical and dangerous cakes (like Ender Pearl or Magnet Cake).
    *   **Masons** buy your Raw Cakes for emeralds.
*   New status effects like Magnetism (pulls items), Gold Rush (makes piglins neutral), and Hiding in Sands (invisibility on sand).

title: ChestLockLite
description: Lock your chests with owner-only protection, password protection, or trusted players system.
body:
# ChestLockLite

A simple, powerful container locking plugin for Spigot/Paper 1.21+ servers. Lock your chests, barrels, hoppers, and furnaces with owner protection, password protection, or trusted players system. **No MySQL required** - uses lightweight SQLite storage.

---

## Lock a Container

![Lock Command Example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/main/.github/lock-example.png)

Look at a chest, barrel, hopper, or furnace and run:

```bash
/cl lock
```

Only you can open it now!

---

## Key Features

### Core Protection
- **Owner Locks** - Lock containers so only you can access them
- **Password Protection** - Share access with passwords (SHA-256 hashed)
- **Trusted Players** - Grant access to specific players without passwords
- **Container Protection** - Prevents breaking, explosions, fire, and pistons

### Container Support
- **Chests** - All chest types (regular, trapped, copper, etc.)
- **Barrels** - Full locking support for barrels
- **Hoppers** - Lock hoppers and control item extraction (configurable)
- **Furnaces** - Lock furnaces, blast furnaces, and smokers (configurable)
- **Per-Container Hopper Control** - Toggle hopper access per container via GUI

### User Interface
- **GUI Menu** - Easy-to-use visual interface (Shift + Right-click with empty hand)
- **Password Input GUI** - Interactive character selection
- **Tab Completion** - Full autocomplete support for all commands
- **Container-Specific Messages** - Messages show the correct container type

### Advanced Features
- **Double Chest Support** - Automatically handles single and double chests
- **Auto-Lock on Place** - Optional automatic locking when placing containers
- **Password Cooldown** - Prevents spam attempts (configurable)
- **Admin Tools** - Clear locks, reload config, bypass permissions
- **Admin Notifications** - Admins see notifications when opening locked containers
- **SQLite Storage** - Fast, lightweight, no external database needed
- **Auto-Backup** - Automatic database backups
- **Automatic Migration** - Seamless database upgrades

---

## Quick Setup

1. Download the `ChestLockLite.jar` file
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Start your server
4. Configure as needed in `plugins/ChestLockLite/config.yml` (optional)

That's it! The plugin is ready to use.

---

## Usage Examples

### Password Protection

![Password GUI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/main/.github/password-gui.png)

Set a password so anyone with the password can unlock the container:

```bash
/cl password mypassword123
```

Or use the **GUI** (Shift + Right-click → "Set Password") for an interactive password input!

---

### Trust a Player

![Trusted Players GUI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/main/.github/trusted-players.png)

Grant a player access without sharing passwords:

```bash
/cl trust FriendName
```

The trusted player will receive a notification and can now access your container!

---

### Using the GUI

**Shift + Right-click** any container to open the menu (Must have empty hand)

Click buttons to:
- Lock/unlock containers
- Set or remove passwords
- Manage trusted players
- Toggle hopper access (per container)
- View lock information

No commands to remember!

---

## Common Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/cl lock` | Lock the container you're looking at |
| `/cl unlock` | Unlock your container |
| `/cl password <pass>` | Set or enter password |
| `/cl trust <player>` | Trust a player on your container |
| `/cl untrust <player>` | Remove trust from a player |
| `/cl trustedlist` | List trusted players |
| `/cl gui` | Open GUI menu |
| `/cl info` | View lock information |

**Aliases:** `/chestlock`, `/lockchest`

---

## Security Features

- **SHA-256 Password Hashing** - Passwords are never stored in plain text
- **Unique Salt Per Password** - Prevents rainbow table attacks
- **Container Break Protection** - Prevents unauthorized breaking
- **Explosion Protection** - Protects from creepers, TNT, etc.
- **Fire/Lava Protection** - Protects from fire and lava damage
- **Piston Protection** - Prevents pistons from moving locked containers
- **Hopper Control** - Prevent hoppers from extracting items from locked containers

---

## Configuration

New in v1.1.0:

```yaml
locks:
  # Support for hoppers (allow locking hoppers)
  allow-hoppers: true
  
  # Support for furnaces (allow locking furnaces, blast furnaces, smokers)
  allow-furnaces: true
  
  # Show notification to admins when they open locked containers
  admin-notification: true
```

---

## Perfect For

- **Survival Servers** - Protect player containers from griefing
- **SMP Servers** - Secure shared storage areas
- **Economy Servers** - Protect shop chests and storage
- **Towny/Factions** - Team-based container protection
- **Any Server** - Simple, lightweight container protection

---

## Documentation

- **Full Documentation**: [GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/wiki)
- **Quick Start Guide**: [Quick Start](https://github.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/wiki/Quick-Start)
- **Configuration**: [Config Reference](https://github.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/wiki/Configuration)
- **Permissions**: [Permissions Guide](https://github.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/wiki/Permissions)

---

## Admin Commands

Admins have access to powerful management tools:

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/cl clear` | Clear lock on targeted container | `chestlocklite.admin.clear` |
| `/cl clearall <player>` | Clear all locks by player | `chestlocklite.admin.clearall` |
| `/cl cleararea [radius]` | Clear locks in area | `chestlocklite.admin.cleararea` |
| `/cl reload` | Reload configuration | `chestlocklite.admin.reload` |

---

## Performance

- **Lightweight** - Minimal server impact
- **SQLite Storage** - Fast, no external database needed
- **Indexed Queries** - O(log n) lookup time
- **Tested** - Handles 10,000+ locks without issues
- **Comprehensive Testing** - 39 unit tests ensure reliability

---

## What's New in v1.1.0

- 🎉 **Barrel, Hopper & Furnace Support** - Lock all container types!
- 🎛️ **Per-Container Hopper Control** - Toggle hopper access via GUI
- 🔔 **Admin Notifications** - Admins see notifications when opening locked containers
- 💬 **Container-Specific Messages** - Messages show correct container type
- 🐛 **Bug Fixes** - Fixed password GUI bug and GUI access with items
- 🧪 **Test Suite** - Comprehensive testing infrastructure (39 tests)

---

## License

This project is licensed under the **MIT License**.

---

## Links

- **Download**: [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/releases)
- **Report Issues**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/issues)
- **Wiki**: [Documentation Wiki](https://github.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/wiki)
- **Support**: Check the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://github.com/eldor47/ChestLockLite/wiki/Troubleshooting)

---

**Made with ❤️ for the Minecraft community**

*Perfect for survival, SMP, and economy servers. Simple configuration, comprehensive permissions system, and full documentation included.*

body:
# RealEconomy

A Minecraft economy plugin (or server-side-only mod) for Fabric, Forge and NeoForge that supports multiple currencies.

It's a fork of the unmaintained MC 1.20 [MultiEconomy mod](https://github.com/bencrow11/MultiEconomy)

## Why use RealEconomy?

RealEconomy is a minecraft server-side-only mod made for Forge, Fabric and NeoForge. 

It provides standard economy plugin features while supporting multiple currencies. You can run this mod like a regular currency mod with a singular currency too. For more details on how to use RealEconomy, see the [wiki](https://github.com/jblemee/RealEconomy/wiki).

RealEconomy has a few requirements:
- **RealEconomy currently supports Minecraft versions 1.21**
- **Fabric** requires [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/), [Minecraft Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) and [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)
- **Forge** requires [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/) and [Minecraft Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/)
- **NeoForge** requires [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/) and [Minecraft NeoForge](https://projects.neoforged.net/neoforged/neoforge)

## Features

- Supports multiple currencies
- Offline payments
- Payment on specified currencies only
- Admin commands to add / remove / set balances
- Placeholders

## Screenshots

![Balances Screenshot](https://github.com/jblemee/RealEconomy/raw/develop/balance.png)
![pay Screenshot](https://i.imgur.com/2HtuKBz.png)
![pay2 Screenshot](https://i.imgur.com/BKKRpvt.png)

## Building

To build RealEconomy, you need JDK 21 or higher.

Clone this repository, then run the following command:

- On Linux or macOS:  ``./gradlew build``
- On Windows:  ``gradlew build``

## Documentation

[See the wiki for details on how to use this mod.](https://github.com/jblemee/RealEconomy/wiki)

title: Alex's Enhancements Legacy
description: A 1.20.2/1.20.1 Fabric-based modpack for Minecraft
body:
Alex's Enhancements is a **quality-of-life modpack** dedicated to improving the game's performance and graphics, visuals, and overall experience. Originally crafted as my personal modpack, I decided to share it with the community due to the overwhelming interest. 

Alex's Enhancements offers a range of modern performance modifications, including Sodium, Lithium, Starlight, and many others. Additionally, it incorporates numerous tweaks designed to enhance the user experience. These include support for various Optifine features like zoom, connected textures, and shaders. Alex's Enhancements also addresses and fixes known bugs, introduce additional HUDs, and many other quality-of-life improvements.

## ⚙ Compatibility

Alex's Enhancements is able to run on almost any device, from high and low specifications. The pack is compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux. Unfortunately in its current state, Alex's Enhancements was only built for 1.20.1 *(1.20.2 Alpha available)*, but this is subject to change in the future.

title: Cult of Cats
description: Adds a magical cat cult into the game
body:
Have any suggestion? Want to report a bug? We have a Discord server! You can join and ask anything you want!


Introduction

This mod aims to add a secret cult of cats to the world. This mod is meant to give a kind of unnerving feeling when playing the game. The structures added by this mod are kind of rare, and they're meant to be that rare just so you don't face cat cult stuff all the time. Remember that the Cult of Cats is meant to be rare to find.

 

This mod is for Forge and there will never be a Fabric port.

 

List of mobs & information about them

 

Cat Cultist

HP: 15

Aggression: Hostile

Spawning: Cat cult structures

Attack damage: 2

Drops: Magic shard

Special information: They drop magic shards, which are used for crafting magic minerals, which are later used for crafting a new weapon called ''Unpredictable Wand'', which is a weapon that can give random negative effect to enemies when hurting them.

 

Magical Cultist

HP: 20

Aggression: Hostile

Spawning: Cat cult structures

Attack damage: 3

Drops: Magic shard

Special information: They are immune to fire, drowning, fall damage and potion effects. When they attack you, they can give you these effects: poison, wither, levitation, slowness, nausea, or set you on fire.

 

Cat Necromancer

HP: 15

Aggression: Hostile

Spawning: Cat cult structures

Attack damage: 3

Drops: Old relic (Commonly) & Necromancing Staff (Rarely)

Special information: They drop Old Relics, which are used for crafting different kinds of relics that give you different kinds of effects. When hurt, they'll spawn skeletal cats that will help them.

 

Skeletal Cat

HP: 10

Aggression: Hostile (Spawned by Cat Necromancer) / Neutral (Spawned by the Necromancing Staff)

Spawning: Spawned by Cat Necromancer (Hostile) / Spawned by the Necromancing Staff (Neutral)

Attack damage: 2

Drops: Bones

Special information: When spawned by the Necromancing Staff, they'll attack any hostile creature around them. When spawned by Cat Necromancers, they'll only attack players and entities who hurt them.

 

Greenat

HP: 50

Aggression: Hostile

Spawning: Big Cult Mansion

Attack damage: 6

Drops: Green Key

Special information: It floats around instead of walking. It's immune to fire and potion effects. When this mini-boss hurts you, it can give you the Nausea effect, Levitation, and spawn a skeleton with a bow. When killed, it drops a Green Key, which is used for summoning Terr.

 

Hellat

HP: 50

Aggression: Hostile

Spawning: Big Cult Mansion

Attack damage: 6

Drops: Dark Key

Special information: It floats around instead of walking. It's immune to fire and potion effects. When this mini-boss hurts you, it can give you blindness, or spawn a Wither Skeleton. When killed, it drops a Dark Key, which is used for summoning Terr.

 

Terr

HP: 140

Aggression: Hostile

Spawning: Summoned by the Cult Pentagram

Attack damage: 8

Drops: 1 old relic, 4 spectral arrows, 2 dragon breaths, 1 elytra.

Special information: This is the only boss added by the mod. She floats around instead of walking. Terr is the superior entity the cats of the cult cherish. She's immune to all kinds of damage except for melee player attacks and arrows. When she hurts you, she can spawn cat cultists, magical cat cultists, give you the levitation effect, strike lightning around, and spawn shadow clones while blinding you.

 

Beast Cat Cultist

HP: 45

Aggression: Hostile

Spawning: Anywhere in the overworld and Nether / From right-clicking a Cat Symbol with a Dragonfruit

Attack damage: 7

Drops: Fragmented Chaos

Special information: This is the only creature this mod adds that spawns naturally around the world. It has high knockback attack and medium knockback resistance. It drops Fragmented Chaos, which can be used for brewing potions of Random Luck, which is a new potion effect added by the mod that makes you have a chance of getting any of the following effects when hurt: Night Vision, Regeneration, Haste, Mining Fatigue, Wither, Slowness, Strength, Resistance.

 

 

Rituals

Rituals need to be performed within a Rituals Block. You also need 15 Magic Shards to perform any ritual.

 

Ritual of Fulfillment: Gives the player Saturation for 15 seconds


Ritual of Brainwashing: Spawns two Cat Cultist that will be loyal towards you and attack whoever you hit. These cultists will despawn after 5 minutes have passed since they've been summoned.


Ritual of Mealing: Every creature you kill will drop Bone Meal for as long as the effect is on. The effect lasts for 3 minutes.


Ritual of Fishing: Every time you fish up anything, you are guaranteed to fish up one extra Raw Salmon. The effect lasts for 3 minutes.


Ritual of Taxing: Villagers will drop an Emerald with a 50% chance when you punch them. The effect lasts for 1 minute.


Ritual of the Burnt Undead: Sets the nearest Undead entity on fire for 9 seconds. The effect lasts for 4 minutes.

 

Items

Dark Key & Green Key

These keys are used for summoning Terr. When you find the Big Cult House structure, one of the rooms has a Cult Pentagram on the floor. This Cult Pentagram requieres both of these keys in order to summon Terr.

 

Magic Shard, Magic Mineral & Unpredictable Staff

The Magic Shard is dropped by Cat Cultists and Magical Cultists, apart from being obtained aswell from cult loot chests. These shards can be crafted into a Magic Mineral, which is later used for crafting an Unpredictable Staff, which is a new weapon that can give random negative effects to enemies.

 

The possible effects the Unpredictable Staff can give are: blindness, hunger, levitation, mining fatigue, nausea, poison, slowness, weakness & wither.


The Magic Shard can also be used for crafting a Heating Gem, which melts snow and ice around the player that's holding this item.

 

Old Relic & All the relics

You can obtain an Old Relic from killing Cat Necromancers or from cult loot chests. Old Relics are used for crafting different kinds of relics, which give you different effects depending on what kind of relic it is.
Boosting Relic: Gives you jump boost, speed, haste & night vision
Fire Relic: Gives you fire resistance and makes you able to burn your enemies when hiting them. You get hurt when you touch water, though.
Floating Relic: Gives you Slow Falling and makes you able to make your enemies float when hurting them.
Freezing Relic: Gives slowness and weakness to your enemies when you hit them.
Grass Relic: Gives you regeneration and health boost when walking on trees.
Undead Relic: Gives you strength and makes you immune to poison, wither and hunger. If it's daytime and you're not wearing a helmet, you'll start burning.
Water Relic: Gives you water breathing and dolphin's grace. Also makes fire extinguish instantly when you get set on fire.

 

Dragonfruit

It's a new food the mod adds. It can be found in cult loot chests. It can be either eaten or used for summoning a Beast Cat Cultist when right-clicking a Cat Symbol.

 

Necromancing Staff

It's a new weapon that can be dropped by Cat Necromancers. It can also be rarely found in cult loot chests. It makes you able to summon friendly Skeletal Cats that will attack hostile mobs around. These skeletal cats won't attack players unless the player attacks them first. This staff has 100 uses in total.

 

Cat Cult Statue

Around the world, you'll be able to find Cat Cult Statues in the middle of nowhere. You can right-click these statues for obtaining cat cult loot chests. When right-clicking one of these statues, you'll lose 19 HP, leaving you only at 1 HP. This means that you'll only survive activating the statue if you do it at full health.

 

Fragmented Chaos

Dropped by Beast Cat Cultist. It can be used for brewing potions of Random Luck, which is a new potion effect added by the mod that makes you have a chance of getting any of the following effects when hurt: Night Vision, Regeneration, Haste, Mining Fatigue, Wither, Slowness, Strength, Resistance.

This item can also be used for crafting Gambler's Hoe and Gambler's Pickaxe.
Gambler's Pickaxe: 50% chance of giving Random Luck to the player when mining a block.
Gambler's Hoe: 50% chance of giving Random Luck to the player when tilling grass.

title: HIKI: The Unseen Horror
description: HIKI: The Unseen Horror - This mod adds new mobs and events
body:
There was a story about a mysterious entity that came to a house. The house had four rooms, red dust, and flickering lights…

This mod introduces a terrifying entity called Hiki, which brings horror and unsettling events into your world.

Hiki has four phases:


Phase One:
> The player starts in a relatively safe environment but will notice strange occurrences.
> Messages such as "Don't do it" or "Kill yourself" may appear.
> Time will randomly shift between day and night.
> Mysterious potion effects will sometimes manifest in the sky.

2. Phase Two:

> The world becomes more unpredictable and disturbing.
> Doors may open by themselves.
> A Pigman may suddenly approach and attack.
> Creepy ambient sounds play, including the eerie chimes of amethyst.

3. Phase Three:

> The true nightmare begins—Hiki becomes relentless.
> Every 50 seconds, the player is forcefully teleported back to Hiki's house.
> Strange entities, including fast-moving Pigmen, will flicker in and out of existence.
> The sounds of amethyst crystals will echo constantly.

4. Phase Four:

> The player is trapped in the house , with no escape.
> A Pigman, Mimic, Hiki, may appear
> Hiki manipulates time, shifting between day and night at will.

After sleeping, the most disturbing sounds will fill the air.

Many more horrors await—download the mod and uncover the rest… 

Good luck!

title: Project Table Refabricated
description: Adds the project table you've been so nostalgic about.
body: # Project Table Refabricated [](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) [](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) This is a Minecraft Mod for Fabric 1.18.2. It adds the Project Table Block, which may be nostalgic to some people, as it used to be the go-to crafting bench before Tinker's came along with the Crafting Station. ## Motivation This mod came to be because of the [Create: Astral](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/create-astral) Modpack. In version 2.0.* of this Modpack we relied on the Tinker's Crafting Station. However, it has some issues, such as Quests not reliably completing. Some of the dev team then remembered this Block and wanted it in the pack. However, we weren't able to find a 1.18.2 Fabric Version that met our requirements. So let's talk about the features of this mod. ## Features - Full REI Integration. The Block is registered as a Workbench for default crafting and has quick-input support. - Configurable extra storage. People who know the Project Table from using it way back when may remember it featuring two extra rows of storage. That is the default in this mod too, but you can configure it from 0 all the way to 5 rows. - Polymorph Integration, allowing you to select between different conflicting recipes if it is installed. ## Future Versions For the time being, this is a mod specifically for the Create: Astral modpack. Because of this, it will stick to the Minecraft and ModLoader version the Modpack uses. Once the development effort on Create: Astral slows down and I have the time I will look into making this mod multi-loader and update it to newer versions.

body:
# PowerBoard: Scoreboard + Tablist + Prefix + Chat | Animated
[![](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Xitee1/PowerBoard/total?color=44be16&label=Downloads)]()
[![](https://img.shields.io/discord/800477577684844585?color=44be16&label=Discord)]()

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Send%20me%20a%20small%20gift-PayPal-blue.svg)](https://paypal.me/xitee)

PowerBoard is a very powerful open source plugin for your Minecraft server.
It lets you easily add ranks, a tablist, Scoreboards and a small chat system with prefixes and placeholders.
It supports multiple (animated) scoreboards based on [conditions](https://github.com/Xitee1/PowerBoard/wiki/Conditions).
For the ranks it is recommended to use the permission sytem [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/). However, you can use any permission system you like.
If you are a more advanced server owner, you can use the PowerBoard API for easy access to scoreboard and ranks.

title: Belly Flop
description: Entities can take fall damage from landing in fluids. Also makes for very painful belly flops.
body:
## Overview

With this mod, players are capable of taking damage from falling into fluids. They may also take extra damage by landing in water while in a crawling position, triggering the namesake of the mod. *Faire un plat*, if you will.

Originally this mod was only meant to include the belly flopping mechanic (as a fairly silly roleplaying choice), and generic surface tension damage was a nice little afterthought. Credit to [Surface Tension](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/surface-tension) for doing fluid-based fall damage first!

If a player wants to actually take damage via belly flopping, it is recommended that they install a mod like [Personality](https://modrinth.com/mod/personality!) in order to assume a horizontal crawling/swimming pose before hitting the water. This also triggers a loud and unpleasant SMACK sound on impact. So immersive!

<details>
<summary>Hidden Advancement</summary>

Taking massive belly flop damage (5+ hearts) while holding an axe in both hands grants the "Viking Mode" advancement.

</details>

## Config

You can alter the following:
- The damage multiplier for falling into fluids
  - Set to **0.7** by default. Makes MLG bucket saves only slightly more forgiving than solid blocks
- The damage multiplier for falling into fluids while in a crawling pose (belly flop!)
  - Set to **1.5** by default. It takes commitment to take damage in this fashion, and I respect that
- Whether the rules of surface tension only affect players (default: **false**)

Some mobs are naturally unaffected by surface tension, such as any mob that extends `WaterAnimal` (which should include fish and some other waterborne mobs). If there are any other mobs you would like to include in that immunity, feel free to include them in the tag `belly_flop:unaffected_by_surface_tension`. By default, this tag only includes the drowned.


---

**Requires [Blueprint](https://modrinth.com/mod/blueprint) 6.2.0+.** I recommend installing [Personality](https://modrinth.com/mod/personality!) to experience everything that this mod has to offer.

title: wd's Selling Bin
description: A data-driven selling bin mod
body:
### wd's Selling bin adds a way for players to exchange their items for different currencies. 💵

\[❗\] 👷‍♀️ This mod does not include any trades by default! Scroll down or check the wiki for built-in datapacks you can use and instructions on how to make your own.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1483881/description_5fa4cdad-86cc-4d0f-97ed-0b4c01928212.png)

Leftover from selling is stored inside the bin so nothing is lost!

# Price Tooltips

*   To view the price of an item you can simply hover the item and hold shift. 💸 This behaviour can be changed in the config accessible in-game in `Mods > wd's Selling Bin > Config`

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1483881/description_099b2634-c405-46ec-993c-da38bf7f44a3.png)

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1483881/description_726a7bda-e760-4622-993d-b713986c4bd7.png)

# Automation

*   The selling bin has an auto-sell toggle and supports the use of hoppers & modded pipes to deposit items and remove the currency selected!

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1483881/description_bb61d30f-bff4-4e15-802c-afe1b9042a0e.png)

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1483881/description_9bd7038c-1669-4b3d-9568-e2e87eb4d32a.png)

# EMI & JEI Support

*   wd's Selling Bin has support for EMI & JEI! Simply check the uses for the selling bin and you can see all the sellable items & currencies registered by the server 💰

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1483881/description_e5c90db1-75cf-4d92-9220-d70d707e4345.png)

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1483881/description_7dcfa572-f637-4e14-9a60-d955f2112df0.png)

# Built-in Datapacks

There are a few built-in datapacks you can select right from the world creation screen, under the Data Packs area!

You can also use the `/datapack enable` command inside the world

![datapacks](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/47caa7d2-7cd4-4bfd-adda-5200c5e010f8)

# Mod Support & Customization (processors)

The price of an item is calculated using processors. Processors allow for nbt-based valueing, for example, if an item is damaged or has an enchantment.

## Built-in Mod Support

*   Create: Numismatics bank cards can be used to automatically transfer the sales to your bank account
*   Optional datapack for Create: Numismatics coins as currency
*   Optional datapack for Lightman's Currency's coins as currency
*   Optional datapack for Quality Food using a custom processor
*   Optional datapack for \[Let's Do\] Brewery beers using a custom processor
*   Optional datapack for \[Let's Do\] Vinery wines using a custom processor
*   Optional datapack for Starcatcher's fishes size, weight, percentile & golden values

Got a compatibility suggestion? Let me know on discord 💸

## Custom Processors

Check the wiki for the list of processors you can use directly in the datapack jsons and their properties.

# Config

wd's Selling bin also features a global sales multiplier, in case you want to use one of the built-in datapacks but think the prices across the board are too high/low.

Simply access the mod menu and click config on the bottom left.

For editing the available trades please refer to the wiki.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1483881/description_e8fec6a1-d9c2-4c6b-8f4c-93351b931a49.png)

# Wiki

[Please reference the wiki when making a datapack https://github.com/wdiscute/Selling-Bin/wiki](https://github.com/wdiscute/Selling-Bin/wiki)

There is a Guide on the syntax for the formatting settings:
```
%s%	Seconds (to next minute)
%m% 	Minutes (to next hour)
%h% 	Hours   (to next day)
%d%	Days

%tS%	Total Seconds
%tM%	Total Minutes
%tH%	Total Hours

- Insert "\n" for a line break. 
- Put "%\%" to insert a normal "%".
```

title: Shaping Up
description: Shaping Up brings a dynamic change to the pottery making experience with over 12 Quadrillion possible pots.
body:
![Title Text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9bf1b6f20319fe31ed3319fad8319cdbc0b96220.png)

Sculpt personalised pots by hand!

## Getting Started
Create your own unique pot you must craft a Pottery Wheel. These are made using Smooth Stone and any Planks of your choice.

Once your Pottery Wheel is set up you can place a Clay Ball or Clay block onto the top of the wheel, allowing it to spin and for you to start making your very own pot! Adding a whole Clay block lets you sculpt a full sized pot from the jump, or you can use Clay Balls to grow your pot layer by layer.

The Brush can be used to add decorations onto your pots layer by layer, keep interacting to cycle through a small variety of different decorations. When glazed, these decorations change colour too!

If you want more options, apply any Trim material to the pot, this creates a vibrant, unique decoration that isn't dyed with the pot.

For more variety, add a Pottery Sherd, these can show other players where you've been, and what you've faced. These change colour too!

When done, simply break the Pottery Clay and move onto one of the next steps!

## Dying Your Pots
Add any Dye of your choosing to a Water Cauldron to create a cauldron of Dye. When you interact with this cauldron you will dye the pot from the bottom upwards. Think ahead and use a variety of colours to really make your pot designs shine!

Once a pot is designed and dyed, you can craft it with a Clay block to create a duplicate, allowing you to easily create many copies of the one design without making the process feel tedious.

## The Firing Process
Place your Pottery Clay onto a lit campfire to Fire it, and then you have your fully complete Pot block! Pots can be placed in the world and act like a combination of vanilla Flower Pots and Decorated Pots. You can put a stack of any item you wish into a pot, and if it's a flower or plant, it will be displayed inside the pot just like any flower pot!


## Frequently Asked Questions
### Why am I seeing a black cube instead of a pot?
Any mods that directly intefere with the vanilla core shaders prior to release version 26.2 will cause the pots to render where they shouldn't with a pitch-black texture. Unfortunately this is an incompatability issue that cannot be resolved by a Datapack. These mods would commonly include Optifine, Sodium and possibly Distant Horizons.


Have a question? Something not working right? Join the Discord to chat directly and report any bugs you find!

title: Create: Pocket Factory
description: An independent dimensional factory module for "create" automation players. It is designed to reduce the occupation of graphics cards
body:
# Create: Pocket Factory Documentation

## 1. Project Positioning

Create: Pocket Factory is an independent dimension-based factory mod for Create automation players. It is designed to reduce GPU load.

Core ideas:

1. Move automation machines with heavy rendering cost into a separate dimension.
2. After the player leaves the factory, the machines keep running and still consume TPS, but they no longer occupy the rendering budget of the player's active area, which can significantly reduce FPS pressure.
3. Provide convenient ways to transfer fluids, items, and stress across dimensions.

## 2. Design Overview

1. Players can enter a box decorated with a white-gray checkerboard pattern in a new dimension through the entrance. This box is the Pocket Factory.
2. The Pocket Factory keeps its chunk footprint as small as possible and remains permanently loaded so that the player's machines can keep working.
3. When leaving the factory, players will first try to return to their previously recorded position. If that position is invalid, they will be sent back to the Overworld spawn point.
4. When entering the factory, the game will first try to teleport the player onto the first carpet it finds. If none is found, it will look for another safe standing position.
5. Players can spend items to expand the size of the factory.
6. The factory dimension is kept relatively bright at all times. The outer shell of the factory box is built with luminous blocks so that players do not suffer from poor visibility when entering the Pocket Factory, with or without shaders.
7. Players can use the core to right-click certain Create blocks and convert them into linked variants for cross-dimensional automation transfer.

## 3. Config Options

- Allows players to configure whether linking is restricted to inside-versus-outside factory pairing only.

## 4. Item Overview

### Factory Core

Used as the crafting ingredient for the factory entrance, and also as the main tool for creating most linked blocks:

1. Right-click Pocket Factory Block A while holding the core. This means the white blocks on the walls, ceiling, or floor inside the Pocket Factory. This triggers factory expansion. Horizontal expansion consumes 1 core each time; vertical expansion is fixed at 1 block per use.
2. Right-click two Item Vaults to convert both multiblock structures into Linked Item Vaults.
3. Right-click two Fluid Tanks to convert both multiblock structures into Linked Fluid Tanks.
4. Right-click two vertical Chutes to create a Linked Chute binding.
5. Right-click two Clutches to create a Linked Clutch binding.
6. Right-click two Mechanical Pumps to create a Linked Pump binding.
7. Can also be used to craft the factory entrance.

### Factory Entrance

- This is the standard way for normal players to enter a Pocket Factory. Place it and right-click it to teleport inside.
- The block contains a miniature model of the bound Pocket Factory. Some blocks may fail to render, but it is generally enough to identify which factory this entrance belongs to.
- Each placed entrance creates a new Pocket Factory for binding. After being broken, the binding remains, and placing it again allows access to the same factory.
- If a Factory Entrance is lost for some reason, a corresponding entrance can be restored with commands. Otherwise, that factory may become inaccessible unless cheats are enabled.

### Linked Blocks

- They cannot be crafted directly. They can only be created by converting the corresponding normal block with the Factory Core.
- When broken, they drop the normal version of the item, and the linked block on the other side reverts to its vanilla counterpart.
- Bindings are one-to-one. Container-type blocks share capacity, while logistics-type blocks cross-route their transfers.
- Their appearance remains the same as the vanilla or original Create version.
- Cross-dimensional linking is supported.
- Due to implementation limits, this mod does not provide linked Belts, Chain Drives, or other logistics devices that introduce full item-network behavior.

#### Item Vault

- Right-click two Item Vaults with the Factory Core to convert them into Linked Item Vaults.
- The entire multiblock structure is converted.
- The inventories of the linked Item Vaults are shared, and their total capacity equals the sum of both structures.
- When any block in either linked Item Vault structure is broken, the current multiblock structure is destroyed and dropped, while the linked structure on the other side reverts to a normal Item Vault structure.

#### Fluid Tank

- Right-click two Fluid Tanks with the Factory Core to convert them into Linked Fluid Tanks.
- The entire multiblock structure is converted.
- The contents of the linked Fluid Tanks are shared, and the total capacity equals the sum of both structures.
- When any block in either linked Fluid Tank structure is broken, the current multiblock structure is destroyed and dropped, while the linked structure on the other side reverts to a normal Fluid Tank structure.

#### Chute

- Right-click two Chutes with the Factory Core to convert them into Linked Chutes. Slanted Chutes are not supported.
- The outputs of Linked Chute A and B are swapped. Items entering A will drop from below B, and upward airflow entering from below B will continue upward from above A.
- When either linked Chute is broken, the linked block on the other side reverts to a normal Chute.

#### Mechanical Pump

- Right-click two Mechanical Pumps with the Factory Core to convert them into Linked Mechanical Pumps.
- The outputs of Linked Pump A and B are swapped. Fluid entering A will be pumped out from the output side of B.
- For performance reasons, pumped fluid cannot be emitted into open air as world fluid blocks.
- When either linked Mechanical Pump is broken, the linked block on the other side reverts to a normal Mechanical Pump.

#### Clutch

- Right-click two Clutches with the Factory Core to convert them into Linked Clutches.
- Linked Clutches have two states: both sides share the same signal, or both sides have different signals. In other words, this depends on whether each side is powered by redstone.
- When both sides are either powered or unpowered, the linked clutch is in straight-through mode.
- When only one side is powered, the linked clutch is in cross mode.
- In straight-through mode, the linked clutch behaves like a Shaft.
- In cross mode, the outputs of Linked Clutch A and B are swapped. Stress and rotational speed entering A's head are output from B's tail, input entering B's head is output from A's tail, input entering A's tail is output from B's head, and input entering B's tail is output from A's head.
- If one side of a crossed connection already has an input, the corresponding side on the other end is forced to be an output. For example, if A's head is already acting as an input, B's tail can no longer accept input.
- When either linked Clutch is broken, the linked block on the other side reverts to a normal Clutch.

title: Color Cone
description: Multi-mode color blindness simulation shader.
body:
[![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1321365/description_19767e94-ef82-4569-92c6-b1e8b60e6e07.png)](https://discord.gg/XgH4EpyPD2)

**Color Cone** is a real-time color vision simulation shader designed to accurately reproduce how different types of color perception and color blindness affect visual output.

---

### 👁️ Supported Vision Modes

The shader includes simulation for:

* **Normal Vision**
* **Deuteranopia (No Green Cone)**
* **Protanopia (No Red Cone)**
* **Tritanopia (No Blue Cone)**
* **Deuteranomaly (Weak Green Cone)**
* **Protanomaly (Weak Red Cone)**
* **Tritanomaly (Weak Blue Cone)**
* **Achromatopsia (No Cone Cells)**
* **Blue Cone Monochromacy**

Each mode transforms the rendered image to reflect the perceptual characteristics of the selected vision type.

---

# Red Green Blue - Test

## Deuteranopia (No Green Cone)
![Deuteranopia](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5910ebd79f3e79bdd1e5233f4a2764115e252332.png)

## Protanopia (No Red Cone)

## Tritanopia (No Blue Cone)
![Tritanopia](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79190e2a763d3ce9892450e251de358b4b775be7.png)

## Achromatopsia (No Cone Cells)
![Achromatopsia](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bcfb0633549e7eb95b1c5a0544195a3bb5500ac0_0.webp)

---

### ⚙️ How It Works

* Applies cone response transformation matrices
* Adjusts RGB channel sensitivity per vision profile
* Simulates full dichromacy, anomalous trichromacy, and monochromacy
* Runs efficiently in real time

---

### 🎯 Use Cases

* Accessibility testing
* Inclusive game & UI design
* Educational visualization
* Visual research & experimentation

---

### 🚀 Key Features

* Single shader, multiple vision profiles
* Fast and lightweight implementation
* Easy integration into rendering pipelines
* Accurate perceptual approximation

Color Cone helps developers, designers, and researchers better understand how visuals are perceived across different types of color vision.
