title: Ultra Vanish
description: Ultra Vanish is a lightweight, modern vanish plugin for Paper/Spigot 1.20+ with instant vanish, persistent invisibility, hidden join/quit messages, and seamless staff visibility
body:
# 🕶️ Ultra Vanish

**Ultra Vanish** is the ultimate vanish plugin for Minecraft 1.21+ — designed to be smooth, reliable, and admin-friendly.  
It’s lightweight, fast, and built to give your staff full control over visibility — without any of the usual bugs or re-log issues.

---

## ✨ Features

✅ **Instant Vanish / Unvanish**  
- Toggle invisibility for yourself or other players with `/v` or `/vanish`  
- Zero delay, zero re-log needed  

✅ **Persistent Vanish State**  
- Your vanish status is automatically saved in `config.yml`  
- When you leave and rejoin, you stay vanished!  

✅ **No Join/Quit Messages**  
- Vanished players don't trigger join/quit notifications  
- Perfect for stealthy admin logins  

✅ **Always See Each Other**  
- Vanished players can *always* see other vanished players — no permissions required  
- Never get confused about who’s still online in staff mode  

✅ **Tablist Integration**  
- Vanished players show up with a clean **[V]** prefix in the tablist  
- Visible only to vanished players and those with `vanish.see`  

✅ **Multi-Player Visibility System**  
- Uses `hidePlayer()` / `showPlayer()` logic for every player pair  
- Instantly updates for all players — no need to relog or rejoin  

✅ **Scoreboard-Safe Prefix System**  
- Uses isolated scoreboard teams (no TAB/LP interference)  
- Prefix updates instantly without flickering  

✅ **Fully Configurable + Lightweight**  
- Zero dependencies, runs on Paper/Spigot 1.20 → 1.21+  
- No commands spam, no lag, no scoreboard conflicts  

---

## ⚙️ Commands

| Command | Description |
|----------|--------------|
| `/v` | Toggle vanish for yourself |
| `/vanish` | Same as `/v` |
| `/v <player>` | Toggle vanish for another player (requires permission) |

---

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|-------------|--------------|----------|
| `vanish.use` | Allows a player to toggle their own vanish | `op` |
| `vanish.others` | Allows toggling vanish for other players | `op` |
| `vanish.see` | Allows seeing vanished players | `op` |
| `vanish.maintain` | Allows seeing `[V]` indicators in tab | `op` |

---

## 💾 Configuration

When first run, Ultra Vanish automatically creates:
```

plugins/UltraVanish/config.yml

````

Example section (automatically managed):
```yaml
vanished:
  123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000: true
````

No manual configuration required — everything just works.

---

## 🧩 Compatibility

* ✅ Paper 1.20 – 1.21
* ✅ Spigot 1.20 – 1.21
* ✅ Works with TAB, LuckPerms, ProtocolLib (optional)
* ⚡ No NMS, reflection, or version-specific hacks

---

## 🧠 Technical Highlights

* Uses `ConcurrentHashMap` for vanish state — thread-safe and fast
* Scoreboard prefixes isolated per viewer (no global override)
* Dual-tick refresh (instant + 1 tick later) ensures perfect sync
* Full persistence and cleanup on disable

---

## 🧱 Requirements

* Minecraft Server **Paper / Spigot 1.20+**
* Java 17 or higher (tested on Java 21)

---

## 🔗 Links

* 🌍 [Website](https://jonasgrimm.de)
* 🛠️ Author: **beqare / Jonas Grimm**

---

## ❤️ Credits

Created by **Jonas Grimm (beqare)** — clean, minimal, and reliable vanish solution
for modern Minecraft servers.

---

> 🕶️ *Stay hidden, stay clean — with Ultra Vanish.*

title: Cataclysms [By TheOman]
description: Adds a lot of dark creatures and storyline.
body:
**Download GeckoLib for work !**
                                        
                                        
This mod is NOT COMPATIBLE with L_Enders cataclysm mod... Sorry! This is due to the same mod ID/Domain.
  
It's dark here...

It's dark there...


The mod adds a multitude of dark creatures, bosses and events.

To get the Light or Dark Shards, you need to have the Hare attack you and it will drop them!

Quick fact: the flyers that The Real Cataclysm summons are different from the flyers that spawn on their own.

PLEASE WHEN THEY TELL YOU TO RUN DO WHAT YOU ARE TOLD!

If you find any errors, please report them in the comments.

How to **complete the mod?** Yes, the mod has a plot and you can complete it like this: 

**.Wait until the Demon Hare (Cataclysm) attacks you (Run will be written on the screen and in the chat) And you must survive from it. Over time, fragments will fall out of it - 4 light and 1 dark. Then it will disappear and you can make a cross (use JEI for details) After creating a cross, after a while a silhouette will appear and start hunting you. You will need to approach it and it will grab you. You must hit it with a cross and the boss fight will begin. After defeating it, you can find a Hare somewhere nearby who is simply sad ... You must interact with it and it will get up ... HERE IT IS! THE BEFORE THE LAST AND MOST DIFFICULT BOSS - The Real Cataclysm! You defeated the hare and now you are given The Holy Sword that destroys almost all dark creatures with one blow. But suddenly a mini boss will come - C.R.O.W who wants to avenge the death of the cataclysm. By killing him you will receive a dark beak and other fragments. From the dark beak you can make a sword that is strong and atk when you press RMB does something. After some time, Notch himself will give you a gift! You will need to make a sphere out of it (You can eat it, but it's not worth it) The sphere will be needed to crush what will come 3 days after killing The Real Cataclysm - the creature that no one has seen, it is angry because you destroyed its creatures. But the sphere that you made is much more powerful and when you press the RMB when the creature decides to attack you, it will be destroyed, but ... His deputy will come to the rescue. That's what they called him. This is the last boss of the mod. After defeating him, you will finally complete the mod and no creature of darkness will be able to be in the world anymore! (The Real Cataclysm Spawn WILL ONLY BE AVAILABLE IN 1.0.7.5 and the appearance of the final boss - the deputy can only be seen in version 1.1.5).**

It is not recommended to kill the silhouette in a confined space, as this may affect the spawn of the final boss.



Dark-light Block can give you positive effects or drain, and can also be destroyed (random)



To get cataclysm blood you need to: right-click on cataclysm with the butt in your hand and then you will get blood
To get the real cataclysm blood all the same but right-click on the cataclysm boss.





                                                             LORE:



First, a creature appeared that no one had ever seen. It created Silhouette, the Demon Hare, and the Angel. The Angel was always in heaven. Silhouette declared himself king and the Hare began to worship him, but the Angel did not and left Silhouette. The Hare looked for players but could not catch 2 players who were very strong and agile, so the Silhouette decided to catch them himself, and he was able. They became - ??? and ?!?. They worshiped Silhouette and joked about the Hare, but he could not touch them but threatened them. The Hare caught a player who mined diamonds and gave he to Silhouette, who decided to experiment and not only infected him but also mutated into a large creature, his name became Crush. The Rabbit caught the Sniffer and also gave it to Silhouette. He also mutated the Sniffer and he became Observer, which served to transport players and defend. But you came and wanted to stop this madness......................After the death of Silhouette, the Hare went crazy and became the new king who began to continue the work of the silhouette... BUT when you were able to defeat this boss, the same angel who had not left heaven for 10 years came and gave you the Holy Blade and also gave you a lot of experience. One day, an unknown creature appeared, nicknamed C.R.O.W (its origin is unknown, but most likely it was created by a creature that no one has seen) Who hates you for killing The Real Cataclysm and will try to kill you, but you can fight back... But this is not the end... Maybe the creature that no one has ever seen is not very happy that you killed his creations? Apparently now someone will see him... (THE FOLLOWING ONLY AVAILABLE IN VERSION 1.1.5) - After the destruction of the supreme being, his deputy will come and this is the other boss...

If you do not wait for the appearance of the cataclysm (hare), then run the command /run

DO NOT CONFUSE THIS MOD WITH ANOTHER POPULAR MOD WITH A SIMILAR NAME (L_enders Cataclysm)

title: Little John's: Galvanized Square Steel

body:
# Little John's: Galvanized Square Steel 

**Little John's is a cosmetic and QoL mod that adds a varity of different building blocks that are inspired by the meme room redesigning videos found on Tiktok, Instagram Reels or Youtube Shorts.**

![Cherry plank, wood and leaf covers as well as Cherry Wood Fences, a Cherry Plank Wall and a Cherry Table Saw](https://i.ibb.co/jbfWJH5/Cherry-Showcase.png)
_Cherry plank, wood and leaf covers as well as Cherry Wood Fences, a Cherry Plank Wall and a Cherry Table Saw_


## Features:

### Eco Friendly Veneers:
- Leaf Veneers (incl. Bamboo, Crimson and Warped; Cherry generates leaf particles)
- Plank Veneers
- Log Veneers
- Moss and Grass Veneers
- -> Waterloggable


### Galvanized Square Steel:
- Galvanized Square Steel and Galvanited Square Steel Grates
- Screws Borrowed From Aunt
- Galvanized Square Steel Beams
- -> Waterloggable


### Table Saws:
- New Table Saw Block for all vanilla wood types
- Alternative to the Stonecutter, supports all stonecutting recipes, even other modded recipes
- New woodcutting recipes (also work on stonecutter)
- -> Waterloggable


### Chains:
- Grand Chains
- Colossal Chains
- Golden Chains (incl. Golden Grand and Golden Colossal Chains)
- -> Waterloggable


### Frameworks:
- New Wood Frameworks for all Vanilla Log Types
- -> Waterloggable


### Chandeliers:
- New Chandelier Block for all Candle Types
- Can be placed like a lantern; hanging or standing (Will break without supporting block)
- When lit will emit light level 15, regardless of hanging or standing
- -> Waterloggable


### Fences:
- New Fences and Fence Gates made from Log Blocks
- Functioning exactly like vanilla fences


### Walls:
- New Walls made from both Plank and Log Blocks
- Functioning like wooden walls would (who couldve guessed)
- -> Plank variant probably not craftable without a mod like [Polymorph](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymorph), since the recipe is the same as the Trapdoor recipe, however the walls can still be crafted using either a stonecutter or a table saw


### Hedges:
- Basically Walls, but as leaves


### Stairs:
- Log Stairs 
- Function like... stairs


### Slabs:
- Log Slabs
- Functioning like... well yes, slabs
- If placed as a double slab, they take the look of the log standing vertical


### Music Disc:
- A music disc covering [Crazy Donkey - Morsmordre](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yavTMAPeqOw), also known as the Galvanized Square Steel Theme
- -> Craftable, not receivable through loot
- -> Discontinued starting 1.21.5 release (may return)


-> All Covers as well as galvanized steel blocks and wood frameworks are placeable, similar to glow lichen; all Covers are also waterloggable and dont require any support blocks



## Work in progress (NOT YET ADDED!):

### Candle Holders:
- Functioning very much like Torches, however can be lit with flint and steel and waterlogged
- Supporting all vanilla Candle types

---

-> There will be more blocks added in the future, I'd love to hear your ideas though, maybe they could be added next.

## CobbleBadgesBox
## (Multi-)Box 8 Badges-Slot with customizable boosts !
**CobbleBadgesBox** introduces a unique Badges Box(es) & Permanent activable Boosts system. Collect badges to unlock permanent passive bonuses for your character and your Pokémon team!

**Features**
- **!NEW! Standard Multi-Page / Seasonal Boxes / Free Modes !** > MULTI = Multi-page with page button, cumulative boosts / SEASONAL = More than 8 badges possible, but, no page button, only 8 slot and boost available, perfect for seasonal badges and/or over-cumulative bonus cause of only 8 boost slots can be enabled / FREE = More than 8 badges possible, but player is free to choose !
- **!NEW! TAG & RIDE "Boost"** > TAG = giving specified tag in tag / RIDE = Let the player been able to ride his Pokemon
- **!NEW! Disabling Riding by default Setting** _(False by default)_
- **!NEW! KeepBadgesonDeath / DropBadgesonDeath Settings** _(True / False by default)_
- **!NEW! Badge Box Item** _(not craftable)_
- **!NEW! Ability to unable / disable the "/cbb" command via config**

- **Custom Interface:** A **dedicated 8-slot inventory** for your badges (`/cbb`).
- **Custom Effects:** Custom Effects Types + Values : POTION / XP_BOOST / IV_BOOST / EV_BOOST / CATCH_RATE / !NEW! TAG / !NEW! RIDE
- **Custom Badges:** Set which badge item id is for each slot and define your own custom effect, name, color and description !
- **Multi-Boxes:** You will can create as many 8-slot pages you want !
- **Minecraft Boosts:** Unlock effects like **25% Walk Speed** & **Infinite Water Breathing** or **any Potion effect you want** !
- **Cobblemon Boosts:**
**XP Boost:** +10% & +15% experience boosts for a total of 25% Exp final Boost.
**Catch Rate:** +10% capture chance for cathing more pokémon.
**IV / EV :** Boosts **IVs** upon capture (up to +4 for EVERY capture) and accelerates **EV** training trough battles with 25% boost.
- **Total Control:** Toggle each badge's effect on or off at any moment via a clean GUI directly in-game.
- **Integrated default Badges:** 8 integrated default Badges in you don't have others !
- **Auto-Grabbing/Stocking:** When player get the item defined as a badge in the config, the system grab it and lock it into the data & interface
- **Keep Badges at death or not:** Setting for losing badges or not when player died + if player looting his badges or not

**Commands**

` /cbb `
> Opens the badge management interface.

` /cbb add-page `
> Adding a 8-Slot page to the BadgesBox (will add a page switching button to the interface).

` /cbb reload `
> Reload config changes (yes it'll check badges too so if id change > Slot will be wiped).

` /cbb reset <player> <slot_number|all> `
> *(Admin)* Resets a player's badges (useful for new seasons).

title: Radiant
description: This mod aims to integrate Minecraft into the Cosmere universe and add the Radiant Orders from the Stormlight Archive series by Brandon Sanderson
body:
Minecraft Mod based on the Stormlight Archive by Brandon Sanderson. This mod is a fan made project to bring the knights radiants from the works of fiction of Brandon Sanderson to minecraft. The mod contains **SPOILERS** up to **Wind and Truth**.


# **Help Wanted**

I feel that the artistic side of the mod could be much better. I’ve done what I could, but let’s be kind and say it’s not exactly my strong suit. If you think you can improve any of the current textures or models in the mod, open a GitHub issue and let’s see what we can do. I’d be especially interested in improving the model for the Cultivationspren or the Shardplates.

# **FAQ**
## Is the mod multiplayer-friendly?
The mod is intended to be multiplayer friendly but hasn't been properly tested yet. If you found any problems please report it.
## Will you backport the mod to an older version?
No, this mod is made with Mcreator and the tool only supports two versions at a time so its imposible for me to backport it.
## Will you add new content?
Yes, I want to add the new knowledge learned in Wind and Truth or the Cosmere RPG when its released in July, now we know more about some surges than when I started the project.
## When are you gonna update to a new version?
As said previously this mod is made with Mcreator so until the tool updates to a newer version I cannot make anything, the good thing is that once this happens it is extremly easy to update the mod.
## Where is the fifth Ideal?
We currently know next to nothing of the Fith Oath what it does (and the rpg isn't going to add any new information) so until we know more about it expect the Bondsmith treatment, not planned.
## Future Content

- Banner Patterns for each Radiant Order
- Gems in Metal Cages
- Naming your Spren
- Investiture use changing depending on your Oaths progression
- More aluminum funcionality

title: [MTR4] JR East E233 Series | JR東日本 E233系
description: The resourcepack that adds E233 series into minecraft via Minecraft Transit Railway mod
body:
# Orerview
The E233 series (E233系) is a commuter and suburban electric multiple unit (EMU) train type developed by East Japan Railway Company (JR East) from the earlier E231 series and the E531 series design. The first train was introduced in December 2006 for use on the Chūō Line (Rapid), followed by the E233-1000 series variant in 2007 for use on the Keihin–Tōhoku and Negishi lines, the E233-3000 series outer-suburban variant in December 2007 for use on the Tōkaidō Main Line, and narrow-bodied E233-2000 series variant for Jōban Line and Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line through services. Further variants were built for use on the Keiyō Line, Yokohama Line, Saikyō Line, and Nambu Line.                                                                 
                                                                                             
The E233 series features two identical sets of main equipment in case of failure. This is the first JR East stock to feature such backup measures. The E233 series provides for better accessibility for the disabled, and is designed to be more comfortable to ride overall than previous stock. The height between the platform and the train was reduced from the 80 mm (3.1 in) of the 201 and 209 series to only 30 mm (1.2 in). Seats are 460 mm (18.1 in) wide, compared to the 430 mm (16.9 in) of the 201 series and 450 mm (17.7 in) of the 209 series.For standing passengers the handle straps have been lowered by 50 mm (2.0 in) compared to older 
train models.
## This pack includes:
### E233 Series:
- E233-0
- E233-1000
- E233-3000

- Acceleration and deceleration: 2.5 - 2.9 km/h/s

title: Convert Vanilla Horses to SWEM (Star Worm Equestrian) Horses
description: A lightweight datapack that automatically replaces vanilla horses with SWEM horses — no command blocks required. Runs every tick to ensure full immersion when using the Star Worm Equestrian Mod (SWEM).
body:
📦 Description
This (unofficial) really small, simple and lightweight datapack automatically replaces vanilla Minecraft horses with SWEM (Star Worm Equestrian) horses for any world or server — completely in the background and without any need for command blocks. 

It runs every tick and uses an optimized execute command  to detect vanilla horses and summon their SWEM equivalent at the same position.

🧠 Designed for modded servers or singleplayer worlds using the Star Worm Equestrian Mod (SWEM), where you want to fully transition from vanilla to SWEM's horses.

💡 Honestly — this is something the original mod should have done from the beginning. Or at the very least offered as a simple config toggle (true/false). But for some unknown reason, it wasn’t included. Why? I don't know... So this datapack steps in to do exactly what SWEM overlooked: a smooth, automatic replacement of vanilla horses with SWEM horses.

No commands... No setup... 
Just horses that work the way you'd expect in a SWEM-based world.

![How it works](https://i.postimg.cc/T3PBkDKd/Film-bez-tytu-u-Wykonano-za-pomoc-Clipchamp-3.gif)


🛠️ Compatibility
- ✅ Tested with Minecraft 1.20.1 (requires SWEM mod).
- ⚠️ Should be compatible with 1.16.5 & 1.18.2 (same datapack structure - but not guaranteed & not tested).

If you encounter any issues or want to suggest improvements — just let me know (kindly, please!) and leave a comment [(on CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/convert-vanilla-horses-to-swem-horses/comments)!

🔧 How to Install
1. Download the .zip file.
2. Drop it into your world's /datapacks/ folder.
3. Start your world or server.
4. Run /reload (if needed).
5. Done!

✨ Feel free to use this datapack in your own world, server, modpack
Just enjoy it and ride off into the blocky sunset. 🐎🌅

Also on CurseForge

title: Stonecutting Upgrade
description: Bigger stonecutter menus, remembered recipes, and quick refills for speedy crafting.
body:
Stonecutting Upgrade gives the stonecutter menu the overhaul it deserves. 🪨 With a larger recipe selection area, smoother scrolling, and a more convenient layout, stonecutting finally feels comfortable to use again.

No more constantly scrolling through cramped recipe lists or reselecting the same block over and over. This mod remembers your last recipe and includes quick refill controls to keep crafting flowing smoothly. ✨

Best of all, the mod is fully client side, making it easy to use anywhere without requiring server installation. ⚙️

  • 🪨 Expanded Recipe Menu: The stonecutter now displays up to 21 recipes at once instead of vanilla's 12.
  • 🧱 Improved Layout: Inputs, outputs, and recipe selection are rearranged for a cleaner workflow.
  • ✨ Smoother Scrolling: Recipe lists scroll more smoothly for faster and more comfortable browsing.
  • 🔁 Remember Last Recipe: Previously selected recipes are automatically restored when adding more materials.
  • ⌨️ Quick Refill Controls: Press the space bar to refill a single item to the input slot (or a fully stack while holding any shift key).
  • 🌍 Fully Client Side: Enjoy all features without needing the mod installed on servers.

⏩ INSTALLATION REQUIRED ON CLIENT

⏩ REQUIRES PUZZLES LIB TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC & NEOFORGE)

⏩ REQUIRES FABRIC API TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC)

⏩ REQUIRES FORGE CONFIG API PORT TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC)

If available for a mod, configuration is possible directly from in-game using the mod menu (requires Mod Menu by Prospector to be installed on Fabric).

For manual configuration using an external text editor all files are found at .minecraft/config, named as MOD_ID-client.toml, MOD_ID-common.toml, or MOD_ID-server.toml, depending on the type of config. Not all types might exist for a mod, if any at all.

🌟 Thanks to weirdbrackets and their Portable Stonecutter mod for inspiring the improved stonecutter menu.

title: SCP-3008, The Infinite Ikea
description: An endless furniture store that traps those who enter.
body:
The Infinite Ikea adds a new item. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-3008, also known as the Infinite Ikea.


SCP-3008 appears as a regular Ikea building, but entering it teleports the player into an endless interior world filled with rooms resembling areas like living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms and gardens. The dimension is flat and enclosed by bedrock, ensuring there’s no escape except through the exit door, if you can find it. When night falls, the lights flicker off and an announcement echoes through the halls as faceless Ikea staff become violently aggressive. To escape, players must find a rare Store Key, sometimes dropped by these creatures during the night.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Why is there no 1.19.2 Version?

There is no 1.19.2 version of SCP-3008 because MCreator works different in lower versions, which means that some features aren't in 1.19.2. Some Features also break if you port them back to 1.19.2.

► Why do I find empty holes in SCP-3008?

Due to the generation of SCP-3008, it can happen rarely that you find an empty hole in the ground.

► Where does SCP-3008 spawn?

SCP-3008 spawns as structure in the overworld in plains, savannas, desert, forests or badlands. There may be multiple SCP-3008s.

</details>



![SCP-3008](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cad8e78e655749e98427adaaaf1613b02853b742_0.webp)

SCP-3008 itself is an anomalous spatial structure resembling a normal Ikea store from the outside. Upon entering, players are transported into a separate dimension that extends infinitely in all directions. The interior is filled with repeating furniture displays and various themed areas like bedrooms, living rooms, bathrooms, kitchens, and gardens. The store’s lights follow a day-night cycle, and when night falls, the lights will go out and the Creatures inside turn hostile... The only way out is through another Exit Door by right clicking it with a Store Key.

 

- Config File not inculed.
- You are all allowed to use this mod in your modpacks!
- Do not port my mods without permission!

title: polymorph but it's for fabric only but also for 1.21.10
description: No more recipe conflicts! Adds an option to choose the crafting result if more than one is available. (Unofficial fork, updated for Minecraft 1.21.10)
body:
**This is an unofficial fork of [Polymorph](https://github.com/illusivesoulworks/polymorph) by [IllusiveSoulworks](https://github.com/illusivesoulworks), updated for Minecraft 1.21.10.**

Polymorph is a mod that solves recipe conflicts by letting players choose between all potential outputs shared by the same ingredients.

With a sufficiently large amount of mods, recipe conflicts are a common occurrence and the responsibility for resolving these usually falls on the user or modpack developer, using datapacks or other tools to ensure that each recipe is unique.

Polymorph offers an alternative solution, allowing all possible crafting and smelting recipes to co-exist regardless of conflicts.

## Fork Information

This fork updates Polymorph for **Minecraft 1.21.10** (Fabric only).

### Changes from original:

- Updated to Minecraft 1.21.10 API
- Fixed smithing recipe handling for new recipe structure
- Removed NeoForge/Forge support (Fabric only)
- Various API compatibility fixes

### Original Project

- **Author:** [IllusiveSoulworks](https://github.com/illusivesoulworks)
- **Repository:** [github.com/illusivesoulworks/polymorph](https://github.com/illusivesoulworks/polymorph)
- **CurseForge:** [Polymorph](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/polymorph)

If you appreciate this mod, please support the original developer via [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/C0C1NL4O).

## Features

### Crafting

![](https://i.ibb.co/TkWswkG/polymorph.gif)

When a group of ingredients matches more than one recipe, a button will appear above the output slot. Pushing this button will show a list of all possible results and selecting one will change the crafting output to match. Polymorph will also remember the last selection as long as the ingredients don't change, so repeated crafting actions are possible on the same selection.

### Smelting

![](https://i.ibb.co/QX9MNYM/polymorph-furnacedemo.gif)

When a valid input matches more than one output, a button will appear above the output slot. Pushing this button will show a list of all possible results with the currently selected result highlighted in green. Selecting one of the listed results will change the smelting output to match. This selection will be saved to the block itself and persist across world loading and unloading.

### Commands

To assist identifying potential conflicts, there's a command `/polymorph conflicts` that will try to identify recipes that conflict with each other and outputs a list of them to your logs folder.

RU-Русский # ✨ Описание 🎯 Этот шейдер упрощает процесс создания **качественного хромакея**, используя рендер с шейдером в качестве маски игрока вместо сложных настроек освещения и фона. ⚡ С его помощью вы сможете быстро отделить персонажа от фона без традиционной работы с зелёным экраном. --- ## 🛠 Как это работает 1️⃣ Установите данный шейдер. 2️⃣ Запишите **два футажа** с помощью любого мода для записи, например 🎥 [ReplayMod](https://www.replaymod.com/) или 📀 [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback): - 🎨 Один — с **активным шейдером** (он будет служить маской игрока). - 🖤 Второй — **без шейдера** (основная картинка). 3️⃣ В программе для монтажа примените эффект **Ключ маски дорожки** 🖌 к основному футажу, используя запись с шейдером как маску. 4️⃣ Получите аккуратный 🎯 **хромакей персонажа**, готовый к дальнейшему использованию в ваших видео. --- ## 💎 Преимущества - 🪄 **Простота** — не требуется настраивать освещение или подбирать фон. - 🎯 **Качество** — ровная маска персонажа без артефактов. --- ## 📋 Требования - 🔹 Любой загрузчик шейдеров ([Iris]([https://irisshaders.net/](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)) или [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/)). - 🔹 Мод для записи футажей (рекомендовано: [ReplayMod](https://www.replaymod.com/) или [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback)). - 🔹 Программа для монтажа с поддержкой эффекта `Ключ маски дорожки`. --- Так же в помощь мой ролик про шейдеры:
EN-English # ✨ Description 🎯 This shader simplifies the process of creating a **high-quality chroma key**, using a render with the shader as a player mask instead of complex lighting setups and backgrounds. ⚡ With it, you can quickly separate the player from the background without the traditional hassle of setting up a green screen. --- ## 🛠 How It Works 1️⃣ Install this shader. 2️⃣ Record **two footages** using any recording mod, for example 🎥 [ReplayMod](https://www.replaymod.com/) or 📀 [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback): - 🎨 One — with **the shader enabled** (this will serve as the player mask). - 🖤 Another — **without the shader** (main video). 3️⃣ In your video editing software, apply the **Track Matte Key** 🖌 effect to the main footage, using the shader render as the mask. 4️⃣ Get a clean 🎯 **player chroma key**, ready to use in your videos. --- ## 💎 Benefits - 🪄 **Simplicity** — no need to adjust lighting or set up a background. - 🎯 **Quality** — clean player mask without artifacts. --- ## 📋 Requirements - 🔹 Any shader loader ([Iris]([https://irisshaders.net/](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)) or [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/)). - 🔹 A recording mod (recommended: [ReplayMod](https://www.replaymod.com/) or [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback)). - 🔹 Video editing software with support for `Track Matte Key` (or similar) effects.

title: WildLight
description: This modpack transforms Minecraft into an immersive world full of exploration and realism.
body:
# 🌲 WildLight

Step into a world where survival meets subtle beauty. In WildLight, every sound, texture, and detail is crafted to pull you deeper into a refined Minecraft experience. Explore vast landscapes, survive harsh conditions, and uncover the forgotten logic of a world shaped by realism. This is not just Vanilla — it’s nature, reborn through immersion.

## ✨ Features

### 🎧 Enhanced soundscapes and ambient effects ✨

Put on your headphones and listen to the beautiful, magical sounds of nature. With mods like **AmbientSounds** for natural ambience, **Presence Footsteps** that add unique walking sounds, and **Sound Physics Remastered** which makes audio more realistic, you'll feel more immersed in the game more than ever before.

For visuals, countless new particles and stunning shaders make the world more breathtaking than ever. **Particular** add beautiful little animations that make the game feel alive, with waterfalls, falling leaves, and so much more. I also love **Subtle Effects**, it makes fire look truly magical. And of course, with **Iris** for shaders and **Complementary Unbound** enhanced by **Euphoria Patches**, every visual detail looks absolutely incredible.

### 🌄 Diverse new landscapes and discoveries 🔍

Create a new world and discover the richness of the new biomes added by **Biomes O' Plenty**, which introduces a ton of diverse biomes. The Nether also features new biomes thanks to **Pyrellium**. There's also **Wilder Wild**, which adds new biomes and structures to make the world feel even more realistic.

Throughout your world, you'll also encounter many new or revamped structures. **Towns and Towers** adds new villages and pillages outposts, while the End hasn't been forgotten, **Moog's End Structures** brings fresh exploration opportunities there as well. Several Vanilla structures have also been revamped with the **YUNG's** mods.

### ✨ Intuitive quality-of-life improvements 🧬

Countless QoL mods have been added, each playing an important role in the modpack. The essential **AppleSkin** shows you the potential hunger restored while holding food. **Auto HUD** lets you admire the beautiful world by automatically hiding and showing the hotbar, and as a complement, **Dynamic Crosshair** displays useful information right on your crosshair.

There are also many "Better" mods, but **Better Third Person** is especially great if you enjoy playing in third person. If you prefer the first-person view, **First-person Model** allows you to see your own body just like in real life. Another excellent QoL mod is **InvMove**, which lets you move while using your inventory.

In game, you'll never see annoying pop-ups, but if you prefer having them, you can easily configure toasts in the **No More Pop-ups** config via **Mod Menu**.

### 📈 An optimized experience 🔧

You don't have 32Gb RAM, a powerful graphic card, or a high-end chip? No problem! Many mods are included to optimize Minecraft's performance, **Sodium** is one of the most well-known. But there is also **Dynamic FPS**, which reduces memory usage when the game window is unfocused. **ImmediatelyFast** optimizes all immediate mode rendering, while **Concurrent Chunk Management Engine** improves chunk performance. **Entity Culling** is also used to hide blocks and entities that aren't visible.

You can check **Opions Profiles** menu to instantly load custom settings based on your PC's performance. There are 4 presets available:

- Default: The default setup (tested on a Mac Mini M2)
- Performance: No shaders, fast rendering, maximum possible FPS
- Balanced: Uses shaders, offers a middle ground between Performance and Quality
- Quality: Uses shaders, provides maximum visual fidelity, best for powerful PCs

### 🎨 A fresh look at a beautiful UI ✨

The new UI starts at the launch of the game, a little but appreciated mod **Dark Loading Screen**, after, you'll remark a revisited menu thanks to **FancyMenu**. All the GUI has also changed by the **Recolourfull Containers GUI + HUD (DARK)** resource pack. You'll also notice that there are a lot of icons into the buttons, they are created by **Icons**. All this new UI is now smooth when they appeared (**Smooth Gui**), when you scroll (**Smooth Scrolling**) and more. Some resource packs and mods has little UI bugs, so I created **WildLight Compat** mod to patch them manually for a better experience.

### 🛜 Multiplayer 🌍

This modpack is great to play solo, but it's even better to enjoy with friends using [Wabbanode](http://wabbanode.com/affiliate/wildlight). Several mods are included to enhance the multiplayer experience.

For chat, **Better Selection** makes text easier and more pleasant to select, while **Chat Heads** displays player avatar in the chat, just like profile pictures next to message. And finally, I know how annoying it is when you accidentally hit a friend and all the dogs start attacking each other. Now you can calm them down with **Calm down, dog**.

## 🔧 Recommendation

It is recommended to allocate at least 4GB of RAM to Minecraft. This helps ensure smoother performance and reduces lag.

## 🙏 Credits

- Thanks to [nNoidea](https://github.com/nNoidea) for Eating Animation support for Wilder Wild compatibility! (via [Eating Animation PR #62](https://github.com/Theoness1/EatingAnimation/pull/62)) (not anymore in this mod, but in this [resource pack](https://github.com/Alfakynz/Eating-Animation-Modded)).
- Thanks to the [FrozenBlock team](https://modrinth.com/organization/tuit06dH) for [WilderWild](https://modrinth.com/project/AtHRJSUW), and to [voxelotl](https://modrinth.com/user/GgcBbYdM) for allowing me to add some of their textures to the resource pack!
- Thanks to Annie for making the beautiful WildLight logo

## 🚀 Planned Features

- A quest book to discover the mods in the modpack or custom advancements
- A refreshed interface
- Better performance

## 🌐 Looking for a server? Support me at the same time!

Want to play with friends? Get your own server with [Wabbanode](http://wabbanode.com/affiliate/wildlight).

Use the code **WILDLIGHT** to support me and get 25% off.

title: Simple RTP
description:
SimpleRTP is a lightweight and fully configurable random teleport plugin for Paper 1.21.10.
It provides fast, safe, and async-powered teleports across Overworld, Nether, and End — with proper chunk preloading and full WorldBorder support.
body:
🌍 SimpleRTP – Fast, Safe & Configurable Random Teleportation

SimpleRTP is designed to provide a smooth and instant random teleport experience without lag spikes or unsafe landings. Built for modern Paper servers (1.21.10) and fully compatible with Folia, it uses asynchronous chunk preloading to eliminate teleport delays.

⚡ Key Features

GUI-based /rtp system

Supports Overworld, Nether, and End

Fully configurable per-world settings

Async chunk preloading for minimal delay

Safe location detection

WorldBorder-aware teleportation

Cooldown & countdown system

Bedrock compatible (Geyser friendly)

No NMS

No external dependencies required

🚀 Performance & Chunk Handling

SimpleRTP ensures smooth teleports by:

Preloading the destination chunk asynchronously before teleporting

Avoiding main-thread blocking operations

Preventing lag spikes during chunk generation

Respecting the WorldBorder automatically

Only teleporting inside valid border limits

If chunks are already pregenerated (e.g., via Chunky), teleports are nearly instant.
If not, the plugin safely loads only the necessary chunks without freezing the server.

🛡 Safe Teleport System

The plugin guarantees safe landing locations:

Only teleports onto configured safe blocks

Avoids lava, water, fire, magma, void, etc.

Ensures two air blocks above the player

Multiple attempts if unsafe location found

If no safe location is found after defined attempts, the teleport is cancelled gracefully.

🎛 Fully Configurable

Each world entry allows you to configure:

Target world

Min & max distance from spawn

Active / disabled state

GUI slot & material

Cooldown duration

Sounds & messages

Safe and unsafe blocks

You can also disable specific worlds (e.g. End) directly in the config.
Disabled worlds will display as “deactivated” in the GUI.

🌐 WorldBorder Integration

SimpleRTP automatically respects:

Bukkit WorldBorder size

Custom world borders

Chunk boundaries

Players will never be teleported outside of the valid border area.

🧠 Technical Highlights

Java 21

Maven-based project

Folia-ready architecture

Async location search

Async chunk loading

Clean separation of logic (RTPManager, SafeLocationFinder, etc.)

💡 Recommended Setup

For best performance:

Pregenerate chunks within your RTP radius using Chunky

Keep max-distance within your pregenerated area

Avoid extremely large radii on ungenerated worlds

title: IA-Edit
description: A minecraft plugin that integrates WorldEdit and FAWE with custom blocks from ItemsAdder
body:
IA-Edit is a Minecraft plugin designed to bridge the gap between ItemsAdder's custom blocks and the powerful editing capabilities of WorldEdit and FastAsyncWorldEdit (FAWE).

# Key Features:
- ✅ Supports all WorldEdit & FAWE commands (like `//set`, `//replace`, `//cut`, `//copy`, `//paste`, `//undo`, `//redo` and more)
- ✅ Supports schematics with ItemsAdder blocks
- ✅ Entities like furniture can be copied with `//copy -e` & `//paste -e`
- ✅ Autocompletion for ItemsAdder blocks (itemsadder:name)

# Installation & Usage:
1. 📦 **Dependencies:** Ensure that your server has the following plugins installed:
   - [ItemsAdder](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/itemsadder.73355/)
   - [FastAsyncWorldEdit (Recommended)](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/fast-async-worldedit.13932/)
2. 📥 **Installation:** Download the IA-Edit plugin and place it into your server's `plugins` directory.
3. 🔄 **Restart Server:** Restart your server to load the plugin.

title: Inventory Organizer
description: This Inventory Organizer mod for Minecraft adds useful commands that help players efficiently manage and organize their inventories.
body:
# Inventory Organizer
This Inventory Organizer mod for Minecraft adds useful commands that help players efficiently manage and organize their inventories. It simplifies inventory sorting and cleaning with easy-to-use commands, improving the overall gameplay experience.

## Key Features:
- **/sort Command**: This command allows players to quickly sort their inventory in various ways:

- **/sort alphabetical**: Sorts items in the player's inventory in alphabetical order, making it easier to find specific items.
- **/sort bytype**: Organizes items by their type (e.g., blocks, food, tools), grouping similar items together for better accessibility.
- **/sort custom**: Allows players to sort their inventory based on custom rules defined in a configuration file, offering more control over how items are arranged.
- **/clearjunk Command**: This command helps players remove unwanted or "junk" items from their inventory, keeping it clean and organized.

The mod is designed to be **server-side only**, meaning it can be installed on the server and all players will benefit from it without needing to install it locally. It provides a convenient way to maintain a tidy inventory while playing, reducing the time spent on manual item organization.

# > 💡 **Want to see another mod supported?** Feel free to open an issue! 🙌 ## ⚙️ Config A default config file is automatically generated on first load. File path: `config/barched_extra_spears/materials//.json` Example for Bronze: `config/barched_extra_spears/materials/bronze/bronze.json` ### Config File Example ```json { "swingSeconds": 1.0, "kineticDamageMultiplier": 1.0125, "delaySeconds": 0.55, "damageCondDurationSeconds": 2.75, "damageCondMinSpeed": 7.75, "knockbackCondDurationSeconds": 6.625, "knockbackCondMinSpeed": 5.1, "dismountCondDurationSeconds": 10.625, "dismountCondMinRelativeSpeed": 4.6 } ``` ### Attribute Reference | Attribute | Description | Buff Direction | |-----------|-------------|:--------------:| | `swingSeconds` | Swing time (seconds). title: PriVault
description: Adds private vaults to minecraft
body:
# PriVault A powerful multi-vault storage solution for Minecraft servers that gives players secure, permission-based access to multiple private storage spaces. ## Features ### Multiple Personal Vaults Players can access different numbered vaults with a simple command: `/pv [number]`. Each vault functions as a separate inventory space, allowing organization of different item categories. ### Permission-Based Access Server administrators have complete control over which players can access specific vaults. By default, all players receive access to vault #1, while additional vaults require specific permissions. ### Customizable Storage Capacity Adjust the size of each vault through the configuration file. Set vaults to any multiple of 9 slots, from a single row (9 slots) up to a full double chest (54 slots). ### Persistent Storage All vault contents are automatically saved when players close their inventories and when the server shuts down, ensuring no items are ever lost. ### User-Friendly Interface Clean, intuitive interface with customizable titles that can include player names and vault numbers for easy identification. ### Efficient Design Lightweight implementation with minimal server resource usage, even when handling multiple vaults for hundreds of players. ### Complete Configuration Every aspect of the plugin can be tailored to fit your server's needs through the comprehensive config.yml file. ### Sound Effects Optional sound effects when opening and closing vaults enhance the player experience. ## Why Choose This Plugin? This solution stands out from other storage plugins by providing a perfect balance between simplicity and functionality. Players gain access to multiple organized storage spaces without overwhelming complexity, while administrators maintain full control through the permission system. The plugin's efficient storage approach means minimal impact on server performance even with many active players. The clean code architecture also ensures compatibility with most server versions and other plugins. For servers with economy plugins, this creates natural progression paths where players can unlock additional vaults through in-game currency or rank advancements. ## Use Cases - **Survival Servers**: Provide extra storage options as rewards for player advancement - **RPG Servers**: Allow different vaults for different types of items (weapons, potions, valuables) - **Economy Servers**: Sell additional vault access as a premium feature - **Creative Servers**: Give builders separate storage spaces for different building materials ## Admin Commands - `/pv reload` - Reload the configuration file - `/pv admin [player] [number]` - View another player's vault (requires admin permission) With its perfect balance of simplicity for users and control for administrators, this plugin is the ideal storage solution for servers that value both functionality and performance.

title: Transprotwo
description: Transport over short distance without cables.
body:
Transprotwo is a based on [**Transprot**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/transprot "Transprot") by [**KidsDontPlay**](https://www.curseforge.com/members/kidsdontplay/followers) which hasn't received an update in a while. Transprot is licensed **GNU GPL V3** which allows modification/distribution as long as source is disclosed and the license stays the same.

This mod adds 3 type of Dispatchers:

-   **Dispatcher :** A dispatcher which transports items wirelessly
-   **Dispatcher (fluid) :** A dispatcher which transports liquid wirelessly
-   **Dispatcher (power) :** A dispatcher which transports power wirelessly

To transport you first have to link the dispatcher to the block(s) you want to transfer into using the **Linker** item.

To do so you hold the Linker and Shift Right-click the Dispatcher and then click on the block you want it to link to. (repeat until you've linked all the blocks you've wanted it linked to)

The Dispatcher can be upgraded by inserting one of the 4 available upgrades. Each of these provides a speed and stacksize boost.

If you use a III upgrade or higher it will transfer through blocks.

## Overview  
The new spear is a versatile weapon that enhances combat in Minecraft. With its extended reach, it’s perfect for pest control while dealing the same damage as a sword. The spear also has higher durability, making it a reliable choice for adventurers. For balance, crafting the spear requires a sword, shovel, and a stick.

- **Extended Reach:** Attack enemies from a safer distance.  
- **Throwing Ability:** Launch the spear to attack from afar.  

### Custom Enchantments:  
1. **Spectrals:** Summons spectral clone spears to hit multiple mobs at once (up to 6 of them).  
2. **Voidfang:** Teleport to the spear’s landing spot, perfect for surprise attacks or quick escapes. 
3. **Air Burst:** Make a burst of wind where it lands.
4. **Venomous Coil:** Make an area of poison where it lands. 
5. **Recall:** Automatically return the spear to you after a cooldown, preventing others from picking it up.  


## Crafting Recipe  
- **Requires:** 2 Material(eg. 2 Ingots), Shovel of the Material, and Sticks
- Netherite uses 2 netherite ingots and a diamond shovel

Get ready to elevate your gameplay with the new Minecraft spear!

title: Modded Cobblemon
description: A Cobblemon modpack with various mods to provide an authentic modded experience
body:
# Modded Cobblemon

## Overview
Some friends and I wanted to play Cobblemon, but I couldn't find a modpack that'd be both easy for newer players to pick up and have enough depth to be enjoyable for veteran players. So I made this modpack for us to play on our private server. Granted, it grew a lot bigger than I was expecting it to, but I think it achieves the balance I was looking for. 

**--- Update - 12/9/2025 ---**  
We've since moved on from this pack, so I'm no longer working on maintaining it or keeping it up-to-date.

## Features

Of course, the centerpiece of this pack is Cobblemon, along with a bunch of add-ons that add some of the missing features that the base mod doesn't have implemented yet. Alongside that, there's a number of key mods that help give that "modded Minecraft" feel:
* Ambiance:
    * Ambient Sounds
    * Fabric Seasons
    * LambDynamicLights
    * Presence Footsteps
* Agriculture
    * Cooking for Blockheads
    * Croptopia
* Cobblemon Add-ons
    * Breeding
    * Capture EXP
    * Outbreaks
    * Spawn Notifications
    * Mounts
* Decorations
    * Decorative Blocks
    * Macaw's Furniture
    * Supplementaries
* Storage
    * Expanded Storage
    * Extended Drawers
    * Tom's Simple Storage Mod
* Technology
    * Create
* Utilities
    * Right-click Harvest
    * Lootr
    * Nature's Compass
    * Retraining
    * Utility Belt
    * Xaero's Minimap & World Map
* World Generation
    * Terralith

Full Modlist can be found [here](https://michaeldoescoding.net/minecraft/modpacks/cobblemon.html). 

## Datapacks
         
The pack also include folders for datapacks and resource packs to add some additional Pokemon that aren't included in the base mod. To use them, enable all the resource packs included (even if it says the pack is out of date, it should still work) and then include all the datapacks into whatever world you create.
   * CobbleCats
   * Cobblemon Create Compat
   * Cobblemon Shiny Effects
   * Cobblemon Swap Pokeballs
   * CobblemonLoot
   * CobblemonOutbreaks++
   * DeCube's MoMons
   * Diance Addition
   * Dracomon
   * Expanded Moveset
   * Genomons
   * LostMons
   * MissingMons
   * MysticMons
   * Pigeon Pack

## Known Issues

* Opening containers within a minecart contraption occasionally crashes the server
* Deployers that kill a mob will crash the server
    * These are known bugs within Create Fabric. They don't have an official patch yet, but a patched version of Create can be found [here](https://github.com/Fabricators-of-Create/Create/issues/1096#issuecomment-1864507425)

title: Mine Mine No Mi Black Blades
description: Train your weapon bond your weapon master your weapon and turn it into a Legendary Meito Black Blade
body: # Mine Mine No Mi - BlackBlades ## What is this? You know how in One Piece, swords like Yoru and Shusui turned black after years of battle? This mod adds that to Minecraft. Use a sword long enough with Haki, fight strong enemies, and it'll permanently turn into a Black Blade. But that's not all - named blades can also awaken as **Meito**, gaining tiered grades, better Haki synergy, and stronger identity as legendary weapons. Brawlers and Black Leg fighters can also forge their own fists into weapons too. Train hard enough and your bare hands become Black Fists. *** ## Black Blades (Swords) ### How it works To turn a sword into a Black Blade, you need to: * **Name it** - Give your sword a name at an anvil * **Use it** - Keep it in your hand for a while (1 hour by default) * **Imbue it** - Have Busoshoku Haki active while holding it (30 min total) * **Fight** - Kill 50 enemies with 1500+ doriki while imbuing Progress tracks in your mainhand, offhand, and mouth slot (for Santoryu users with Cart Addon). Once you hit all the requirements, your sword transforms. You'll hear the Haki sound, see dark particles, and get a server-wide announcement. Forged Black Blades can also awaken with a **curse**. Curses are random by default, making some blades much rarer and more dangerous than others. ### What Black Blades do * Always look imbued (dark tint) * +5 attack damage (base) * Built-in Unbreaking V (no enchant glint) * Bypass Logia without needing Haki active * Black sweep attack particles * 20% armor penetration * +25% critical hit damage * 1.15x damage when Haki is active ### Cursed Black Blades When a sword becomes a Black Blade, it has a chance to awaken with one of three curses: | Curse |What it does | | ------------- |-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Enma's Hunger |Drains weak wielders over time, but rewards strong Busoshoku control with extra damage | | Death Omen |Applies Unluck, attracts nearby monsters, and makes incoming danger worse | | Bloodthirst |Punishes staying out of combat, but heals and empowers you after kills | Curses are stored on the blade itself, show up in the tooltip, and can be tested directly with admin commands. ### Rank System Your Black Blade evolves as you keep fighting with it. Kill enough enemies after forging and it ranks up: | Rank |Kills Needed |Bonus Damage |Armor Pen | | -------------------- |------------ |------------ |--------- | | Black Blade (Forged) |0 |+5.0 |20% | | Awakened |100 |+7.0 |25% | | Mastered |350 |+10.0 |32.5% | | Legendary |850 |+15.0 |42.5% | Higher ranks also get better crit bonuses. Legendary blades get a server-wide announcement when achieved. ### Visual / Tooltip Changes Black Blade tooltips are cleaner now: * The main **Black Blade** header always stays visible * Rank, curse info, damage bonuses, and battle stats move into the **SHIFT** statistics view * Legendary styling uses gold for important visual elements * Curse names and descriptions appear in the expanded tooltip ### Commands | Command |What it does | | -------------------------------------------------------------- |--------------------------------------------------------- | | /blackblade name name |Name your held blade for Black Blade / Meito progression | | /blackblade status |Check your sword's progress, rank, and curse | | /blackblade stats |View detailed combat stats, rank progress, and curse info | | /blackblade leaderboard |View server-wide Black Blade leaderboard | | /blackblade meitopool |View remaining natural Meito slots by tier | | /blackblade forge |Force turn held sword into Black Blade (OP) | | /blackblade unforge |Remove Black Blade status (OP) | | /blackblade clear |Wipe all progress data (OP) | | /blackblade fillprogress |Max out all requirements (OP) | | /blackblade setwieldtime ticks |Set wield time (OP) | | /blackblade sethakitime ticks |Set imbue time (OP) | | /blackblade setkills number |Set kill count (OP) | | /blackblade setrank 1-4 |Set rank directly (OP) | | /blackblade setcurse none\\|enma\\|deathomen\\|bloodthirst |Force a specific curse for testing (OP) | | /blackblade setmeito none\|grade\|skillful\|great\|supreme |Set Meito grade directly for testing (OP) | | /blackblade completemeitotrial grade\|skillful\|great\|supreme |Complete a Meito trial tier instantly (OP) | | /blackblade flush |Flush buffered Black Blade progress to NBT (OP) | ### Advancements * **Kokutōshi** - Forge your own Black Blade * **Inheritor** - Receive a Black Blade forged by another swordsman *** ## Meito System ### What it is Meito is the legendary blade grading system for named weapons. Instead of every strong sword being treated the same, eligible blades can awaken through four Meito tiers: | Tier |Role | | -------------- |------------------------------------------------- | | Grade |Entry-level legendary blade | | Skillful Grade |Refined named blade with stronger combat bonuses | | Great Grade |Rare high-end Meito with strong Haki synergy | | Supreme Grade |Top-tier Meito reserved for the strongest weapons | Natural Meito is world-limited, so the rarest grades stay rare instead of every server ending up full of top-tier blades. ### How it works Every eligible weapon gets a hidden **Meito potential**. By default this comes from the weapon's displayed main-hand attack damage, though canon overrides can force specific swords into the right tier. To enter natural Meito progression, the blade must be **named**. Once named, it can awaken and climb one rank at a time until it reaches its hidden potential. Meito does **not** jump straight to the final result. A sword with Great or Supreme potential still has to grow through the lower ranks first. If a natural Meito tier is full, the blade keeps its progress and waits until a world slot opens. ### Default trial flow By default, each promotion uses scaled versions of the Black Blade requirements: | Next Meito Tier |Wield Time |Strong Kills |Haki Required | | --------------- |---------- |------------ |------------- | | Grade |15 min |13 |No | | Skillful Grade |30 min |25 |No | | Great Grade |45 min |38 |22.5 min | | Supreme Grade |60 min |50 |30 min | Strong kills use the same strong-enemy logic as Black Blade progression by default, meaning enemies with **1500+ doriki** count unless the server owner changes that config. ### How to use it * **Get an eligible weapon** - The blade needs enough attack power to qualify, or a canon override like Wado Ichimonji or Nidai Kitetsu * **Name it** - Named blades can begin natural Meito progression; unnamed blades will not naturally awaken * **Use it in combat** - Fight with the blade to build wield time and strong kill progress * **Use Haki for higher tiers** - Great Grade and Supreme Grade also require Busoshoku Haki imbue time * **Promote one step at a time** - Each completed trial only raises the blade by one Meito tier * **Check the tooltip or `/blackblade status`** - The mod now shows Meito potential, current tier, next trial, and Meito bonuses more clearly ### What Meito does Meito bonuses are tied to the weapon's **displayed** Meito grade: | Meito Tier |Final Damage |Haki Damage |Haki Efficiency |Enchant Bonus |Double-Level Chance | | -------------- |------------ |----------- |--------------- |------------- |------------------- | | Grade |+4% |+3% |+5% |+4 |5% | | Skillful Grade |+8% |+8% |+10% |+8 |12% | | Great Grade |+14% |+15% |+18% |+14 |25% | | Supreme Grade |+22% |+25% |+30% |+22 |40% | Meito also improves the identity of named blades without giving them their own armor penetration system. If that weapon later becomes a **Black Blade**, its displayed Meito grade increases by **one tier** for bonus calculation and presentation, up to Supreme Grade. ### Meito commands | Command |What it does | | -------------------------------------------------------------- |------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | /blackblade status |Shows Meito potential, current grade, next trial, and progression | | /blackblade stats |Shows Meito bonuses, Black Blade bonuses, rank, curse, and combat data | | /blackblade meitopool |Shows how many Grade, Skillful, Great, and Supreme natural slots are still open | | /blackblade setmeito none\|grade\|skillful\|great\|supreme |Sets a Meito grade directly (OP) | | /blackblade completemeitotrial grade\|skillful\|great\|supreme |Completes a Meito trial tier instantly for testing (OP) | *** ## Black Fists (Brawler / Black Leg) ### How it works If you're a Brawler or Black Leg fighter, you can forge your fists into weapons. The requirements are similar to Black Blades: * **Train** - Stay in combat mode with empty hands (1 hour by default) * **Imbue** - Use Busoshoku Haki while training (30 min total) * **Fight** - Kill 75 enemies with 1500+ doriki with your bare hands Once you complete all three, your fists transform into Iron Fists. You'll get particles, sound effects, and a server announcement. ### What Black Fists do * +4 unarmed damage (base) * 15% armor penetration * +20% critical hit damage * 1.2x damage when Haki is active * Mine blocks with bare hands (see below) ### Rank System Just like Black Blades, your fists evolve with use: | Rank |Kills Needed |Bonus Damage |Armor Pen | | ------------------------ |------------ |------------ |--------- | | Iron Fist (Forged) |0 |+4.0 |15% | | Steel Fist (Awakened) |100 |+6.0 |20% | | Tekkai Fist (Mastered) |250 |+9.0 |30% | | Supreme Fist (Legendary) |500 |+14.0 |45% | ### Bare-Hand Mining Black Fist users can mine blocks with their bare hands. Your mining level depends on your rank: | Rank |Can Mine | | ------------------- |------------------------ | | Training (no forge) |Wood, dirt | | Iron Fist |Stone, cobblestone | | Steel Fist |Iron ore, lapis | | Tekkai Fist |Diamond, gold, emerald | | Supreme Fist |Obsidian, ancient debris | Mining speed is fast - at least 2.5x netherite tool speed. Using Haki while mining doubles it again. ### Fist of Love Passive The "Fist of Love" passive ability shows up for Brawlers and Black Leg fighters. It displays: * Your current rank and bonuses * Training progress (if not yet forged) * Rank progress and kills to next rank (if forged) It's display-only - the bonuses are always active as long as you meet the requirements. ### Commands | Command |What it does | | ---------------------------------------- |-------------------------------------------- | | /blackfist status |Check your training progress or current rank | | /blackfist stats |View detailed combat and mining stats | | /blackfist forge |Force forge your fists (OP) | | /blackfist unforge |Remove Black Fist status (OP) | | /blackfist clear |Wipe all Black Fist data (OP) | | /blackfist fillprogress |Max out all requirements (OP) | | /blackfist settrainingtime <ticks> |Set training time (OP) | | /blackfist sethakitime <ticks> |Set Haki time (OP) | | /blackfist setkills <number> |Set strong kills (OP) | | /blackfist setrank <1-4> |Set rank directly (OP) | *** ## Resource Pack Support BlackBlades supports custom textures for weapons from **any mod** (Cart Addon, EOP Addon, etc.)! ### How it works * **mineminenomi weapons** → Use built-in Black Blade textures * **Other mods' weapons** → Keep original appearance unless a resource pack provides custom textures ### Creating Custom Textures Place textures in the weapon's **original mod namespace**: ``` MyResourcePack/ ├── pack.mcmeta └── assets/ └── / └── textures/ └── item/ ├── _blackblade.png ├── _overlay_blackblade.png ├── _blackblade_sheathed.png (optional) └── _overlay_blackblade_sheathed.png (optional) ``` ### Texture Types | File |Layer |Purpose | | ---------------------------------------------- |------ |--------------------- | | <weapon>_blackblade.png |layer0 |Main texture / Handle | | <weapon>_overlay_blackblade.png |layer1 |Blade/Metal overlay | | <weapon>_blackblade_sheathed.png |layer0 |Sheathed handle | | <weapon>_overlay_blackblade_sheathed.png |layer1 |Sheathed blade | ### Examples **Cart Addon - Shigure:** ``` assets/cartaddon/textures/item/shigure_blackblade.png assets/cartaddon/textures/item/shigure_overlay_blackblade.png ``` **EOP Addon - Murakumogiri:** ``` assets/eopaddon/textures/item/murakumogiri_blackblade.png ``` ### pack.mcmeta ``` { "pack": { "pack_format": 6, "description": "Custom Black Blade textures for One Piece mods" } } ``` > **Tip:** Press F3+H in-game to see full item IDs (e.g., `cartaddon:shigure`) *** ## Config `config/blackblades-common.toml` You can change everything: **Black Blades:** * Wield time, Haki time, kills required * Doriki threshold for "strong" enemies * Damage bonus, armor penetration, crit bonus * Haki damage multiplier * Rank thresholds and bonuses * Cursed blade enable/disable and curse chance **Meito:** * Enable/disable the Meito system * Use natural Meito trials or force the highest grade immediately * Grade, Skillful, Great, and Supreme world slot counts * Attack damage thresholds for automatic Meito potential * Exclude tool-class items from automatic Meito grading * 1.16.5 Zitoen Piece ownership toggle **Black Fists:** * Training time, Haki time, kills required * Damage bonus, armor penetration, crit bonus * Mining levels per rank * Mining speed multiplier * Rank thresholds and bonuses *** ## Zitoen Piece Compatibility (1.16.5 Only) If Zitoen Piece is installed on 1.16.5, BlackBlades can now take ownership of overlapping grade and black blade behavior by default. That means: * BlackBlades handles the active sword progression instead of both mods trying to apply their own grade logic * Zitoen's overlapping grade combat bonuses no longer stack on top of BlackBlades when BlackBlades is set as main * Zitoen black blade progression no longer competes with BlackBlades while compatibility mode is enabled * A config toggle lets you hand control back to Zitoen Piece if you want its native behavior instead *** ## Notes * Black Blades can be traded/given to other players * The owner name is stored on the sword * Curses are stored on the blade and stay with it when traded * Natural Meito progression is stored on the blade and respects world-limited tier pools * Black Blades display one Meito tier higher than their underlying base Meito grade * Receiving a blade from another player grants the "Inheritor" advancement * Server leaderboard persists across restarts * Black Fist data is stored on the player (not an item) * Both systems track detailed stats: kills, damage, crits, boss kills, and Meito progression data * Black Blade and Black Fist text now supports lang-file translation

title: Confettinator
description: A block for dispensing confetti and fireworks with color configurable by redstone.
body: ## The Confettinator mod ![fabric api badge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7aa5a26a674baa26092eb1661393f4a4196a38b0.png) **The Confettinator mod adds one block—the Confettinator!** It works similarly to a dispenser, you can access its 9-slot inventory by right-clicking. It can be oriented in any of 4 directions, though it always shoots upwards. Unlike a dispenser, instead of choosing a random item, it uses the first item it finds in the inventory. When activated with redstone, it can shoot out: - Confetti (by giving a paper item) - Colored confetti (by giving any dye item) - Rainbow confetti (by giving a glowstone dust item) - Fireworks (like a regular dispenser) - Firework stars (like a firework but it immediately explodes) The Confettinator also has one special side for *redstone calibration*. It may be familiar to you if you've ever used a calibrated sculk sensor. When a redstone dust has power on the calibration side, it changes the color of any confetti (only as a paper item), firework, and firework star to the color corresponding to the redstone signal strength. (note: only one explosion is kept in each firework modified this way, and any fade color of any firework or firework star is removed) This mod uses [Confetti Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/confetti-lib) by Tomate0613. The source code of this project is available at https://github.com/Overgeneralized/confettinator.

body: # Mod Menu Filter [![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/H2H51ZR38L) ![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/mtxCore/Modmenu-filter?style=flat-square) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Fabric-blue?style=flat-square) ![Side](https://img.shields.io/badge/Side-Client%20Only-orange?style=flat-square) **Mod Menu Filter** is a client Fabric utility mod that enhances [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) with tag-based filtering, coloured badge overlays, favorites, and per-profile configurations --- ## Features - **Tag Badges** - Coloured inline badges drawn next to every mod name. - **Tag Filtering** - A toggle-button filter bar above the mod list. Click to show matching mods, with optional all-selected-tags matching for narrow searches. - **Favourites** - Favorite your mods! Easily filter between favorites and non-favorites. - **Profiles** - Supports multiple configurations that you can switch between. --- ## Requirements | Dependency | Notes | |---|---| | [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) | `>= 0.18.4` | | [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | any | | [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) | any | | [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) | any | --- ## Installation 1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for your Minecraft version. 2. Drop **Mod Menu Filter**, **Fabric API**, **Mod Menu**, and **Cloth Config** into your `mods/` folder. 3. Launch the game - a default configuration is generated automatically on first run. --- ## Configuration Open **Mod Menu → Mod Menu Filter → (gear icon)** to access the full settings screen. ### Tag database (`config/mod_menu_filter.json`) Tags and the mods they apply to are stored in `config/mod_menu_filter.json`. A bundled `default_tags.json` is written on first launch as the base. > Most of these settings can be configured through the built-in configuration screen ```jsonc { "tagOverrides": { // add a mod to an existing built-in tag "sodium": ["performance"], // assign multiple tags to one mod "iris": ["performance", "rendering"] }, "customTags": { // define a completely new tag "rendering": { "displayName": "Rendering", "color": 9699609, "mods": ["iris"] } }, "hiddenTags": ["library"], "favoriteMods": ["sodium"], "matchAllTagFilters": false, "activeProfile": "default" } ``` ## License Feel free to include in any modpack!

title: Piglin Trading Menu
description: Transform Piglin bartering into a traditional villager trading interface. Exchange gold massively, quickly, and comfortably with 100% vanilla-accurate loot.
body:
# Piglin Trading Menu

Tired of throwing gold on the ground and waiting for Piglins to inspect it? Piglin Trading Menu overhauls the vanilla bartering system by introducing a clean, traditional Villager-style trading interface! 🐷✨

![Exchange gold directly through a custom GUI. It shows your available items, locked trades when a Piglin is out of stock, and supports quick shift-clicking! 💎](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19d8fb1c0c2d38c88908969ebab7315f9df4738f.png)

## Core Features

* **Instant GUI Trading:** Simply right-click any adult Piglin to open the trading menu. You can shift-click massive amounts of gold instantly without waiting for the drop animation or dealing with ghost items!
* **100% Vanilla Accurate Loot:** The trades mirror the exact vanilla bartering loot table and probabilities. Each Piglin gets a unique, seeded set of 6 items they are willing to trade.
* **Smart Restock System:** Just like real Villagers, Piglins have a limited stock for each item. Once a trade is locked, you will need to wait half a Minecraft day (10 real-world minutes) for them to restock their inventory automatically.
* **Safe Trading:** Are you exploring the Nether without gold armor? No problem! Opening the trading menu will instantly pacify an angry Piglin, freezing them in place while you do business. Once you close the menu, they will resume their normal behavior. 🛡️

![Piglins will temporarily forget their anger and become completely peaceful while you are bartering with them, even if you are not wearing gold armor. 🤝](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vbYS9Vt8/images/ff4beb621742688cf2fde3836797ee39de4b853e.gif)

## Build Your Own Trading Hall

Because Piglins now retain their unique trades and restock over time, you can finally build organized Piglin Trading Halls in the Nether just like you would with Villagers. Lock in your favorite trades and farm resources efficiently! 🏰

![Since each Piglin keeps their unique seeded trades and restocks automatically over time, you can finally build organized Piglin trading halls in the Nether. 🏰](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5403d5354845c5214745832c093caadfac592da.png)

## Technical Details

* **Requirements:** This mod must be installed on both the **Client** and the **Server** to work properly and synchronize the inventory and AI changes.

---

title: Fast Better Grass: Untinted Edition
description: A micro-pack that removes biome coloring from Fast Better Grass so it matches classic/alpha, fixed-palette foliage packs.
body:
# Fast Better Grass – **Untinted Edition**  
*A micro-pack that removes biome coloring from Fast Better Grass so it matches classic/alpha, fixed-palette foliage packs.*

---

## 🌿 **Why This Exists**  
Packs like **Golden Days + Alpha Addon** and **PACP + Beta Addon + Alpha Addon** revive the bright, always-green look of Minecraft Classic/Alpha.  
Fast Better Grass keeps terrain edges tidy, but its full grass-blocks still pick up biome tints—so plains, jungles, swamps, etc. show jarring color shifts.  
This add-on keeps Fast Better Grass’s sides overlay while **locking the grass color** to the grass_block_top.png texture, giving you seamless greenery everywhere.

---

## 🗒️ **What’s Inside**  
The *only* file touched is:

```
assets/minecraft/models/block/grass_block.json
```

It simply drops every `tintindex: 0`, disabling biome tint:

<details><summary>❌  Original (from Fast Better Grass)</summary>

```json
{
  "parent": "block/block",
  "textures": {
    "particle": "block/dirt",
    "bottom":   "block/dirt",
    "top":      "block/grass_block_top"
  },
  "elements": [
    {
      "from": [0, 0, 0],
      "to":   [16, 16, 16],
      "faces": {
        "down":  { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#bottom", "cullface": "down" },
        "up":    { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#top",    "cullface": "up",    "tintindex": 0 },
        "north": { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#top",    "cullface": "north", "tintindex": 0 },
        "south": { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#top",    "cullface": "south", "tintindex": 0 },
        "west":  { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#top",    "cullface": "west",  "tintindex": 0 },
        "east":  { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#top",    "cullface": "east",  "tintindex": 0 }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
</details>

<details><summary>👌  Untinted Edition</summary>

```json
{
  "parent": "block/block",
  "textures": {
    "particle": "block/dirt",
    "bottom":   "block/dirt",
    "top":      "block/grass_block_top"
  },
  "elements": [
    {
      "from": [0, 0, 0],
      "to":   [16, 16, 16],
      "faces": {
        "down":  { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#bottom", "cullface": "down" },
        "up":    { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#top",    "cullface": "up" },
        "north": { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#top",    "cullface": "north" },
        "south": { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#top",    "cullface": "south" },
        "west":  { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#top",    "cullface": "west" },
        "east":  { "uv": [0,0,16,16], "texture": "#top",    "cullface": "east" }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
</details>

Load order recommendation:

```
⬆️ Fast Better Grass – Untinted Edition
➡️ Fast Better Grass (original)
⬇️ Golden Days + Alpha Addon  /  PACP + Beta Addon + Alpha Addon
```

---

## ✅ **Compatibility**  

| Feature                         | Status |
|---------------------------------|--------|
| Minecraft 1.20-1.21.5 (Java)    | ✔ Tested, no mods needed |
| Fast Better Grass 1.21.5        | ✔ Tested, should also work for newer versions |
| Other resourcepacks             | ✔ Works with any colored grass_block_top.png (if gray, it will not work) |

---

## 🤝 **Credits**  
- **Fast Better Grass** by **robotkoer** – base pack and overlay logic.  
- Untinted tweak by **HandLock_**  
- Distributed under the same license as the original (MIT).  

*“Sometimes the best color… is the one that never changes.”*
