title: Paint And Seek
description: Hide in plain sight, with a paintbrush and some hubris.
body:
This mod was inspired by Meccha Chameleon ([on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4704690/MECCHA_CHAMELEON/)). I wanted to play this with my kids after seeing some of our favourite Minecraft content creators playing this game together ([on Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDP3UVRoiapQu6ty4xWZUtM6LcFJaqYuE)), but Meccha is Windows only. So over the weekend, with the help of Claude Code, I put together this mod to play a simiar style game in Minecraft :)

![A player painting their skin to blend into a village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/087a136a9bb92f6e8338334a8696f001e0c9661f_0.webp)

You need this mod, Fabric, Fabric Api, and Fabric Language Kotlin. Then start a multiplayer game and choose a starting location. A village is a great first start.

Then run `/paintandseek newround` to start a new round with your friends. A seeker will be automatically chosen, and given blidness, a paintbrush, and a bow with spectral arrows. The hiders have to run and hide, and are given a paintbrush.

Right click with the paintbrush in your hand to bring up the paint screen. Right click to eye dropper a color from the screen, and left click to paint on your skin. W-S-A-D to orbit around, and select different poses.

The longer you are in the view of the seeker, and the closer you are while in view, the more points you get. The seeker must shoot hiders with a spectral arrow to stop their point counter. If the hiders are able to stay hidden until the seek time expires, the hiders win.

Start a new round with `/paintandseek newround [playername]` to select a seeker, and optionally set the hide time and seek time.

If you want to customise what happens at various stages, there is an example datapack, where you can modify the functions for each of the steps. For example, **start_seek.mcfunction**:
```
# Runs once when the seek phase begins (server context). Edit freely.
effect clear @a[tag=paintandseek.seeker] minecraft:blindness
title @a times 10 70 20
title @a[tag=paintandseek.seeker] title {"text":"SEEK!","bold":true,"color":"gold"}
title @a[tag=paintandseek.hider] title {"text":"HIDE!","bold":true,"color":"green"}
```

title: Disable Villager Trade
description: A lightweight plugin to prevent players from trading with villagers.
body:
# Disable Villager Trade

## Overview

DisableVillagerTrade is a lightweight mod/plugin crafted to block trading interactions exclusively with villagers while preserving interactions with other non-player characters (NPCs). This ensures a balanced and immersive gameplay experience on your server.

**Now available for multiple platforms!**

## 🎮 Supported Platforms

| Platform | Minecraft Version | Status |
|----------|-------------------|--------|
| **Bukkit/Spigot/Paper** | 1.14 - 1.21.11+ | ✅ Full Support |
| **Fabric** | 1.21.11 | ✅ Full Support |
| **Forge** | 1.21.11 | ✅ Full Support |
| **NeoForge** | 1.21.11 | ✅ Full Support |
| **Quilt** | 1.21.11 | ✅ Use Fabric version |

## ✨ Key Features

- **Custom Interaction Messages** - Personalize interaction messages to match your server's tone and style, enhancing player engagement.
- **Toggle Interaction Messages** - Easily enable or disable interaction messages according to server preferences.
- **World/Dimension-Specific Disablement** - Fine-tune gameplay dynamics by enabling or disabling the plugin on a per-world/dimension basis, granting precise control over trading functionalities.
- **Bypass Permission** - Allow staff to trade with `disabletrade.bypass` permission.
- **Smart Profession Detection** - Villagers with no profession (NONE) can still be interacted with.
- **Automatic Update Checker** - Get notified when a new version is available.
- **Admin Commands** - Manage the mod with simple commands on all platforms (`/dvt reload|status|help`).

## 📦 Installation

### Bukkit/Spigot/Paper
1. Download `DisableVillagerTrade-Bukkit-x.x.x.jar`
2. Place in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure in `plugins/DisableVillagerTrade/config.yml`

### Fabric
1. Download `DisableVillagerTrade-Fabric-x.x.x.jar`
2. Ensure you have Fabric Loader and Fabric API installed
3. Place in your `mods` folder
4. Configure in `config/disablevillagertrade.json`

### Forge / NeoForge
1. Download the appropriate JAR for your mod loader
2. Place in your `mods` folder
3. Configure in `config/disablevillagertrade-server.toml`

## ⚙️ Configuration (Bukkit)

```yaml
# Message settings
message:
  enabled: true
  text: "&cYou can't trade with villagers on this server."

# Worlds where trading is ALLOWED
disabled-worlds:
  - example-world
```

## 🎮 Commands

All platforms support the `/dvt` command. Bukkit additionally registers `/disabletrade` and `/tradetoggle` as aliases.

### Bukkit

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/disabletrade reload` | Reload the plugin configuration | `disabletrade.admin` |
| `/disabletrade status` | Show plugin status and settings | `disabletrade.admin` |
| `/disabletrade toggle [player]` | Check bypass permission status | `disabletrade.admin` |
| `/disabletrade help` | Show help message | `disabletrade.admin` |

**Aliases:** `/dvt`, `/tradetoggle`

### Fabric / Forge / NeoForge

| Command | Description | Required Permission |
|---------|-------------|---------------------|
| `/dvt reload` | Reload the mod configuration | OP level 2 |
| `/dvt status` | Show mod status and settings | OP level 2 |
| `/dvt help` | Show help message | OP level 2 |

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `disabletrade.admin` | Access to all admin commands | OP |
| `disabletrade.bypass` | Allows the player to bypass trade block | OP |
| `disabletrade.update` | Receives update notifications on join | OP |

> **Note:** On Fabric, permissions work with [Fabric Permissions API](https://github.com/lucko/fabric-permissions-api) or fall back to OP level 2+. On Forge/NeoForge, OP level 2+ is required.

## 💻 Supported Versions

- **Minecraft**: 1.14 - 1.21.11+ (varies by platform)
- **Java**: 21+

- [Source Code](https://github.com/dodoflix/DisableVillagerTrade)
- [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/dodoflix/DisableVillagerTrade/issues)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/dodoflix/DisableVillagerTrade/releases)

title: Ecospherical Expansion Lite
description: Overhauled generation to the biomes of the Overworld.
body:
Ecospherical Expansion Lite is a datapack aimed towards recreating biomes with more diversity and aesthetically pleasing scenes. The mod version of this datapack has many more features such as custom rocks, giant trees, underground pillar formations, and lots more. (https://modrinth.com/mod/ecospherical-expansion)

Additionally, this datapack adds custom integration with the Large Biomes and Amplified world presets; While also adding 7 new world presets to chose from.

NOTE: Versions below 1.19.4 do not have world presets. In those versions, this datapack simply redoes the vanilla biomes. 

Default: 
- Terrain above the surface is the same as vanilla.
- Caves are now much more open.
- Oceans now lead into sprawling cave systems.

Large Biomes: 
- Adds some massive plateaus with smooth surfaces.
- Biomes are much larger.

Amplified: 
- Biome generation has been altered to make Y63 and below always oceans.
- World height has been extended to Y512.
- Terrain has been reworked to add massive variation in style across large distances.
- There are now small floating islands that generate above the existing terrain.

Tropospherical: 
- Sparse floating islands. 
- The bottom of the world is entirely submerged in ocean.
- The nether is also transformed in the same way.

Stratospherical: 
- Large, multi-layered, dense floating islands.
- The bottom of the world is an empty void.
- The nether is also transformed in the same way.

OG Stratospherical: 
- Ridiculously dense floating islands.
- Insane amounts of verticality.
- Does not have the floating island rivers. (To stay consistent with the OG mod.)
- The nether is not affected. (To stay consistent with the OG mod.)

Mesospherical: 
- A large, single layer of moderately spaced floating islands. 
- The bottom of the world is an empty void. 
- The nether is also transformed in the same way.

Thermospherical: 
- Two layers of sparse floating islands. 
- Floating islands are made to be more vertically variant. 
- The bottom of the world is an empty void. 
- The nether is also transformed in the same way.

Lithospherical: 
- One massive cave system comprises the entire world. 
- World height has been lowered to Y128. 
- The nether is also transformed to have a similar appearance, but the height remains the same.

Asthenospherical: 
- The top of the dimension is one massive ceiling. 
- One layer of small, but dense, floating islands. 
- World height has been lowered to Y128. 
- The nether is also transformed in the same way.


Screenshots of each preset can be found in the gallery on this page.

Compatability: 
- Terralith: Incompatible. 
- Biomes O' Plenty: Compatible on only the Default and Large Biomes world presets. (This is likely the case for all terrablender-based biome mods.)

title: Status4Discord
description: A discord bot, showing the current status of your server as embed, activity and more.
body:
# Status4Discord Status4Discord is a dynamic Discord bot for Minecraft servers that provides real-time server stats through embeds and activities. It effortlessly connects your Minecraft server to Discord, keeping your community in the loop and engaged with information ranging from TPS to player counts. ## Getting started https://github.com/LasaJoniHD/Status4DiscordMC/wiki/Setup ## Commands ### Minecraft ``/status4discord reload`` reload the config
``/status4discord invite`` invite the discord bot
``/status4discord info`` info about this plugin
``/status4discord help`` all commands ### Discord ``@YourDiscordBot setembed`` set the embed textchannel
``@YourDiscordBot setlogs`` set the logs textchannel ## Permissions ### Minecraft + ``status4mc.admin`` Use /status4discord reload and /status4discord invite ### Discord + Permission.ADMINISTRATOR ## Config
Show config ``` # _____ _ _ _ _ _____ _ _ # / ____| | | | | || | | __ \(_) | | # | (___ | |_ __ _| |_ _ _ ___| || |_| | | |_ ___ ___ ___ _ __ __| | # \___ \| __/ _` | __| | | / __|__ _| | | | / __|/ __/ _ \| '__/ _` | # ____) | || (_| | |_| |_| \__ \ | | | |__| | \__ \ (_| (_) | | | (_| | # |_____/ \__\__,_|\__|\__,_|___/ |_| |_____/|_|___/\___\___/|_| \__,_| # # Thank you for using Status4Discord by Joni # To setup Status4Discord, please visit https://github.com/LasaJoniHD/Status4DiscordMC/wiki/Setup # _____ ___ _ _____ _ _ # |_ _/ _ \| |/ / __| \| | # | || (_) | ' <| _|| .` | # |_| \___/|_|\_\___|_|\_| # # Please paste your discord bot token here token: "" # _ ___ _____ _____ _____ _______ __ # /_\ / __|_ _|_ _\ \ / /_ _|_ _\ \ / / # / _ \ (__ | | | | \ V / | | | | \ V / # /_/ \_\___| |_| |___| \_/ |___| |_| |_| # # Available Activities: # PLAYING, WATCHING, LISTENING, CUSTOM_STATUS, COMPETING # Available Status: # ONLINE, IDLE, DO_NOT_DISTURB, INVISIBLE, OFFLINE # You can use PlaceholderAPI if installed (only placeholders that do not require a player). # Find placeholders included in Status4Discord at https://github.com/LasaJoniHD/Status4DiscordMC/wiki/Placeholders. activity: "PLAYING %online_players% / %max_players% Players" status-activity: "ONLINE" update-activity: 30 # in seconds # Activities for server start server-starting-activity: "CUSTOM_STATUS Server is starting..." server-starting-status: "IDLE" # ServerIP # will replace internal Placeholder %serverip% # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 'serverIP' sets the server IP shown in activity and in the embed. # If in server.properties, it will obtain the IP that the server is bound to; if not set, it will display "not set." serverIP: "server.properties" # _ ___ ___ ___ # | | / _ \ / __/ __| # | |_| (_) | (_ \__ \ # |____\___/ \___|___/ # # If enabled, the bot will send a message when the server starts/stops in the specified logs channel. # If you don't know how to obtain the textChannelID and have admin privileges, # simply send a message in Discord in the channel like this: @MentionYourDiscordBot setlogs. logs: enabled: true textChannelID: "" start: color: "GREEN" message: ":white_check_mark: **Server started!**" stop: color: "RED" message: ":x: **Server stopped!**" # ___ __ __ ___ ___ ___ # | __| \/ | _ ) __| \ # | _|| |\/| | _ \ _|| |) | # |___|_| |_|___/___|___/ # # If enabled, the bot will send a status embed in the specified channel; this embed will be updated every few seconds. # If you don't know how to obtain the textChannelID and have admin privileges, # simply send a message in Discord in the channel like this: # @MentionYourDiscordBot setembed. embed: enabled: true textChannelID: "" update: 15 # in seconds online: title: "Online" color: "GREEN" # supports any java.awt.Color enum name (e.g. `RED`, `BLUE`, etc.) or a hex code (e.g. `#FF0000` for red) timestamp: true footer: text: "Uptime: %uptime%" fields: - name: "Server IP" value: "%serverip%" inline: true - name: "Player Count" value: "%online_players% / %max_players%" inline: true - name: "RAM" value: "Used: %usedram_percentage% % (%usedram% mb / %maxram% mb)" inline: false - name: "Uptime" value: "%uptime%" inline: true - name: "TPS" value: "%tps%" inline: true - name: "CPU" value: "%cpu% %" inline: true offline: title: "Offline" color: "RED" fields: - name: "Server IP" value: "%serverip%" inline: true # Do not touch if you don't know what this setting does embedMessageID: "" debug: false config-version: 4 ```

title: No More JoinLeave Message
description: Removes completly the "Joined" and "Leaved" the server message from Chat and Console in Fabric.
body:
# NoMoreJoinLeaveMessage Mod

## Description
The NoMoreJoinLeaveMessage mod is a Minecraft mod that allows you to customize or completely remove the join and leave server messages. This feature can be useful to reduce spam in the server chat or to customize the player experience.

## Features
- **Message Removal**: You can choose to completely remove the join and leave messages.
- **Configuration**: The mod uses a configuration file in YAML format (`notification.yml`) to manage the message settings.

## Configuration
The mod's configuration is done through the `notification.yml` file. This file is loaded when the server starts.

Here is an example of what the configuration file might look like:

```yaml
{joinNotification: false, leaveNotification: false}
```

In this example, join messages are enabled while leave messages are disabled.

## Installation
To install the mod, follow these steps:

1. Download the latest version of the mod.
2. Copy the mod file into your server's `mods` folder.
3. Restart the server to load the mod.

After installation, the mod will automatically create the `notification.yml` configuration file in the `./config/no-more-join-leave-message` folder if it does not already exist.

## Support
If you need help with the mod, you can open an issue on the GitHub page or directly make pull requests.

## License
The NoMoreJoinLeaveMessage mod is released under the MIT license. You can use, modify, and distribute the mod as you like, as long as you respect the terms of the license.

description: Superflat world but with normal presets including all biomes.
body:
# Features as of Minecraft version 1.19:

* The overworld is unchanged compared to previous versions. Everything is working fine.
* The nether won't generate many stuff if I flatten it so the best I could do was to remove the bedrock ceiling thus you can easily dig up to the flat surface of the world this way traversing the nether and getting flat surface for builds is still a viable thing.
* The end is untouched.
* Two editions: Regular, that only flattens the overworld and Plus that removes the bedrock ceiling in the nether too

# Features as of Minecraft version 1.18:

* Redone the data pack so now achieving flatness with different methods
* Now aquatic biomes spawn too!
* Jungle and desert pyramids are added back!
* Everything seem to be working in order in the overworld
* Mountainous biomes are obviously flat so there isn't too much to them
*  In plus version the nether and the end are both quite flattened, at least the top of them
* In achieving that I accidentally made the ender dragon easier to beat since there are no obsidian monoliths and crystals... Sorry?
* The nether is relatively safe to walk around but don't go diving deep in lava while using the plus version. For some reason where there is lava lake there isn't any bedrock. You might just... you know. Fall out of the world?

* The world surface generates in only one plane, highly resembling to Mojang's original superflat mode, except for it is not but tries to achieve it by sticking to a given height
* The world is still very ideal for both survival and creative modes for the majority of the world space is still empty as seen in the very first picture in the description

title: EasierCrafting updated

body:
# Easier Crafting:
The definitive unofficial port of [EasierCrafting](https://modrinth.com/mod/easiercrafting), completely rewritten for Minecraft 1.21+ and modern performance.

Easier Crafting replace the vanilla recipe book with a custom recipe display (like ones in rei) that only shows what you can craft, and can br categorized. Click on those recipes to craft items instantly. Search for items you cant craft. Should work with most mods.

![inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82509e8518b9fff3c28352132403ee3c711920ab.png)

## Key Features
Smart Recipe List: Automatically displays all recipes you can currently craft based on your inventory.

Quick Crafting: **Left Click** to crafts the item once immediately.

Shift-Click: Automatically crafts the item as many times as possible (up to a full stack or until you run out of ingredients).

Advanced Search Bar: Search by item name (full or partial) in English or your local language. You can set to show all recipes when searching (even ones you cant craft). If you cant craft, the items and ingredients will have a red background.

Ingredient Tooltips: Hover over a item to see exactly which materials you need/ are missing.

Config: Includes a detailed configuration screen with multi-language support. (using cloth config and ai translation, may not be 100% accurate)

and more :3 check [changelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/easiercrafting-updated/changelog)

## Version

| Version | Avaliability |
| -------- | -------- |
| 26.2.x | ✅ |
| 26.1.x | ✅ |
| 1.21.x | ✅ |
| 1.21-1.21.1 | ✅* |
| 1.20 and below | ❌ |

✅: available, major update available  
🔥: rapid development -> get alpha/beta build in github  
❌: unavailable: use original author's version  

\* Minecraft 1.21 - 1.21.1: This version is a fork of taoge407's work ([github page](https://github.com/taoge407/EasierCrafting-Reloaded)), featuring additional improvements and bug fixes. Support for these versions is now limited to major bug fixes only.


<details>
<summary>Note</summary>

Rewritten Logic: Because of the 1.21.2 recipe overhaul, some older features are still being ported to the newer versions. Most of the features are restored currently. Newer versions are considered testing builds and may contain bugs. Your feedback is essential!

</details>

- fabric api

title: QoL Crafting
description: Adds many QoL recipes including woodcutting, full blocks from slabs, smelting raw ore blocks, and more
body:
**QoL Crafting** adds new crafting recipes and changes some existing ones to improve quality of life and make many recipes more consistent. It maintains the Vanilla feel and balance, and it has built-in advancements so that the recipes seemlessly appear in your recipe book.

### Additions
- Slabs and carpets can be crafting back into full blocks
- Stonecutters can cut wood items
- Stonecutters can cut Sandstone and Red Sandstone into 2 Sand and 2 Red Sand respectively
- All wool, carpets, stained glass, stained glass panes, terracotta, concrete, concrete powder, banners, and candles can be dyed and redyed.
- Four chests can be crafted at once using logs
- Raw ore blocks can be smelted at 1/9 speed
- Dispensers can be crafted in bulk with droppers, string, and sticks
- Chest Boats can be crafted in bulk with planks and a chest
- Chest, furnace, hopper, and tnt minecarts can be crafted in bulk in a similar manner
- Leather armor and potions can be recyled in a crafting window
- Rooted Dirt can be crafted from Dirt and Hanging Roots
- Charcoal can be crafted into Black Dye
- Glow Ink Sacs can be crafted into Cyan Dye
- Green dye can be crafted from 1 blue and 1 yellow dye
- Cyan dye can be crafted from 2 blue and 1 yellow dye
- Lime dye can be crafted from 1 blue and 2 yellow dye
  
### Tweaks
- More stone types can be used in crafting recipes
- Smelting iron and gold armor yeilds ingots instead of nuggets
- Lime dye is crafted from green and yellow dye rather than green and white
- Looms require 4 planks instead of 2 like other workstation blocks
- 8 wool can be dyed at a time like other dyeable blocks
- Nether Bricks can be smelted from Crimson Nylium and Warped Nylium
- The Rail recipe yeilds 20 instead of 16
- The Powered Rail recipe yeilds 8 instead of 6
- The Ladder recipe yields 6 instead of 3
- The Banner recipes yield 3 rather than 1
- The Candle recipe now yields 2 instead of 1
- The Repeated recipe now yields 2 instead of 1
- The Comparator recipe now yields 2 instead of 1
- The Sandstone recipe now yields 2 instead of 1
- The Red Sandstone recipe now yields 2 instead of 1

title: ToggleSprint
description: ToggleSprint is a lightweight, client-side utility mod that brings permanent sprinting capabilities to Minecraft without compromising your vanilla experience.
body:
# ToggleSprint
ToggleSprint is a lightweight, client-side utility mod designed to bring a permanent sprinting mechanic to Minecraft without intrusive or jarring gameplay alterations. Instead of constantly holding down your sprint key during long journeys or intense combat, this mod allows you to automate your movement state seamlessly.

## Features
* **Persistent Sprinting:** Once the toggle is activated, your character will automatically begin to sprint anytime you press your forward movement key.
* **Vanilla Mechanics Retained:** The mod respects native game physics. If you are sneaking, the automatic sprinting is temporarily overridden. This acts as a safety measure and prevents you from accidentally sprinting off edges while bridging or building.
* **Customizable Keybinds:** The sprint toggle is mapped to the Left Control key by default, but it can be fully remapped via a dedicated category native to the standard Minecraft controls menu.
* **HUD Integration:** Includes a clean, minimalistic status indicator on your screen to ensure you always know when your toggle sprint is armed or disabled.

## Compatibility
ToggleSprint is currently built and optimized for Minecraft 1.21.11 using the Fabric loader. Simply place the downloaded file into your mods directory, assign your preferred hotkey in the settings, and you are ready to go.

body:
# HoYoI (Aka. HoYo UI, HoUI)
## Introduction
This mod simply adds miHoYo/HoYoVerse games UI for Minecraft (like Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rial) with vanilla-like style.  
Now HoYoI only implemented Genshin Style, Star Rail Style is still working in progress.  
Genshin style loading screen has two theme: light and dark. In reallife time 19:00 ~ 7:00 next day the ui will be dark theme.
## Screenshots
### Genshin Style
![Starting game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7055e4140676da4418473d64ecc5dd6323a0701f.jpeg)
This loading screen will only show once when the game starting. Because NeoForge has an early display, so this feature is broken on NeoForge platform.
![Ingame loading](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c5dde7a7d87e188d4780619e76bc0dd1ca61c63.jpeg)
This loading screen will be normally seen in the game, the picture in the center and the tips at the bottom are all random, customizable and localized (I'll talk about how to customize below).
![Pause screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/303a82fc6d43104791af6ba24e44811e489d1458.jpeg)
The ESC pause screen in the game, the "M" button in the sidebar is Mod List button, for Fabric, you need install Mod Menu to open the Mod List screen.
### Star Rail Style
**WIP**

## Customization
You can customize the center picture and bottom tips in loading screen.  

**FIRST**: Create a resource pack (Check [Minecraft Wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Resource_pack))  

### Tips
**SECOND**: Create a file in assets/{yourpack}/tips folder with name {languageCode}.json like "en_us.json"  
**THIRD**: Edit the file like the example shown below
```json
[
  {
    "title": "Example Tip 1",
    "desc": [
      "Line 1",
      "Line 2"
    ]
  },
  {
    "title": "Example Tip 2",
    "desc": [
      "Line 1",
      "Line 2",
      "Line 3",
      "Line 4" // I don't suggest over 4 lines
    ]
  },
  ...
]
```  
**FOURTH**: Load your resource pack
### Center picture
**SECOND**: Put pictures with png format in assets/{yourpack}/textures/ui/regions folder with any filename you like  
**THIRD**: Load your resource pack

## Credits
- [7777777_4547](https://modrinth.com/user/7777777_4547), loading screen ui textures.
- [DeeChael](https://modrinth.com/user/DeeChael), programming and pause screen ui textures. Some tips.

title: Christmas Spirit: Rewoven
description: Christmas joy and cheer
body:
Introduction

Spread Christmas cheer in this mod full of holiday decor! This mod includes many features like gifting presents, decorating Christmas trees, baking holiday sweets, and much more!

This mod is designed to be played with others as it contains a gift system. The intent of this mod is to have it installed, and when December (or any other fitting time) arrives, simply run a command to enable daily gifts. 

This mod is also in Forge! Scroll down to see the version.

 

Features

 

World Gen

When this mod is installed, all biomes generated (excluding oceans by default) will freeze, creating snow and ice all through the lands! This feature can be completely disabled by config.

 

Music

Minecraft's default ambient music has been removed in exchange for 11 Kevin Macleod Christmas songs (which are royalty-free)! This mod also includes Christmas-themed music discs such as "Minecraft Christmas - Area 11 feat Simon from the Yogscasts" & "Wish Backing - Kevin Macleod."

 

Baking

Gingerbread, Sugar Cookies, Peppermint Candy, Soda...and...even...Sprite Cranberry can all be crafted via an involved baking process. These baked goods offer a special effect that will be explained further later.

 

Decorations

Garland, Reefs, Candy Cane Blocks, Christmas Lights, Ornaments, Stockings, Frosted Glass, and much more can all be crafted and help "holiday-ify" your Minecraft world. 

 

Give Gifts to Players

By crafting an Unwrapped Present, players can place any item they'd like to give as a gift. With that item, players specify the color of the present, date, and player they want to open the present. This allows players to set dates when the present can be opened. 

 

Santa Gifts

Every day, when a player logs in, they'll receive a Present from Santa with a random surprise inside! The possible gifts change based on the day it was given. The present's chances of giving you a great item can be increased via stacking the "Holiday Spirit" effect.

 

Naughty or Nice

What if you don't like spreading Christmas cheer? Well, there's a special place in the nether for you! ...Just kidding, there's content for you as well! By doing naughty deeds like killing baby animals, players, cats, dogs, etc., you will gain the "Naughty" effect. When the naughty effect reaches a stack of 5, Santa will write you on his Naughty List! When on the list, instead of receiving cool items from Santa's presents, you will instead be given Lumps of Coal (can be increased with more stacks of Naughty). If Jack Frosts appears, you can trade with him to gain Frostbourne Ingots, which can be crafted into overpowered armor and weapons! If you are on the Naughty List and want to be removed, eat a hard-to-craft Santa Cookie!

 

This Mod is Greatly Enhanced by its Resource Pack!

Get it here!

 

Wiki

Link to Wiki

 

Will you update your mod to x?

1.16.3- I will not update this mod to any previous versions, unfortunately. The reason being; if I did, I would have to keep up with feature updates and bug fixes on both versions, and I simply do not have the time to handle something like that. The source is out there, and I give anyone permission to update this mod as a branch. I will notice your git commit and most likely accept the branch as a new version.

1.16.4+ This mod will be kept updated to future versions when the season arrives around each year (if I'm still inspired to do so)

Forge: CLICK HERE FOR THE FORGE VERSION: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/christmas-spirit

 

 

 

Modpack Policy

You can use this mod in any modpack, whether it's public or private. Just do not claim this mod as your own!

title: BlockShips
description: build ships or airships out of blocks and sail or fly them smoothly - without client side mods or resource packs!
body:
# BlockShips A Minecraft plugin that lets players create rideable, physics-enabled ships. Build custom ships from blocks or spawn pre-built vessels, then sail the seas or take to the skies. All of this *without any client side mods or resource packs!* [![Demo Gif](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/demo_vid.gif)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/demo_vid.webm) **WARNING:** THIS PROJECT IS IN PRE-ALPHA. EXPECT BUGS, MISSING FEATURES, AND BREAKING CHANGES. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK, AND BACKUP YOUR WORLD OFTEN. THE DEVELOPER IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR ANY DAMAGE CAUSED BY THIS PLUGIN. For reporting bugs, either submit a [github issue](https://github.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/issues) or email me at `def9a2a4 d3420b8b7fe04 name`. Sign up for the mailing list at def9a2a4.github.io/signup ![BlockShips](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/main.png) # Features Ships can include: - **Functional blocks** - Crafting tables, anvils, enchanting tables work as normal. (furnaces/brewing stands don't yet work) - **Seats** - Stairs for passengers - **Cannons** - a dispenser with a block of obsidian behind it will shoot its contents. fire all through the ship menu, or right click on the obsidian to fire. | Cannons Firing | Cannon Menu | | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------: | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------: | | ![Cannons Firing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/cannons_firing.png) | ![Cannon Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/menu_cannons.png) (or, right click obsidian to fire individually) | - **Storage** - Chests, barrels, dispensers remain accessible - **Lead points** - Anything leashed to a fence will stay tied to the ship. You can lead things to the ship while its moving. Prefab ships have a single lead point. ## Custom Ships 1. Build a structure from allowed blocks (see or edit this in `blocks.yml`) - generally, wood/metal/functional blocks are allowed, while stone/dirt/other natural blocks are not - light-giving blocks, like glowstone, end rods, and beacons, serve as floatation aids. enough of these, and you get an airship! 3. Craft a "Ship Wheel" 4. Place the wheel on your structure 5. Right-click the wheel to assemble 6. Right-click again to board and steer 7. Right-click the wheel, or sneak right-click, to open menu and disassemble ## Prefab Ships Spawn ready-to-use ships, with customizable banners/colors/wood types: - **Small Ship** - Fast, lightweight water vessel - **Large Ship** - Larger water vessel with more health - **Small Airship** - Floats in the air with vertical controls **Command:** `/blockships give ` ## Physics System - **Walk on your ships** - Players can walk around on deck while sailing/flying. this is still buggy! - **Buoyancy** - Ships float based on block weight and density. this is buggy sometimes! - **Movement** - Acceleration, drag, and collision response - **Collision detection** - Ships interact with terrain and entities (interacting with other ships is buggy) ## Controls | Key | Action | | ------ | ----------------------- | | W | Move forward | | S | Move backward / brake | | A | Rotate left | | D | Rotate right | | Space | Ascend (airships only) | | Sprint | Descend (airships only) | ## Crafting Recipes | Item | Recipe | | :---------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **Ship Wheel** | ![Ship Wheel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/crafting/ship_wheel.png) | | **Small Ship**
*Wood type, banner customizable* | ![Small Ship](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/crafting/small_ship.png) | | **Large Ship**
*Wood type, banner customizable* | ![Large Ship](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/crafting/large_ship.png) | | **Ship Balloon**
*Wool color customizable* | ![Ship Balloon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/crafting/ship_balloon.png) | | **Small Airship**
*Wood type, balloon type customizable* | ![Small Airship](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/BlockShips/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/crafting/small_airship.png) | ## Commands | Command | Description | Permission | | --------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | | `/blockships reload` | Reload configuration | `blockships.reload` | | `/blockships give ` | Give yourself a prefab ship kit | `blockships.give` | | `/blockships recipes [player]` | Unlock crafting recipes | `blockships.recipes` | | `/blockships forcedisassembleall` | **(DANGEROUS) Disassemble all custom ships** | `blockships.admin` | | `/blockships killentities` | **(DANGEROUS) Remove all ship entities** | `blockships.admin` | # Installation 1. Download the BlockShips jar file 2. **IMPORTANT: Download [ProtocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/)** 3. Place both jars in your server's `plugins` folder 4. Restart the server # Configuration ## config.yml Main plugin settings including: - Ship physics (speed, acceleration, drag) - Buoyancy values (density, strength) - Collision settings (mass, response) - Crafting recipes ## blocks.yml Configure which blocks can be used in custom ships: - **Weight scale** - Affects buoyancy - **Collider** - Custom collision shapes - **Seat/storage** - Special block behaviors # Inspiration This plugin is inspired by mods which also implement rideable ships, as well as plugins which have attempted similar functionality. I made this plugin because I realized that with the addition of display entities, it might be possible to create a better ship plugin than previously possible, but without requiring any client-side mods. No code from any of other project has been used. In particular, this plugin was inspired by: - [Ships](https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/ships) and [Movecraft](https://github.com/APDevTeam/Movecraft) plugins - [Archimedes Ships mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/archimedes-ships) - [Eureka Ships / Valkyrian Skies mods](https://www.valkyrienskies.org/) # License You are free to use this plugin only for non-commercial projects and servers. For commercial use, please contact the author for a license. For more details, see the `LICENSE.txt` file.

title: Practical Pets
description: Adds unique useful pets to your game. Each one has a unique use and you can also level them up and wear them special equipment.
body:
## No dependencies

This mod has no dependencies. It required Geckolib in the very first version but not anymore.

# General

Adds unique useful pets to your game. Focused on actually contributing to survival gameplay instead of having the pets constantly sit in a corner.

### [Join the Discord server to discuss development and get new versions sooner!](https://discord.gg/42WWwG8)

# Info Book

*   The info book is an **item** where you can **learn everything about the mod** without having to constantly go to the the Discord changelogs or the CurseForge/Modrinth page
*   It's **given to you when you first join** but you can also **craft it** with 2 strings, 2 feathers, and a book ![info book homepage](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1561/829/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-03-02-164950-png.png) ![info book banana duck page](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1561/828/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-03-02-165016-png.png)

# Bedrock Edition

This will basically be a Java port of my [Bedrock add-on called Billey's Mobs](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft-bedrock/addons/billeys-mobs-addon) but only the mobs from it that have both a good model and a good use.

Fun fact: Billey's Mobs is the oldest ongoing Bedrock add-on

# Pet Equipment

## General

This mods adds several things you can put on your pets, such as **duck armor**, **bowties**, the **founder's pet hat** and the **rubber ducky hat** (see Duck for its function).

To take any equipment off a pet use shears on it or use a pet equipment item that goes in the same slot.

**All of them** except the founder's hat and non-leather duck armor **can be dyed like vanilla leather armor.**

## Pet Bowtie

Pets will get a bowtie for free on tame. The bowtie does nothing useful but bowties dropped by dead pets now show their name, species, level and death message,

## Rubber Ducky Pet Hat

See the duck's info below.

## Pet Chef Hat

Allows rats able to cook ratatouille, can also be put on other pets but it doesn't do anything.

## Pet Backpack

Works like a bundle that can be put on pets. Also allows pigeons to send items to other players.

## Pet End Rod Launcher

Can be put on a pet's back to make it shoot end rods that deal weakness. It needs to be filled with end rods to work. It also gives "bravery" to pets, making them defend themself and their owner even if they normally can't, just like the rubber ducky pet hat and duck armor. ##

![ducks and banana ducks with equipment](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1233/510/image-webp.webp) ![pigeons with equipment](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1496/411/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-01-20-230531-png.png)

# Limited-time Founder's Pet Hat

The first 5 pets you tame before the mod gets popular will get a Founder's Pet Hat. The founder's pet hat makes a pet level up twice as fast. It looks like a blue party hat with glowing yellow dots and a glowing yellow 0 above it.

If the mod ever becomes popular, an update will make the hat unobtainable in survival but it will still be useable for leveling pets or flexing on other players.

A similar anniversary hat will be out every year around the anniversary of either the release date of 0.1.0 or 1.0.0.

# Leveling

Pets can be leveled up by making them kill mobs. Pets become stronger and better at their uses the higher their level is. The [Jade mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jade) is recommended for being able to see a pet's level and its progress to the next one.

All pets start at level 1 and unlike Bedrock Edition there is no max level in this port. However the xp formula kind of blows up around level 15 so you should maybe set level 10 as your goal.

Pets get 1 xp when they successfully hit a mob, and if the hit kills the mob they get `mobMaxHealth / 20` extra, for most monsters this means 1 extra.

Level 2 needs 50 XP, level 2 to level 3 needs 160 - 50 = 110, level 3 to level 4 needs 390 - 160 = 230, and so on according to the formula: `totalXpNeededForLevel = 40 \* (level - 1) + 10 \* (level - 1) \* (level - 1) \* (level - 1)`

There's also a **command** to set a pet's level: **`/practicalpets:set_pet_level <entity> <integer>`**

![level 2 duck with equipment and other pets around it](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1497/979/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-01-27-132013-png.png)

# Other behavior shared by all pets

You can __**double sneak**__ to force all following pets of yours to be teleported to you.

Doing what would make a vanilla pet sit or stand makes a pet of this mod cycle between follow, sit and **wander** instead.

Pets that are mainly non-combat like ducks, banana ducks, rats and pigeons need to be equipped with something that makes them stronger in order for them to be able to defend their owner. Such equipment consists of duck armor, the rubber ducky pet hat, and the pet end rod launcher.

# Pet menu

**Shift-right click** a pet to open its menu. You can use this menu to take equipment on/off a pet, and also to send a pigeon to a player. More functionality will be added to it in the future, such as giving your pet to another player.

![pet menu](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1497/980/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-01-27-132101-png.png)

# Summary of Pets

*   **Banana Duck**: Can make bananas that give you effects and a banana peel that can be used as a trap
*   **Duck**: Finds random items in grass and water, mostly fishing junk and seeds. However rarely it can find the Rubber Ducky Pet Hat or nuggets, including diamond nuggets
*   **Rat**: Can cook ratatouille for you when equipped with a chef hat, and can steal most mobs' weapons and give them to you
*   **Stick Bug**: Defends you from enemies usually without the enemies attacking it back. Can also make potato sticks which can be eaten very fast
*   **Giraffe Cat**: Can extend its neck so you can climb on it, and can also throw your pets at enemies
*   **Piranha**: Not exactly a pet but it can be put in the piranha launcher to shoot piranhas, and the piranha launcher can also be used by pets

Scroll down for more info on the pets.

# Banana Duck

**\- General**  
**Banana ducks** spawn in **jungles**. They are **tamed with bread**.

**\- Bananas**  
After being tamed, you can feed them an **apple** to get a **"poultry banana"**. Poultry bananas give you **random amplifier II beneficial effects**. Eating a desert banana also gives you a **banana peel**, which can be **placed down** and **when something steps on it, it'll lose 12 HP (6 hearts) and get slowness and nausea** for a few seconds. This means **2 banana peels are enough to kill most monsters and even players** not wearing armor.

Banana peels **don’t affect sneaking entities and tamed mobs**.

**\- Duck Armor**  
You can also craft **armor** for banana ducks. Banana ducks equipped with armor will **defend their owner**, and to **take off the armor** use **dirt**. **End rod duck armor** makes the banana duck **shoot end rods at its target** that inflict _weakness_.

**\- Leveling**  
Banana ducks can be **leveled up**. Aside from **their health and attack damage increasing**, leveled banana ducks will also **become able to turn more items into sand bananas instead of just apples**.

*   From **level 5** and onwards they can use **sweet berries**.
*   From **level 7** and onwards they will be able to use poultry oranges when orange penguins are ported.
*   At **level 10** and onwards they can use **melon slices**.

Other mods can add more fruit items to this by adding to the tags "practicalpets:level\_1\_to\_poultry\_banana", "practicalpets:level\_5\_to\_poultry\_banana" etc. Non-modders can also ask me to to add modded fruit items to the tags myself.

![Banana ducks in jungle](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1496/409/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-01-26-231848-png.png)

# Duck

**\- General**  
Ducks _spawn_ in **lakes and rivers** and are **tamed with any kind of seeds**, **carrots**, **melon**, or **bread**.

**\- Finding Items**  
After being tamed, _if they're not sitting_, they'll find **random items in grass and water**, mostly **seeds**, sometimes **fishing loot**, and _rarely_ ore nuggets (including **diamond nuggets**).

**\- Duck Armor**  
You can also craft **armor** for them. Ducks equipped with armor will **defend their owner**. Duck armor has the same tiers as vanilla player armor

**\- Rubber Ducky Pet Hat**  
The **Rubber Ducky** pet hat is an item _rarely_ found by ducks in water. It can be equipped on **any pet** from this mod and makes it **more likely to "combo"**. It also enables pets that don't usually fight for you to **fight for you anyway**, just like any piece of pet equipment that makes the pet stronger does (_currently just this and duck armor_).

**\- Leveling**  
Ducks can be **leveled up**. To **level up** ducks, you have to **make them kill mobs** (by equipping the duck with armor and then attacking mobs). When a duck levels up, its **health and attack damage increase**. Leveled ducks will also **find items in grass and water more often** and also become likely to find **valuable items**

![ducks](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1498/89/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-01-27-182749-png.png)

# Rat

**\- General**  
Rats spawn in forests and swamps. They also spawn underground in most biomes in dark and dim light levels, in y levels 0 to 60.

**\- Taming**  
Tameable with any kind of fruit, seeds, and crops from vanilla or any mod.

**\- Leveling**  
Levelable by killing mobs, higher level rats have more health, more attack damage and make better ratatouille.

**\- Breeding & Patterns**  
If you breed 2 rats of a different color you'll get a rat with a pattern and both of those 2 colors.

**\- Stealing**  
Can steal mobs' equipment\* by you attacking the mob. Unlike bedrock however, they will also bring the stolen item to you instead of just dropping it. The stolen item will also get a random amount of durability damage, which becomes less as the rat levels up until level 10 where damage is added.

**\- Cooking (Ratatouille)**  
If you equip one with a pet chef hat (crafted with carpets), and give a rat a bowl and then 3 crops other than wheat (eg. 2 potatoes and a carrot), it will start cooking and after 10 seconds it'll make Ratatouille which gives night vision and a bit of regeneration and resistance after eaten.

**\- Equipment**  
The chef hat can be dyed in the crafting table like leather armor, rubber ducky hats and pet bowties. It can also be put on pets that can't cook as a purely cosmetic hat.

\-# \*: Only items with a base rarity of Common (items whose name is white unenchanted), and they can't steal items from bosses, so that you don't just get a modded boss's weapon for free

![Rats](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1359/345/screenshot-2025-10-16-204120-png.png)

# Pigeon

*   Spawns in most overworld biomes
*   **Tameable** with **seeds, bread or carrots**

## Sending items to players

*   Equip a pigeon with a **pet backpack** and put items in it and then it'll be able to **send the backpack's content** to other players.
*   The target player must be in the same dimension as you, and more than 32 blocks away.
*   To send a pigeon to a player open **the screen where you put equipment on/off** by shift-right clicking the pigeon, and then press the mail button.
*   Sending a pigeon consumes **1 level** from you. If you don't have a level, you can't send a pigeon.

## Picking up items and bringing them to you

*   Punch air or a block while looking at a dropped item, and the pigeon will bring it to you. Works for items up to 32 blocks away

## Leveling

*   You could level up a pigeon by giving it a rubber ducky hat and carefully making it attack things, but leveling pigeons up doesn't do anything other than increase their health and damage.

![Pigeons](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1496/410/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-01-26-235547-png.png)

# Stick Bug

*   Spawns in forests and jungles
*   **Tameable** with **leaves, seeds** or **fruit**
*   Randomly dance, and also dance to jukeboxes
*   **Defend their owner**, no rubber ducky hat or armor needed
*   **Become invisible when attacking** and also **mobs don't defend themselves from stick bugs**.
*   Mobs that just attack everything like wardens, zoglins and Johnny illagers will still attack them though. They are also not immune to fire/projectiles/explosions/etc.
*   If they randomly dance on a **full grown potato crop**, they'll turn it into **potato sticks** which can be **eaten very fast**
*   Can be leveled up by making them attack things, leveled up stick bugs are stronger and dance randomly more often

![Stick bugs](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1506/168/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-01-31-173250-png.png)

# Giraffe Cat

*   Spawns in savannas
*   **Tameable** with **leaves** or **raw fish**
*   Always defends its owner, no pet equipment needed

## Ladder mode

*   Press the **ladder button in your giraffe cat's menu** to make it **extend its neck** and be **climbable like a ladder**
*   You can alternatively toggle the ladder mode by using a ladder on the giraffe cat. The ladder won't be consumed
*   When it's in ladder mode, **right click** it to **extend its neck**, **shift right click** it to **shrink it**
*   If its neck is shrunk to under 2 blocks, it'll exit ladder mode
*   If it's hurt, including by you, while in ladder mode, it will take no damage and exit ladder mode
*   **Teleports to you after you climb it**

## Throwing pets at enemies

*   If a tamed giraffe cat is angry at something, it'll **pick up** non-sitting **pets** of the same owner **and throw them at its target**
*   It can pick up any pet, whether from this mod, other mods or vanilla
*   If the thrown pet hits the target, the giraffe cat's and thrown pet's attack damage and effects are both applied to it
*   If the thrown pet hits the target, or misses it but can pathfind to it, **the thrown pet will become angry at the target**, even if it usually wouldn't defend its owner

## Crossbreeding with cats

if you breed a giraffe cat with a cat, the baby will be a **giraffe cat with the cat's variant**

## Leveling

Giraffe cats can **level up** by attacking/killing mobs, whether directly or by throwing pets. Higher level giraffe cats just have more health and more attack damage.

![Giraffe cats](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1524/788/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-02-09-175631-png.png)

# Kiwi

*   Spawns in forests at night
*   Tameable with **spider eyes** and fermented spider eyes
*   Can also be bred and healed with seeds and fruit

## Shearing

*   Can be **sheared** for its feathers, which can be used to **craft** most of the **pet equipment**
*   Leveling it up makes its feathers regrow faster
*   Can also be **bone mealed** to regrow its feathers faster

## Pet Hat

*   **Crafted** with a piece of **kiwi feathers** and **a piece of leather**
*   **Dyeable** like most pet equipment and vanilla leather amor
*   Looks like a very plain hat
*   Destroys itself to **absorb damage that would've otherwise killed the pet**

## Leveling

Kiwis can be **leveled up** by **making them kill things**. Since they don't usually defend you you have to equip them with something that makes them stronger (currently just the **rubber ducky pet hat**, and the pet end rod launcher but pets can't level with it).

![Kiwis](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1550/584/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-02-24-092022-png.png)

# Piranha

## General

Piranhas spawn in **rivers** and especially **jungle** **rivers** and are tamed with any kind of **fish**. Taming them makes them not attack other fish and their owner, but they'll still attack monsters and other players. They can also be put in a **bucket**.

## Attacking

Wild piranhas attack monsters, players and other fish randomly if the total amount of nearby piranhas x 5 is greater than the mob or player's health. For example, to attack a full-health player unprovoked, there need to be at least 4 piranhas.

## Piranha Launcher

The piranha launcher can be **crafted** with a raw piranha and some iron and redstone. **Punch** **piranhas** while holding a piranha launcher to **load** **it**. A piranha launcher can fit up to **64** piranhas. Right click with a loaded piranha launcher to shoot. The piranha launcher can also be **dyed** in the crafting table.

## Launched Piranhas

Launched piranhas will **attach** to their target and **continuously** **attack** it. After 30 seconds they'll **despawn** even though they are tamed. If you want to keep a launched piranha as a pet instead of a weapon, put it in and out of a **bucket**.

## On Pets

The piranha launcher can be put on a pet's head and the pet will then use it to throw piranhas at enemies. It also allows weak pets to defend themselves and their owner.",

## In Dispensers

The piranha launcher can also be put in dispensers. The dispensed piranhas will have the player who last loaded the piranha launcher as their owner.

![Piranhas](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1583/926/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-03-16-130708-png.png)

# Vanilla pets

**Cats**, **wolves** and **parrots** can now use **every** **feature** from this mod, which is:

*   Pet equipment
*   Pet leveling
*   Wandering
*   Double sneaking to force them to teleport to you if they're following you
*   Guarding
*   Cats and parrots can defend themselves and their owner if equipped with something that makes them stronger, such as a rubber ducky or a piranha launcher.

There are plans to also do this with pets from Alex's Mobs and Alex's Caves(and maybe a few other pet mods, suggest which ones), and also plans to give vanilla pets more uses.

Also, despite Domestication Innovation also making cats, wolves and parrots able to wander, **this mod works fine both with** and **without** Domestication Innovation installed.

![Vanilla pets](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1595/779/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-03-23-222405-png.png)

# Alex's Mobs Pets

**Raccoons** and **crows** can also use the features of this mod. More other mod pets soon, suggest which ones.

![Alex's Mobs Pets](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1599/702/iii1i3i14i1iiiii-ii-ii12ii-2026-03-26-131253-png.png)

# To do next:

1.  Make pets from alex's mobs and caves able to use this mod's features
2.  Port more mobs over from the bedrock version, the next ones will probably be mercats, anglerfish, netherrats and the rat king boss

See the respective section in the [Bedrock add-on's page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft-bedrock/addons/billeys-mobs-addon) for details on these plans.

title: REP
description: REP introduces a dynamic reputation system to Minecraft, where player actions influence their standing in the world, affecting mob behavior, villager interactions, and environmental responses.
body:
# REP

![REP Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/749c0d3580d5ecab3d9537baa79780b70955a794.png)

REP introduces a dynamic and immersive reputation system to Minecraft, fundamentally changing how players interact with the game world. This mod creates a living, reactive environment where every action has consequences, adding depth and strategic thinking to your Minecraft experience.

## Important Note on Multiplayer Compatibility

**REP is primarily designed for single-player experiences.** The current implementation uses global variables to track reputation, which means in a multiplayer setting, all players share the same reputation score. Any reputation-altering event triggered by one player will affect all players equally. This design choice may lead to unexpected gameplay experiences in multiplayer environments.

## Core Features:

1. **Dynamic Reputation System**: Your reputation score, ranging from 0 to 100, reflects your standing in the world. Start at a very good 100 and watch as your actions influence this score.

2. **Mob Behavior Changes**: As your reputation drops, the world becomes more hostile. Experience increased spawn rates of aggressive mobs, with additional hostiles potentially spawning alongside regular mobs.

3. **Iron Golem Reactions**: These village protectors become more than just passive guardians. With a low reputation, Iron Golems may turn hostile, adding a new layer of challenge to village interactions.

4. **Agricultural Consequences**: Your reputation affects your ability to cultivate the land. Low-reputation players face a high chance of crop growth failure and reduced harvest yields, making survival more challenging.

5. **Villager Trade Alterations**: Your standing in the world directly impacts your economic interactions. Higher reputations lead to better deals with villagers, while a poor reputation results in inflated prices and potential trade rejection.

6. **Weather Influence**: Your actions don't just affect the inhabitants - they impact the very environment. Lower reputations increase the frequency and duration of rain, with very low standings potentially triggering more thunderstorms.

7. **Achievement Rewards**: Positive actions are rewarded! Earn 10 reputation points for each advancement you complete. Defeat the mighty Ender Dragon or the fearsome Wither, and your reputation will soar to the maximum of 100!

8. **Explosive Mining Consequences:** With low reputation, mining becomes a risky endeavor. Ores have a chance to explode upon being mined, adding an element of danger to resource gathering.

# 

REP seamlessly integrates into the single-player environment, adding a new dimension to survival and roleplay. Every decision becomes meaningful as players balance their actions against potential reputation loss or gain.

Whether you're building a thriving, respected community or embracing the role of a notorious outlaw, ReputationMod ensures your choices shape the world around you. Will you be revered as a hero or feared as a villain? The choice - and the consequences - are yours.

Compatible with Minecraft Forge 1.20.1, REP is more than just an addition to your game - it's a complete reimagining of how you interact with the Minecraft world.

Embark on a new adventure where your reputation precedes you, and every action echoes through the cubic landscapes of Minecraft!

title: The Psychological Backrooms
description: A backrooms mod. A psychological, spontaneous, unpredictable one.
body:
There are plenty of other Backrooms mods out there. LudoCrypt's, Gargin's, SpacePotato's... but mine is different. 

My Backrooms mod has 6 levels complete, and I am adding more and more. My entities are complex and cannot be stopped by simply pillaring up. I am making my own OST of music for my mod to add to the ambience. My Backrooms are not something to escape. They are something to accept. I do not plan on adding an easy escape. There may be an escape, but it is better to accept your fate. The walls of my Backrooms can be torn down. You can craft things. Make things. You don’t just wander and run from things. You eke out an existence, and try not to have it torn down. My Backrooms are psychological.

In this mod, as you walk around the Overworld, you will notice that something is... off. A block's texture might repeat in an ugly way. The lighting might look weird. When you touch these objects, you will slip out of reality and into a strange place.

_Which you are unlikely to ever leave._

# Levels
Each level is unique, from the strange, perfect serenity of the Poolrooms to the oddly comforting darkness of the Baywalk. These diverse environments are connected by a variety of entrances and exits that take a variety of different forms. But beware not to linger; nowhere is really, truly safe.

# Entities
My entities aren't just a bunch of GeckoLib models that chase you around. Mine are different. For one, they spawn differently. They spawn only occasionally rarely, and when they do spawn, they spawn near you, but just out of your sight. I have a wide variety of entities. They can exhibit complex behaviors; the Troglosidae are procedurally animated, the Smilers can become incorporeal to phase through blocks you might place behind you to stymie it, the Dullers make you hallucinate, making you think you're somewhere you aren't, and making you see _things_ out of the corner of your eye, and more. You can't pillar up. You can't fight back. You just run. Learned helplessness, Wanderer. Accept your fate.

# Objects
Do not worry, my Backrooms are not endless terror. There are strange and beautiful moments, as well as absurd ones. As an example, take the random, strange items. Chocolate Sludge, Almond Water, Portable Purifiers; they do things. Strange things you wouldn't expect. I won't say how they work.

# Sanity
Stay sane, Wanderer. Keep drinking Almond Water. Keep resting. Don't go seeing things that your brain cannot handle. Otherwise, _things may happen to you._

Ok but in all seriousness, I have this really complicated sanity system. Your sanity goes up and down due to a variety of factors, such as where you are, your diet, and even stuff like if you have flowers or other certain items in your inventory.

title: Re:Zero RBD

To understand the mod, every 20 minutes (base value, the duration of the interval can be changed with the command "/setinterval <min>" ) a checkpoint is automatically created, and at each achievement, there is a 25% chance that a checkpoint is also created ("/setchance <0 -> 100>"). You can also use "/cp" to force a checkpoint and "/restore" to force the restoration of the checkpoint ("/kill @p" works just as well).

description: Adds kelpies to Minecraft
body: Simple Kelpies, as the name suggests, adds kelpies to Minecraft! Kelpies are mythical beings, said to take the form of (usually white) horses in order to lure people onto their backs so they can take them into the water and drown/eat them. The mod adds kelpies in the form of white horses that can be found on beaches, near rivers, or near oceans. Should you try and ride one, they'll do exactly what the myth says and gallop off towards the water with you to kill you. Be careful, a kelpie in the water is a lot stronger than a kelpie on land! Should you choose, you can tame a kelpie of your own! Plenty of stories say that if you bridle a kelpie, it becomes tame. Find the rare golden bridle in a dungeon (rare), shipwreck (less rare), or underwater ruin (common) and you can see for yourself! A tamed kelpie is faster and can jump higher than your average horse. They'll eat any meat, salmon, or cod, that you offer them if you need to heal them. To breed kelpies (version 1.2.0 and higher) you'll need to catch the rare goldfin cod. Kelpies can not only be bred with other kelpies, you can also crossbreed them with horses to try and breed superior horses! If you're lucky, breeding two kelpies might reward you with the rare black kelpie. Take a look here if you'd prefer a quick video overview: Like my mods? Consider donating to my Ko-fi!

title: SmoothMount
description: This mod adds smooth animations for mounting horses, camels, and other riding creatures.
body:
# 🐴 SmoothMount

**SmoothMount** overhauls the mounting and dismounting mechanics in Minecraft, replacing instant teleportation with smooth, natural animations. The mod adds a cinematic touch to interacting with mounts, making gameplay more immersive and visually pleasing.

![Pig Animation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ug2E4xy4/images/51ddf3b84bd9e98eb1fe4a8a06fee363c09e7a6a.gif)

## ✨ How it Works?

In vanilla Minecraft, the player instantly teleports onto the creature's back, which often looks abrupt and breaks immersion.
**SmoothMount** fixes this:

- **Mounting Animation:** A full animation plays showing the character climbing into the saddle.
- **Dismounting Animation:** When getting off, the player smoothly lowers themselves to the ground instead of instantly appearing standing next to the mount.
- **Dynamic Camera:** The camera gently follows the player's movement during the animation, avoiding sharp jumps in viewing angle and creating a sense of presence.

![Minecart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ug2E4xy4/images/d08cbc157643e41682bf3467b0071df929d6925a.gif)

## 🐾 Supported Entities

**The current beta versions support** the following mobs with full animation implementation:

- 🐎 **Horses**, **Donkeys**, **Mules**
- 🐷 **Pigs**

### ⚠️ Limitations
On other rideable entities (camels, striders, boats, minecarts, etc.), animations are **not yet played**, and mounting occurs in the standard way.
Support for additional transport will be added in future updates.
Please note that existing animations may also be refined or changed in future updates.

## ⚔️ Conflicts

- **Entity Model Features (EMF):** There is partial support, but animations may appear jittery or stuttering.
- Other mods have not been tested

title: No OP TP Port
description: No OP TP Port allows players to teleport without OP or enabling cheats.
body:
No OP TP Port allows players to teleport without OP or enabling cheats.

Designed to work perfectly with Xaero’s World Map, but also provides a standalone /tp command — meaning players can teleport even without any map mod installed.

This mod replaces vanilla /tp with a safe implementation so servers and singleplayer worlds can keep cheats disabled while still allowing teleportation.

Works on both servers and singleplayer.

Features:
- Teleport without OP
- Cheats OFF supported
- Works on multiplayer servers
- Works without any map mod installed
- Compatible with Xaero’s World Map
- Supports /tp, /tp @s, and /tp @s <player>
- Blocks all other OP commands

Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric)

Requires Fabric API.

                                                                                                                                                                             



⚠️ WARNING FOR SERVER OWNERS:

This mod intentionally enables /tp for ALL players without OP.

Anyone on your server will be able to teleport using /tp, even with cheats disabled.

Only install this mod if you WANT players to have teleport access.

This mod is designed for:
- SMP servers with trusted players
- Private servers
- Modpacks that allow teleporting
- Singleplayer worlds

Do NOT use on public servers unless you understand the implications.

Server installation:
- Upload the mod to your server's mods folder
- Make sure Fabric API is also installed
- Restart the server

                                                                                                                                                                             

Permissions:

This mod replaces Minecraft’s default /tp command and sets it to permission level 0.

This means ALL players can teleport without OP.

No other operator commands are affected.

Only /tp is enabled — commands like /give, /gamemode, and /op remain locked.

                                                                                                                                                                             

FAQ:

Q: Does this work on servers?
A: Yes. This mod works on both multiplayer servers and singleplayer.

Q: Does this require Xaero’s World Map?
A: No. Xaero’s Map is optional. The mod provides a standalone /tp command.

Q: Do players need OP?
A: No. /tp works without OP.

Q: Does this enable cheats?
A: No. Cheats remain disabled.

Q: Can I teleport a player to me?
A: No. Only self teleport is supported.

Q: Can I teleport myself to another player?
A: Yes. via /tp @s player, Or if useing Xaero's world map right click on player and left click teleport.

Q: Is Fabric API required?
A: Yes.

Q: What Minecraft versions are supported?
A: Currently Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric).

Q: Is this safe for public servers?
A: Only if you WANT all players to have teleport access.

                                                                                                                                                                             

Troubleshooting:

/tp says "Unknown command"
- Make sure Fabric API is installed
- Make sure No OP Port (Fabric) is in the mods folder
- Restart the game or server

Players still need OP
- Make sure no other mods are overriding /tp
- Restart after installing the mod
- Verify you are running Fabric, not Forge or Vanilla

Server won’t start
- Confirm Fabric Loader is installed on the server
- Confirm Fabric API is present
- Check latest.log for missing dependencies

Teleport does nothing
- Make sure you are using supported formats:
/tp x y z
/tp @s x y z
/tp @s <player>

Xaero’s Map teleport doesn’t work
- Ensure both No OP Port and Fabric API are installed on the server
- Restart server after installing mods

Mod not loading
- Verify Minecraft version is 1.20.1
- Check that Fabric Loader version matches
- Remove conflicting mods and test again

Still having issues?
If you find a bug, please include your Minecraft version and latest.log. ( If you dont want everyone to see your log please send me a DM And i will get back to you ASAP)

                                                                                                                                                                             

Known Issues:

- This mod intentionally allows ALL players to use /tp without OP.
  This is not a bug.

- Cannot distinguish between chat teleport and map teleport on Fabric 1.20.1.
  Players can manually type /tp.

- Incompatible with mods that replace or heavily modify Minecraft’s command system.

- Player names must be exact when using /tp @s <player>.

- Cross-dimension teleport may behave differently depending on server configuration.

- Public servers should only use this mod if teleporting is intended.

If you find a bug, please include your Minecraft version and latest.log. ( If you dont want everyone to see your log please send me a DM And i will get back to you ASAP)

## Fast Paths

A minimalist utility designed to give a functional purpose to your terraforming. In standard Minecraft, dirt paths are purely decorative; this project changes that by granting players a subtle, natural speed increase while walking on any Dirt Path block.

body:
### **Modpack Information**
**The Guild Pack is a 1.20.1 "kitchen sink" styled modpack using the Fabric mod loader.** The pack is designed to renew your interest in Minecraft by utilizing some of the best mods currently available for Fabric. This means massive overhauls to exploration and world generation, magic, machines, and plenty more!

![An image of terrain generation in the modpack](https://i.imgur.com/MoxDQKT.jpeg)
Seed: 8027209745897565245 | Coordinates: -861 63 1127

### Like most kitchen sink packs, we offer a variety of mods to help keep you entertained, including *(but not limited to)*:
- **Better Nether & End:** We can all agree that the nether update was a massive step in the right direction, though the end's still a bit lacking. Well, with Better Nether and Better End both dimensions receive a massive facelift and content expansion!
- **Create:** One of the most innovative mods in recent Minecraft history, Create allows you to make the most extravagant machines your mind can imagine. The sky and your framerate is unironically the limit with Create. We also have a few other addon mods for Create to help enhance the experience even further!
- **William Wythers' Expanded Ecosphere:** Explore a vastly improved overworld filled with over 200 new biomes. There are a few other mods in the mix to make sure that overworld terrain looks amazing!
- **YUNG's Better Structures:** This isn't actually the name of the mod, but YUNGNICKYOUNG has made a library of mods which overhaul desert temples, dungeons, mineshafts, nether fortresses, ocean monuments, witch huts, and some smaller side-extras, too!

![An example of End terrain generation](https://i.imgur.com/JvKguGP.jpeg)
Seed: 8027209745897565245 | Coordinates: 423 60 -6915

### We also have some uncommonly used mods, as well!:
- **Figura**: Figura allows users to make their own and fully custom player models. While there is ultimately a limit on what you can do, the amount of customization and personalization this mod offers is absolutely impressive!
- **Victus:** Victus transforms getting damaged into a beneficial gameplay mechanic to completely customize your combat experience. By making and using custom "aspects", you can alter your hearts to give effects which trigger when that heart no longer has any health. From replicating the totem of undying's effect to effectively turning yourself into a creeper, the possibilities are vast!
- **This is a non-complete list!** There's plenty more commonly and uncommonly used mods in the pack! If you'd like to see the full list, click on the latest version and scroll down!

![An example of terrain generation.](https://i.imgur.com/JlJfLvM.jpeg)
Seed: 8027209745897565245 | Coordinates: 1665 66 -1066

### **6 gigabytes of RAM is recommended to run this pack!** 
We've done our best to optimize everything given how many mods are in the pack, but for the smoothest experience; definitely run it with at least 6 gigabytes of RAM allocated. You can run the pack in singleplayer with as little as 4 gigabytes, but you may have some stuttering on occasion.

### **Java 17 is strongly recommended!** 
[You can find a list of downloads for that here!](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/corretto/latest/corretto-17-ug/downloads-list.html)

> [You can find the specific mods that we use by looking in the Dependencies list for our latest version of the modpack!](https://modrinth.com/modpack/the-guild-pack/version/2.17.25-v1)
Note: This is only for the mods hosted on Modrinth! All the other mods will be credited below.
