The Create mod is among the best mods in all of modern minecraft. Good enough to have tons of addons for itself alone. This modpack will introduce you to many Create addons for you to enjoy.

# What is Create? 
Create is a technology mod based on automation and movement. Create's simple yet complex functions make it the perfect candidate to expand. Using Create, you can automate the production, extraction and refinement of Minecraft's resources at the same time.

Create relies on a thing called rotational force. Rotational force operates on 2 variables: speed and stress. Speed is the rpm of a shaft, and stress is the capacity of a machine before it stops working. Rotational Force is the lifeblood of Create, and Create: Maximized by extension. There are many ways to create Rotational Force.

Create features machines called contraptions. Contraptions are capable of smoothly moving blocks around, and many other functions you can explore, such as mining, cutting down whole trees, farming, the possibilities in Create are truly endless.

# Maximized
A quest tree is available now on versions up to 0.4. Coming to later versions soon.

title: MTE Patches
description: Fix bugs and add useful patches for various mods.
body:
# MTE Patches
Fix bugs, add useful patches, and maybe some optimizations for various mods.  
Made for the modpack Minetech Evolution. Use freely if you want any fixes in the mod. Most fixes are toggleable via config. 
This mod works outside of the modpack as well.  
## Generic Features:

### Connection Timeout
Add a timeout when it's retrieving info for some mods, prevent it from freezing the loading progress forever on a lossy internet connection.  
Supported mods:
- Biomes o' Plenty
- Industrial Foregoing

### Multitool Compatibility
Some mod have tools that can consume the entire multitool item from Omniwand/morph-o-tool on breaking.  
This provides fix to certain tools by firing a PlayerDestroyItemEvent on breaking.  

#### Supported items:
- IndustrialCraft2 Wrench
- ProjectRed Screwdriver
- Immersive Engineering Hammer 

### [Client] Render Culling
Skips rendering of certain complex things of some tileentities, when:
- It's far away from the player. (distance configurable)
- It's rendering shadows for shaders.

Including:
- Buildcraft(Items and Fluid in pipes)
- Forestry(Fluid in machines)
- Thermal Dynamics(Items/Fluid in ducts)
- Project Red(Items in pipes)
- Any custom TileEntity with a special renderer

Culled TileEntity types can be configured separately for far and shadow.  

### World Leak Fix
After quitting a world, some mod keeps referencing it somewhere, preventing it from being cleaned by java's garbage collection.  
This patch fixes some world leaks in these mods:  
- Immersive Engineering
- Railcraft
- Thermal Dynamics
- Energy Control
- FTB Utilities

However, it's difficult to fix all world leaks in a large modpack.  

## Mod-specific patches:  
### Railcraft
#### Multiblock Desync fix  
  Fix a desync bug of multiblock that when the multiblock is across chunks.
  This can be easily reproduced by building a multiblock tank across 4 chunks, forceload one chunk of them, walk away from the tank, quit and rejoin world, then walk back slowly.  
  When desync, client can get its inventory scrambled when right-clicking at the bugged multiblock.  
  RC 12.1.0-beta8 doesn't need this fix. Other fixes may still work.  
#### Free Turbine Repair fix  
  Fix turbine being fixed for free when putting in crafting slot with a blade and take it out.
#### Outfitted Track Drops fix
Fix outfitted tracks drops only the kit but not the track when destroyed.  
#### Replace Outfitted Track
Allow track relayer to replace outfitted track.  
#### Item Loader/Unloader Optimization
Optimize item loader/unloaders by moving many items at an interval, instead of moving one item every tick  
#### Tile Cache Purging
Tile caches can miss some updates occuring in neighbouring tileentities, like multiblock formation.  
This patch adds an interval(in ticks) to purge the cache.  
#### Charge Network Fix[EXPERIMENTAL]
Charge Network in RC is very buggy. This fix improves its stability by a lot, but it's still a bit buggy yet.  
#### Railcraft IC2 EU Loader/Unloader Drop Fix
Fix EU Loader/Unloader not dropping upgrades on break.  

### IndustrialCraft 2
#### Mass Fabricator Stuck  
Mass fabricator stuck forever when its output is blocked once. This mod can fix this.  
#### Crops and Farmlands  
This is a enhancement for IC2, allowing crop sticks to be put on other mod's farmlands, as long as it extends from BlockFarmland.  
#### Crop Trample Prevention
Prevent breaking crop sticks when walking over it  
#### Block Keybinds in GUI  
Prevent IC2 keybinds in GUIs. Fixes jetpack being activated when pressing jump with the inventory open.  
#### LAN message fix
Fixes a bug that on a LAN server, all IC2 messages are sent to the host, instead of the player that should receive the message.  
#### Scale Generator Buffers
Increase buffer size of generators that had very small buffers with energy generation factors in config, to prevent output capping when a large factor is set.
#### Explosion Protection
Make IC2 Explosions respect to FTB Utilities Permissions, so IC2 explosions won't break blocks in chunks protected by FTBU.  

### Thermal Series
#### Fuzzy NBT Recycling  
Enhancement for Thermal Expansion, allows recycling enchanted items with induction smelter and sawmill.  

### Forestry  
#### Faulty Queen Bee Fix  
Prevent crashing when placing a faulty queen bee into apiary  
#### MultiFarm Soil Replacement Fix
Fix multi-farm does not return dirt or sand when replacing soil  
#### BuildCraft Compat Fix
Fix Forestry's BuildCraft compat modules not working with BC8.0.  
#### Allow Analyzer with Errors
Allow analyzing bees in apiary gui, even when the apiary has errors active.  
#### Allow Partially Filled Containers
Make container slot of squeezer and still accept partially filled containers.  

### RFTools
#### [Client] Modular Storage GUI Tweaks  
- Shift Tweak  

  When pulling out items with shift, don't refresh the list until the mouse is released.  Improves compatibility with MouseTweaks.  

- Insertion Tweak  

  When putting your held item into the storage, prevent swapping the hovered item out from the storage.

### BuildCraft
#### Item Pipe Accepts Ejection
Allows BuildCraft item pipes to accept items ejected from vanilla hoppers and machines from other mods.  
#### RF/FE Compatibility
(Disabled by default) Simply make BuildCraft works with RF/FE.  
#### Enforce Power Limits
(Disabled by default) Apply the transfer rate limits to kinesis pipes. Also limits how much power can be stored in it.  
#### Clean owner profile from NBT
Some mod adds additional data to player profile, and these are stored to NBT in BC blocks. This patch removes them from BC NBT as they are useless there.  

### Moar Tinkers
#### Disable Mining Boost when Sneaking
A QoL Feature, disables server-side mining speed boost of traits when sneaking, to prevent over-mining with it  

### Industrial Foregoing
#### Insertion Conveyor Upgrade Duplication Fix
Fixed a item duplication bug for insertion conveyor upgrade.  
#### Meat Feeder Null Handler Check
Do null check before meat feeder drains fluid from containers. Prevents potential NullPointerException

### ProjectRed
#### Breaking Speed Fix
Fix breaking speed for machines and parts on ProjectRed. Now their breaking speed are affected by player's tool and effects.  
#### Pressure Tube Item Limit
Items can cram up in ProjectRed's pressure tubes under some conditions.  
With this feature, pressure tubes with item stacks more than this value will be considered unpassable when pathfinding, so items won't cram up infinitely and cause huge lags.  
#### Machine inventory size fix
Fix inventory sizes of certain machines to fix related crashes.  
#### [Client] Lamp Shaders Compat
A workaround to make lamp halos render correctly with shaders.  

### Storage Drawers
#### Clear empty slot
QoL feature: Unmark an empty slot from an formerly-locked drawer with a left-click.
#### Trim Pick Block Patch
Fixes pick block on trims from storage drawers and storage drawers extra.  
#### [Client] Backface Culling
Do not render items in drawers that are backwards towards the player. Improves FPS.  

### Storage Drawers Extras
#### Extra trim subtypes
Fixes silk touch drops for Extra Trims
#### Localization key fix
Fix unlocalized keys in trim tooltips

### Biomes o' Plenty
#### [Client] Fog performance fix
Improves FPS by reducing looped calculations on every frame in BOP's event listener.  

### Steve's Carts Reborn
#### More Bridger Blocks
Allows all solid, opaque, non-falling blocks to be used in bridger module.  

### IC2 crop breeding plugin
#### Calculator GUI fix
Fix wrong items appearing in crop calculator GUI on inventory update.  

### Not Enough Wands
#### GL attribute leakage fix
NotEnoughWands leaks OpenGL attributes in its overlay, and may break other mod's overlay. This fixes the leak.  
#### Wand RF cost fix
Fix wand RF cost being capped at the value configured.  
Some wands may cost more than configured, like acceleration wand in faster and fastest modes  

### Vanilla
#### [Client] Don't receive item entities when dead
Stops receiving new item entities on client when player is dead. Item entities doesn't remove correctly on client-side when player is dead, so they can get more and more over time, causing huge lags.  
#### Falling block dupe glitch
(Disabled by default) Stops vanilla falling block duplication with end portal, by blocking falling block entities from being teleported by the portal.  
#### Floating Pumpkins & Floating Fence Gates
Allows placing pumpkins and/or fence gates without a block below it.

title: Velocity
description: A high performance shader forked from Mellow. Improved in basically every aspect.
body:
# Velocity Shaders
A higher performance fork of Mellow Shaders for basicially every version of Minecraft.

This project results in an average framerate of rougly 133 FPS on a 5GB NVIDIA Quadro P2200 with the Remarkably Optimized modpack.
Most GPUs can run this at 240 FPS or higher.

Per the original author's request, this project has been named Velocity instead of Mellow: Reimagined, so if you dig through the files and see references to it, this is why. I didn't see the file until the end, so sorry!

## Optional Performance Increases
The #1 and BEST method for increasing your framerate is a good modpack for this. I recommend Remarkably Optimized for the best experience, though some mods are incompatable with Ixeris if you like adding mods such as flashback. Adding flashback also requires removing the C2ME mod from RO

If your running this on integrated graphics, disable water reflections, set the profile from custom to fast (default), disable dynamic shadows and lighting, and if you want to be extra cautious, disable the sun rays and bloom.
Most players will not encounter issues like this as Mellow is already a highly performance based shader and this is a fork of it featuring additional performance upgrades over base Mellow.

title: Forge & Fables II
description: Tech meets Pokémon: automate, survive, and catch 'em all!
body:
#
Welcome to **[WIP]** 'Forge & Fables II'!


##
Modpack Features

### 🌍 Worldgen & Exploration 🌎 _Explore, Explore, Explore!_ - Experience & Explore Larger, More Layed out Biomes to get a Fresh & Unique experience every time thanks to our World Generation Mods like [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith), [Biomes O' Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty) and [Continents](https://modrinth.com/datapack/continents)! - While exploring you will also be encountering many new Plants & Crops from mods like [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) (+ Add-ons) that you will be able to Farm, which are integrated with [Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons) to more effectively grow certain Crops depending on the Season! - There are plenty of non-vanilla Dimensions for you to explore! A good example of relatively new one would be _The Other Side_ from [Deeper and Darker](), as well as some of the more classic ones; [The Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest) and [The Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether)!

### ![poke_ball](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b515403f9389a30ec023f7918372fc42e0c2e5b.png) Pokémon & Custom 'Mons ![poke_ball](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c26aac2724cf2f732bf190e2f5fefe413de1dff6.png) _Gotta catch 'em all!_ - We use the very beloved and easily customizable [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) mod in order to give players the best Pokémon experience within Minecraft! - There are also plenty of add-on to build upon the foundation of base Cobblemon, such as [Mega Showdown](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-mega-showdown) which adds Mega Evolution and many other features from other Pokémon games, while something like [Raid Dens](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemonraiddens) expand on ways to obtain Pokémon! - We also couldn't exclude some amazing Datapacks such as [ATM x MSD](https://modrinth.com/datapack/allthemons-x-mega-showdown-legacy) to expand even more upon available Pokémon & their Variants, and even [ATM x MSD - Radiants](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-radiants) to expand even more upon that idea! - Lastly, we have our own mod called [Cobbleworks](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobbleworks-fw) which adds a few Custom 'Mons inspired by various things, including one Custom Mega Evolution!

### ⚔️ Weapons & Tools 🛠️ _Craft Some Trusty Tools!_ - The Combat Experience has been completely overhauled by the [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat) Mod, allowing for easier, more consistent hits and being able hold down your Attack Button as well as introducing more Strengths & Weaknesses depending on what type of Weapon you are wielding! - There's also plenty of Craftable and Upgradables Weapons & Tools to extend progression and give you as the player more options, like [Immersive Ores](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-ores) that adds unique craftable Tools & Weapons that expand upon Netherite! - Lastly, there are new Mobs, as well as Mob Variants to test out your new arsenal on!

### ⚙️ Machinery & Quality of Life ⛏️ _Become a self-proclaimed Engineer!_ - With [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) (+ Add-ons) you will be able to make very complex machinery and set up automations that vanilla won't allow you to do, all while keeping it looking and feeling interesting! - The [Carpet](https://modrinth.com/mod/carpet) Mod is also included within the modpack, changing a lot of the game from a technical perspective, most notably being able to move certain Entities with Pistons (such as Chests!) - You can't have a Modpack without any Quality of Life. We have added mods to make your experience more enjoyable, seemless & immersive! - The Performance of the Modpack remains (relatively) stable thanks to mods like [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium/versions)!

### 🏡 Building Blocks & Decoration 🏮 _Build away!_ - We have added [Stoneworks](https://modrinth.com/mod/stoneworks) to expand on Vanilla Blocks (Variants), giving you many more Vanilla-friendly options to build with! - Other than the Lots & Lots of Building Blocks that have been added, there are also a few new Decoration Blocks available, such as the Magical Lanterns from [Arcane Lanterns](https://modrinth.com/mod/arcane-lanterns/versions) or Functional Trash Cans from the [Trash Cans](https://modrinth.com/mod/trash-cans/versions) Mod! - [Every Compat (Wood)](https://modrinth.com/mod/every-compat) and [Every Compat (Stone)](https://modrinth.com/mod/stone-zone) have also been included, automatically implementing a lot of recipes with custom wood & stone types!

### 🖼️ Textures & Shaders ☀️ _Prettifying your game since 2026!_ - Our Modpack makes use of [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) to the best Minecraft Shaders experience to you! - By Default, you will have access to the [Complementary - Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined) & [Solas](https://modrinth.com/shader/solas-shader) Shader Packs, but you can always import any Shader Packs of your own choosing! - We also use [Colorwheel](https://modrinth.com/mod/colorwheel) to optimize supported Modpacks to increase performance drastically when rendering moving parts from mods like Create! - Our Pack also comes with [Unique Dark - Lite](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/unique-dark), [ATM x MSD](https://modrinth.com/datapack/allthemons-x-mega-showdown-legacy), [Cobblemon Minimap Icons](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/e19_cobblemon_minimap_icons), [Emissive Cobblemon Ores](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cobblemon-emissive-ores) and [Just Expressions](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/just-expressions) Enabled by Default to give players a Clean Dark-mode Experience and a few great Quality of Life Features right out the box!

_(Unique Dark - Lite can be toggled within the Resource Pack menu in-game!)_

## Additional Information

### 📈 Memory Settings 📉 _Where did my frames go?_ - Make sure you Allocate plenty of Memory (RAM) to your Minecraft instance! - Unsure how to do that? It's easy: 1. Open up the **_Modrinth App_** 2. Head to your **_'Forge & Fables II'_** Instance (where you Launch the Modpack!) 3. Press the **_Big Cogwheel_** (⚙️) in the Top-Right Corner 4. Head to the **_(🍵) 'Java and memory'_** Tab 5. Check (✅) the **_'Custom memory allocation'_** box 6. Change the value to **_'6144' (MB)_**, or to **_'10240' (MB)_** for beefier PC's! 7. Enjoy!

### 👥 Public Server 👥 _Time to build a community!_ - This Modpack comes with a Ready-to-Play Multiplayer Experience right from the moment you first launch the game! title: Shinier Copper
description: Makes vanilla & modded copper blocks and items have an improved color palette while maintaining the new textures style
body:
This resource pack is a mix between the old copper color palettes from Create and the new vanilla versions of Minecraft. The textures of both Create 6.0+ and Minecraft vanilla remain the same, the only change is the **color palette** and some tweaks to some blocks and items.
- Clean copper is brighter and has a red-orange tone.
- Exposed copper is rougher and duller and more yellow-brown.
- Weathered copper is dirtier and brown-green.
- Oxidized copper is almost vanilla, I just tweaked the saturation of some colors a little bit.

Create is one of my favorite mods, I use it all the time, and I loved the copper textures and colors from the old versions of the mod.
Shinier, more saturated and stylized, instead of the vanilla copper that looks dull and ugly.
(Waiting and working for the new version 1.21.9.)

**I'm still updating the gallery**

## COMPATIBILITY:
- Minecraft vanilla (until 1.21.10)
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
- [Musket Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/musket-mod) by ewewukek
  - [Muskets Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/muskets-overhaul) or [Flintl0cks - Musket Mod Overhaul](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/flintl0cks) using my compatibility addon [Muskets Overhaul + Shinier Copper Compatibility](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/muskets-overhaul-shinier-copper-compatibility)
- [Immersive Aircraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-aircraft)
- [F708 Guns (Bren Remake)](https://modrinth.com/mod/f708-gun-mod)
- [Create Stuff 'N Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-stuff-additions)

## UPCOMING COMPATIBILITY:
- [Create Immersive Aircrafts](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/create-immersive-aircrafts-resource-pack), [Create Immersive Aircraft : Warship](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/create-immersive-aircraft-warship) and [Create Immersive Aircraft : Bamboo Hopper](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/create-immersive-aircraft-bamboo-hopper) using a compatibility addon or creating my own pack between Create, Immersive Aircraft and Shinier Copper.
- [Create Factory Logistics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create_factory_logistics)
- and more...

## CREDITS:
**_Kisutora_** (Who fixed some problems when using Complementary Shaders, and helped me with the textures, useful tips and resource pack management, THANKS A LOT!)

## (Versions 1.20.1 and earlier) Why not use the mod's built-in legacy copper texture?
Create already has a built-in resource pack changing the copper ingot and blocks, but doesn't change the raw and ore version, and I also don't like the retexture from the blocks.
So I made my own pack, with retextured blocks and the new raw and ore version.

## (Versions 1.21.1 and later) Why not use other resource packs that returns old Create copper?
This resource pack, unlike others, does not copy-paste the old texture from Create's mod, instead I used the new textures and changed the color palette carefully.

## Does this also work in vanilla Minecraft, without the mods?
****YES!**** I changed Create's, vanilla Minecraft and other blocks, items, entities and gui to match, but there are no problems if you don't have the mods installed.

## Is this really necessary?
****MAYBE?**** I know this is a very small and maybe unnecessary resource pack, but Create mod is almost vanilla for me, I play with it 99% of the time, and although I really like Create's old color palette, but I wanted to give it my own touch:
- In 1.20.1 it bothered me when the copper from the mod and vanilla looked different.
- In 1.21.1 it makes me angry the vanilla copper looks so bad and ugly.

title: Starfall SMP

body:
[![Starfall SMP Discord Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Starfall_SMP-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&color=%235865F2)](https://discord.com/invite/DUGwVJgZs9)

This is the official client-side modpack for **Starfall SMP**, a Java Minecraft server focused on community, friendship, and memories.  What sets us apart from other servers is our commitment to fairness and a fun experience for everyone. We have anti-cheat, custom-made quests, planned events, daily rewards, emotes, cosmetics, and so much more each season. To keep things balanced, we delay access to the Nether and End and make them server-wide events, ensuring a more engaging progression.

While this modpack is not required to join the server, it’s recommended for the best experience. It includes QoL (Quality-of-life) mods and performance enhancements used by most players on the server.

### ❓ FAQ 
**Q: Can I add mods or delete mods from the modpack?**

A: It's totally up to you whether to delete or add mods to the modpack.  We recommend keeping it 
as is, as some mods may be bannable or you may encounter issues.  

**Q: I thought that this was a modded server; why is the modpack optional?**

A: We switched from modded to paper.  This is now a client-side modpack that provides a better experience for players on the server.

body:
# Simple Chat Formatter

A simple chat formatter for Spigot/Paper servers. See below for a full list of features!

**🐛 Bugs / 💡 Suggestions:** Please [open an issue](https://github.com/srnyx/simple-chat-formatter/issues/new/choose) to report a bug or suggest an idea

**🆘 Support:** Please [join the Discord](https://srnyx.com/discord) to get support

### Features

I may only update this list once in a while, so not all features may be listed here!

- **Customizable:** Customize the chat format to your liking, supports PlaceholderAPI and formatting codes
- **Use formatting codes in chat:** Players with the `chat.format` permission can use formatting codes in their chat messages
- **Disable chat reporting:** Remove the ability for people to report other player's messages on 1.19.1+ servers
- **`/broadcast`:** Allow admins to broadcast important messages to the entire server
  - Message is sent both in chat and as a title
  - Has a configurable typing animation for the title
  - Can also be sent to a Discord channel through DiscordSRV
- **Anti-spam:** Configurable anti-spam preventing fast message sending and repeating messages
  - You can configure the speed and similarity thresholds to your liking
  - Players with the `chat.spam.bypass` permission can bypass the anti-spam
- **Filter:** Configurable chat filter to prevent certain words from being sent in chat
  - Has different modes for how to handle filtered messages (delete, shadow, censor)
  - Players with the `chat.filter.bypass` permission can bypass the filter
  - Players with the `chat.filter.see` permission can see filtered messages
- **`/clearchat`:** Quickly clear the chat for all online players
  - Players with the `chat.clear.bypass` permission can bypass the clear

**🚧 Snapshot:** You can download the latest **snapshot** version at [github.com/srnyx/simple-chat-formatter/actions/workflows/build.yml](https://github.com/srnyx/simple-chat-formatter/actions/workflows/build.yml)

title: HitSpan
description:
HUD for hit range/reach, knockback, and other PvP metrics.

body:
**HitSpan** is a lightweight, client-side HUD mod for Minecraft **1.8.9** and **1.12.2** that displays combat-related information such as: - **Hit range (reach)** - **Knockback distance** - **CPS** - **Combo Counter** I made this because there were no good alternatives that were accurate, clean, and configurable. If you run into issues or have suggestions, feel free to open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/bewf/HitSpan/issues) ---


Example of HitSpan in use.

## Features - **Dynamic range tracking** - Uses Minecraft’s own ray tracing from the player’s eye position to the target’s hitbox. - Green for long-range hits - Yellow for mid-range hits - Red for close-range hits - Fully configurable thresholds and colours. - **Knockback tracking** - Measures horizontal knockback over multiple ticks after a hit. - **CPS HUD** - Displays your clicks per second with configurable averaging and formatting - **Combos HUD** - Shows how many times you hit an entity without them hitting you. - **OneConfig HUD** - Drag, scale, and toggle each HUD element. - Integrated with the OneConfig HUD editor. - **Client-side & multiplayer-safe** - Does not send packets or modify reach. - Safe to use on servers. ## OneConfig Integration


HitSpan OneConfig page, v1.3.4.

# Phantom Lucidity

[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/haykam821/Phantom-Lucidity.svg?style=popout&label=github)](https://github.com/haykam821/Phantom-Lucidity/releases/latest)
[![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?style=popout&label=curseforge&message=project&color=6441A4)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/phantom-lucidity)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?style=popout&label=chat&message=discord&color=7289DA)](https://haykam.com/links/discord)

Allows players to opt into fighting phantoms.

Phantom Lucidity requires the [Fabric modloader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) and [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api).

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api) if it is not installed.
2. Download Phantom Lucidity from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/phantom-lucidity/files) or [GitHub](https://github.com/haykam821/Phantom-Lucidity/releases).
3. Place the downloaded file in your `mods` folder.

## Usage

When this mod is installed, phantoms will spawn with a translucent appearance. In this state, phantoms will not make noise and will not attempt to attack players. In addition, if killed in this state, phantoms will not drop loot or experience.

Players can look at a phantom through a spyglass to reveal it. After a phantom has been revealed, it will resume its normal attack behavior and drop loot if killed.

### Tags

Items added to the `#phantomlucidity:phantoms_revealed_while_using` tag will reveal phantoms while they are actively being used. Spyglasses are in this tag by default.

title: mark it!
description: Markdown? In this Minecraft!?
body:
mark it! (sic) is a mod that adds (basic) Markdown formatting to your Minecraft! It can be used almost everywhere.

The supported markdown-esqe features:
- Surround your text with `**` (two asterisks) to make it **bold**!
- Surround your text with `*` (one asterisk) or `_` (underscore) to make it _italic_!
- Surround your text with `__` (two underscores) to <u>underline it</u>!
- Surround your text with `~~` (two tildes) to give it a ~~strikethrough~~!
- Surround your text with `||` (two vertical bars) to obfuscate it!
- If you want to use any of the above without having a style, put a `\` (backslash) before it.
  - For multi-character markers (e.g. `**` (two asterisks) and `~~` (two tildes)) just one `\` (backslash) is needed

## Mod compatibility?

It should be compatible with mods as a baseline. For the "editor" styliziation to work (where the control characters mentioned above are shown) specific support needs to be added for that mod, either in this mod (most likely) or in the affected mod itself.

Some additional work still needs to be done to make this more seamless for development and existing content in Vanilla, though the main functionality is definitely working.

Developers can use certain methods to customize the functionality in this mod. See the wiki for more information: [it's right here click mee](https://github.com/der-fruhling-entertainment/markit/wiki).

title: World Preview TFC
description: Fork of World Preview Neoforged adding TFC support and features.
body:
**World Preview TFC**

Fork of [World Preview](https://modrinth.com/project/WtfpyicL)
World Preview TFC adds a World Preview tab to the Create World screen and uses TerraFirmaCraft (TFC) world generation to preview seeds.
It can visualize biomes, temperature, rainfall, land and water, rock types, rock layers, kaolin clay areas and hotspots.

Issue tracker: https://github.com/TKFT/World-Preview-TFC/issues

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.234
- TerraFirmaCraft (TFC) 4.2.0+

## Usage
Open `Create New World` and switch to the `World Preview` tab. Drag on the map to move along X and Z. This will load:
- Biomes
- Heightmap (if enabled)
- Rainfall Map
- Tempature Map
- Land/Water/River Map
- Rock Layer Maps
- Rock Type Map
- Kaolin Clay Areas Map
- Forest Map
- Tree Map
- Soil Map
- Hotspot Map
- Volcano Icons

## Other Features
- Persistent seed storage
- Highlighting specific biomes
- Highly configurable and extendable
- Seed Searching

## Compatibility
- Incompatible with the original World Preview Neoforged mod (mod id `world_preview`)

title: EasyMiner
description: A vanilla-friendly Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 that improves mining and tree chopping with tool-restricted 3×3 mining and tree felling.
body:
EasyMiner is a vanilla-friendly Fabric mod for Minecraft that improves mining and woodcutting efficiency without changing core gameplay balance.

It adds 3×3 mining and tree felling features that only activate when the correct tool is used for each block. Holding Shift (sneak) temporarily disables all features, allowing precise block breaking when needed.

The mod is designed to feel natural, balanced, and fully compatible with standard survival gameplay.

# Some notes to start with

- If the game crashes due to this mod, then its probably not caused by this mod, rather caused by scripts.
- If the game crashes after updating the mod, then try deleting the config at `[Minecraft folder]/config/lua_runtime_config.json`

# Benefits of using the mod

- Backwards compatibility: All scripts made for older versions of Minecraft will work on newer versions of Minecraft. (breaking changes are in alpha versions)

# Using the mod

## Adding mods
Drag and drop Lua scripts into the `lua` folder in your Minecraft instance folder.

## Example script
```lua
print("Hello World!")
Minecraft.AddClientLoadedListener(function()
  local gui = Minecraft.CreateNewGUI("Lua Screen")
  gui.Display()
end)
```

title: Real Nether
description: You'll burn in the Nether without protection.
body:
# Intro
Have you ever thought that the Nether was a little too, what's the word?  *Cold* ?\
Well, never fear!  The **Real Nether** is here!

### Supplementary Material

<details>
<summary>Recipes</summary>

| Item | Crafting Block | Recipe |
|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| Ice Machine | Crafting Table | ![Ice Machine Recipe.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/flBaUYpY/images/1e4dae1b63b694bf54a4072c2ff4cd3dd3c31c44.png) |
| Ice | Ice Machine | ![Ice Recipe.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/flBaUYpY/images/5cc8cf541bae2e52037996a2984af28169fea7d4.png) |
| Packed Ice | Ice Machine | *Packed Ice Recipe.png* (same as Vanilla Crafting Table)|
| Blue Ice | Ice Machine | *Blue Ice Recipe.png* (same as Vanilla Crafting Table)|
| Icy Soul | Ice Machine | ![Icy Soul Recipe.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/flBaUYpY/images/388ee8e27b197b48511cad2d8e029d571f4f0f94.png) |
| Frozen Spirit | Ice Machine | ![Frozen Spirit Recipe.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/flBaUYpY/images/c8d9f6691212cbec5af5c1f2034641f3e06ee742.png) |
| Glaciated Wraith | Ice Machine | ![Glaciated Wraith Recipe.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/flBaUYpY/images/a1551d3d03dca990ac4bb91d2991132ffa066fb8.png) |
| Netherite Smithtable | Crafting Table | ![Netherite Smithtable Recipe.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/flBaUYpY/images/76bcd063d1b3a4ff70e22f4e04e33ecfb8622ac1.png) |
| Netherite Items | Netherite Smithtable | ![Netherite Items Recipes.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/flBaUYpY/images/7e2b132199a47ec5151e4bfe6438e41e20a313c9.gif) |

</details>

<details>
<summary>Walkthrough</summary>
  
>_0a) Collect Ice Shards from Ice_
> 
>_0b) Collect Ice, Packed Ice, and/or Blue Ice_

    
**1)** Use 6 Cobblestone, 1 Cobblestone Slab, 1 Smooth Stone Slab, and 1 Hopper (recipe in gallery) to craft Ice Machine

>_1a) Craft Ice from Ice Shards in the Ice Machine  (see recipes)_

    
**2)** Use the Ice Machine to craft Icy Totems  _(see recipes)_

>_2a) Tier 1 - 6 Ice, 3 Gold Ingot_
> 
>_2b) Tier 2 - 6 Packed Ice, 3 Diamond_
> 
>_2c) Tier 3 - 6 Blue Ice, 2 Soul Lantern, 1 Netherite [Alloy] Ingot_


**3)** Go to the Nether to acquire Black Stone & Ancient Debris


**4)** Use Black Stone to create Netherite Forge (Diagram from back to front)

```
    ▓ - air
    ░ - any
    ■ - Polished Blackstone Bricks
    ╚ ═ ╝ - Polished Blackstone Brick Stairs
    ◘ - Chiseled Polished Blackstone (placed very last)
```


```
         0              1               2              3              4
    ░░ ■ ■ ■ ░░    ■ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ ■     ■ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ ■     ■ ▓▓▓▓▓ ■     ░░ ■ ■ ■ ░░
    ░░ ■ ■ ■ ░░    ■ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ ■     ■ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ ■     ■ ■ ■ ■ ■     ░░ ╚ ═ ╝ ░░
    ░░ ■ ■ ■ ░░    ■ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ ■     ■ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ ■     ■ ■ ■ ■ ■     ░░ ■ ◘ ■ ░░
    ░░░░░░░░░░░   ░░░ ■ ■ ■ ░░░   ░░░ ■ ■ ■ ░░░   ░░ ■ ■ ■ ░░    ░░░░░░░░░░░
    
```
>_4a) Use Lava to power your Forge (1 Lava smelts 100 items)_

    
**5)** Use your forge to smelt Ancient Debris to Scrap then Nuggets


**6)** Use 4 Polished Blackstone Bricks, 3 Netherite Scrap, 1 Campfire, and 1 Smithing Table to craft Netherite Smithtable  _(see recipes)_

>_6a) Use Netherite Smithtable to craft non-alloy Netherite items  (see recipes)_

    
**7)** Equip your Netherite Armor to protect yourself in the Nether

>_7a) These also lessen burning: Powdered Snow, Fire Resistance, Fire Protection_
</details>

### Summary
This data pack assumes that the Nether is spicy hot!

Real Nether is a data pack which aims to make the Nether a little harder while also providing a new twist to the way that Netherite works, and new ways to traverse the Nether.

The vanilla Netherite has been replaced with Netherite Alloy.  Use a Netherite Forge to get *real* Netherite.

# Function

Going into the Nether **without** one of these will cause you to combust:
- Full Netherite Armor _(not Netherite Alloy)_
- Ice Totem _(in off-hand)_
    - Icy Soul
    - Frozen Spirit
    - Glaciated Wraith
- Fire Resistance
- Inside Powdered Snow

### _¡ New Features !_
**-- The Netherite Forge!**\
     _(a new player-made structure)_

The Netherite Forge is made from polished blackstone _(which is acquired in the Nether)_, and is used to smelt Ancient Debris and Netherite Scrap, producing Netherite Scrap and Netherite Nuggets respectively.

**-- The Ice Machine**

The Ice Machine is used to make Ice _(from Ice Shards)_, Ice Totems, and Packed/Blue ice.

**-- The Netherite Smithtable**

The Netherite Smithtable is used to create Netherite Items, such as: Ingots, Swords, Pickaxes, Armor, etc. . .



Have an issue or suggestion?  Click here: https://forms.gle/DzwTNuuRfbimWPu36

title: Incremental Mining
description: A satisfying overhaul to Minecraft's block mining swings.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80883f714931451d9ed4e63ed8a9633e5bbcd81a.png)

**Incremental Mining** changes block harvesting to work based on tool swings (like Stardew Valley or Terraria)

The goal of this mod is to improve the feel of the fairly common action of mining. In vanilla, progress feels more like a mining drill than distinct impacts. So, Incremental Mining addresses this nitpick.

If you enjoy the mod, please consider [supporting me](https://buymeacoffee.com/jdynamo)!
![div](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce30bd6f91f8052603ec7bca92fcf70156cf7a5b.png)

## Features
- **Block Damage**:
	- Each time you swing your tool, it chips away at the block. After a few hits, the block will break.
	- Buffs like Efficiency and Haste will increase how fast your arm swings and deals block damage.
	- Your tool's tier (Wood, Stone, Iron, etc.) will deal different amounts of block damage.
- **Synced Swing Animation**:
	- The player's swing animation is synced up with each swing of your tool.
	- By default, this is quite a bit slower than the superhuman arm flailing in vanilla, while still taking about the same amount of time to mine.
- **Sound Effects**: 
	- New sounds are given to blocks to play on each impact, opposed to the rapidly looping breaking sound.
	- Ore blocks have been giving unique sounds when hit.
    - These sounds can be fully customized in the config.
- **Water splashing**:
  - You can splash water by swinging/punching it!
  - Custom sounds will be played when mining underwater
  
![div](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce30bd6f91f8052603ec7bca92fcf70156cf7a5b.png)
![Chopping](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/218be5c2995134d169e6857bb74df7e0ac2fd60c.gif)
![div](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce30bd6f91f8052603ec7bca92fcf70156cf7a5b.png)

## Compatibility
- Supports first person animation mods, such as **Punchy** or **Vintage Animations**
  - Make sure to go into the preset menu and pick your matching preset!
  - This will make each swing timed with the animation
- Compatibility with **Multi Mine** (persistant block damage)
- Compatibility for **HT's TreeChop**
- Compatibility for **Mining & Placing Animations** (Mining Quakes)
- New: Compatibility for **Dynamic Trees**
- Incremental Mining will not work properly on servers without the mod. Client-side only support may be looked into!

![div](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce30bd6f91f8052603ec7bca92fcf70156cf7a5b.png)

## Config

The mod's behavior can be customized and balanced to your liking! Some example settings include:
-   *Mod Enabled*: So you can toggle to compare to vanilla
-   *Swing Interval*: Amount of ticks between swings
-   *Damage Multiplier*: Will change amount of block damage per swing
-   *Vanilla Foliage Break*: Allows breaking foliage to ignore the mod's system
-   *Sounds*: You can customize what sounds are played when hitting certain block types.
-   *Instant Tool Raise*: Visually disables the slow raising/switching of tools.

![div](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce30bd6f91f8052603ec7bca92fcf70156cf7a5b.png)
![Mining](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9a6616f6350de78531c0b475e9d3da188c50468.gif)
![div](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce30bd6f91f8052603ec7bca92fcf70156cf7a5b.png)

title: Controllable Carts
description: Adds player controllable Minecarts.
body:
# Controllable Carts


This mod adds the **Minecart with Controls**, a new type of Minecart which is controllable by the player.


## How to use it
### Crafting
Craft the Minecart with Controls by combining a Furnace Minecart with a lever.  
![recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/telecter/ControllableCarts/refs/heads/master/recipe.png)

### Fueling
First, you add fuel to the cart via Coal, Charcoal, or Coal Blocks. Coal and Charcoal add one fuel point, and coal blocks add 9.   
Carts can hold a maximum of 100 fuel points.

When no fuel is remaining, you can no longer accelerate the cart.
### Controls
To control the cart, by default use `W` to accelerate and `S` to decelerate. These keys are based on whatever keys you have set for the `forward` and `backward` actions.  
  
### HUD
When riding the cart, a small HUD will appear above your hotbar.
This includes the speed of the cart in blocks per second (bl/s) and the amount of fuel remaining.

**Enjoy!**

title: Mailbox
description: This datapack adds mailboxes that are used to deliver items between players.
body:
# Mailbox
This datapack adds mailboxes in the form of barrels that can be used to send and receive items between other players. This is intended for multiplayer use on servers.

<video muted preload="auto" autoplay="autoplay" loop="loop" style="width: 200px; height: 200px;">
    <source src="https://imgur.com/OKeiwr1.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source>
</video>

## Setting up your mailbox
Look directly at an empty barrel which you want to make your mailbox, then run the command `/trigger set-mailbox`. Said barrel is now your mailbox. Whenever other players send you any items, those items will appear in your mailbox.

If you want to change the position of your mailbox, break your current mailbox and follow the steps above again.

## Sending mail to other players
Run the command `/trigger send-mail` and a barrel will appear in front of you. Instructions on what to do next will be written in your chat.

You can send mail to other players even if they are offline and the chunk their mailbox is in isn't loaded. You also do not need to have your own mailbox to send mail.

## Other things to note...
- To remove the datapack, run `/function mailbox:uninstall`.
- To allow players to send mail ONLY IF they are within 10 blocks of any mailbox, run `/scoreboard players set MustBeNearMailboxToSend mailbox.config 1`. By default, this is set to 0 so players can send mail from anywhere in the world.
- To set a SEND-ONLY mailbox, run `/function mailbox:send-only-mailbox/set`. These mailboxes are intended to be used together with the 10 blocks rule if enabled.
- The two scoreboards `mailbox.stats.sent` and `mailbox.stats.received` track the number of sent/received mail for each player.

---

Credit to [PlayerDB](https://github.com/rx-modules/PlayerDB) as it was used extensively in this datapack.

description:
Minecraft Classic with RPG Mechanics, Meat-Based Tech, and Multiplayer Compatible Hardcore. 
The journey to remembering is not for the feint of heart.
body:
![Ruins and Renewal Title Card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/t0mg3DmM/images/aec29e501dad931bc8030de5b73e1668fb2b85a2.png)


What if Minecraft was developed as an RPG?, What if it was entirely focused on challenge, what if it forced you to slow down, stop speed running through your burnout phase, and finally take the time to enjoy minecraft again?... Personally I wouldn't know, but maybe try out Forgotten? Pretty please???

![A Foreign Object in a Familiar Land](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/t0mg3DmM/images/9ae83127f5c459d7d5b12a9373a840bd9de05aa2.png)
A Hardcore Challenge RPG Modpack, designed to be experienced and learned alongside friends. Start with barely your wits about you and learn what the world has to offer as if still experiencing your first fresh playthrough of Minecraft. So much awaits you as you grow and learn, slowly unlocking new features, items, and paths, Forgotten is the way of old, but here you will remember it.

![A Small Camp in the Darkness](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/t0mg3DmM/images/d91766f5eca33a43e17285f4cdd25803fdbafd8e.png)
Forgotten currently (as of 1.2.0) has 107 unique quests and works well as an SMP Modpack even in spite of it being Hardcore thanks to mods like Hardcore Revival, and Hardcore Redeploy keeping players in the game so long as a few of you are prepared enough to do so. 

Many vanilla features are reworked such as mending and totems of undying both being removed in leu of the new harcore revival systems and the more punishing blood-mending enchantment. Forgotten aims to be a Fun Challenge, a balanced Multiplayer Experience, and a Cure to Minecraft Burnout!

title: Inundated
description: Completely floods worlds with water
body:
### **🌊DO NOT ENTER WORLDS THAT YOU DO NOT WANT TO FLOOD - THE NEW CHUNKS WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY FLOODED**
![flooded nether](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac92857b98a179825851166888d187508c8b5310.jpeg)
### 
### ABOUT
**Inundated** injects chunk generation and fill with water your overworld, nether and the end dimensions from **Y 320 to -64**.
It injects **at the very end** of chunk generation, meaning biomes, terrain, ores, and structures **stay untouched.**

Basically, all _air_ and _cave_air_ blocks are replaced with water, and all **waterloggable blocks** are properly **waterlogged**.
This keeps leaves, slabs, fences, and other blocks visually consistent underwater.

And yet - torches, sugarcanes, nether vegetation **left as a feature** and grass/flowers will eventually flood itself and dropped as item. (does all of this need to be replaced with water too?)

Inundated turns the game into a unique survival challenge, where you're forced to adapt to living entirely underwater — and figuring out how to **live**, **explore**, and **build** while everything is submerged.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/fwNL7MsW6As" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### NON-GENERATION FEATURE
There’s also a legacy command:

_/inundated start/stop_ — it floods nearby chunks **manually.** (OP only)
This is useful for non-flooded chunks that were generated **before installing the mod.**

⚠️ **Be careful:** this process is **resource-intensive**. It recalculates every air block in the chunk and updates all surrounding water, triggering physics and neighbor updates.
When used with mods like **Particular** (that add 3D splash particles), it may cause **lag spikes** or even **crashes.**

The command finishes after flooding nearby chunks — you can run it **again to continue**.

**(1.21.5+)** _/inundated vision on/off_ — off by default. Gives the effect of night vision when the player's head is in the water. If the player swims out, the effect is removed.

### KNOWN ISSUES
1. Generation of any new chunks is now **many times slower** than in vanilla.
2. Updating large **lava lakes** in the nether will probably cause a **lag spike**.
3. The End is flooded at a lower level of generation, causing the world to disappear chorus; end crystals have pockets of air; the portal generates on Y 320, therefore, the dragon's egg is **unattainable**; end cities are barely flooded.

### COMPATIBILITY
Mods that **change vanilla** generaton or dimensions should **work fine**, since the flooding of the world with water occurs at the very end.

**New dimensions** will be filled in depending on whether the _populateEntities_ method is used there or not.

### CREDITS
Almost all the code is written by ChatGPT, I just used my promt engineering skills, logic bulding and _inundated_ with solving a bunch of errors, the solution to which I had to look for myself in yarn mappings.
I'm surprised it works at all, but I really wanted to make this mod and make it open source, since its alternatives are behind a paywall -  GPL-3.0 now.

title: Astro! Remix
description: Introduces Mauveine, a powerful fusion of netherite and amethyst, allowing you to control local gravity. Forge rewrite of the Astro! mod by Prismatica.
body:
![](https://dl.vixen.link/5tnah2/astro_remix_banner.png) # Astro! Remix Astro! Remix is a Forge 1.20.1 rewrite of the original [Astro! Fabric mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/astro!) by Prismatica. Astro is a small mod that introduces Mauveine, a new material crafted from netherite scrap and amethyst clusters. Mauveine has a unique effect on local gravity, and it can be harnessed to make armor that's lighter than air, swords that can be effortlessly swung, and even the ability to completely override gravity in a small area. This mod works well when used in combination with other mods, especially other movement-based items when you're floating around. Download Astro! Remix from Modrinth: [https://modrinth.com/mod/astro!-remix](https://modrinth.com/mod/astro!-remix) ![Available for Forge](https://badges.penpow.dev/badges/supported/forge/cozy.svg) [![Available on Modrinth](https://badges.penpow.dev/badges/available/modrinth/cozy.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/astro!-remix) ## Gameplay ![Astro! Remix Gameplay GIF](https://dl.vixen.link/t57n7m/astro_remix_gameplay.gif) ## Items ### Mauveine Ingot ![](https://dl.vixen.link/pswkhm/crafting_ingot.png) The Mauveine Ingot is the base material used to craft all Mauveine armor, tools, and other gravity-manipulating items. Crafted by combining netherite scrap and amethyst clusters in your crafting table. ### Mauevine Armor ![](https://dl.vixen.link/z4s4wm/crafting_helmet.png) ![](https://dl.vixen.link/djfc91/crafting_chestplate.png) ![](https://dl.vixen.link/fazxet/crafting_leggings.png) ![](https://dl.vixen.link/dd0p3e/crafting_boots.png) Mauveine armor is lighter than air, and wearing a full set will allow you to float gently through the air when you jump. The more pieces you wear, the lighter you become, and the slower you fall. Craft the Mauveine Diadem, Mauveine Shoulder Pads, Mauveine Leggings, and Mauveine boots to make a full set! Additionally, since Mauveine armor directly affects and controls your local gravity, wearing it will negate weaker external gravity manipulation, like gravity bombs. ### Mauveine Sabre ![](https://dl.vixen.link/swe7ns/crafting_sword.png) The Mauveine Sabre is a lightweight sword that can be swung effortlessly, allowing you to attack much faster compared to a regular sword. ### Gravity Bombs ![](https://dl.vixen.link/bf4k1k/crafting_bomb_down.png) ![](https://dl.vixen.link/5p3qf9/crafting_bomb_up.png) Gravity Bombs are throwable items that can be used to manipulate gravity in a small area, kind of like a lingering potion. Craft a Gravity Bomb (Up) to increase gravity in an area, or a Gravity Bomb (Down) to decrease gravity in an area. When they explode, they shower the surrounding space with tiny shards and particles that, for a short while, will affect the gravity of any entity that comes into contact with them. ## Authors Original Astro! Fabric mod by [Prismatica (aka PRI5MA)](https://modrinth.com/user/PRI5MA).
Rewritten for Forge as Astro! Remix by [luavixen](https://foxgirl.dev/).

title: CraftGPT
description: ChatGPT in Minecraft, completely client-sided!
body:
This simple client-sided mod allows you to prompt ChatGPT without leaving your game. It always assumes you are talking about Minecraft, making it a useful Minecraft assistant!

<details>
<summary>How to use it</summary>

1. Go to [OpenAI's website](platform.openai.com/account/api-keys) and obtain an API key. **Make sure to keep this API key somewhere safe because it will only show you the key once.**
2. Go into the config file for the mod (Mod Menu works too) and enter the API key into its respective field. The other option lets you change what [model](https://platform.openai.com/docs/models) the AI uses. ```gpt-4o-mini``` is the default because it is the cheapest one. You can change this to ```gpt-4o``` for more expensive but accurate responses (no matter what model you choose, the AI may get some things wrong). Keep in mind that with the most recent models, ChatGPT is trained up to October 2023, just a month after 1.20.2 was released, meaning that it does not know anything about Minecraft versions newer than 1.20.2.
3. Enter any world and use ```/ai prompt <prompt>``` (use ```/ai chat <prompt>``` to have the AI remember what you said) to ask ChatGPT anything. To get information on the current held item, use ```/ai info hand```. For information about the targeted block or entity, use ```/ai info looking```.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Known issues</summary>

- Game freezes when prompting the AI until the response is done generating. (found by: me) (probably unfixable)

</details>

title: wayland-fixes
description: Fix/work around wayland bugs on modern versions. Sibling mod to legacy-lwjgl3.
body:
# Minecraft & Wayland

Other mods already promise to run the game on wayland natively, yet they also tell you that for example you are going to loose the window icon. This mod doesn't, you won't have to miss out on anything!

This is a sibling mod to [legacy-lwjgl3](https://modrinth.com/mod/moehreag-legacy-lwjgl3) and more or less does the same things in terms of wayland compatibility, just on very different versions of the game. All sections in its description regarding this also apply to this mod.

> If you are running the game inside a sandbox, e.g. by using a launcher packaged as a flatpak, make sure to allow the paths listed below to be accessed for this mod to function correctly!

<details>
<summary>Accesses Paths & Programs and why</summary>

This part is mostly copied from the previously mentioned mod since it also applies here.

### Features

- Injects a .desktop file and the icon in the correct locations for them to function correctly
- Loads & Displays a virtual cursor on in-game screens to support setting the cursor position

### Properties

- `virtual_mouse.export` may be passed as `true` to export the loaded cursor to a `cursors` directory in the instance folder. It will contain all images contained in the cursor as well as all metadata. It will also create a human-readable metadata file for each image, and a `cursor.cursor` file in the cursor config format. This file may be used to generate a new X11 cursor out of the images with the `xcursorgen` program.

### Accessed Paths
- `$HOME/.local/share/applications/com.mojang.minecraft.desktop` (write)
- `$HOME/.local/share/icons/hicolor/apps/{16x16, 32x32}/minecraft.png` (write)
- `$HOME/.local/share/icons/<theme>/cursors/left_ptr` (read only)
- `$HOME/.icons/<theme>/cursors/left_ptr` (read only)
- `/usr/share/icons/<theme>/cursors/left_ptr` (read only)

### Accessed Programs
- `xdg-icon-resource` (to update the icon system)
- `gsettings` (to query for cursor theme & size)

</details>

### Credits

- KDE visual design group (the fallback cursor file shipped with the mod is from KDE's breeze cursor theme)

title: Easymenu
description: A lightweight GUI menu plugin for Paper and Spigot servers. Create menus easily with YAML configuration.
body:
# EasyMenu

**EasyMenu** is a lightweight GUI menu plugin for Spigot and Paper servers.

Create clean, clickable Minecraft menus using simple YAML files. Build a main menu, add unlimited submenus, run commands from items, customize sounds and lore, and reload your menu setup without restarting the server.

日本語にも対応しています
---

## Features

- **YAML-based menu creation**  
  Create and edit menus with simple configuration files.

- **Main menu and submenu support**  
  Use `main.yml` for the main menu and place submenu files inside the `sub/` folder.

- **Unlimited nested menus**  
  Open submenus from menu items and return to the main menu when needed.

- **Command execution from menu items**  
  Run player commands such as `/spawn`, `/home`, `/warp`, or any command provided by other plugins.

- **Custom item display**  
  Configure materials, names, lore, sounds, slot positions, and custom model data.

- **Multi-language support**  
  Built-in language files for English, Japanese, and Russian.

- **Async loading and cache system**  
  Menu loading and submenu access are optimized with asynchronous processing and configurable caching.

- **No external dependencies**  
  EasyMenu works without requiring Vault, PlaceholderAPI, or any other plugin.
  

---

## Requirements

| Requirement | Version |
|---|---|
| Java | 17 or newer |
| Server software | Spigot / Paper / Purpur|
| Minecraft API version | 1.20+ |
| Verified Versions| 1.21.8 |
|Supported Versions (Not all versions have been individually tested)|1.16.x~paper latest|
| Dependencies | None |
Folia may load, but full compatibility is not guaranteed.
---

## Installation

1. Download the latest EasyMenu `.jar` file.
2. Place it into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart the server.
4. Edit the generated files in `plugins/EasyMenu/`.
5. Run `/menu` in-game to open the menu.

After the first startup, EasyMenu generates the following structure:

```text
plugins/EasyMenu/
├── config.yml
├── main.yml
├── lang/
└── sub/
```

---

## Basic Usage

### Open the main menu

```text
/menu
```

### Reload the configuration

```text
/menu reload
```

### Open a submenu directly

```text
/submenu <id>
```

Example:

```text
/submenu shop
```

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `easymenu.admin` | Allows reloading the EasyMenu configuration | OP |
| `menu.reload` | Legacy reload permission kept for compatibility | OP |

`/menureload` is still available for compatibility, but `/menu reload` is the recommended command.

---

## Example Main Menu

Create or edit `plugins/EasyMenu/main.yml`.

```yaml
menu-title: "&6&lEasyMenu"
menu-opensound: "ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP"
menu-background-item: "GRAY_STAINED_GLASS_PANE"
menu-size: 54

menu-items:
  - location: "5,3"
    material: "DIAMOND"
    name: "&bTeleport Home"
    command: "/home"
    sound: "ENTITY_ENDERMAN_TELEPORT"
    close-menu: true
    lore:
      - "&7Click to teleport"
      - "&7to your home."

  - location: "5,4"
    material: "EMERALD"
    name: "&aShop"
    command: "sub_shop"
    sound: "BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_PLING"
    close-menu: true
    lore:
      - "&7Open the shop menu."
```

---

## Example Submenu

Create `plugins/EasyMenu/sub/shop.yml`.

```yaml
menu-title: "&a&lShop Menu"
menu-opensound: "BLOCK_CHEST_OPEN"
menu-background-item: "LIME_STAINED_GLASS_PANE"
menu-size: 27

menu-items:
  - location: "3,2"
    material: "DIAMOND"
    name: "&bBuy Diamonds"
    command: "/buy diamond 1"
    sound: "ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP"
    close-menu: false
    lore:
      - "&7Price: $100"

  - location: "5,3"
    material: "BARRIER"
    name: "&cBack to Main Menu"
    command: "main_mainopen"
    sound: "UI_BUTTON_CLICK"
    close-menu: true
    lore:
      - "&7Return to the main menu."
```

To open this submenu from another menu item, use:

```yaml
command: "sub_shop"
```

---

## Supported Item Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `location` | Menu slot position in `column,row` format |
| `material` | Bukkit material name |
| `name` | Item display name with color codes |
| `command` | Command or EasyMenu special action |
| `sound` | Sound played when the item is clicked |
| `close-menu` | Whether the inventory closes after clicking |
| `lore` | Item lore lines |
| `custom-model-data` | Custom model data for resource packs |

---

## Special Commands

| Format | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `/command` | Runs a command as the player |
| `sub_<name>` | Opens `plugins/EasyMenu/sub/<name>.yml` |
| `main_mainopen` | Returns to the main menu |

---

## Configuration Overview

`config.yml` is used for plugin behavior and performance settings.

```yaml
language: "en_us"
load-on-startup: true
precache-submenus: true

async:
  worker-threads: 2

cache:
  submenu-expiry-seconds: 300
  submenu-max-size: 100
  cleanup-interval-seconds: 60
  resolved-path-max-size: 200

submenu:
  search-depth: 3
  listener-failsafe-seconds: 30
```

`main.yml` is used only for the main menu layout.

This separation makes large menu setups easier to manage and reduces the risk of mixing plugin settings with menu definitions.

---

## Language Files

EasyMenu includes language files for:

- English: `en_us.yml`
- Japanese: `ja_jp.yml`
- Russian: `ru_ru.yml`

You can edit the generated language files in `plugins/EasyMenu/lang/` and reload the plugin afterward.

---

## Good For

EasyMenu is useful for:

- server navigation menus
- warp menus
- shop menus
- rule and help menus
- player utility menus
- server selector-style menus
- custom lobby menus
- resource-pack based custom GUI items

---

## Notes for Updating from Older Versions

EasyMenu v5.0.0 uses a cleaner folder and configuration structure.

Older versions used:

```text
plugins/EasyMenuPlugin/config.yml
```

Newer versions use:

```text
plugins/EasyMenu/config.yml
plugins/EasyMenu/main.yml
```

Move your main menu definition into `main.yml` and keep plugin behavior settings in `config.yml`.

---


## License

This plugin is free to use on Minecraft servers.
Redistribution, resale, modified redistribution, or claiming this plugin as your own is not allowed without permission.

title: Nethermond
description: Makes netherite tools look cooler by having it look plated onto diamond.
body:
# Nethermond

What is nethermond?
Nethermond is a texturepack to tweak the textures for Netherite items in Minecraft. It makes Netherite tools look like Netherite partially plated over diamond, to be consistent with how its made in game. It's intended to feel vanilla, and not be distracting visually, just a tweak to let the diamond shine through while being clear its still Netherite.

It also does not include armor textures, those are planned for a future update.

# FAQ:


- ### Why did you make this texturepack?
 
 I always imagined the player plating Netherite over diamond, so that's what this pack is!
  

- ### Does this pack work on Bedrock Edition? Do you have any plans to make a Bedrock Port?
 
 The pack supports Minecraft: Java edition, and not Bedrock. If I do ever make a port it would likely not receive the same attention / updates.
 

- ### When will you add armor textures?
  
 Presumably in 2.0. At some point I'll release a beta for testing out armor before putting it in the main pack.
 

- ### Is this texturepack compatible with my favorite mods?
 
 As it is a texture pack it retains compatibility with all mods that don't remove or alter the textures for Netherite items; for mods that add new Netherite items to Minecraft, it currently does not have textures for those, although that is something planned with no hard deadline.
 
- ### What versions of Minecraft does the pack support?
  
 Nethermond supports all updates in the 1.21 family, as well as a packport for 1.20.1 since thats most common for modpacks.
  
  
- ### Is Nethermond available for the latest version of Minecraft?

 As I experience linear time I cannot tell you if it is up to date when you're reading it or not: however I do try to keep it updated with the latest version whenever I find time.


- ### Is there a discord or anywhere I can report suggestions or issues?
  
Not at the moment but I've considered it, I'll most likely do that at some point.
  
  
- ### Can I include Nethermond in my Modpack / Youtube Video etc?
  
Feel free to use it in a Modpack! as long as it has a link back here and you don't attempt to say it's you're own; same with youtube videos, you are more than welcome to feature/talk about/use it in any media you make as long as you're not attempting to say you made it. Any other uses fall under common sense and the GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 or later.


- ### What is your favorite type of Pie?
  
 Pecan.

title: Ley's Modpack
description: Ley's Modpack is a client-side Minecraft enhancement pack focused on performance, visuals, and UI improvements. It includes mods like Sodium, Litematica, and Iris for optimization and building assistance, alongside immersive sound and graphical tweaks.
body:
# Ley's Modpack
Ley’s Modpack is a Fabric-based client-side modpack designed to enhance Minecraft’s performance, visuals, and usability while staying true to the vanilla experience. Unlike Forge modpacks, which tend to be larger and include heavy modifications, Fabric allows for a lightweight and highly optimized experience with minimal impact on system performance. Whether you’re a casual player, builder, or explorer, this modpack offers a smooth, immersive, and refined vanilla-friendly experience that runs efficiently on any multiplayer server without requiring server-side modifications while maintaining full compatibility.

## Content
### Performance & Optimization Mods:
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), and [Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton), work together to improve FPS, reduce lag spikes, and optimize networking.
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) and [Memory Leak Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/memoryleakfix) minimizes RAM usage and improve stability.
- [Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps) and [FPS Reducer](https://modrinth.com/mod/fps-reducer) help manage system resources efficiently, reducing unnecessary strain.

### Graphical & Visueal Enhancement Mods:
- [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) and [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) enable shader support and connected textures for a more seamless look.
- [Falling Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/fallingleaves), [Ambient Environment](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambient-environment), and [Visuality](https://modrinth.com/mod/visuality) add subtle visual details to enhance immersion.

### User Interface & QOL Mods:
- [Xaero’s Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) and [Xaero’s World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) provide easy navigation without breaking immersion.
- [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade) and [Held Item Info](https://modrinth.com/mod/held-item-info) display useful block and item details without intrusive menus.
- [Better Statistics Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-stats) and [Clean F3](https://modrinth.com/mod/clean-f3) offer more organized and readable in-game data.

### Building & Gameplay Mods:
- [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) and [Tweakeroo](https://modrinth.com/mod/tweakeroo) introduce advanced building tools for precise placement and blueprint visualization.
- [Attack Through Grass](https://modrinth.com/mod/attack-through-grass) and [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) improve combat and inventory interactions.
- [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) and [Status Effect Bars](https://modrinth.com/mod/status-effect-bars) give better hunger and status effect visualization.

### Immersive Sound & Ambience Mods:
- [Ambient Sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds) and [Presence Footsteps](https://modrinth.com/mod/presence-footsteps) add realistic audio cues to enhance exploration.
- [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered) introduces realistic reverb and occlusion effects.
- [Drip Sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/dripsounds) and [Cave Dust](https://modrinth.com/mod/cave-dust) make underground exploration more atmospheric.

## Modpack Customization
Ley’s Modpack is designed to be highly customizable, allowing players to tweak the experience to their liking. Whether you prefer higher FPS, more immersive visuals, or additional quality-of-life mods, you can easily adjust the modpack by adding or removing specific mods.

### How to Customize the Modpack:
1. Enable or Disable Mods – Use Mod Menu (included in the pack) to toggle mods on or off without uninstalling them.
2. Adjust Settings – Many mods, such as Sodium, Iris, and Tweakeroo, have in-game settings menus that let you fine-tune performance, visuals, and controls.
3. Add Your Own Mods – Since this modpack is built on Fabric, you can expand it by downloading additional Fabric mods that suit your playstyle.
4. Modify Resource Packs – The pack includes Vanilla Tweaks, but you can add or remove resource packs through Minecraft’s settings for a more personalized look.
5. Use Shader Packs – With Iris installed, you can add shader packs to enhance Minecraft’s lighting and atmosphere.

title: Forgetful Vaults
description: Reset vaults so players can open them multiple times. Configurable.
body:
Forgetful Vaults is a minecraft plugin to allow server owners the ability to automatically or manually reset Trial Chamber's Vaults so players can reuse them multiple times.

## Purpose
Normally, vaults can be looted by an infinite number of players, but only can be looted once per individual player. The Forgetful Vaults plugin removes this limitation, where the vault block will "**forget**" existing players, so they can use it again as if it was their first time.

## Commands
- /**fv refresh <coords> _[player]_**
  - If you specify a player, the vault will only be refreshed for that player. Not adding the player argument will reset the vault for everyone
- /**fv refresh-loaded _[ominous]_**
  - Refresh all vaults in currently loaded chunks, as well as any previously opened vaults the plugin was able to log. 
  - Optional **_ominous_** command argument, if set to true, will only affect ominous vaults. Defaults to false if not included
- /**fv reload**
  - Reload the plugin's config.yml

## Automatic Reset Schedule
The plugin can be configured to automatically reset all vaults that are in currently loaded chunks, or ones that the plugin detects have been previously used.

The schedule can be configured to automatically reset vaults at certain times, on certain days, including multiple different times on the same day.

## Configuration
The config file can be found in the `ForgetfulVaults` plugin folder, in the `config.yml` file.
```yml
# When using the 'instant-reset' or 'reset-after-open' options below
# Determine whether it should reset for all players, or just the player who interacted
global-reset: false

# Instantly reset a vault after a player opens it
instant-reset: false

# How many seconds after opening a vault to reset it, or -1 to disable
reset-after-open: -1

# What kind of Vault should be affected by the plugin's resets.
# Acceptable values are: ALL, REGULAR, OMINOUS
only-reset-type: ALL


# [ SCHEDULED RESETS ]

announce-scheduled-reset: true
scheduled-reset-announcement-msg: "&#e7721eGlobally refreshed all looted Vaults!"

# What timezone should the schedule clock use.
# By default, it will the local time of wherever the server is located.
# A list of all available Timezone IDs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones#List
timezone-id: "LOCAL" # Example: "America/New_York"

timed-reset: {}

# EXAMPLE SCHEDULE
#timed-reset:
#  saturday:
#    - "16:00" // Saturday at 4PM
#    - "12:00" // Saturday at Noon
#  sunday:
#    - "08:00" // Sunday at 8AM
#    - "00:00" // Sunday at Midnight
```

# 
In the same folder as the config, you will also find the `data.yml`. This file stores a list of any vaults that were opened while the plugin was enabled.
This list is used by the `/fv refresh-loaded` command and for the scheduled resets. It is not recommended to manually edit this file unless you know what you are doing.
#

### Permissions: 
- `forgetfulvaults.admin` - Use the `/fv` admin command, defaults to **OP** only 

## Miscellaneous
- If you'd like to report an issue or suggest a feature, you can do so [here](https://github.com/Pro4D/Forgetful-Vaults)
- This plugin supports **Spigot**, **Bukkit**, **Paper**, **Purpur**, or any other similar forks that support spigot plugins.
- Project icon made by [gopg](https://beacons.ai/gopg)

title: Immersive Lanterns (Unofficial Patch
description: Unofficial patch of Immersive Lanterns by Toni. Removes hard dependencies on Sodium Dynamic Lights and Accessories, allowing use with LambDynamicLights and/or Curios API.
body:
The original [Immersive Lanterns](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-lanterns) mod by Toni has not been updated for current loaders and shipped with hard dependencies that break many modpacks notably requiring specific dynamic-light and belt-slot mods even when you use alternatives.

This is an **unofficial NeoForge 1.21.1 build** that removes those requirements and restores proper optional integration. All credit for the mod concept and assets goes to **Toni (Txni)**; this fork only ports and fixes compatibility ([GitHub](https://github.com/kgbcupcake/ImmersiveLanterns-Fix) · [issue #38 on the original repo](https://github.com/txnimc/ImmersiveLanterns/issues/38)).

## What changed

- **NeoForge 1.21.1 only**  no Fabric / old Forge / Stonecutter
- **No txnilib**  native NeoForge config
- **No hard `mods.toml` dependencies**  the game loads without Curios, Accessories, or dynamic-light mods installed
- **Curios and Accessories**  use either or **both** in the same pack (belt detection, rendering, and dynamic lights work for both)
- **Dynamic lights optional**  [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights) and/or [Sodium Dynamic Lights](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-dynamic-lights)
- **Iris**  optional shader held-item light mapping when Iris is present

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- **NeoForge**
- At least one belt-slot mod: **[Curios](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios)** and/or **[Accessories](https://modrinth.com/mod/accessories)**

## Optional

- LambDynamicLights or Sodium Dynamic Lights  glow while the lantern is worn
- Iris  shader compatibility

## Report bugs

Please use the [ImmersiveLanterns-Fix issue tracker](https://github.com/kgbcupcake/ImmersiveLanterns-Fix/issues) for this version only  not Toni.

## License

[Toni's MMC License](https://license.txni.dev/)

title: Mob Banners
description: Adds decorative banners to commemorate your combat conquests.
body:
This mod adds mob banners to your game. A mob banner is a decorative block that has different variant for every mob in the game. Players can receive a banner by killing the same mob at least 50 times. For example if you kill 50 zombies you will get the zombie banner. Placing the banner will give nearby mobs of the same type as the banner a small slowness and weakness debuff.

Additional Notes

  • This mod will work for any mob that has a spawn egg, yes even modded mobs.
  • Kills are only tracked after the mod has been installed. Previous kills will not count.
  • You must kill 50 of the same mob. This amount is configurable.
  • Players will only get one banner of each type.
  • You can disable the debuffs effect in the config file.

You died during a recording. DO NOT JOIN BACK until told to.

* Use this mod to maintain fairness in recorded events.
* Players **should not rejoin** until instructed by the server admin.

This mod prevents unfair advantages during recordings by ensuring players **cannot immediately respawn after death**, keeping events organized and fair for all participants.
