title: Scavenger-Host
description: A Fabric item speedrun mod for Minecraft 1.21-1.21.11 with server, LAN, solo, duo, trio, teams, custom nicknames, synced timers, and victory screens.
body:
# Scavenger Host

Scavenger Host is a modified GPL-3.0 fork of Scavenger for Minecraft Fabric item speedruns. It lets a server admin, moderator, or single-player/LAN host roll or choose a target block or item, choose an extra challenge modifier, select solo/duo/trio mode, and then start a timed race with `/scavenger startgame`.

This fork is designed for dedicated servers, LAN worlds, Radmin VPN play, and single-player worlds.

## What It Adds

- Server-ready Scavenger runs with synchronized item, modifier, timer, winner, and victory screen data.
- A control menu for admins, moderators, server operators, and single-player/LAN hosts.
- A separate preparation step and start step, so choosing teams or rolling the wheels does not start the timer.
- `/scavenger startgame` to begin the prepared run.
- Solo, duo, and trio race modes.
- Team management commands for duo/trio runs.
- Custom Scavenger nicknames for chat, victory messages, and team display.
- Shared win announcements when a player or team finds the target item.
- Solo win flow that shows the winner and then disconnects players so the host can recreate the world.
- Support for Minecraft 1.21 through 1.21.11 with version-specific dependency requirements.
- Safer handling for world-generation modifiers: server/LAN runs reject modifiers that require a new world, while single-player can recreate the world when needed.

## Installation

Install Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer, Fabric API, Architectury API, and the correct OctoLib or ShatterLib build for your Minecraft version.

Use exactly one Scavenger jar for your Minecraft version. For example, use the 1.21.1 Scavenger jar only on Minecraft 1.21.1.

On Modrinth, each Minecraft version should be uploaded as its own project version with one primary Scavenger jar. Do not upload jars for other Minecraft versions as additional files. Additional files should only be used for things such as `sources.jar` or Javadocs.

## Version Dependencies

| Minecraft | Fabric API | Architectury | Library |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.21 | 0.102.0+1.21 | 13.0.8+ | OctoLib 0.6.2+1.21 |
| 1.21.1 | 0.116.12+1.21.1 | 13.0.8+ | OctoLib 0.6.2+1.21 |
| 1.21.2 | 0.106.1+1.21.2 | 14.0.4+ | OctoLib 0.6.2+1.21 |
| 1.21.3 | 0.114.1+1.21.3 | 14.0.4+ | OctoLib 0.6.2+1.21 |
| 1.21.4 | 0.119.4+1.21.4 | 15.0.3+ | OctoLib 0.6.2+1.21 |
| 1.21.5 | 0.128.2+1.21.5 | 16.1.4+ | OctoLib 0.6.2+1.21 |
| 1.21.6 | 0.128.2+1.21.6 | 17.0.6+ | OctoLib 0.6.2+1.21 |
| 1.21.7 | 0.129.0+1.21.7 | 17.0.8+ | OctoLib 0.6.2+1.21 |
| 1.21.8 | 0.136.1+1.21.8 | 17.0.8+ | ShatterLib 0.6.0.4+1.21.8 |
| 1.21.9 | 0.134.1+1.21.9 | 18.0.5+ | ShatterLib 0.6.0.5+1.21.9 |
| 1.21.10 | 0.138.4+1.21.10 | 18.0.8+ | ShatterLib 0.6.0.5+1.21.9 |
| 1.21.11 | 0.141.4+1.21.11 | 19.0.1+ | ShatterLib 0.6.0.8+1.21.11 |

Do not mix dependencies from different Minecraft versions. For example, Architectury 19.0.1 is for Minecraft 1.21.11 and should not be installed on a Minecraft 1.21.1 profile.

## How To Start A Run

1. Join the dedicated server, LAN world, or single-player world.
2. An admin, operator, moderator, or host opens the Scavenger menu or uses commands.
3. Roll or choose the target block/item.
4. Roll or choose the modifier.
5. Choose `solo`, `duo`, or `trio`.
6. Set up teams if the mode is `duo` or `trio`.
7. Run `/scavenger startgame` when everyone is ready.

Preparing a run does not start the timer. The timer starts only after `/scavenger startgame`.

## Modes

- `solo`: every player races alone. The first player to obtain the target item wins.
- `duo`: teams can have up to 2 players. If one team member obtains the target item, the whole team wins.
- `trio`: teams can have up to 3 players. If one team member obtains the target item, the whole team wins.

Players without a team in duo or trio mode race as solo players. Oversized teams are blocked when the game starts.

## Commands

Run management commands require server operator/admin permissions, or single-player/LAN host access.

```mcfunction
/scavenger
/scavenger help
/scavenger menu
/scavenger random
/scavenger random <solo|duo|trio>
/scavenger start <item> <modifier>
/scavenger start <item> <modifier> <solo|duo|trio>
/scavenger startgame
/scavenger stop
/scavenger clear
```

Team commands:

```mcfunction
/scavenger addteam <leader> add <player>
/scavenger addteam <leader> remove <player>
/scavenger addteam <leader> list
/scavenger addteam <leader> delete
/scavenger addteam <leader> clear
/scavenger team <leader> add <player>
/scavenger teams
/scavenger teamlist
/scavenger teams clear
/scavenger unteam <player>
```

Nickname commands:

```mcfunction
/scavenger nick
/scavenger nick <nickname>
/scavenger nick clear
/scavenger nick set <player> <nickname>
/scavenger nick clearplayer <player>
/scavenger nick list
```

Examples:

```mcfunction
/scavenger random duo
/scavenger addteam minesgames11 add vanya228
/scavenger nick SpeedRunner
/scavenger start minecraft:diamond scavenger:none trio
/scavenger startgame
```

## Configuration

The config file is saved at:

```text
config/scavenger.yaml
```

You can configure timer display, wheel behavior, rollable items, modifier blacklist entries, item blacklist/whitelist behavior, and victory screen colors.

## License And Attribution

This project is a modified fork of Scavenger by catboybinary.

- Original project: https://github.com/catboybinary/scavenger
- Fork source repository: https://github.com/nrxzwq/scavenger-host
- License: GNU General Public License v3.0

This fork keeps the GPL-3.0 license, includes the original license text, and marks the project as modified. See `NOTICE.md` for attribution and a summary of the major fork changes.

title: Hungry Waters
description: The piranhas have arrived, and they are hungry.
body:
# Hungry Waters

Beware the waters... Piranhas have arrived!

![Piranhas](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e70b3792f4dfd1c87e7995a9c6c90f70d240de6_0.webp)

## Overview
This mod introduces a new fish entity: the piranha.
A school of piranhas will spawn randomly in either swamp biomes, or river biomes. Piranhas have a hunger bar which goes down over time, then they enter hunting mode and will attack anything near them to refill their hunger bar.

## Features
- Piranha custom entity
- Piranha have a hunger bar, when it reaches zero, they will enter into hunting mode and start hunting anything alive nearby (including you)
- Piranhas will fight back when attacked
- Piranhas will only spawn in river or swamp water biomes.

## Configuration
The mod includes a config file allowing you to tweak many things!

## Datapack
Spawn frequency and school size can be customized via datapack, as these values are loaded from a biome modifier file.

## Compatibility
Has native support for [Nature's Spirit](https://modrinth.com/mod/natures-spirit) as well as [Biomes O' Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty), and most likely any other biome mod (using common tags).

## Credits
Huge thanks to @HotWizard for all of the artwork — model, textures, and animations.


## Modpacks
You can use the mod in your modpacks as long as I get credit for the mod.


## Bug report
Encountered a compatibility issue or something feels off? Report it on [Github](https://github.com/acorsicanfrog/hungrywaters) and I'll get to it as soon as I can.

title: Fossilcraft
description: Archeology and Dinosaurs Hatching. Jurassic World!
body:
# Fossilcraft!
**Unearth the past. Rebuild history. Survive the dig.**

Explore ancient ruins, resurrect lost creatures, and build your own archaeological empire. **Fossilcraft!** combines fossils, exploration, crafting, and performance—for adventurers who dig deeper.

![DinosaurImageMenu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91a24176ddbdebcd1b0ddfd170ecc312153209d2_0.webp)

---

## ⚒️ Core Mechanic: Excavate, Restore, and Evolve

The central gameplay loop involves uncovering buried secrets and using modern ingenuity to bring the past back to life.

### The Process:
1.  **Excavate:** Travel the world to uncover **buried fossils**, ancient tools, and **forgotten ruins**.
2.  **Analyze:** Use **modern technology** to analyze DNA from fragmented bones.
3.  **Restore & Evolve:** **Resurrect extinct creatures** and **construct research facilities** to study and preserve them.

Every discovery pushes the limits between science and nature, and every fossil tells a new story of the world before mankind.

---

## 🌍 Exploration & Survival: Adventure Meets Archaeology

The world of *Fossilcraft!* is an immersive, living environment where adaptation is key to survival and discovery.

### Key Survival Features:
* **Dynamic World:** Shifting seasons, changing weather, and hidden biomes are enhanced by **Fabric Seasons** and **Nature's Compass**.
* **Deepened Survival:** Cultivation and cooking are expanded with **Farmer’s Delight**, making survival about adaptation and discovery, not just endurance.
* **Full Immersion:** The world reacts to every step you take with realistic sound and light effects from **AmbientSounds**, **Presence Footsteps**, and **LambDynamicLights**.
* **Legacy:** If you dig too deep, **Gravestones** ensures your legacy remains—a monument to the explorer.

---

## 🦖 Fossils & Archaeology: Bringing History to Life

The core of the experience lies in paleontology—the thrill of discovery and the power of resurrection.

### Archaeological Tools & Mods:
* **Resurrection:** **Fossils and Archaeology: Legacy** allows players to excavate ancient remains, extract DNA, and **resurrect long-lost species**—from peaceful herbivores to towering predators.
* **Advanced Digging:** **Better Archeology** expands your excavation tools, relics, and dig site mechanics, turning every expedition into a true scientific endeavor.

Every artifact you uncover carries a piece of forgotten history. Combine your finds with modern innovation to create **museums, research stations, or prehistoric sanctuaries** that bridge the gap between eras. Every fossil you revive reshapes the balance of life itself.

---

# **ANY ERRORS ? contact me on discord: .akafashan**
# You can view all version numbers [here](https://cdn.akanoka.fr/akanoka/modrinth/config/viarestricted/config.yaml).
VersionRestrictor is a Minecraft plugin designed to secure and control the versions of clients connecting to your server. It integrates seamlessly with ViaVersion, making it easy to manage compatibility between different Minecraft versions.

# Key Features:

**Version Control**: Only allows players whose Minecraft protocol is listed in the configuration.

**Reliable Version Detection**: Uses ViaVersion to accurately detect the player's version, even when multiple versions share the same protocol.

**Automatic Kick & Customizable Messages**: Players with unsupported versions are kicked with clear, colored messages configurable in config.yml.

**Detailed Logging**: Option to log all kicks in the console for precise monitoring.

# Simple & Flexible Configuration:

Allowed protocols list editable in config.yml.

Supports configuration reload without restarting the server.

Compatible with all ViaVersion-supported versions: Makes managing multi-version servers easy.

# Use Cases:

SMP servers that only want to allow 1.20.x and 1.21.4 clients.

Anarchy or mini-game servers where only certain versions are allowed to avoid version-specific bugs.

title: Dragonights
description: The official Minecraft mod for the Dragonights TV series, developed and maintained by J9 Studios and representatives of the Dragonights franchise.
body:
![dragonights_banner](https://us-east-1.tixte.net/uploads/cdn.dragonights.com/dragonights_minecraft_logo_text_t_1024_png.png)



--- Dragonights is an upcoming 3D-animated sci-fi action TV series set in the J9 Universe. Rated TV-14 for fantasy violence. This is the official Minecraft mod for the Dragonights TV series, developed and maintained by J9 Studios and representatives of the Dragonights™ franchise. Its purpose is to help promote the franchise via popular outlets such as video gaming and other fan-generated media surrounding it.
##
☄️ Introduction ☄️
The mod aims to bring the majority of contents from the TV show into the world of Minecraft so you can create your own adventures with your friends inside the J9 Universe. In order to make this fully complete and in-parity with what Minecraft offers, some things will be integrated in ways that are non-cannon to the series. To get started, you will need to find rare Meteors that crashed into the Overworld. From there, using the crystals you found and a Thick Potion, you will be able to brew a new Crystallization Potion that will grant you the ability of whatever crystal you brewed it with, turning you into a Dragonight. Currently, only a few dragonite crystals have been implemented alongside Chondrite and a few paintings. Additionally, an oozing mechanic has been introduced using smelted Ender Pearls (Pearl Ooze), which can disable the crystals' terraforming abilities similarly to how waxing copper prevents oxidation. If a crystal is hit by lightning, it will instantly speed up terraformation once. | **Crystal** | **Description** | | -------------| ------------------------------------------------ | | [Lefonti](https://www.dragonights.wiki/items/lefonti_crystal) | Will terraform deserts and other biomes into lush jungles, under the right conditions. Meteors containing Lefonti Clusters can be found in both vanilla and modded Jungle biomes. | | Corrupted Lefonti | Will terraform living biomes into wastelands, killing nearby entities. Meteors containing Corrupted Lefonti Clusters can be found in Ancient Cities. | | [Fusite](https://www.dragonights.wiki/items/fusite_crystal) | Will terraform biomes into deserts, killing nearby entities. Meteors containing Fusite Clusters can be found in both vanilla and modded Desert biomes. |
##
☄️ Upcoming Features ☄️
There are so much planned, but one of the largest struggles is going to be somehow keeping the overall feel of this the most vanilla-ish possible. Currently, the mod is only available for the latest version of Minecraft, NeoForge 1.21.8. As development gets closer to completion we plan on porting it down to more popular verions of the game, including making it available for the Fabric modloader and releasing an addon for Bedrock Edition. | **Feature** | **Description** | | -------------| ----------------------------------------------- | | Dragonight Abilities | Turn yourself or an entity into a dragonight by making a Dragonization Potion using a Thick Potion and a Dragonite Crystal. Becoming a dragonight will grant the full abilities, and a lot more, of that specific crystal. An entity can only be one kind of dragonight at a time, but are able to use a Reset Potion to switch. | | Dragonite Crystals | With over a couple dozen unique crystal varients, you can now automatically terraform your world in any way imaginable and use their unique abilities to your advantage. | | Planets | A dozen fresh [dragonite planets](https://www.dragonights.wiki/location/j9_dimension) to explore in another planetary system with [Ad Adstra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra) integration. Each planet will be populated by diverse cultures and entities, and offering many new blocks and items. | Not Tested | | Aliens | Fight off aliens who want to claim the world as their own by participating in Cold Raids, a new raid system involving the antagonists, [Plozonies](https://www.dragonights.wiki/species/plozoni). Collect Vortanium, a magic resistant metal from the planet Pluton, during Cold Raids and craft unique armor and tools that are above Netherite tier and get stronger in cold biomes, but weaker in warm climates. | | Trims | Brand new Smithing Templates and trim materials for all Dragonite Crystals | | Meteors | Take the first step into the world of Dragonights by finding a meteor containing Dragonite Crystals. The types of crystals will depend of the biome you are in. | | Crystallgropher | This new type of Villager will sell you crystals and gems already in-game, and offer you a Dragonite Crystal on master level. Wandering Traders can also offer Dragonite Crystals from their journeys. | | Astral State | This becomes more special and realistic when played in hardcore mode. As a dragonight you will have two inventories, your physical and your astral. You can switch between them at any given time, but if you die as a dragonight you are trapped as a ghost unless you give-up or find another specific dragonight who can transfer your astral body to the physical world. Upon that transfer, you will loose access to your second inventory. Don't think the Astral World is friendly, its far more dangerous than the physical, but offers a great view of the world below and is like adventure mode for spectators. | | Bosses | Face off against all the head antagonists from the Dragonights™ franchise. Most of them will be hardly beatable without becoming a dragonight or to the least gaining some sort of supernatural ability. |
##
☄️ External Compatibilities ☄️
This early in development there are no specific compatibilities intentionally made by us. Any mod that properly uses datapack tags should automatically be compatible with one-way terraformation. As development gets closer to completion we plan on making this mod the most compatible with all major mods to provide a seamless experience for modpack players and creators.

# A simple way to experience Cobblemon on Fabric 1.20.1

This modpack was originally created as a way for me and my friend to play together, and I decided to share this modpack with everyone. Please be aware that this pack is not necessarily meant to be anything super extraordinary or impactful, just another way to experience Cobblemon.

## Small Project Size!

This modpack only has around 50+ projects inside, with most being mods. The small size is meant to rely more on the vanilla feel than one might expect, leaving much of the experience to the player.

## Play your way!

The main thing with this pack is meant to be played in a variety of ways without having too many mods that might deter users from playing a certain way. Want to farm and build with [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped 'By Terrarium') in peaceful mode and live your life with Pokemon right beside you? You bet! Want to have an epic adventure in the harder difficulties of fighting monsters, you can do that too! Much of this is up to you and the way you want to play.

## Don't struggle with storage!

The pack provides some storage mods, such as [Extended Drawers](https://modrinth.com/mod/extended-drawers 'By MattiDragon') and [Inmis](https://modrinth.com/mod/inmis 'By draylar') as to aid you on your adventure. Given how Cobblemon adds quite a few items, this serves as a way to manage your storage much more easily and with little worry.

## Multiplayer!

This pack includes [e4mc](https://modrinth.com/mod/e4mc 'By vgskye') to play multiplayer just from LAN! No need to worry as much as using a server host, although you still can if you still feel the need.

## Visual experience!

This pack comes with a few mods that make the experience ever so much more enjoyable. With optimization with [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium 'By jellysquid3'), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium 'By jellysquid3') to mods that make the world look different with [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris 'By coderbot'), you'll hopefully enjoy yourself as you customize it to your needs. There are a few other mods but that is for you to find out.

## Resourcepacks!

This pack also comes with a few resource packs you could use, such as [Fancy Crops](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancy-crops 'By bebebea_loste') and [Fast Better Grass](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fast-better-grass 'By robotkoer') to enhance your experience even further.

# Closing Notes

I'm not necessarily the most experienced Minecraft player, but I do want to try my best to make this pack enjoyable for those who want to play Cobblemon without too much of a worry. As always, you can change up the pack as you see fit as Modrinth gives users the resources to do so. This pack will always remain as small as I can keep it, as I know large modpacks aren't everyone's cup of tea.

title: Auto Shulker Inventory Loader
description: A Minecraft mod that automatically stores items in shulker boxes within your inventory when the main inventory becomes full.
body:
# 📦 Auto Shulker Inventory Loader

**Never worry about a full inventory again!** This lightweight Fabric/NeoForge mod automatically organizes overflow items into shulker boxes in your inventory, keeping your gameplay smooth and uninterrupted.

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Smart Auto-Storage
- **Automatic overflow handling** - Items automatically transfer to available shulker boxes when your inventory fills up
- **Shift-click support** - Works seamlessly with shift-click operations in containers and chests
- **Intelligent stacking** - Items are efficiently stacked before storage to maximize space
- **Priority system** - Smart logic prioritizes cursor items, then container shulkers, then inventory shulkers

### 🎮 Player-Friendly
- **Zero configuration required** - Works perfectly out of the box
- **Visual & audio feedback** - Optional chat notifications and sound effects when items are auto-stored
- **All shulker variants** - Supports all 17 shulker box colors plus the undyed variant
- **ModMenu integration** - Customize settings through an intuitive in-game config screen 

## ⚙️ Customization

Configure the mod to your preferences:
- Toggle auto-storage on/off
- Enable/disable shift-click storage
- Customize priority system behavior
- Adjust chat notifications and sound effects
- Debug logging for troubleshooting

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.21 - 1.21.11 & 26.x
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.18.3 or higher
- **Fabric API**: Required
- **Java**: 21 or higher
- **ModMenu**: Optional (required for in-game config screen via ClothConfig)

## 🚀 How It Works

1. Your inventory becomes full
2. You pick up items or shift-click from a container
3. The mod automatically finds shulker boxes with available space
4. Overflow items are intelligently stored in the shulker
5. You receive a notification (if enabled)

**No manual intervention needed!** Just play the game while the mod handles your inventory management.

## 💡 Perfect For

- **Miners** - Keep mining without constant inventory trips
- **Builders** - Gather materials efficiently without interruption
- **Explorers** - Loot dungeons and structures without worrying about space
- **Farmers** - Harvest large quantities automatically
- **Everyone** - Anyone who wants smarter inventory management!

## 🔗 Links

- **Issues & Bugs**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/DennisTheGamer/auto-shulker-inventory/issues)
- **Source Code**: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/DennisTheGamer/auto-shulker-inventory)

# Overgeared x Epic Knights *A compatibility mod bridging Epic Knights and Overgeared* ## What does it do? Out of the box, everything in Epic Knights is crafted through vanilla crafting tables, which clashes with Overgeared's forging system. This mod fixes that. All vanilla Epic Knights crafting recipes are **removed** and replaced with proper Overgeared recipes using **forging**, **casting**, and **assembly**.
![Shortsword-Blade forging recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7156a85793c7bf78ceb969e9ce4ebc410bc687b.png) → ![Shortsword assembly using the Blade and a Hilt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df051f49809ae69e814561f4dd67d45c306e7ee2.png)
**Blueprints** are also included for Armor, Shields and Weapons. ### New Items To achieve this, the mod adds new intermediate **blade and component items**. These work exactly like Overgeared's own components: you cast or forge the blade first, then assemble the final weapon. This keeps the crafting process consistent with how Overgeared handles its own gear.
Steel Forging Items ![All steel forging items added by this mod, from Shortsword-Blade to Morgenster-Head](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec62d1cfc830efcb2e3c7b2d839bdf51811def58.png)

body:
This mod has a similar goal to mods like Alex's Mods, Naturalist, or Mo Creatures. In where I plan on adding all kinds of new mobs to enhance Minecraft with new world-building, features, and of course drops.

The goal is that this mod will be like a series where on Mondays or every couple of Mondays because I doubt I'll actually be able to update every Monday. I will add a new mob or mobs. As well as new items and features related to those mobs. Mobs will range from real-life-inspired animals, to fantasy, or even more goofier ideas.

Showcase Videos with more detail: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLnDlAGDQtYpuI5Y9PKjqck23dl0t2FrI-

All New Mobs (So Far):
Moobloom
 - Yellow Flower Moobloom from 2020 Mob Vote. Similar to Cow, but you can use a bottle to "milk" it for honey. Spawns in Flower Forests.

Blue Orchid Moobloom
- Similar to the Moobloom, but spawns in swamp biomes

Lily of the Valley Moobloom
- Similar to the Moobloom, but poisons you if you come to close.
* Heisenberg Moobloom 
- (Breaking Bad Easter egg for the Lily of the Valley Moobloom)

Wither Rose Moobloom
- Moobloom that spawns in Soul Sand Valleys. Withers you if you get too close.

Chocolate Cow
- Cow that gives you Chocolate Milk.

Strawberry Cow
- Cow that gives you Strawberry Milk.

Soy Cow
- Cow that gives you Soy Milk.

Wooly Cow
- Cow Variant that spawns in Snowy & Taiga Biomes

Albino Cow
- Cow that's Albino

Holy Cow
- Majestic Cow that can be grant you bottles of xp, apples to golden apples, and more.

Turkey
- Similar to Chicken.

Punching Bag
- Can be spawned in with two hay bales and pumpkin on top. Its only purpose is for the player to test out weapons and combat abilities on this completely harmless innocent being. Or just punch to let off some steam.

Pinata
- Same as Punching Bag, but can be spawned in with Glazed Light Blue Terracota, Glazed Red Terracota, and then a pumpkin on top. It also will drop many sweet food items like cookies, pie, cake, and a new food item: candy. Candy is a very low food source that has the chance to give you a sugar rush.

Testificate Man - A Batman-inspired Villager Guardian who fights hostile mobs. Inspired by Element Animation's Testificate Man. I couldn't figure out how to spawn them in villages. So I made them able to spawn in biomes that villages can spawn in like plains, deserts, taiga, etc. Abilities: Has a chance to teleport randomly when damaged and leave behind some smoke particles. Has a chance to go invisible when damaged. Has a chance to spawn bats. Has a chance to do multiple abilities. Drops: Totem of Testificate Man Totem makes the player invisible while equipped. When right-clicked it will teleport the player in a random direction. Basically a multi-use chorus fruit

The Chillager -  My version of the Iceologer from the 2020 mob vote. It throws ice blocks that when they hit the player will summon falling ice blocks that do a bit of damage and apply a freeze effect to the player for a bit. They spawn in mountain or ice biomes. Drops: Totem of Chill Totem grants player slow fall and jump boost while in held by the player. This is helpful for climbing tall mountains.

The Griefer -  A joker inspired illager. He throws tnt at the player that explode immediately if they hit the player. Upon death he will explode and summon a creeper. Drops: Totem of Grief Totem gives the player strong resistance while in the player's main hand. It can be right-clicked to create a small explosion near the player. This can be used to damage nearby mobs. And even to do rocket jumps. However, this ability will cost food points, xp, and even has a chance to fail.

The Gambler - A two-face inspired illager. This illager has an appearance of half a villager and half an illager. It attacks by punching the player. It's ability is that it has a 50/50 chance to either give positive effects to the player or negative effects. Making it either an easier fight or a harder one. Drops: Totem of Chances Totem's ability is only used when right-clicked with. This will have a 50/50 chance to either insta heal the player or give a wither effect. title: Custom Splashes
description: Easily create custom title screen splashes in game!
body:
What does this mod do?

This mod allows you to add your own splashes to the title screen using a simple in game GUI

How do I add a splash?

Click on the "Splashes" button in the top right of the title screen and it will bring you to the splashes GUI. From here you can type a splash you want into the box and click "Add". If you want to delete or edit a splash you can scroll through the list to find a splash, then click on it to edit it. With the splash selected you also have the option to delete the splash.

I want to hide the button on the title screen?

Go to the config file at config/custom_splash_text.json and set show_title_screen_button to false. This is perfect if you want to include the mod in a modpack to add custom splashes to the title screen, however don't want the user to be able to modify them.

Something is broken / doesn't work

Please let me know in the comments below so I can fix it.

# SquidUtils - Essential Server Utilities

**SquidUtils** is a mod that provides advanced tools and APIs for creating custom experiences in Minecraft.

---

## ✨ Main Features

### 🎯 Custom Titles
Display fully customizable titles and subtitles on players' screens with complete control over:
- Colors and scales
- Duration and fade effects
- Screen positioning
- Automatic timers

### 🌀 Blur Effects
Apply visual blur effects on screen borders with:
- Customizable colors
- Adjustable intensity and width
- Temporary or permanent activation
- Perfect for indicating states (poisoned, stunned, etc.)

### 🔢 Numbering System
Automatically assign numbers to players:
- Automatic numbering on join
- TAB display
- Ideal for tournaments and competitions
- Integration with death messages

### 💀 Custom Death Messages
Complete death handling system:
- Custom messages with player numbers
- "Floating soul" effect with inertia
- Screen darkening
- Programmable post-death commands

### ⚙️ Scheduled Commands on Death
Execute command sequences automatically when a player dies:
- Precise delays in seconds (even decimals)
- Player-specific commands
- Fully configurable via JSON
- Perfect for custom respawn systems

### 🚪 Waiting Room System
Professional lobby with:
- Customizable HUD
- Real-time player counter
- Automatic phase system
- Complete visual configuration

## 📦 Installation

### For Players
1. Download the mod from Modrinth
2. Place it in your Fabric client's `mods/` folder
3. Done! The mod will work automatically on servers that have it installed

### For Administrators
1. Download the mod from Modrinth
2. Place it in your Fabric server's `mods/` folder
3. Start the server to generate configurations
4. Customize the files in `config/squidutils/`

---

## 🔧 Configuration

The mod automatically generates configuration files in `config/squidutils/`:

### `dead.json`
Configure commands that execute when a player dies:
```json
{
  "commands": [
    {
      "delaySeconds": 0,
      "command": "say {player} has been eliminated!"
    },
    {
      "delaySeconds": 3,
      "command": "title {player} title {\"text\":\"ELIMINATED\",\"color\":\"red\"}"
    }
  ]
}
```

### `waitinghud.json`
Customize colors, sizes, and positions of the waiting room HUD.

---

## 🎯 Commands

### `/squidutils`
- `/squidutils numberplayer start` - Start player numbering
- `/squidutils numberplayer stop` - Stop numbering
- `/squidutils numberplayer stats` - Show statistics
- `/squidutils deathmessage start` - Enable custom death messages
- `/squidutils deathmessage stop` - Disable death messages

### `/waitingroom`
- `/waitingroom start <maxPlayers>` - Start waiting room
- `/waitingroom stop` - Stop waiting room
- `/waitingroom status` - Show current status

*All commands require operator permissions (level 2)*

---

SquidUtils provides complete APIs for developers:

### PlayerTitleAPI
```java
PlayerTitleAPI.showTitle(player, "VICTORY!", "You won", PlayerTitleAPI.COLOR_GOLD);
```

```java
BlurEffectAPI.enableBlurTemporary(player, 5000, BlurEffectAPI.COLOR_POISON);
```

**[See full documentation on GitHub](https://github.com/ELBGG/SquidUtils)**

```gradle
repositories {
```

description: KantoModels is a decoration mod created for map building!
body:
# KantoModels **KantoModels** is a Fabric decoration mod made for builders, map creators, and Cobblemon projects. This mod was originally created for the **[CobbleKanto](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblekanto)** project, but it can also be used by other creators who want more decorative blocks for their own Minecraft worlds. Please, go check our [main project](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblekanto) and hop on in this adventure with us! It adds more than **280 Kanto inspired decorative models**, including furniture, machines, signs, fossils, shelves, counters, lab props, city decorations, cave props, gym details, and many other objects designed to help bring your custom maps to life. --- [![Shockbyte sponsor banner for CobbleKanto projects](https://i.imgur.com/TXhP6bJ.png)](https://shockbyte.com/billing/aff.php?aff=10741) Get 25% off your Minecraft server with Shockbyte! Ready to start an epic adventure with your friends? Just click [here](https://shockbyte.com/billing/aff.php?aff=10741) or on the banner and use promo code “COBBLEKANTO”, plus you’ll be helping us keep improving the mod and developing future projects! --- ## Features - 280+ decorative models and props - Custom block shapes and directional placement - Interactive signs with custom dialogue support - Built-in EN-US and PT-BR dialogue files - Additional dialogue languages supported through resource packs - KantoModels Converter block --- ## KantoModels Converter KantoModels includes a custom block called the **KantoModels Converter**. The converter works like a simple exchange table. Players can use supported currency items, such as copper ingots or all kinds of Poké Balls, to obtain decorative models from the mod. The GIF below shows the Converter block opening its exchange screen and letting players trade supported currency items for decorative models. ![GIF showing the KantoModels Converter block exchanging currency items for decorative models](https://i.imgur.com/wJSeAOF.gif) This is useful for servers and adventure maps where you want players to unlock or buy decoration models without giving direct creative access. --- ## Interactive Signs and Dialogues Some blocks can open custom dialogue screens when clicked. The GIF below shows an interactive KantoModels sign opening a custom dialogue screen after being clicked. ![GIF showing an interactive KantoModels sign opening a custom dialogue screen](https://i.imgur.com/m4iZ0KM.gif) To configure an interactive sign or block: 1. Place an interactive sign/block in the world. 2. Look directly at the block. 3. Run the command: `/kantomodels setsignid ` The mod includes dialogue files for: - `en_us` - `pt_br` Additional languages and custom IDs can be added with resource packs using the same file format. Example path: `assets/kantomodels/dialogs/dialogs_es_es.json` You can check the built-in dialogue files and available IDs here: [View KantoModels Default Available IDs Files](https://gist.github.com/PrimordioCobble/f32f7ee709bd5f7208e1f91b821627a6) --- ## Known Issues - Some models may still have imperfect hitboxes. For now, map builders can use **barriers** to prevent undesirable collision/bug in specific models. - Not all models are interactive yet. We're currently working to improve this in a future update. --- ## Compatibility & Dependencies - Minecraft 1.21.1 - Fabric API - Java 21 - **Framework Mod by MrCrayfish** - **GeckoLib** Note: - **Cobblemon** — not required to launch the mod, but KantoModels was made with Cobblemon map building in mind! --- ## FAQ ### Does KantoModels only work with Cobblemon? Not really! This mod can be part of any journey... even Vanilla maps! ### Why are some models invisible or not loading? Make sure you have all required dependencies installed: - Fabric API - Framework Mod - GeckoLib ### Can I use this mod in my modpack, server or content creation? Yes, absolutely! Credit is appreciated, especially if the mod is being used in a public project, server, or map. ### Will more models and interactive blocks be added? Our plan is to finish and polish all the existing models! We might already have every "Kanto" model... Maybe more models in the next region? --- ## Special Thanks - To **LunazStudios** for early development help and the connected models! - To everybody who is currently helping on polishing all the **[CobbleKanto](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblekanto)** mods! If you have any ideas, feedback or **multiblock/connected experience** and want to assist us on delivering the best of the best that the Cobblemon community deserves, drop a direct message at "cobblekanto" Discord! ---

KantoModels is an unofficial fan-made Minecraft mod.

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or approved by Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures Inc., The Pokémon Company, Mojang Studios, Microsoft, or the Cobblemon team.

Minecraft is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation. Pokémon and related names are trademarks of their respective owners. Cobblemon belongs to its respective creators.

title: Discord Webhook Wizard
description: send game chat messages into your server's webhook
body:
# dchook

Send Minecraft chat messages to Discord server channels with ease! dchook is a
lightweight and simple mod for the fabric mod loader, and newer Minecraft versions (more supported versions coming soon).

![chat message transfer example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qJ9ZfKma/images/0e822ef2aec1062fd27973191cb2cf85a5734910.png)

## Features

This mod offers:

- One-way chat message proxying or two-way if desired;
- Simple configuration;
- Straightforward features;
- Server-side, Discord Bot-less architecture.

### Configurable and toggleable messages

Toggle server status messages such as: server staring, server started, server
stopping, server stopped.

Toggle whether users can make their messages unproxyable (ignored by the mod) by
applying two forward slashes (`//`) at the end of their chat messages.

### Easy setup

Setting this mod up is just a matter of following the steps on the [documentation page](https://pinmacaroon.github.io/hook/docs.html#setup)

## "HELP, IT AINT WORKIN', WHAT AM I SUPPOSD' TO DO?"

Calm down, we'll go step by step.

Check the config file.

- Did I paste the URL to the right place?
- Is it the right URL?
- Did I delete an `=`?
- Did I put an extra space somewhere?
- Did I accidentally turn the mod off?

Check the console of the server.

- Did my server say something about the webhook not being a valid API endpoint?
- Did my server say something about the webhook not being found or not having
  connection to Discord?

Still doesn't work? Well, I (pin, the one who made this mod) am also a "human",
so I make mistakes too. If you think I made one, report it to me! See the
sidebar for links!

## Credits

- This mod uses
  [simple-config](https://github.com/magistermaks/fabric-simplelibs/tree/master/simple-config)
  for configuration file management.
- This mod uses [crafthead](https://crafthead.net/)'s API for player chat icons.

title: Focus
description: Z-targeting lock-on mod, customizable & great for combat.
body:
DO NOT USE THIS ON PUBLIC SERVERS WITHOUT ADMIN PERMISSION, YOU ARE VERY LIKELY TO BE BANNED.


![focus banner text, and a player using the z-targeting on a blaze](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43e93503fef9ce0dd15a5c49e09216710b783a06.png) Focus adds a proper **lock-on system** for **third-person combat**, with a camera that stays centered on your target and makes fights feel a lot more deliberate. - **Lock onto nearby enemies** and keep your camera focused on the fight - **Swap between targets** with directional mouse flicks - **Swap shoulders on the fly** depending on how you want combat framed - **Save your own camera presets** instead of being stuck with one setup - Use a full **camera editor** to tweak: - offsets - distance - rotation - shoulder behavior ![Gameplay footage 1: showcasing z-targeting indoors, player fighting skeletons from a spawner](https://i.imgur.com/eZVekT9.gif) ![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec0e4dc78ec1a652eb11b233dd2926f7461fe770.png) Focus also helps fix one of the big annoyances with third-person combat by supporting a **corrected crosshair**, so aiming and hit feedback feel much more consistent while locked on. On top of that, you can also: - use **target filters** - choose between different **lock-on indicator styles** - enable **cinematic bars** - make your player **fade out** when they get in the way of the camera ![Gameplay footage 2: player switching between two targets, the spider and the skeleton (spider jockey), using mouse direction flicks](https://i.imgur.com/wjYIE2b.gif) ![keybinds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/201d5ce49ba16974e3c3b0b562c392e03f38e35f.png) ## Default keybinds - **Lock On Target** - `V` - Locks onto the best nearby target - Press again to disengage - **Swap Shoulder** - `X` - Switches the camera between left and right shoulder - **Open Camera Editor** - `F6` - Opens the in-game camera editor - Lets you preview and adjust your current camera setup live - **Adjust Camera Offsets** *(same default controls as Shoulder Surfing Reloaded)* These can be used while locked on, or while previewing in the camera editor: - **Move camera up** - `Page Up` - **Move camera down** - `Page Down` - **Move camera in** - `Up Arrow` - **Move camera out** - `Down Arrow` - **Move camera left** - `Left Arrow` - **Move camera right** - `Right Arrow` ![Gameplay footage 3: player swapping between shoulders while targeting](https://i.imgur.com/Kx3ewj5.gif) ![compatibility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1252c11050b7daf8b8621712b58dd1005e7ba982.png) Focus currently has **native compatibility** with **[Shoulder Surfing Reloaded](https://modrinth.com/mod/shoulder-surfing-reloaded)** as an **optional dependency**. `Disable "Decoupled camera" in the 'Camera' section of the client config for **SHOULDER SURFING**. As of [1.0.0-beta.2], the decoupled camera doesn't play well with focus. I'm working on proper integration for this :P` Support for other mods is also planned, including: - **[Controlify](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlify)** - **[MidnightControls](https://modrinth.com/mod/midnightcontrols)** If there's a specific mod you would like compatibility with, open an issue in the GitHub repo.

Note: These mods have NOT been tested yet.
Please don’t report issues to those developers. Report any bugs to the GitHub or via Discord DM (ijvn).

![roadmap](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04825ea0e2e5462ffa075e783ca38b0c63a36d34.png) ## Version and Loaders - ✅ **NeoForge 1.21.1** [Active development] - ⛔ **NeoForge 1.20.1** [Not planned] - ⛔ **Forge 1.21.1** [Not planned] - ✅ **Forge 1.20.1** [Active development] - 🚧 **Fabric 1.21.1** [Planned port] - 🚧 **Fabric 1.20.1** [Planned port] - Eventually, will skip straight to 26.1/whatever the newest standard will be for modding. ## Planned Features - Controller support through Controlify & MidnightControls - Overhaul of the entire camera editor screen - Custom indicator icon creator; colour, size, position, texture, etc. - Server-side admin control commands/config to prevent certain features for users ![credits & license](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5fd3ad80e342e6985dd6ebda1f7afd9c48749fce.png) ## Credits The camera system in Focus derives from **[Exopandora's](https://modrinth.com/user/Exopandora)** port of **[Sabar's](https://www.minecraftforum.net/forums/mapping-and-modding-java-edition/minecraft-mods/1287308-shoulder-surfing-modded-third-person-camera)** mod, **[Shoulder Surfing Reloaded](https://modrinth.com/mod/shoulder-surfing-reloaded)**, with further modifications made for Focus. ## License This project is licensed under the **[GNU General Public License v3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html)**. Feel free to use this mod in modpacks, videos, etc. Just provide a link back to this page if possible :) Looking to port the mod to your favourite loader/version outside of my scope? Feel free to, and let me know so I can add a sub-section to direct users to it! For any general queries/unlisted questions, DM me on Twitter (@prodbyjvn) / Discord (ijvn).

title: Hotkey Chat Messages
description: This mod allows you to hotkey up to 10 chat messages/commands!
body:
# Hotkey Chat
## Bind chat messages and commands to hotkeys with dynamic variable support!

### **Features**
- 10 Configurable Chat Presets - Bind frequently used messages or commands to Numpad keys (1-9 and 0)
- Dynamic Variables - Automatically insert real-time game data into your messages:
> - **{coords}** - Your current coordinates
> - **{health} / {food}** - Health and hunger levels
> - **{dimension} / {biome}** - Current dimension and biome
> - **{facing}** - Direction you're facing
> - **{player}** - Your username
> - **{target}** - Entity you're looking at
> - **{time} / {date}** - Real-world time
**And more!**
- **Command Support** - Messages starting with / are sent as commands
- **In-Game Config Screen** - Press H to configure presets (rebindable)
- **Mod Menu Integration** - Access settings from Mod Menu
## Use Cases
- Share your location with friends: "I'm at {coords} in the {dimension}!"
- Quick status updates: "Health: {health}/{max_health} | Food: {food}"
- Server commands: "/home", "/tpa {receiver}"

title: Space's craftable Chainmail armor
description: Chainmail Armor is now craftable using actual Chains! A vanilla-friendly datapack that fills the armor gap and gives the Chain item a much-needed purpose.
body:
## 🔗 Craftable Chainmail

A simple, vanilla-friendly Minecraft datapack that introduces reliable crafting recipes for Chainmail Armor using **Chains**. Stop waiting for lucky mob drops and start crafting this classic mid-tier armor\!

### ✨ Features

  * **Four New Recipes:** Adds crafting recipes for the **Chainmail Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, and Boots**.
  * **Thematic Material:** Recipes utilize the **Chain** item, giving this block/item a meaningful role in armor progression and world loot.
  * **Vanilla Integration:** This is a pure datapack that works seamlessly in any survival world.
  * **Balanced Progression:** Provides a consistent armor choice between Gold/Leather and Iron, utilizing materials that require a small investment of Iron Ingots.

### 🛠️ Crafting Recipes

The recipes follow the standard armor patterns, using **Chains** instead of ingots.

| Item | Chains Required |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Chainmail Helmet** | 5 |
| **Chainmail Chestplate** | 8 |
| **Chainmail Leggings** | 7 |
| **Chainmail Boots** | 4 |

#### **Example Recipe: Chainmail Chestplate**

The Chainmail Chestplate requires 8 Chains arranged in the standard chestplate shape:

```
[Chain] [ ] [Chain]
[Chain] [Chain] [Chain]
[Chain] [Chain] [Chain]
```

*(Note: Use a **Crafting Table** for all recipes.)*

### ⬇️ Installation

This datapack is incredibly easy to install into your Minecraft world:

1.  **Download** the latest version of the datapack `.zip` file.
2.  Open your Minecraft world's folder (you can usually do this in-game by going to the world selection screen, selecting the world, and clicking "Edit" \> "Open World Folder").
3.  Locate the **`datapacks`** folder inside the world folder.
4.  Drag and drop the downloaded **datapack `.zip` file** directly into the `datapacks` folder. **(Do not extract the ZIP file\!)**
5.  If your world is already running, run the command `/reload` in the game. You should see a message indicating the datapack has loaded.
6.  Enjoy crafting your new armor\!

### 🗺️ Compatibility

  * **Minecraft Versions:** Designed for **1.13** and later.
  * **Dependencies:** None\! This is a vanilla datapack.

title: PlayerGrave
description: Creating death chests
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e666376da28ff70d9b310ea6840000619cc93d1.png)
## Main Purpose:
The PlayerGrave plugin adds the functionality of creating death chests in Minecraft, which store players' inventory upon death. This helps players recover their items easily without losing them.

## Key Features:

### Death Chest Creation:
When a player with the appropriate permission (`playergrave.use`) dies, a chest is created at the death location containing their inventory. If the location is occupied, the chest spawns above the block.

### Interactive Chest Menu:
Players can interact with the death chest through a custom menu (`DeathMenu`) that allows them to retrieve their items.

### Automatic Chest Removal:
Death chests have a limited lifespan (default: 600 seconds). If not emptied in time, they are automatically removed, and any remaining items drop on the ground.

### Explosion Protection:
Death chests are protected from explosions (e.g., creeper blasts).

### Chest Breaking:
If a player breaks the chest, all remaining items are dropped naturally.

### Visual Indicators:
Two invisible armor stands are created above the chest:
- One displays the name of the player who owns the chest.
- The other shows the remaining lifespan of the chest.

### Compass Guidance:
Upon respawn, players receive a compass pointing to their death location (the chest).

## Benefits:
- Protects player items after death.
- Convenient chest interaction menu.
- Explosion protection.
- Compass for quick navigation to the death chest.

## Usage:
- Players must have the permission `playergrave.use` to use the plugin.
- Upon death, a chest is automatically created, and a compass helps locate its position.
- Players can retrieve their items or leave them until the chest is automatically removed.

A simple data pack & Fabric/Quilt mod that restores and enhances sword blocking in Minecraft 1.21.5 - 1.21.8.

New Sword Blocking is no longer supported. The data pack and mod are available as-is and there won't be any updates or assistance. Please read more [here](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/New-Sword-Blocking/wiki/End-of-Life-Announcement).

<center>

| Sword | Damage Blocked | Durability Lost*
| :--: | :--: | :--: |
Wooden | 20% | 7
Golden | 25% | 9
Stone | 30% | 5
Iron | 40% | 4
Diamond | 50% | 3
Netherite | 60% | 2

title: Stargate
description: The original, and still the best, survival-friendly transportation solution!
body:
The original, and still the best, MineCraft transportation solution!

An expansive yet intuitive sign-based portal system designed with player creation and usage in mind.
Highly immersive, robustly capable, deeply configurable, and easily expandable!

![Stargate Profile Banner](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/49039536/233811046-97f88b83-6582-48dc-9925-ec841f1d2547.png)
Discord Server: link | Website: link | Documentation: link

> **Stargate is actively undergoing a complete rewrite**.
> Until superseded, development on legacy versions (0.X.X.X) will be slow.
> For more information on the rewrite, please see this [link](https://hangar.papermc.io/Stargate/Stargate/pages/Resource-Page/Rewrite-Info); to become an alpha tester, please join our [Discord](https://sgrewritten.org/discord). > **As a stop-gap until the rewrite is ready, this page presently distributes a "legacy" channel**.
> The legacy build is simply a maintained fork that contains all features from all other known stargate forks!
> A full migration service will be available when the rewrite releases; you will be able to import your legacy data.
___________________________________________________________________________________________________
NOTE: The features showcased below correspond to a legacy release.
This information will be replaced once the rewritten version produces a public release.
‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾ | Showcase Video: | | -------- | | [![Youtube Logo](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/49039536/233812280-31a3afc1-a443-4f52-9289-91fcc5b98f17.svg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-4uG7-5fyBM) |

Features

(Click to expand) * Expanded teleportation script: * Teleports vehicles (boats, minecarts) and mounts (horses, pigs, etc). * Entering a portal with leashed entities will teleport both the player and those entities. * Support for a wide variety of materials: * Numerous materials may now be used as buttons (activators) * As long as a waterproof material is used, portals can be placed underwater! * Material tags may are now supported (for instance, #wool) * A wide variety of technical improvements * The legacy codebase has been refactored, with numerous bugs patched. * An API is now available for legacy addons. * Support for many use cases * Vault support for economic integration * Cross-server (i.e. bungeecord) teleportation options * Highly customisable * Granular player permission nodes * Ability to create server-wide custom gate designs * Ability to assign unique properties and behaviours to these custom designs. * Configurable sign formatting * Highlighting and accent colours can be set on a per-sign, per-gate, or global basis * Full RGB and dye-colour support, both in-game and in the configuration. * Expanded Integration`*` * Dynmap is now supported by default. * StargateCommand is now supported by default (edit gate properties and retrieve gate information, all from a tab-completable command) * Deep functionality: * Portals may be always-on, or button-activated. * Portals may share a networks or be split into clusters. * Portals may have a fixed destination, or a selection of options. * Portals may be public, hidden, or private. * Through the use of flags, portal behaviour may be customised * Provided sufficient permissions, players may construct and use portals in survival mode. `*` *These features will be moved to separate modules in the upcoming rewritten release.*

Background

(Click to expand) * This plugin was originally TheDgtl's Bukkit port of the Stargate plugin for hMod by Dinnerbone. * After this plugin was dropped by TheDgtl, PseudoKnight began maintaining it for modern versions of Spigot (adding support for UUIDs & Material Strings). * EpicKnarvik97 forked that version to clean up the code, added leash support, and improved vehicle support. * LockedCraft and LittleBigBug also forked that version to add underwater and tag support, as well as a few bug fixes. * The current legacy release combines all the forks above, and is maintained by the Stargate Rewritten project. * As total rewrite is forthcoming, these legacy versions are (for the most part) in maintenance-only mode.

Installation / Migration

(Click to expand) Installation and migration should be drag-and-drop. * If there is a "Stargate" directory, SG will migrate its contents, configurations, and data into a new format. * In theory, this migration script should support all known post-drakia (i.e. UUIDs & String-Based block IDs) stargate forks. * If you run into any problems, please post an issue report or ask about it on discord. * If there is no "Stargate" directory in your Plugins folder, SG will create a fresh install.
If you find any bugs, please post them here!

Support can also be found through this Discord!

title: Cobblemon KO Shiny
description: Increase your chances of getting a shiny Pokemon by KOing wild versions of it!
body:
# This project is now part of Cobblemon Unchained!

This mod will only receive bug fixes going forward. [Cobblemon Unchained](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-unchained) makes it so that this mod and a handful of others I made surrounding Pokémon spawning could play well together.

# KO Shiny

Increase your chances of getting a shiny Pokemon by KOing wild versions of it!

## Help

[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/WKAR27SdSv)

## Features

### Defeat Streak

Whenever a player defeats a wild Pokémon, a counter associated with that Pokémon’s species is increased for that player. This counter is never reset, and persists throughout the life of the player on that world.

### Bonus Shiny Chance

As a player’s wild Pokémon KO counter increases, any Pokémon of that counter’s species that spawns nearby will gain a higher chance of becoming shiny. The chances are organized by thresholds; when a player’s KO counter becomes high enough, they unlock additional chances. When there are multiple players nearby who have unlocked a threshold for the spawning Pokémon’s species, the player with the highest unlocked threshold will add their chances.

### Config

In the config, you can change the range at which a Pokémon considers a player’s count when spawning. By default it’s 64 blocks. You can also configure the thresholds, which by default are at a count of 101+ you get 2 chances, 301+ you get 3, and 501+ you get 4. If there isn’t a player nearby who has achieved a threshold, there’s just 1 chance. The other side of the chance is determined by the `shinyRate` in the Cobblemon config, which is 8196 by default.

## Dependencies

Cobblemon [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) / [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cobblemon)

Fabric Language Kotlin [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) / [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-language-kotlin)

title: Animatica Continuation
description: Unofficial continuation of Animatica for Minecraft 1.21.11. Allows for animating more game textures using the MCPatcher/OptiFine animation format.
body:
Unofficial continuation of Animatica for modern Minecraft versions.

Animatica Continuation is an unofficial continuation of Animatica by FoundationGames, ported to newer Minecraft versions. This beta release currently supports Minecraft 1.21.11 on Fabric. Animatica adds support for resource packs that use MCPatcher/OptiFine-style custom animated textures. These are different from normal vanilla animated textures and are commonly found in older OptiFine resource packs. ## What does Animatica do? Animatica supports custom animated texture definitions from resource packs using the MCPatcher/OptiFine animation format. This can include: - Animated GUI textures - Animated entity textures - Animated block entity textures - Animated armor textures - Other custom animated textures Normal animated blocks and items using vanilla `.mcmeta` files are already supported by Minecraft and do not require Animatica. ## Supported Minecraft Versions Currently supported: - Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric beta More versions may be added as testing continues. ## Supported Animation Paths Animatica Continuation supports animations from: - `optifine/anim/` - `mcpatcher/anim/` - `animatica/anim/` ## What This Mod Does Not Support Animatica Continuation does not add every OptiFine feature. It does not support: - Fully custom GUIs. Use OptiGUI for that. - Custom entity models. Use CEM for that. - Custom entity model part animations. - Connected textures. - Custom item textures. - Any other MCPatcher/OptiFine feature outside custom animated textures. For custom item textures, use CIT Resewn Continuation. ## Beta Status This port is currently marked as beta while more resource packs are tested. The mod has been tested with several MCPatcher/OptiFine-style animated texture packs. Some animations have been confirmed to only work when Animatica Continuation is installed. There may still be bugs or resource-pack-specific issues. If you find broken animations, crashes, or reload problems, please report them on GitHub. ## Resource Pack Compatibility Some older resource packs may reference texture paths that changed in newer Minecraft versions. When that happens, Animatica may skip animations that target textures Minecraft no longer has at that path. This is usually a resource pack compatibility issue rather than a crash-level mod issue. ## Credits Animatica Continuation is an unofficial continuation of Animatica by FoundationGames. Original Animatica: https://modrinth.com/mod/animatica This project is not an official release of Animatica. Thank you to FoundationGames and the MCPatcher/OptiFine resource pack community for the original work that made these animated texture formats possible.

The player has items with various durability levels, a map, and basic performance info being shown in a convenient on-screen HUD](https://files.thatstel.la/hidden/modrinth-support/Star/Screenshots/StarInGameShaders3.0.png?) ## Performance Star is very performant out of the box, and achieves higher framerates than modpacks like Fabulously Optimized*. *Performance comparisons for Star 3.0 pending, it runs good though trust me ## Quality of life changes ### Faster launch speed Star can start up faster than other modpacks thanks to resource caching, and it also loads into worlds faster. This helps make sure that you're not left waiting for the game to catch up while still giving you the freedom to use even the fanciest of resource packs. ### Improved in-game HUD ![Screenshot of gameplay in Star. The player has items with various durability levels, a map, and basic performance info being shown in a convenient on-screen HUD](https://files.thatstel.la/hidden/modrinth-support/Star/Screenshots/StarInGame3.0.png) Star adds a few different things to your game HUD, all intended to improve your gameplay. It adds some info on the top left including coordinates, framerate, your movement speed, the current biome, in-game world time, ping and server TPS. On the middle left you get a minimal HUD with a display for armor and held-item durability. Hopefully you can repair your armor before it breaks! On the top middle you get information about what you are looking at, down to mob health and effects or block information. This info is from Jade. Finally, on the bottom middle and right you can see your saturation in your hunger bar and also a clock showing real-life time so you don't lose track of time. ### Preconfigured Mellow Shader Star includes Mellow Shader custom-configured for a balance of great performance and graphics quality. You can toggle it on or off at any time **by pressing K**. ### Better block GUIs (crafting, cooking, etc) Star has some nice touches for when you're crafting, cooking, enchanting, or even when the game is just paused. ![A screenshot of the inventory screen in Star, showing JustEnoughItems for easy item searching](https://files.thatstel.la/hidden/modrinth-support/Star/Screenshots/StarInventory3.0.png?) Star adds JustEnoughItems so you can easily search for items, find crafting recipes, lookup brewing ingredients and more, all without having to leave your game. ### Unintrusive improvements to some game functions - Adds satisfying camera movement for strafing, turning, jumping, falling, flying, and more, with [Camera Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/cameraoverhaul) - Adds dynamic lights, so you can put things like torches in your offhand to light the way - Adds tooltips to Shulker boxes so you can see what's inside (with [Shulker Box Tooltips](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip)) - Adds tasteful extra particles (with [Visuality](https://modrinth.com/mod/visuality)) - Adds wavy capes (with [WaveyCapes](https://modrinth.com/mod/wavey-capes)) - Adds a zoom function similar to Optifine (with [OK Zoomer](https://modrinth.com/mod/ok-zoomer)) - Adds [Client Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/client-tweaks) to do things like preventing placing your last torch from your offhand - Adds [Controlify](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlify) to support any controller via SDL3 - Adds connected texture support with [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) ### Better multiplayer When you're playing with others, Star adds an extra level of polish. Player skins are brought to life with [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers) and support additional customization via [Ears](https://modrinth.com/mod/ears)!
No server hosting? No problem! Just open the Open To LAN screen, and you can forward the game port with one click, thanks to UPnP!\ Requires UPnP to be supported & enabled on your machine, router and ISP. Once your friends join, chat messages will have player heads displayed next to them so you know who is who, at a glance. ### Even more technical changes In addition to making your gaming experience better, Star also does the following: - Keeps a small memory profile, which lets me give Star its 768MB memory allocation requirement - Adds autocomplete for NBT tags when writing commands in chat and in command blocks - Fixes known bugs in the game with [Debugify](https://modrinth.com/mod/debugify) - Optimizes aggressively with [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations) and much more for you to find...\ (or you can check the mods list here in Modrinth, that works too) ## Requirements ### Software #### Modern versions of desktop Windows or Linux with Java 21 are recommended. macOS also works well but OpenGL support is not ideal so I don't expressly recommend it. Mobile launchers like Amethyst or Fold Craft Launcher are not supported because Star includes Sodium. ### Compute #### 8th generation quad core Intel CPU recommended You can play the game on much weaker hardware like a 6th generation dual core Intel CPU, but singleplayer especially can be a toss up on how nice it will be to play. On ARM64 machines, 4x Cortex-A78 cores are pretty playable as long as your graphics device is up to par. #### 1GB+ RAM allocation recommended You'll need a minimum of 768MB RAM allocated to play using Star, and 1GB or more is recommended for the best experience. ### Graphics #### OpenGL 4.6 required Star includes the [Sodium mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), so a graphics device supporting **OpenGL 4.6** is required. If you're having trouble figuring out what OpenGL you have, check out this part of Sodium's description: > Most graphics cards released in the past 12 years are compatible. This includes the following hardware: > - Intel HD Graphics 500 Series (Skylake) or newer > - Nvidia GeForce 400 Series (Fermi) or newer > - AMD Radeon HD 7000 Series (GCN 1) or newer Translation layers may work on a "your mileage may vary" basis but are not recommended by myself or Sodium's developer in lieu of a proper driver natively supporting OpenGL 4.6. This includes Macs running macOS as well as Windows ARM64 computers with chips older than the Snapdragon X-series (see below). #### Note for Windows ARM64 users The game works perfectly if you play on a machine with the Snapdragon X-series chips or newer, like the X Plus, X Elite or the upcoming X2 Elite. Shaders and all. **However**, if you are playing on a machine with anything older than the Snapdragon X-series like the Snapdragon 8cx series or Microsoft SQ-series, turning on Iris shaders will crash the game. This is because Qualcomm didn't ship a native OpenGL driver for these older chips and Microsoft had to include a translator driver in Windows for OpenGL apps like Minecraft. Unfortunately, this translator driver is not as good as native OpenGL and it makes the game crash when it tries to compile the shaderpack's shaders. Please don't turn on shaders and especially do not report crashes on these platforms to Sodium's developer. There is currently no solution except for switching to a machine with an Intel/NVIDIA/AMD GPU, or buying a newer Snapdragon machine with the X-series or newer. ### VR #### VR is not a supported usecase Star is not tested for or on VR. If it works for you, it works. Otherwise, I likely will not apply fixes just to support VR. ## Mod list This is the full mod list for Star **3.0.1** - [3d\-Skin\-Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/zV5r3pPn) by tr7zw - [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/EsAfCjCV) by squeek502 - title: Merry Snow
description: Focuses on snow-related mechanics, aiming to add more variations to the vanilla snow mechanics in Minecraft.
body:
## Merry Snow

This is a mod that focuses on snow-related mechanics, aiming to add more variations to the vanilla snow mechanics in Minecraft.

### Frozen Kingdom

All biomes can be set to have snow weather, even deserts!

Simply set `enforceSnowWeather = "true"` in the configuration file, and use the command `/weather rain` to make it snow across the entire dimension.

This only changes the weather appearance on the client side and does not force weather to activate. To enable snow accumulation and ice freezing effects, see below.

Additionally, this feature supports fine-tuning. For example, you can set only the jungle biome to have snow weather, or set the frozen ocean biome to have rain weather.

For details, refer to the configuration file: `weatherModify = ["minecraft:forest=snow", "minecraft:ocean=rain", "minecraft:jungle=none"]`. Here, `none` means no weather at all.

### Snow and Ice Coverage

Besides weather, you can adjust whether a biome accumulates snow or freezes ice.

But first, let's see how to make the entire dimension covered in snow and ice!

Set `enforceSnowCover = "true"` in the configuration file to enable forced snow accumulation, and `enforceIceFreeze = true` to enable forced ice freezing.

Note that snow accumulation only takes effect when weather is active.

This feature also supports fine-tuning. For example, you can set the jungle biome to accumulate snow when it snows, or prevent the frozen ocean biome from freezing.

See the configuration files for details:
- `snowModify = ["minecraft:forest=true", "minecraft:ocean=false"]`
- `iceModify = ["minecraft:forest=true", "minecraft:ocean=false"]`

### Sunny Snow

In vanilla Minecraft, weather and clear skies (with the sun and moon) cannot coexist—when it rains or snows, you cannot see the sky. This mod allows you to adjust the "sunny snow factor" to make weather and clear skies appear together.

Specifically, the sunny snow factor represents a transition value from completely clear to full weather, which can be thought of as light snow, moderate snow, or heavy snow. More adjustable options will be added in the future.

Effect:  
![img](https://resource-api.xyeidc.com/client/pics/87a23ce2)  
With shaders:  
![img](https://resource-api.xyeidc.com/client/pics/438665ad)

You can adjust the value of the `sunnySnow` option in the configuration file, or use the hotkey (default: M) + mouse wheel in-game to change the sunny snow factor.

This is a client-side feature and can also be used to temporarily disable weather effects easily.

Additionally, if you enable the `randomSunnySnow` option in the configuration file, a random sunny snow factor will be applied each time the weather changes.

### Merry Snow

Tired of villages turning into ghost towns? Enable the `merryPowderSnow` option, and powder snow will always have a collision box equivalent to the bottom slab, with no freezing damage.

Annoyed by monsters spawning during snow? Enable `merrySnowWeather`, and if a monster is about to spawn naturally in a location where it is snowing, it will not spawn.

Also, if you enable `merrySnowLayer`, snow layers will no longer have collision volume, so they won't block your path.

### Others

This mod also provides a new command to quickly get biome IDs:
- `/biomeid current` – Gets the biome ID at the player's current location.
- `/biomeid all` – Returns an array containing all biome IDs.

### Future Plans

- Mobs will reduce snow layer depth by 1 when stepping on it, and they will experience slight slowdown in snow, with higher layers causing more slowdown.
- Items related to snow and weather, such as a snow doll that influences weather.
- Ice skating gameplay mechanics.

title: Elegant Spells
description: This is a flashy and high-quality magic RPG mod, and it's really interesting.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce0f69d3ba9b3f07f053308f5b6298716aa404c0.png)

## Thank you all for your support of the Elegant series—your support is the driving force behind the Great Witch's updates. 😊
This time, the Great Witch has brought the magic segment of the Elegant series: Elegant Spells. It is an RPG adventure mod, currently in its initial version. After the upcoming first-phase update, the number of spells will see a significant increase. At present, there are roughly 12 types of spells, various recipes, as well as adventure elements like a mana bar and ruins. Among these, the crafting section is particularly flashy. Are you ready to become an apprentice of the Great Witch! 😊 

**The main gameplay of Elegant Spells revolves around RPG adventures and multi-school classes, with flashy and gorgeous magic as well as crafting tables being the mod's distinctive features.**  

The mod includes various player animations, rituals, model animations, and more.  

The author notes that the current version (uploaded on July 27, 2025) is in the release testing phase. Due to the "features" of MCreator, the mod has some instability, but the author states that most issues with this mod creator have been largely avoided.  

Currently, the mod has at least 12 types of spells and 6 types of crafting tables, and the author has announced plans to continue adding a large number of new magic types and weapons.

#  How to Start?

In any such mod, there must be an initial craftable item. The initial craftable item of this mod is: Universal Magic. It can be obtained by right-clicking in the Stargazer to empty the mana bar, and it is also the essential basic material for crafting any item in this mod:


![STAR](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5226130b933741789fd41873e76e0896d994b5cc.gif)

After that, you need to craft a Potion Cauldron to refine items and crafting materials within the mod;

Once the Potion Cauldron is crafted, you need to make a Scripting Table and a Mana Scripting Table to craft Tomes of Scrolls and Spell Scrolls.

Scripting Table: Used to craft Tomes of Scrolls. It requires 5 refined materials, a bottle of scripting ink of a specified level, and blank scrolls. The key material is runes. For example, 3 Level 1 runes and 2 refined materials are needed to craft the Firebolt Tome.

Mana Scripting Table: Used to copy a tome into a spell scroll for casting. It is powered by a bottle of Mana Ink, a Mana Quill, and a magical blank scroll.

If possible, next you need to craft a set of Mana Armor, which requires a Magic Sewing Machine, a Mana Clothes Hanger, and a Spinning Wheel to participate in the crafting process.

Magic Sewing Machine: Used to craft various types of Mana Cloth, which is used for sewing and repairing clothes (the repair function is implemented in the Phase 2 version).

Mana Clothes Hanger: Used to craft Mana Armor. It requires adding a set of clothing blanks to the base part and a set of Mana Cloth to the material part for crafting magical equipment.

Spinning Wheel: Used to craft linen cloth and some basic fabrics. Linen cloth is the most basic fabric unit, used to craft better Mana Cloth, and is also an essential item for crafting clothing blanks.

Next, you should explore the Overworld, where you will find some in-mod ruins (you need to install Elegant Architecture and Elegant Countryside to properly display NBT structures). These ruins may contain loot chests, which may drop some interesting equipment and items...
![logo2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1545fac4c8778372900cadc228a534c4835253a6.png)

title: Yomi's Minecraft Transit Railway
description: A fixed and enhanced fork of Minecraft-Transit Railway mod version 3.2.2-1.20.1.
body:
# Yomi's Minecraft Transit Railway

## English
This is an **unofficial fork** of [Minecraft Transit Railway (MTR)](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-transit-railway) mod, specifically for **version 1.20.1‑3.2.2**. It fixes long‑standing bugs unique to this version and adds useful new features.

> Note: If you want to use this mod together with **JCM**, please install [the special compatibility version](https://modrinth.com/project/GuxlRbJ2).


### Added Features

- **Manual driving enhancements**  
  - MTR4‑style dashboard and alignment bar (gradually approaches from the top)  
  - Distance to next station (in meters) always visible  
  - After passing a station, the alignment bar automatically switches to the next stop

- **Train operations**  
  - **Early braking: Trains decelerate in advance so that speed drops to the limit precisely when entering a restricted track – switchable per siding**
  - **Waiting time after door closing**

- **Rendering**  
  - **Vehicle render distance is now independent from simulation distance – fully adjustable on its own**
  - More realistic SP1900 train texture (same as MTR4)

- **Lift improvements**  
  - Adjustable acceleration and maximum speed  
  - Choose between transparent or opaque lift styles
  - Redesigned two-column lift settings panel

- **Broadcaster**  
  - Supports playing network audio (`.wav` format only for now)


### Fixed Issues

- Lift doors and platform doors can now be placed, opened, and broken **properly (original MTR 3.2.2-1.20 bug)**

title: Dimension Parasite
description: Challenge the erosion of the Dimension Parasite and struggle in the out-of-control alien world.
body:
# **Dimension Parasite**
## Requires GeckoLib as a prerequisite!
## _Introduction_
This is a dimension-related mod created using MCreator.
It currently includes 4 new dimensions, multiple biomes, various creatures, and 8 tools.
 
The story of this mod begins with a kind of parasite from the void—they stealthily invade and infect various dimensions. Players will step into these newly eroded dimensions to explore, and only by actively devouring the parasites can they be guided to even vaster unknown dimensions!
 
## _Gameplay flow_
Head to the new biome in the Overworld, defeat and consume the infected creatures to enter the first dimension.

In the first dimension, kill the semi-infected zombies, obtain their blood and drink it to enter the second dimension.

Collect all infected foods, merge them, and consume the mixture to enter the third dimension.

Craft the dimension parasite to enter the fourth dimension and defeat the boss.
 
## _Mechanic_
Lightning deals more damage to infected creatures.

Contact with large infected creatures results in infection and injury.

Infected food can only be consumed in specific dimensions to enter the next one (for example, only consuming a parasite in the Overworld allows entry into the first dimension).

Purification Blocks will turn into infected blocks when placed in an infected dimension.

Infected creatures have a damage reduction system: the higher the weapon's damage, the less damage they take.
 
Find the Purification Crafting Table to upgrade the Blade of Purification.
