### An Optifine/CIT pack that adds variations to firework rockets, depending on their flight duration and whether they have explosions or not.

**Updated for compatibility with Minecraft 1.20.5 and beyond, due to changes with the NBT data system.**

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AsVQBClb/images/191581f590b47eb03c986bf4a71af8d7a19c48dd.png)

Rockets with explosions will use the vanilla texture, while rockets without explosions will appear without the vanilla red stripes and instead have a progress bar indicating the flight duration. Rockets without explosions and with a flight duration of 2 or 3 will be colored yellow or green. Rockets without NBT data (from creative inventory or commands) will appear without stripes and without number.

_Original pack made by [Legofelix55 on Planet Minecraft](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/firework-rocket-colors/). Updated with permission from the original creator._

title: Mine Prevention
description: This is a simple client-side mod that gives you the ability to allow or disallow the mining of certain blocks.
body:
# Mine Prevention

![GitHub license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/BVengo/mine-prevention.svg)
![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/BVengo/mine-prevention.svg)
![GitHub issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/BVengo/mine-prevention.svg)

This is a simple client-side mod that gives you the ability to avoid mining certain blocks. 

For example, block all ores while you're mining without Silktouch or Fortune so you can save them for later! Or perhaps only allow yourself to mine large amethyst buds so that you don't accidentally break the budding block!

## Usage
Simply press 'M' to open the GUI and select the blocks you want to block or allow. The keybind can be changed in the controls menu, and you can also choose to remove it in favour of ModMenu.

The config file for this mod is located in the `config` folder of your Minecraft directory, and is called `mineprevention.json`. It only contains a deny list, to minimise the amount of data stored.

## Images
![The options screen with all ores denied.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BVengo/mine-prevention/refs/heads/main/assets/block_ores.png)

![The options screen with only large amethyst buds allowed.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BVengo/mine-prevention/refs/heads/main/assets/allow_amethyst.png)

## Contributing
Contributions and suggestions are always welcome! Please limit all issues to only one feature at a time - feel free to open multiple at once if you have many ideas. Similarly, please limit pull requests to a single feature at a time and try to follow the existing code style.


To further discuss or get notifications of new updates, check out my [Discord](https://discord.gg/gyTa5v7kKk). If you like what I do, consider supporting me on Ko-Fi! [![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/C0C7DZ3FB)

title: Minecraft But Backwards
description: Minecraft But Backwards completely reverses progression; you begin in the End and slowly work your way back to the Overworld.
body:
### Minecraft But Backwards
Minecraft But Backwards completely reverses Minecraft’s normal progression; you begin stranded in the End, defeat the Ender Dragon to escape, survive through the Nether, and finally reach the Overworld.
Every step of the journey is flipped upside down, turning simple milestones into major achievements, where even getting your first wood block becomes the true end goal.

### **Features**
- You Spawn in the End Dimension
- Goal: Wood Log.
- Multiplayer support.
- Custom Objective advancement tab.

### 📦 Installation
This is a Datapack - no mods required.

1. Download the .zip file
2. Open Minecraft and navigate to your world's folder
   - %appdata%\.minecraft\saves\<YourWorldName>\ on Windows
   - ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/saves/<YourWorldName>/ on macOS
3. Drop the .zip directly into the datapacks folder (do not unzip it)
4. Launch your world and run /reload if the world is already open
5. Watch for the Bebu load message in chat, you're live!


### ❓ FAQ
Q: Does this work with Fabric or Forge mods?

A: Yes. It's a vanilla datapack and runs alongside any mods without conflict.


Q: Can I use this on a server?

A: Absolutely. It's designed with multiplayer in mind.


Q: Does it work on existing worlds?

A: Not tested. Recommended on a Fresh World

title: Froggy's InControlContinuation
description: Mob spawn control and actions, continued for 1.12.2
body:
![title text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df06f5cf88addf929a9224f425434213e2e28a3e.png)
**Note: This mod is a fork of [In Control! by McJty (link)](https://modrinth.com/mod/in-control) created for maintenance and new features. For the original mod please go to their page.**  
  
Froggy's InControlContinuation commissioned by Frog.  
  
As with the original, Froggy's InControlContinuation allows control over various aspects of mob spawning including restricting spawns, adding new spawns, and applying actions when mobs are spawned.  
For instructions on using Froggy's InControlContinuation, view the [original wiki (link)](https://www.mcjty.eu/docs/mods/control-mods/control-mods-legacy), with additional features listed below.  
  
Current main changes:  
- Multiple mobs are now allowed to be defined per spawn entry in potential spawns to reduce writing duplicate spawn entries.  
- Potential spawns removal now allows for defining "*" to remove all entries matching the given filter.  
- Added "biomereg" filter to all groups to allow for defining biomes by registry name rather than display name.  
- Added "creaturetype" filter to potential spawns to allow limiting rule application to specific creature type passes.  
- Creature type filter is not required however if used fixes issues with added spawn entries spawning too fast and bypassing spawn limits.  
- Added "minplayerdist" and "maxplayerdist" filters to all groups to allow for defining how close or far a player has to be.  
- Added general config options to allow for changing the monster and general mob minimum spawning distance from players.  
- Added Nyx/Hyxcate event compat filters "harvestmoon", "starshower", "bloodmoon", "fullmoon", "redgiant", "grimeclipse", and "bluemoon".  
- Fixed existing general config max player distance setting not being properly applied.  
- Fixed summonaid not properly applying actions to the additional summoned mobs.  
- Added missing spawn rule mob attribute multiply/add actions for "followrange_", "knockbackresistance_", "flyingspeed_", "armor_", and "armortoughness_".  
- Added spawn rule actions to add damage source modifiers "sourcemodifiers" which allow for changing the damage received by a mob for specific damage sources.  
- Each damage source modifier entry is defined as: "name", the name of the damage source to modify, "mult", value to multiply the damage by, "add", value to add to the damage after multiplying.  
- Fix spawn actions applied through onJoin applying multiple times to the same entity.  
- Reordered filter rules for better performance.  
  
Please report any issues to the issue tracker linked at the top.

title: DebugStick
description: This plugin allows you to set up a debug stick on your server so you can give it access to players in survival mode
body:
### Description
This plugin allows you to set up a debug stick on your server so you can provide access to it for players in survival mode

### Setup
To give access to the debug stick in survival mode, you need to set permission **minecraft.debugstick.always** to **true**

### Features
Blacklist blocks  
List worlds prevent waterlogged  
Custom crafting recipe debug stick  

### Commands  
**/debugstick reload** - To reload plugin    
 
### Permissions  
 **debugstick.reload** - Permission to reload plugin (default: op)  
 **debugstick.bypass** - Bypassing plugin check (default: false)  
### Config
<details>
<summary>Config</summary>

```ini
# Disables checking for players in creative
# Отключает проверку игроков в креативе
Bypass_In_Creative: false

# Message when a player tries to interact with a block or state on the blacklist
# Сообщение когда игрок пытается взаимодействовать с блоком или состоянием блока из черного списка
Interaction_cancellation_messages:
  enable: true
  actionbar: true
  messageBlock: "You cannot interact with this block"
  messageState: "You cannot interact with this state"

# List of worlds where the player cannot create water using the debug stick
# Список миров, в которых игрок не может создать воду с помощью палочки отладки
Prevent_water_in_world:
  - "world_nether"
 #- "custom_world_name"

# Debug stick recipe config
# Конфиг рецепта палочки отладки
Debug_stick_craft:
  enabled: true

  # if grid is 2x2, line3 is ignored and the line length is 2 characters
  # если сетка 2x2, строка 3 игнорируется и длина строки составляет 2 символа
  grid_size: 2 # 3x3 => 3, 2x2 => 2, 1x1 => 1
  shape:
    line1: " N"  # craft grid | сетка крафта
    line2: "S "  # use space for empty slot
    line3: "   " # использовать space для пустого слота

  # ingredient key for craft grid
  # ключ ингредиента для сетки крафта
  ingredient:
    N: "NETHER_STAR"
    S: "STICK"

# List of blocks that the player will not be able to interact with
# Список блоков, с которыми игрок не сможет взаимодействовать
Blacklist_block:
  - bee_nest
  - beehive
  - cake
  - composter
  - respawn_anchor
  - end_portal_frame
  - turtle_egg
  - trial_spawner
  - vault
  - sculk_shrieker
  - sea_pickle
  - grass_block
  - water_cauldron

# List of block tags that the player will not be able to interact with
# Список тегов блоков, с которыми игрок не сможет взаимодействовать
Blacklist_tag_block:
  - candles
  - crops
  - doors
  - slabs
  - tall_flowers

title: Gamemode Shortener
description: A simple mod the that adds /gmc for /gamemode creative, /gms for /gamemode survival, /gmsp for /gamemode spectator, and /gma for /gamemode adventure
body:
## Minecraft Mod: Easy Gamemode Switcher

This simple mod for **Minecraft Fabric (1.20.5 to 1.21.4)** adds easy command aliases for switching gamemodes. Instead of typing `/gamemode <whatever>` command, you can use shorter, more accessible commands:

- `/gmc` for **Creative Mode**
- `/gms` for **Survival Mode**
- `/gmsp` for **Spectator Mode**
- `/gma` for **Adventure Mode**

These commands make it easier to change your gamemode, especially in multiplayer environments or during testing.

### Features:
- **Quick Gamemode Switching**: Use shorter commands to quickly switch between gamemodes.
- **Compatibility**: Works with Minecraft versions 1.20.5 to 1.21.4.

Enjoy an enhanced gameplay experience with quicker gamemode changes!

title: InstantReload
description: InstantReload is a client-side Fabric mod that speeds up resource pack reloads by rebuilding only the textures that changed instead of reloading everything.
body:
# ⚡ InstantReload

**InstantReload** is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that improves resource pack reload performance.

Instead of rebuilding every texture atlas whenever a resource pack is toggled, InstantReload detects what actually changed and reloads only the affected atlases.  
This reduces lag spikes, shortens reload time, and keeps the vanilla reload lifecycle intact.

The mod is fully client-side, safe by design, and automatically falls back to a full vanilla reload if any inconsistency is detected.

## 🚀 When Does It Help Most?

- Toggling resource packs that modify only a few textures  
- Development workflows with frequent reloads  
- Large modpacks where atlas rebuilds are expensive  

## ⚙ Compatibility Notes

InstantReload modifies the atlas reload pipeline using mixins.  
It may conflict with other mods that:

- Rewrite or cancel the resource reload pipeline  
- Replace or heavily modify atlas management logic  
- Inject into texture stitching or atlas creation methods  
- Implement their own texture atlas optimization system  
- Override async resource reload behavior  

In general, it should be compatible with most mods that do not directly alter the texture atlas rebuild process.

## 🧩 In Short

> InstantReload makes resource pack reloading smarter and smoother  
> by updating only what changed — nothing more.

title: Redstone Scrambler
description: Adds a throwable redstone EMP item to the game!
body:
#
Redstone Scrambler Adds a throwable redstone EMP item to the game.

##
What's it do? When thrown, it sticks to wherever it lands and randomly forces a redstone power signal to be sent or ignored to the surrounding blocks. Kind of like an EMP but for redstone.

##
How do I get it? You can craft it with 1 ender pearl, 1 amethsyt shard, 1 echo shard, and 1 redstone dust.

![In a 3x3 crafting interface, a shapeless recipe consisting of one redstone dust, one ender pearl, one amethyst shard, and one echo shard are placed into the inputs, where the output is the redstone scrambler item.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/504282937a86dc96cc9f800aea182a9d42fb2d99.png)

##
Okay, but _why_ would I want this? You can use it to mess with your friends' redstone builds, though I wouldn't recommend that since this _can_ permanently ruin a mechanism due to it constantly powering blocks out of the intended order. It still has many versatile usages, though. For example, you can use it: - As a remote temporary activation signal! - To forcibly open a redstone door so you can sneak in _without_ (physically) breaking anything! - To annoy everyone through noteblock/trapdoor/door/piston spam!
![A player standing infront of a collection of doors, trapdoors, and other noisy blocks, activating them with the redstone scrambler](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/505065505470478aa4ad7c50998f41b3d4611915.gif)
- As a super-fast kind-of reliable temporary redstone clock!
![A short gif of husks walking towards a building, while getting pelted in the face with a barrage of arrows](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9b1f441f74da4da41b60813cb7581b42c2476ca.gif)
- For fancy light shows?
![A wall of redstone lamps and copper bulbs switching from on and off randomly](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89616c5dfc139aa4c1344d4dd6061fd16b576e77.gif)
- To remotely set off bundles of TNT in your friend's base that just so happened to be there for some inexplicable reason!
![A player entering a house and leaving after a short while, throwing the redstone scrambler at it to detonate the TNT inside](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fce979f7c890f168819bcf928c914c2c02e5129.gif)
- And more things that I probably didn't even think of!! ## IMPORTANT NOTE: I've tried to reduce the amount of block updates this item creates, but it should be noted that having multiple of these active at the same time can cause lag. Also, it does not play nicely with powered rails. So be careful!

**Immersivity** is a Minecraft modpack centered around one thing: [Immersive Portals](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersiveportals). title: Toggle Keybinds
description: A mod that adds keybinds that let you toggle between hotbar slots.
body:
# Toggle Keybinds Mod

This mod allows you to add keybindings that let you switch between 2 hotbar slots with one button.
Useful if you want to navigate your hotbar quickly but don't like to use a lot of hotkeys.

## Installation

### Required Mods

 - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/)
 - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)

### Configuration

Keybinds can be configured on the config screen from the mods menu.  
(Esc -> Mods -> Toggle Keybinds -> [config icon in top right])

Because the bindings are saved in "keybinds.json" in the mod's config folder, it is also possible to edit them directly (although I don't recommend this).
They are stored in the following format:

    [
        {
        "keyCode": 70,
        "slot1": 0,
        "slot2": 8
        }
    ]

This keybind binds the "F" key to toggle between the first and the last slot.
Keycodes can be found here:
- [Mouse buttons](https://www.glfw.org/docs/latest/group__buttons.html)
- [Keyboard keys](https://www.glfw.org/docs/latest/group__keys.html)

title: KantoBlocks
description: 480+ blocks for building Kanto-style towns, routes, caves, interiors, and adventure maps in Minecraft.
body:
# KantoBlocks **KantoBlocks** is a building-block library made for creators who want to build classic Kanto-inspired towns, routes, interiors, caves, gyms, and adventure maps in Minecraft. It was originally created for the **[CobbleKanto](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblekanto)** project, where we needed a lot more than a few decorative blocks. The map needed city floors, walls, carpets, cave tiles, route details, signs, furniture-like pieces, themed interiors, connected textures, and a cleaner way to give builders access to the whole block set. --- [![KantoBlocks Shockbyte sponsor banner](https://i.imgur.com/OoiRMfj.png)](https://shockbyte.com/billing/aff.php?aff=10741) Get 25% off your Minecraft server with Shockbyte! Ready to start an epic adventure with your friends? Just click [here](https://shockbyte.com/billing/aff.php?aff=10741) or on the banner and use promo code “COBBLEKANTO”, plus you’ll be helping us keep improving the mod and developing future projects! --- ## Features - 480+ Kanto-inspired building blocks - City, route, cave, gym, interior, mansion, ship, tower, and endgame-themed block sets - Connected texture blocks powered by Athena - Custom block shapes for signs, carpets, panes, fences, slabs, stairs, doors, plants, and small details - KantoBlocks Converter Block - Converter support for copper ingots and compatible "ball-tag" currencies when available - Loot tables and tool tags for normal block drops and mining behavior --- ## What It Is For KantoBlocks is not meant to be a generic “random blocks” mod. It is a focused building kit. It works best for: - survival Minecraft maps - Cobblemon adventure maps - multiplayer towns and routes - gyms and challenge areas - caves and tunnels - server hubs - decorative builds with a retro RPG feeling - map makers who need consistent tiles across a large project The main goal is to make it easier to build a full adventure region without having every house, route, cave, and interior depend only on vanilla blocks. --- ## Block Themes KantoBlocks includes sets inspired by many different map areas and building types, including: - Celadon City - Cerulean City - Cinnabar Island - Fuchsia City - Lavender Town - Pallet Town - Pewter City - Saffron City - Vermilion City - Viridian City - Center & Mart interiors - Caves - Underground Path - ship interiors - endgame and elite4 inspired rooms - global decorative blocks used across the map Some blocks are full cubes, while others use custom shapes, directional placement, slabs, stairs, carpets, panes, fences, plants, signs, or connected textures. --- ## Connected Textures Several KantoBlocks use connected textures through Athena. This helps walls, floors, carpets, cave tiles, and other surfaces blend more naturally when placed together. It is especially useful for large interiors or route sections where repeating the same square texture would look too harsh. Because of that, **Athena is required** for the intended visual result. --- ## KantoBlocks Converter KantoBlocks includes a **KantoBlocks Converter**, a utility block made to help players access the block set more comfortably. The converter has a scrollable GUI with a block palette. You insert a valid currency item, select the block you want, and receive the selected KantoBlock. ![KantoBlocks Converter GUI Showcase](https://i.imgur.com/LQLUq2t.png) The converter is useful for: - adventure servers - controlled block access - creative-style building stations - server shops By default, the converter can use pokéballs and copper ingots as currencies to get the blocks. --- ## Dependencies Required: - Minecraft 1.21.1 - Fabric Loader - Fabric API - Java 21 - Athena - GeckoLib Recommended / ecosystem: - Cobblemon Cobblemon is part of the **[CobbleKanto](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblekanto)** ecosystem and is recommended for the intended adventure-map experience, but KantoBlocks itself is primarily a building-block mod. Do not forget to install Athena and GeckoLib. Some blocks and visual features depend on them. --- ## FAQ **Does this mod add natural world generation?** No. KantoBlocks is a building/decorative block library. It does not generate structures or terrain by itself. **Is this only for CobbleKanto?** No. It was made for **[CobbleKanto](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblekanto)**, but you can use it in your own maps, servers, modpacks, or builds. **Can I use this in my own map, server or content?** Yes. You can use it in maps, servers, modpacks, screenshots, videos, livestreams, and showcases, as long as you do not reupload or claim the mod/assets as your own. **Why does it require Athena?** Athena is used for connected texture blocks. **Why does it require GeckoLib?** GeckoLib is used by some custom rendered blocks and items. **Can I use WorldEdit with these blocks?** Yes. KantoBlocks is useful for map building workflows, including WorldEdit-based building, as long as your server/client has the mod installed. --- ## Notes - Some blocks are designed for very specific visual use cases. - Connected textures may look wrong if Athena is missing. - Custom rendered blocks may not work correctly if GeckoLib is missing. - Always back up important worlds before adding or updating large building-block mods. ## Building Note KantoBlocks gives you the main visual foundation, but it works best when treated as part of a larger building palette. For more detailed areas, you may want to **mix it** with vanilla Minecraft blocks or other decoration mods, such as Chipped, to reach the exact look you want. For the most complete building experience, we recommend combining KantoBlocks with **[KantoModels](https://modrinth.com/mod/kantomodels)**. While **[KantoModels](https://modrinth.com/mod/kantomodels)** provides the main floors, walls, paths, caves, and structural pieces, KantoModels adds the extra decorative models and small details that help towns, routes, interiors, and special areas feel more alive. --- ## Credits Special thanks to everyone following the **[CobbleKanto](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblekanto)** project and to the Cobblemon community for inspiring so many map makers to build bigger worlds. ---

KantoBlocks is an unofficial fan-made Minecraft mod.

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or approved by Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures Inc., The Pokémon Company, Mojang Studios, Microsoft, or the Cobblemon team.

Minecraft is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation. Pokémon and related names are trademarks of their respective owners. Cobblemon belongs to its respective creators.

🇬🇧 English

BleedOut adds a knockdown mechanic to the game. When you take fatal damage, you don't die instantly—you fall to the ground and start bleeding out.

Features
Downed State: You enter a crawling pose with a limited time to live. You can move to cover, but cannot jump, use items, or fight.
Revival: Teammates can revive you by holding Right-Click nearby. If they move too far, the process cancels.
Give Up: Hold Left-Click to succumb to injuries immediately if help isn't coming.
Weapon Compatibility

Full integration with TACZ and SuperbWarfare.

Firing is strictly blocked while downed (prevents exploits).
Works via reflection (no hard dependencies).

BleedOut добавляет механику нокдауна. При получении смертельного урона вы не умираете мгновенно, а падаете на землю и начинаете истекать кровью.

title: NxLinks
description: A lightweight and customizable Minecraft plugin to share server links, social media, and custom commands in style — fully configurable with permissions and colorful messages.
body:
# 🌐 NxLinks

**NxLinks** is a lightweight and customizable Minecraft plugin that makes sharing your server’s links simple, stylish, and professional.
Whether it’s your **Discord**, **Store**, **YouTube**, or custom pages like `/vote` or `/forum`, NxLinks helps you organize everything into clean commands with colorful messages.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🎯 **Customizable Config** – Edit everything in `config.yml` (titles, messages, colors, permissions).
* 🔗 **Built-in Social Media Commands** – Discord, Store, YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram.
* ⚡ **Unlimited Custom Commands** – Add your own links like `/blog`, `/forum`, `/vote`, etc.
* 🛡️ **Permissions System** – Control who can use which command.
* 🎨 **Color Codes & Placeholders** – Use `&a &b &c` and `{player}` in your messages.
* 🔄 **Reload Support** – Apply config changes instantly with `/nxlinks reload`.

---

## 📂 Installation

1. Download the latest release of NxLinks.
2. Place the `.jar` file into your server’s `/plugins` folder.
3. Restart or reload the server.
4. Edit the `config.yml` to fit your server’s style.
5. Use `/nxlinks reload` to apply changes without restarting.

---

## ⚙️ Commands

* `/nxlinks` → Main command (reload/help)
* `/discord` → Shows your Discord link
* `/store` → Shows your webstore link
* `/youtube` → Shows your YouTube channel
* `/twitter` → Shows your Twitter/X
* `/instagram` → Shows your Instagram
* Plus any **custom commands** you add in the config!

---

## 🔑 Permissions

* `nxlinks.*` → Access to all NxLinks commands
* `nxlinks.admin` → Manage/reload plugin
* `nxlinks.discord` → Use `/discord`
* `nxlinks.store` → Use `/store`
* `nxlinks.youtube` → Use `/youtube`
* `nxlinks.twitter` → Use `/twitter`
* `nxlinks.instagram` → Use `/instagram`
* `nxlinks.blog` / `nxlinks.forum` / `nxlinks.vote` → For custom links

---

## 💡 Why NxLinks?

NxLinks gives your server a **professional touch** by turning boring text commands into stylish link menus.
It’s perfect for community servers, networks, or anyone who wants to share links cleanly and effectively.

🚀 **Simple. Stylish. Configurable.** That’s NxLinks.

title: Custom XP Scaling
description: Change how much experience is required to level up
body:
Allow you to customize the XP scaling in the game. You can set the XP scaling to be linear, exponential, or any custom curve you want.

In mod configuration, you can use a math formula to describe the relationship between the level and the XP required to reach the next level.
Available operations and functions can be found [here](https://ezylang.github.io/EvalEx/references/references.html).

Here is an example of what the vanilla XP scaling looks like:
```IF(level >= 31, level * 9 - 158, IF(level >= 16, 5 * level - 38, 2 * level + 7))```

title: Biome Vote Swamp
description: How The Swamp Update Should Have Been!
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Anv-lZc0pIM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Back in 2019, Mojang published this video on what the swamp update would look like. But as everyone knows this is not what we got in 1.19. The regular swamp was left pretty much unchanged, frogs have a different model and different colors that barely resemble a typical frog, and mangrove trees look completely different.  
  
Biome Vote Swamp makes the swamp update into what it should've been, fixing all the previously mentioned problems and more!

# Changes
## Frogs
- The frog model has been replaced with a new one that looks much more like a frog and matches the one in the video (requires [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)). The new model is also compatible with frog textures from other resources packs.
- A typical frog is green, not orange, and it was green in the video, but the vanilla cold frog is green, so all the frog colors have been redesigned to match real-world frog species. The temperate frog now resembles a bullfrog, the warm frog now resembles a mangrove frog, and the cold frog now resembles a wood frog. (fun fact: wood frogs can survive in the coldest climate of any known frog species)  
- Froglight mechanics are unchanged.
  
![New Frog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ccDPVgCh/images/2e9518f18bef2edd16a54796c53bf2d6afc4fb33.webp)
- Frogs can also now spawn in all river biomes -with cold frogs now spawning naturally in frozen rivers- and very rarely in lush caves (requires [Lithostitched](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithostitched)).
- Frogs can now spawn on moss blocks, clay, mangrove leaves, and anything they prefer to jump to.
- Cold and warm frog variants are now used when a frog spawns in a biome where cold and warm variant farm animals can spawn respectively.

## Mangrove Trees
- The shape of mangrove trees has been changed to match the one in the video.

![New Mangrove Tree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ccDPVgCh/images/6f8e641bd1ee085ed6a1a5f18cef679ebf7427ae.webp)

## Swamps
- The "swamp oak" trees that generate in swamps have been replaced with mangrove trees, just like in the video.
- The color of leaves in swamps now matches their color in mangrove swamps (requires [Lithostitched](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithostitched)).

![Swamp Biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ccDPVgCh/images/8a1046be8a5d6831ef90d92a91ced258b14529c2.webp)

## Mangrove Swamps
- Witch huts can now spawn here.
- Mud no longer generates at or higher than y=64. (requires [Lithostitched](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithostitched)).

![Mangrove Swamp Biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ccDPVgCh/images/471de0c1682436b15e4f04f3772ba26ca2de7059.webp)

---
The new frog models and textures are client-side, and everything else is server-side. Use on both sides for all features.  
Certain features won't work without [Lithostitched](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithostitched) & [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features).

title: Curiosities
description:
一个为Minecraft 1.20.1添加多种有趣功能和物品的Forge模组。
A Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds various fun features and items.
body:
# Curiosities (趣味物品)

一个为Minecraft 1.20.1添加多种有趣功能和物品的Forge模组。内容均为AI制作

A Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds various fun features and items. All content is made by AI.

## 🌟 Features

### 🗡️ Weapons & Tools

- **Rose Gold Tools** - Balanced tools with iron mining level, gold mining speed, and enhanced enchantability
- **Void Devourer Sword** - Powerful weapon that collects void energy and creates black holes
- **Lucky Sword** - Unpredictable weapon with random damage output (-15 to +30)
- **Probability Holy Sword** - Mysterious weapon with 20% chance for special effects
- **Staff of Control** - Control entities to fight each other
- **Scythes** - Efficient farming tools for bulk crop harvesting with auto-replanting
- **Rocket Boots** - Charge-jump boots with fall damage reduction

### 🧪 Magical Items

- **Causal Pocket Watch** - Store and revert player states with time manipulation
- **Scroll of Spacetime** - Create anchors and teleport across dimensions
- **Entity Compass** - Track and highlight specific entity types
- **Time-Space Scroll** - Ancient magical scroll for instant travel

### 🍯 Consumables & Utilities

- **Infinite Water Bucket** - Unlimited water source with 3x3 collection
- **Wolf Fang Potato** - Grants Wolf Pack Leader effect
- **Toxic Gland** - Dangerous food with multiple negative effects
- **Bee Grenade** - Throwable weapon that releases angry bees
- **Rich Potions** - Make villagers follow you with love effects
- **Undying Potions** - Trigger Totem of Undying effects

### ⚡ Enchantments

- **Chain Mining** - Mine connected blocks of the same type (Max Level 4)
- **Super Fortune** - 1.5x vanilla Fortune effect, compatible with Silk Touch (Max Level 3)
- **Moral Balance** - Different effects for peaceful vs hostile mobs
- **Steel Covenant** - Damage cap protection for chestplates (Max Level 5)
- **Proficiency** - Increases weapon attack speed (Max Level 4)

### 🌀 Status Effects

- **Wolf Pack Leader** - Nearby wolves assist in combat
- **Guilt** - Increases villager trade prices
- **Dizzy** - Reverses movement controls
- **Spinning** - Random camera rotation
- **Dissolving Body** - Reduces damage immunity time
- **Rich** - Attracts villagers with heart effects
- **Confusion** - Chance to redirect attacks to yourself
- **Undying** - Triggers totem effects on fatal damage

### 🧱 Blocks & Mechanics

- **Fake TNT** - TNT-like block with special interaction mechanics
- **Glass Bottle to Water Bottle** - Automatic conversion when thrown in water

## 🔧 Installation

1. Download and install [Minecraft Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/) for your Minecraft version
2. Download the latest Curiosities mod file from the releases page
3. Place the mod file in your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft with the Forge profile

## 🎮 Getting Started

### Basic Crafting

Most items in Curiosities require advanced materials. Start by gathering:

- **Basic Materials**: Iron, Gold, Copper, Diamonds
- **Advanced Materials**: Netherite, Nether Stars, End Crystals
- **Special Items**: Totems of Undying, Dragon Heads, Various Mob Heads

### Configuration

The mod includes an extensive configuration system accessible through the mod menu:

- **Items Settings** - Enable/disable specific items and adjust their properties
- **Status Effects Settings** - Control effect durations and intensities
- **Enchantments Settings** - Modify enchantment availability and power
- **Blocks Settings** - Toggle block features and mechanics

### Key Recipes

```
Rose Gold Tools: Golden Tool + Copper Ingot (Smithing Table)
Entity Compass: Mob Heads + Compass + Leather + Feather
Causal Pocket Watch: Iron + Clock + Nether Stars
Infinite Water Bucket: Water Bucket surrounded by Prismarine Shards + Sponges
```

## 📖 Usage Examples

### Combat Enhancement

1. Craft a **Void Devourer Sword** for energy-based combat
2. Enchant weapons with **Proficiency** for faster attacks
3. Use **Steel Covenant** on chestplates for damage protection
4. Consume **Wolf Fang Potato** to get wolf allies

### Exploration & Utility

1. Create **Scroll of Spacetime** for quick travel
2. Use **Entity Compass** to track specific mobs
3. Equip **Rocket Boots** for enhanced mobility
4. Carry **Causal Pocket Watch** for emergency state restoration

### Farming & Resources

1. Craft **Scythes** for efficient crop harvesting
2. Use **Chain Mining** enchantment for bulk resource gathering
3. Apply **Super Fortune** for increased drops
4. Utilize **Infinite Water Bucket** for large-scale farming

## 🔄 Version History

### Version 2025.6 (Latest - June 2025)

- **Major Features**: Rose Gold Tools, Entity Compass, Probability Holy Sword
- **New Items**: Staff of Control, Causal Pocket Watch
- **Optimizations**: Debug logging improvements, recipe cost reductions
- **New Effects**: Undying status effect with corresponding potions
- **Vanilla Modifications**: Glass Bottle to Water Bottle conversion

### Version 2025.5 (May 2025)

- **Bug Fixes**: Config synchronization, texture issues, enchantment applications
- **New Content**: Dizzy/Spinning effects, Rich potions, Void Devourer Sword
- **UI Improvements**: Redesigned configuration interface with two-column layout
- **New Items**: Infinite Water Bucket, Toxic Gland, Lucky Sword, Bee Grenade
- **Enhanced Features**: Scroll of Spacetime, Fake TNT block

### Version 2025.4 (April 2025)

- **Core Features**: Wolf Pack Leader effect, Chain Mining enchantment
- **New Items**: Rocket Boots, Scythes, Wolf Fang Potato
- **Enchantments**: Super Fortune, Moral Balance
- **UI Changes**: Updated creative mode tab icon

## ⚙️ Configuration Options

The mod provides extensive customization through configuration files:

- **Item Toggles**: Enable/disable individual items
- **Recipe Control**: Allow/disallow crafting for specific items
- **Effect Durations**: Adjust status effect timings
- **Damage Values**: Modify weapon and tool statistics
- **Range Settings**: Control area-of-effect ranges
- **Cooldown Times**: Adjust item usage cooldowns

## 🤝 Contributing

This mod is actively developed with regular updates. Check the changelog for the latest features and improvements.

## 📄 License

Please refer to the mod's license file for usage and distribution terms.

---
## 🌟 特色功能

### 🗡️ 武器与工具

- **虚空吞噬之剑** - 强力武器，可收集虚空能量并创造黑洞

- **时空卷轴** - 创建锚点并跨维度传送

- **时空卷轴** - 古老的魔法卷轴，用于瞬间旅行

### 🍯 消耗品与实用工具

- **无限水桶** - 无限水源，具有3x3收集功能
- **狼牙土豆** - 赋予狼群领袖效果
- **涡毒腺体** - 危险食物，具有多种负面效果

- **富有药水** - 让村民跟随你并显示爱心效果

### ⚡ 附魔

- **连锁挖掘** - 挖掘相同类型的连接方块（最高4级）
- **超级时运** - 1.5倍原版时运效果，与精准采集兼容（最高3级）
- **道德天平** - 对和平与敌对生物有不同效果
- **钢契** - 胸甲伤害上限保护（最高5级）
- **熟练** - 增加武器攻击速度（最高4级）

### 🌀 状态效果

- **狼群领袖** - 附近的狼协助战斗
- **罪恶** - 增加村民交易价格
- **颠颠倒倒** - 反转移动控制
- **天旋地转** - 随机摄像头旋转
- **瓦解之躯** - 减少伤害免疫时间
- **富有** - 吸引村民并显示爱心效果
- **混乱** - 有概率将攻击重定向到自己
- **不死** - 在致命伤害时触发图腾效果

### 🧱 方块与机制

- **假TNT** - 类似TNT的方块，具有特殊交互机制
- **玻璃瓶转水瓶** - 投掷到水中时自动转换

1. 下载并安装适合您Minecraft版本的[Minecraft Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/)

title: Craftable Light Blocks
description: A simple datapack that adds a crafting recipe to your game which allows you to craft Light Blocks with the light power of 15 in Survival Mode.
body:
### **README:**

A simple datapack that adds a crafting recipe to your game which allows you to craft Light Blocks with the light power of 15 (possible in Survival). This datapack already includes a default crafting recipe but you could also change it by yourself by using online generators like [TheDestruc7i0n's Crafting Recipe - Generator](https://crafting.thedestruc7i0n.ca/).

When you have created your json file you can put the content of that generated file into the file _light.json_, which you can find inside the **craftable-light-blocks** datapack folder under the path: **\data\light-blocks\recipe\light.json**

About the default crafting recipe: To craft a Light Block you only need one torch and 6 not stained glass panes and follow the scheme seen in the picture:

![How to craft light blocks by default](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c88f512eebb5a57c81bf3ee021797e7f46b328aa.png)

The [Source Code](https://github.com/Knall-TV/Craftable-Light-Blocks/) is only available for the newest version of this datapack for the newest version of Minecraft that is included in the version range of this datapack. (In this case the datapack version v.2.1 for Minecraft version 1.21.4)

Download the datapack in any available version on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/craftable-light-blocks)!

**Have fun with this Datapack! :)**

_If you find any problems or bugs while using this datapack feel free to report it via the [Report issues - Panel](https://github.com/Knall-TV/Craftable-Light-Blocks/issues)._

title: ClearrChatZ

body:
# ClearrChatZ - The Ultimate Chat Management Plugin ## Introduction ClearrChatZ is a lightweight yet powerful Minecraft server plugin designed to provide server administrators and moderators with an elegant solution for managing chat clutter. With a single command, it instantly clears the chat window by filling it with blank lines, providing a fresh start for conversations while maintaining a professional server appearance. ## Key Features ### 🌟 Instant Chat Clearing ClearrChatZ provides a simple `/clearchat` or `/cc` command that instantly clears the chat window by adding configurable blank lines, making previous conversations scroll out of view. This feature is perfect for: - Starting fresh discussions - - Removing inappropriate content quickly - - Creating clean breaks between server announcements - - Resetting chat after heated discussions - - Keeping your server chat organized and professional ### 🛠️ Highly Customizable Every aspect of the plugin can be tailored to your server's needs: - Customize the plugin prefix and colors - - Adjust the number of blank lines for different chat window sizes - - Configure notification messages and sounds - - Show or hide who cleared the chat - - Choose to broadcast clear notifications or keep them private - - Set permission nodes for different staff ranks ### 💼 Staff-Friendly Features - Permission-based access control system - - Option to display which staff member performed the clearing action - - Concise command (`/cc`) for quick access during moderation - - Console support for remote moderation ### 🚀 Performance Optimized - Minimal server resource usage - - No database requirements - - Efficiently handles high-traffic servers - - No lag or performance impact ### 🔌 Easy Integration - Simple installation process - - Compatible with all major Minecraft versions (1.20 - 1.21.5) - - Works alongside other chat management plugins - - No dependencies required ## Why Choose ClearrChatZ? ### 🎯 Focused Design Unlike bloated chat management plugins, ClearrChatZ does one thing and does it exceptionally well. The focused approach ensures reliability, performance, and ease of use. ### 👥 Player Experience Players appreciate a clean, well-moderated chat environment. ClearrChatZ helps create a more enjoyable communication experience for your community by reducing clutter and emphasizing important messages. ### 🔧 Administrator Experience Server administrators will love the simple yet powerful tools ClearrChatZ provides. With minimal configuration required and intuitive commands, chat management becomes effortless. ### 🌱 Future Development The plugin is actively maintained with planned future enhancements including: - Timed automatic chat clearing - - Per-world chat clearing options - - Chat slow mode and cooldown features - - Chat formatting and anti-spam functionality - - Custom clear animations and effects ## Technical Specifications - Lightweight JAR file - - Efficient code design with minimal CPU usage - - Compatible with Minecraft versions 1.20+ - - Works with Paper, Spigot, Bukkit servers - - Supports all major permission systems ## Getting Started Installation is simple - just drop the plugin into your server's plugins folder and restart. The default configuration works out of the box, but you can easily customize all aspects through the config.yml file. Make your server chat experience cleaner and more professional with ClearrChatZ - the clear choice for chat management!

title: Colorblind Swap
description: Time-varying color perception remapping shader.
body:
[![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1321365/description_19767e94-ef82-4569-92c6-b1e8b60e6e07.png)](https://discord.gg/XgH4EpyPD2)

> *The world stays the same. Your perception does not.*

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93c8cf2cd2e5bcb1d64fe45d050c7e548d434bb0_0.webp)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9aa61a35df8a3c3c82675537e1351961a08c5fe_0.webp)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de40341569cb265c10ee8a3514c6220baec55284_0.webp)

Colorblind Swap is a lightweight full-screen post-processing shader that alters how colors are perceived over time. Instead of applying a fixed color filter, the shader periodically changes the relationship between color channels, causing different parts of the spectrum to be interpreted in new ways. The result is a shifting visual experience where familiar environments can temporarily appear as though viewed through different forms of altered color perception.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e9b717b5ee713ce2ad6157e4da4629c3939679f_0.webp)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/337505724820ba083ed237fd8af8e7679db05cfd_0.webp)

---

### ✨ Highlights

**Dynamic Color Perception Shifts.**

The shader operates in timed intervals and selects a new color interpretation mode for each cycle. Rather than permanently remapping colors, it continuously transitions between different channel configurations, making the visual effect feel unstable and perceptual rather than purely cosmetic.

**Red–Green Channel Reassignment.**

One of the available modes exchanges portions of the red and green channels. Reds begin to inherit green information and vice versa, creating a perception similar to common red–green color vision deficiencies while preserving overall scene brightness.

**Blue–Green Spectral Blending.**

Another mode blends blue and green information together. Vegetation, water, sky colors, and other blue-green surfaces gradually lose their usual separation, producing a shifted color balance across the scene.

**Luminance-Based Red Suppression.**

A protanopia-inspired mode reduces the influence of the red channel by partially replacing it with scene luminance. This causes red-heavy surfaces to become less distinct while preserving image structure through brightness information.

**Warm–Cool Spectrum Reconstruction.**

The shader also includes a stylized mode that reorganizes color information into warm and cool groups. Reds and yellows are emphasized into warmer tones while blues are reinforced into cooler tones, creating a split-spectrum appearance.

**Smooth Epoch Transitions.**

Color modes are not switched instantly. Each cycle uses gradual blending to transition between states, avoiding abrupt hard cuts and allowing the visual perception shift to develop naturally over time.

**Transition Flash Effect.**

At the beginning of each color cycle, the shader briefly introduces a complementary-color inversion flicker. This short-lived flash simulates a momentary recalibration of color interpretation before the next mode fully settles.

**Minimal Post-Processing Pipeline.**

The implementation is intentionally simple and focused. The shader performs only color remapping and transition effects. It does not introduce bloom, depth effects, vignette, distortion, lighting changes, shadows, or geometry-based rendering features.

---

### ⚙️ Compatibility

* Implemented as a composite post-processing shader pass.
* Written in GLSL 1.20 (`#version 120`).
* Operates exclusively on the rendered color buffer (`colortex0`).
* Does not require depth information, normals, shadow maps, or additional render targets.
* Designed as a screen-space effect with very low computational complexity.
* No shader-pack-specific configuration files or feature modules were found beyond the composite pass.

This resource pack enhances the classic Minecraft aesthetic with selective texture updates, Stardew Valley-inspired GUI, OptiFine-enhanced features like more mob varieties and custom enchantment book textures, and much more!
body:
This resource pack is designed to preserve the classic vanilla Minecraft aesthetic while enhancing it with thoughtful improvements and creative additions. It’s perfect for players who appreciate the original look of Minecraft but desire more detail and variety without a complete overhaul.

To get all features of this resource pack, you need to download these mods:

[Cull Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/cull-leaves)

[Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)

[Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)

(If you use **Forge** then use OptiFine instead, along side a Leaf Culling mod.)

Key Features:

**Selective Texture Overhaul:** While not every texture and model in Minecraft has been changed, a significant number have been carefully reimagined to provide a fresh experience while maintaining the game’s original charm.

**3D Models:** Enhanced 3D models add depth and realism to certain blocks and items, giving your world a more detailed and immersive feel.

**Stardew Valley-Inspired GUI:** The graphical user interface has been revamped with a Stardew Valley-inspired design, offering a nostalgic and cozy vibe that fans of the game will appreciate.

**OptiFine-Enhanced Features:** When paired with OptiFine, this pack unlocks additional features, including more mob varieties, health bars, custom enchantment book textures, and more, adding further depth and customization to your gameplay experience.

**Selective Music Updates:** While not every piece of music has been changed, some tracks, such as Music Disc 13, feature new and unique music that add a fresh feel to your gameplay.

**Highlight: Double Slab Block Textures**
One of the standout features of this pack is the unique double slab block textures. In vanilla Minecraft, placing two slabs on top of each other creates a regular full-sized block. With this texture pack, instead of the slabs merging into the standard block, they combine to form a new variant with its own distinct texture. This feature adds more variety to your builds, allowing for greater creativity and a more dynamic visual experience.

Why Download This Pack?

If you’re looking for a resource pack that stays true to the original Minecraft experience while offering selective enhancements and unique features, this pack is for you. It’s ideal for players who want to refresh their world without losing the nostalgic charm of vanilla Minecraft. Whether you’re a seasoned builder or a new player, this pack adds depth, variety, and a touch of creativity to every corner of your world.

title: Mysticism
description: A modpack focused on performance, including aesthetic-ready mods and QoL improvements!
body:
# **Welcome to Mysticism!**
This modpack aims to greatly enhance Minecraft's performance and overall gameplay experience, making it ideal for both single-player and multiplayer adventures.
The modpack is usually updated once I tested that all the mods work fine and there won't be any performance drops. 

---
## Why Choose This Modpack?

The Modpack aims to provide a set of __optimization and enhancement mods__, configured for maximum performance and compatibility with connected textures and shaders. I try to test and improve the modpack everyday, making sure to get also as many fixes as I can, so if you find bugs please feel free to tell me thru my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/rpf4gr52Zg).

This modpack is also designed with simplicity and ease of maintenance in mind. While it includes a selection of visual and quality-of-life improvements, the primary focus remains on optimization. Feel free to add, remove or use as-is the modpack as you like, and thank you again for downloading!

---

## **Features**

---

### Performance Improvements
- **Sodium** (by CaffeineMC): Overhauls Minecraft's rendering engine, boosting frame rates and reducing stutter.
  - **Sodium Extras** (by FlashyReese): Adds more configuration options for Sodium.
  - **Reese's Sodium Options** (by FlashyReese): Enhances Sodium's settings menu with additional options.
- **Lithium** (by CaffeineMC): Optimizes game physics and AI for better performance.
- **Starlight** (by Spottedleaf): Replaces the light engine with a faster, optimized version.
- **FerriteCore** (by malte0811): Reduces memory usage to prevent out-of-memory crashes.
- **Modern Fix** (by ishland): Addresses performance issues in modern Minecraft versions.
- **Thread Tweak** (by someaddon): Improves multi-threading for smoother gameplay.
- **MoreCulling** (by fxmorin): Enhances rendering by optimizing entity and block culling.
- **VeryManyPlayers** (by motd): Boosts server performance, especially for large player counts.

### Visual and Audio Enhancements
- **3D Skin Layers** (by tr7zw): Adds depth to player skins, making characters look more dynamic.
- **AmbientSounds** (by CreativeMD): Introduces ambient sounds to create a more immersive atmosphere.
- **Sound Physics** (by SonicEther): Improves sound propagation for a realistic audio experience.
- **Animation mods**: A set of animation mods chosen to improve the looks and the movement of your character and the mobs around you

---

## **QoL Improvements**

- **Bad Optimizations** (by fundryi): Provides performance tweaks that may reduce visual quality for better performance.
- **Better Mount HUD** (by Motschen): Improves HUD for mounts with more detailed information.
- **Camera Utils** (by iamkron): Adds camera utilities for better control and screenshots.
- **Continuity** (by Pepper_Bell): Ensures connected textures work seamlessly with resource packs.
- **Drippy Loading Screen** (by shedaniel) (may be removed): Adds a custom loading screen.
- **Do a Barrel Roll** (by threezach): Allows players to perform camera rolls.
- **Enhanced Block Entities** (by FoundationGames): Optimizes block entity rendering to reduce lag.
- **Essential** (by Sk1erLLC): Adds essential multiplayer features and enhancements.
- **LambDynamicLights** (by LambdAurora): Adds dynamic lighting where light sources illuminate the surroundings.
- **MidnightControls** (by TeamMidnightDust): Improves control customization, including controller support.
- **Mod Menu** (by Prospector): Adds a mod menu for easier mod management.
- **No Chat Reports** (by Aizistral): Disables the chat reporting feature for a safer chat experience.

---
## **Before Downloading know that:**

While this modpack aims to improve performance, results may vary depending on your hardware, settings and configuration. You can also add mods such as [Nvidium](https://modrinth.com/mod/nvidium) for having an extra performance on nvidia cards.

title: VanillaVibes+
description: A Vanilla+ experience blending quality-of-life enhancements, immersive features, and vanilla-style additions for a perfect balance of simplicity and sophistication
body:
**Embark on a redefined Minecraft adventure with VanillaVibes+, meticulously crafted to elevate every aspect of your gameplay. Immerse yourself in a Vanilla+ experience that seamlessly integrates quality-of-life enhancements, immersive features, and a diverse array of decorative, culinary, and vanilla-style technology additions.**

Delight in the aesthetic beauty brought by carefully chosen decorative elements, allowing you to personalize your world with style. Dive into the culinary delights of the game, with new recipes and food options that add a flavorful touch to your survival journey. Embrace the subtle technologies introduced, providing enhanced convenience without straying from the classic Minecraft feel.

Discover a world where quality meets playability, where each addition is thoughtfully curated to enhance your enjoyment without overwhelming the core experience. VanillaVibes+ invites you to explore the perfect balance between tradition and innovation, ensuring that every improvement feels like a natural extension of the beloved Minecraft universe.

## Additions

### Culinary

**Indulge in a culinary adventure like never before with our modpack's extensive additions to the world of food and beverages.**

- Unleash your inner vintner with a new crafting system for wine, offering multiple variants that affect you differently.
- Satisfy your sweet cravings with new food items like bread, cupcakes, cakes, and tarts.
- Experiment with new crafting stations—glazing, baking, and caking—and enjoy new effects that enhance your gameplay.
- Cook with potions to infuse your meals with special effects.
- Embrace the culinary delights of cheese with a dedicated crafting system and explore a fully overhauled meadow biome with new animal breeds, wool, carpets, and beds.
- Venture to the beach biome with palm trees, sea stars, and sand waves.
- Craft with palm wood and decorate with beach-themed blocks like deck chairs, lounge chairs, and tiki bars.
- Savor the summer vibes with ice cream, popsicles, and cocktails, and encounter new beach-dwelling creatures like pelicans.
- Experience the charm of tea time with Herbal Brews, introducing lavender tea, black tea, green tea, coffee, and potions.
- Unwind with a variety of vials offering long-lasting strengthening effects.

### Decorative

**Transform your Minecraft world into a haven of style and functionality with our modpack's extensive decorative features.**

- Enhance your architectural aesthetics with shutters for windows, terracotta amphoras, book piles that power enchanting tables, and cozy woolen sofas.
- Create vibrant outdoor spaces with hanging pots, book stacks, blinds, picture frames, and climbing ropes.
- Illuminate your surroundings with bamboo lanterns, candelabras, glow essence jars, and light bulbs.
- Introduce clutter to your world with lattices for plants on walls and ceilings, offering a 'vanilla-ish' feel.
- Explore fun gameplay mechanics like new potion effects, such as Vulnerability, and variations of the Elytra, like Butterfly Elytras.
- Unlock a treasure trove of over 1,000 pieces of functional and visually appealing furniture, crafted with attention to detail.
- Enjoy compatibility with other mods like Sandwichable, REI, JEI, EMI, Patchouli, and Farmer's Delight.

### Immersive

**Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of Minecraft with our modpack's meticulously crafted immersion features.**

- Rediscover the game with enhanced third-person animations, adding a layer of realism to the way your character interacts with the world.
- Experience a more atmospheric Minecraft with improved in-game models, allowing for better animations and subtle effects that simulate physics and bring the game to life.
- Engage your senses with immersive audio enhancements, including water pop sounds for droplets landing, sizzle sounds for lava drops, and biome-specific environment sounds that evolve with the time of day.
- Delve into the depths of the earth with cave sounds intensifying as you mine deeper, only to fade away as you illuminate the area.
- Traverse villages accompanied by general activity sounds during the day, creating a dynamic and lively atmosphere.
- Experience the world like never before with realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks.
- Watch as your surroundings come alive with new particles, from crystal sparkles and custom blob particles for slimes to environmental particles that add depth to your Minecraft adventure.
- Feel the realism beneath your feet as you walk on different surfaces, each block contributing to the immersive soundscape.

## More

This modpack also adds several features to make Minecraft more friendly. Specially graves to make death less devastating in some situations. It also includes Iris along with the Complementary shaders and several performance mods which should allow this modpack to run with a wide variety of graphics settings while still working on most machines.

title: PrefixPro
description: Add luckperms prefixes everywhere
body:
# PrefixPro

PrefixPro is a powerful and lightweight Minecraft plugin that seamlessly integrates with LuckPerms to manage and display player prefixes. With extensive customization options and an advanced AFK system, it enhances your server's visual appearance and player interaction.

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Core Features
- **LuckPerms Integration:** Automatically displays prefixes from LuckPerms in:
  - Tab list
  - Chat
  - Above-head nametags
- **Real-time Updates:** Instantly applies prefix changes when modified in LuckPerms
- **Configurable Display:** Toggle prefix visibility individually for tab, chat, and nametags

### 🛡️ AFK System
- **Auto-AFK:** Automatically marks players as AFK after 5 minutes (configurable)
- **Disable AFK:** Sneak to get out of afk.
- **AFK Command:** `/afk` to manually toggle AFK status
- **Protection:** AFK players receive god mode and can't be pushed
- **Visual Indicator:** Customizable AFK suffix shows other players who is AFK
- **AFK Message:** A big title on your screen will tell you you are afk.

### ⚙️ Administration
- **Easy Configuration:** Simple config.yml with detailed comments
- **Live Reloading:** Update settings without server restart
  - `/prefixpro config reload` - Reload configuration
  - `/prefixpro plugin reload` - Reload entire plugin
- **Customizable Messages:** Configure all plugin messages with color support

## 🔧 Permissions
- `prefixpro.admin` - Access to admin commands
- `prefixpro.afk` - Access to AFK features
- `prefixpro.version` - Receive update notifications on join

## 📋 Commands
- `/afk` - Toggle AFK status
- `/prefixpro <config|plugin> reload` - Reload configuration or plugin

## 📦 Dependencies
- [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/) - Required for prefix management

## ⚡ Performance
- Lightweight and optimized
- No database required
- Minimal resource usage

## 🔍 Configuration

```
# PrefixPro Configuration
config-version: 3

# Display Settings
display:
  tab: true
  chat: true
  nametag: true

# Message Settings
messages:
  prefix: "&8[&6PrefixPro&8] &7"
  join-leave-message:
    enabled: true

# AFK Settings
afk:
  # Time in seconds before auto-AFK (300 = 5 minutes)
  auto-time: 300
  # Suffix that appears when AFK
  suffix: " &7[AFK]"
  # Enable auto-AFK feature
  auto-enabled: true

```


## 🎯 Coming Soon
- Multi-language support
- Placeholder API integration
- Custom prefix commands
- And more!

## 💬 Support
Need help? Found a bug? Have a suggestion? Feel free to:
- Open an issue on our [Github](https://github.com/SamVolvo/PrefixPro) repository
- Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/BejfuCsSUB) community

Enhance your server's appearance and player interaction with PrefixPro - the complete prefix management solution!

# Overview:

This plugin adds a God Trident to your server which has many powerful abilities. The Trident could be a fun event item or a race to the mace style start to your server.

## Setting the plugin up:

This is very simple all you need to do is to drag the .jar file into the plugins folder of your 1.21.11+ server.

title: Bigger Industrialisation
description: Synthesise rocks. Drill oil. Turn them into circuits. Industrialise the world.
body:
# Bigger Industrialisation

**[MAKE SURE TO READ THE EXTENSIVE DOCUMENTATION!!!](https://bigger-industrialisation.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)**

This is a Minecraft modpack based around [GregTech CEu Modern](https://modrinth.com/mod/gregtechceu-modern).
The current skeleton of content is implemented up to the beginning of
the Insane Voltage tier. Please read this whole README.

[Join the server](https://discord.gg/ehgHyScMVx) for
questions/support/etc. Please report bugs in the issue tab, not in the
linked server!

## Philosophy

Bigger Industrialisation is about building a
large factory to create ever-advancing alloys and circuitry. If you\'ve
ever played Factorio; or even better, a Factorio overhaul mod like Bobs
& Angel\'s Mods; it\'s a lot like that, only 3D and more in depth.

Notable features:

-   An accelerated earlygame compared to most GregTech packs
-   Mandatory peaceful mode - minimal survival, minimal noise, only
    industry.
-   Semi-realistic chemical chains with lots of steps, intermediates,
    byproducts, and research gone into them
-   A bunch of custom multiblocks! Who doesn\'t love multiblocks!
-   Designed for both newcomers to GregTech and Nomifactory fans.
-   Doesn\'t include a single proprietary mod.

### A Note on Realism

The chemical chains in this pack are *inspired* by real-world processes,
but are not truly *realistic*. A lot of things have been abstracted
away, such as substance dilution or the tricky parts of industrial vs
labratory methods.

In addition, most of the chemistry is heavily simplified until the HV
tier, in order to accelerate you into the actually fun part of an
automation pack instead of getting RSI working over a crafting table.
There\'s no holds barred from late HV onwards. If you\'ve ever gotten to
Blue Science in Factorio, it\'s like that.

### A Note on Completion

The current content is complete up to the very beginning of the Insane
Voltage tier. Content after that may be incoherent, dissonant, or
straight-up unplayable.

## Included Mods

This pack includes a small number of mods directly in the pack, rather
than being fetched by Kamuidrome, for various reasons. These are:

-   [We No Speak
    Umbrellarino](https://modrinth.com/mod/wenospeakumbrellarino),
    because the 1.20 ported version (made by yours truly) isn\'t
    uploaded to Modrinth. MIT licensed.
-   [Tool Belt](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tool-belt),
    which isn\'t available on Modrinth. BSD 3-Clause.

## Credits

Special shoutouts to:

- All my friends who listened to me go insane as I taught myself (organic) chemistry
- One special friend who kept trying to convince me to take a break and who I repeatedly ignored

title: Quick Commands
description: Command aliases that work. Add them while playing and use them immediately.
body:
Create command aliases and run them easily with `Quick Commands` key (`.` by
default). Handles suggestions and usable entirely through chat commands (i.e.
it doesn't have gui).

## Usage

`Quick Commands` key (`.` by default) opens chat window with
`/quickcommands run ` already typed in. Keybinding changeable in
`Options -> Controls -> Key Binds -> Multiplayer`.

Avialable commands:
1. `/quickcommands add [alias] [command]` - registers new alias,
2. `/quickcommands remove [alias]` - removes an alias,
3. `/quickcommands run [alias]` - executes command associated with an alias,
4. `/quickcommands list` - lists available commands,
5. `/quickcommands clear` - removes all aliases.

All commands have suggestions to make them easier to use.

title: Litematica Printer Addon
description: A Forge port of the Forgematica Printer mod, bringing automatic block placement functionality to older Minecraft versions for faster schematic building.
body:
# Litematica Printer Addon

An **unofficial** backport of the [Forgematica Printer](https://github.com/ThinkingStudios/ForgematicaPrinter) mod to **Minecraft Forge 1.16.5 & 1.18.2**.
This project is an independent adaptation derived from the open-source work by ThinkingStudios. It is **not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by** the original authors of Litematica or Forgematica Printer.

This addon extends **Forgematica** by adding automated “printing” functionality—allowing players to construct large schematics more efficiently by automatically placing correct blocks around the player.
Because this version targets Forge 1.18.2, it required extensive adjustments to **rendering logic, mixins, and Forge APIs** to function correctly in this older environment.
It is **not a direct repost**, but a **custom reimplementation** for compatibility with the 1.18.2 ecosystem.

![Printer Demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mdembree218/forgematica-printer-1.16.5/refs/heads/master/printer_demo.gif)

---

## How to Use

* **Toggle Printer:** Press `CAPS_LOCK` (default) to enable or disable the printer.
* **Quick Print:** Hold `V` (default) to print temporarily, regardless of toggle state.
* **Configure Settings:** Open Forgematica’s settings with `M + C`, then navigate to the **Generic** tab.
  Printer options—such as **printing speed** and **range**—are located at the bottom.
  You can also rebind the toggle key under the **Hotkeys** tab.

---

## Reporting Issues

Please **do not contact** *maruohon* (the creator of Litematica) or the authors of the original Forgematica Printer regarding issues with this fork.
All bug reports, feature requests, and feedback for this version should be submitted via the [GitHub Issues page](https://github.com/mdembree218/forgematica-printer-1.16.5/issues).

Before creating an issue, ensure you are running the **latest version** of this mod. When reporting bugs, please include:

* Minecraft version
* Forgematica version
* Printer version
* Detailed steps to reproduce
* Any relevant logs, screenshots, or **problematic schematics**

---

## Known Issues

Some features are still incomplete or nonfunctional in this version:

* Placing liquids (printing **in** liquids works)
* Printing without support directly in air (`printInAir`)
* Rail placement algorithm occasionally fails to handle complex layouts safely
* “Legit mode” (anticheat-friendly printing) not implemented

Note: Features such as **automatic excavation** or **auto-correction of misplaced blocks** are intentionally **out of scope** for this project.

title: HexBoard

body:
# Hex Board

[Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/hexboard) | [Github](https://github.com/yggdyy/hexboard)  

Hex Board is an addon for Hex Casting (Minecraft 1.20.1) that introduces an in-world board workflow for composing and editing hex patterns.

In short, this mod adds:

- A connectable `Board` block system for slot-based pattern organization.
- Multiple `Type Block` items (Quartz, Wool, Lapis, Redstone) for storing different iota data.
- A `Staff For Board` with dedicated edit modes (add, delete, move, copy, resolve, literal resolve, load).
- Five board-operation patterns (`load`, `delete`, `move`, `resolve`, `literal_resolve`) for direct spell-side board manipulation.
- Patchouli integration for in-book navigation and pattern-assisted placement.

# Modern chunk detector
This mod is a tool that can be used on server that updated their version from a really old version like 1.12 to a more recent one like 1.20. This mod will display a pink overlay on new chunks similar to the chunk border debug option (F3+G).
## How to use it
You can toogle the visibility ON/OFF using the keybind (default is O) that can be changed in settings>controls>keybinds

This mod looks in the ground to find if there is copper or ancient debris and if so marks the chunk as new. This means that if there is an anticheat like anti-x-ray the mod will probably get a ton of false positive.

title: Datamosh
description: MPEG-style datamosh compression artifacts.
body:
[![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1321365/description_19767e94-ef82-4569-92c6-b1e8b60e6e07.png)](https://discord.gg/XgH4EpyPD2)

> *Digital compression errors woven into the world.*

Datamosh is a post-processing shader that recreates the visual artifacts associated with corrupted MPEG-style video compression. Instead of traditional visual enhancement, the shader deliberately introduces macroblock displacement, color quantization, chroma reconstruction errors, and edge artifacts to emulate the appearance of damaged or mispredicted P-frames. The result is a constantly shifting image where sections of the scene appear to borrow data from the wrong locations, producing a convincing datamosh-inspired aesthetic during gameplay.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eec1e3cd344f3b586d10035b57e916141f24a653_0.webp)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a8fbcf9ee8e2f79b8b02e73b8431b11a87e0705_0.webp)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87b7d49f6e58d601da59c23af75ce0a4f7399151_0.webp)

---

### ✨ Highlights

**Macroblock Motion Corruption.**
The image is divided into 8×8 pixel macroblocks. Each block periodically generates its own motion behavior and samples pixels from offset locations rather than its original position. Most blocks remain stable, while others drift or suddenly jump across the frame, reproducing the characteristic block displacement seen in damaged compressed video streams.

**Asynchronous Block Updates.**
Each macroblock updates on its own timing interval rather than following a uniform pattern. This prevents the effect from appearing synchronized and creates the impression of independent compression errors spreading through the image over time.

**Datamosh-Style Frame Smearing.**
When a block shifts, it continues to reconstruct its contents using pixel positions from the displaced source region. This preserves the structure of the macroblock while pulling visual information from elsewhere in the frame, creating the smeared and fragmented appearance associated with motion-vector corruption.

**DCT Edge Ringing Simulation.**
Additional brightness variation is applied near macroblock boundaries to mimic ringing artifacts commonly produced by discrete cosine transform compression. These subtle bright and dark fringes help reinforce the illusion of heavily compressed video.

**Adaptive Color Quantization.**
Color values are reduced to a limited number of levels on a per-block basis. Blocks experiencing stronger displacement receive heavier quantization, producing visible banding and compression breakup similar to low-bitrate MPEG footage.

**Chroma Subsampling Artifacts.**
Color information is reconstructed at a lower effective resolution by sampling chroma from neighboring pixels while preserving local luminance. This reproduces the color bleeding and misalignment often associated with 4:2:0 video compression.

**Mosquito Noise Around Edges.**
High-frequency noise is introduced around areas of contrast, imitating the shimmering edge artifacts that appear after aggressive video compression. The effect is strongest around detailed image features and moving regions.

---

### ⚙️ Compatibility

* Implemented as a composite post-processing pass.
* Uses GLSL 1.20 shaders.
* Operates entirely on the rendered image (`colortex0`) rather than modifying lighting, materials, shadows, or world rendering.
* No custom buffers, lighting systems, or advanced rendering pipelines are present in the project.
* Designed as a visual-effect shader focused on compression artifacts and datamosh simulation.

title: SCP: Modern
description: Enter a modern world inspired by the SCP universe where exploration, survival, and mysterious encounters change the way you play Minecraft.
body:
![tu?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ff20721406c0574c63835bb8e8d3a0785a8ca55.png)

# SCP Modern

**SCP Modern** is an interactive Minecraft Java mod currently in beta that immerses players in a modern environment inspired by the SCP universe. In this mod, you will encounter hostile and friendly SCP entities, advanced technology, security systems, and unique mechanics that significantly change the way Minecraft is played.

This mod focuses on **quality over quantity**, featuring complex systems, clean implementations, and exceptional optimization so it can run on all types of computers without requiring large modpacks or complicated setups.

---

# Main Features

## Security Camera System
One of the main systems in the mod is the security system. A lot of time has been invested into creating a clean, functional, and expandable system.

The system currently includes:
- Functional security cameras  
- Monitors to view cameras in real time  
- Disks that record and store camera data  
- A system prepared for future security expansions  

This system will continue to expand in future updates.

---

## Rank System
The mod includes a rank system based on progression through missions.  
This system is designed to be **scalable**, allowing players to unlock access to new areas, systems, tools, and content within the facility.

This system is still in development during the beta, but it will become one of the core systems of the mod in the future.

---

## Modern Blocks and Decoration
The mod also adds:
- Modern decorative blocks  
- Technological equipment  
- Furniture  
- Laboratory objects  
- SCP facility decorations  
- Blocks for building modern bases and installations  
Everything is designed with a modern, clean, and detailed visual style.

---

## Optimization
One of the most important goals of **SCP Modern** is optimization.  
The mod is designed to:
- Use low resources
- Run on low-end computers
- Not require large modpacks
- Maintain complex systems without affecting performance

Our goal is for any player to enjoy the mod without performance issues.

---

# Mod Status
The mod is currently in **Beta**, which means:
- Some systems are incomplete
- More SCPs will be added
- More technological systems will be added
- More blocks and mechanics will be added
- There may be major changes in future versions

---

# Extra / Future Plans
Additional information about the future of the mod and related projects:

Planned features for the future:
- Advanced NPC systems
- More complex mission system
- Complementary maps
- Mod expansions
- Possible premium content such as maps or special add-ons

However, the main mod **will always have content accessible for all players**, and not everything will be paid content. Regular players will also have access to important and unique features.

A large part of the development has been done independently, so some updates may take time, but we always prioritize **quality, optimization, and well-built systems**.

---

# Summary
**SCP Modern is not just an SCP mod, it is a mod about systems, technology, security, and building modern facilities inside Minecraft.**

title: Primordial Harvest
description: Unearth the forgotten bounty of a bygone era.
body:
Primordial harvest invites you to unearth the forgotten bounty of a bygone era, one when ancient flora thrived! With the help of a Sniffer you can revive these long lost crops. Cultivate these rare plants, each with unique traits and properties, to transform your farm into a living relic!

## Crops

### Spireshuck
This odd crop sprouts thick spiraling vines that block mobs other than the player from passing through. The aroma of a fruiting spireshuck plant weakens and repels some undead mobs like zombies and skeletons. The vines produce a large kernel-like accessory fruit. The fruit has a metallic taste and eating one will temporarily sap your strength. It will also ward off the effects of insomnia, including phatom attacks! The fruit can also be brewed into a potion of weakness. The seeds can also be used to craft pink dye.

### Rumblepea
The rumblepea is a temperamental crop that must be handled with care. Its delicate root system attracts bacteria that can boost nearby crop growth. The rumblepea produces a highly explosive substance that it uses to deter predators and trampling. While the fruit of the rumblepea lacks a distinct flavour, it has a feint smell of rotten eggs when freshly picked. Eating the fruit will release a gust of steam that can toggle some nearby blocks like redstone components. The seeds can also be used to craft gunpowder.

### Paleogourd
The paleogourd sprouts thick roots that stabilize nearby soil preventing trampling and erosion. The largest specimens create vast root networks, securing soil up to 5 blocks away! While the fruit is safe to eat, it has a grainy texture and tastes very salty. It is better used to brew the portion of fortitude which reduces damage taken by 20%! The seeds can also be used to craft brown dye.

## Inspirations
This mod was created for EC's ModJam in 2025. The theme of this jam was synergy which was used as the basis for this mod. I knew I wanted to do something with plants for the jam and remembered "The Three Sisters". This is a companion planting technique where corn (spireshuck), climbing beans (rumblepea), and squash (paleogourd) are planted together. The cornstalks provide a trellis for the beans to climb while the beans fix nitrogen into the soil and the squash covers the ground with its leaves preventing weeds from taking hold. This set of crops is also based on the "Three Primes" of alchemy where each crop is visually and mechanically based on a different prime. The rumblepea incorporates sulfur which represents soul and combustibility. The spireshuck represents spirit and volatility. The paleogourd represents the body and non-volatility.

## Future Plans
In the future I plan to add several new plants that continue the theme of alchemical inspiration, likely drawing from the seven planetary metals. I would also like to spend more time improving the textures for the mod, or perhaps find an artist to work with me on them. While I really like the work on some of the textures like the spreading roots of the paleogourd, other textures like the seeds and fruit feel a bit flat and are definetly programmer art.
