title: Hunger Overhaul Reborn
description: A Revival of the Hunger Overhaul mod.
body:
Hunger Overhaul Reborn is a survival rebalance mod focused on hunger, food, crops, tools, and animals.  

> **Alpha Notice**  
> This mod is in early alpha and has only been minimally tested. Bugs are guaranteed—please report them if you find any.  
> This is my first published mod since the old META-INF days!  

---

## Features

- **passive hunger use**
- **Food fully rebalanced** with Well Fed and Hungry status effects.
- - **Stackable container foods** - Bowl foods, honey bottles, and milk buckets now stack (configurable stack sizes)
- **Difficulty-based crop growth** - Growth rates scale with world difficulty:
  - Peaceful: 100% (full vanilla speed)
  - Easy: 67% of vanilla speed
  - Normal: 50% of vanilla speed  
  - Hard: 34% of vanilla speed
- **Crops**
  - **Serene Seasons integration** - Respects seasonal fertility and growth rates
  - Grows only in daylight.  
  - Right-click harvest automatically replants.  
  - Breaking crops drops only planted seeds.  
- **Hoes**
  - Dirt near water tills normally.  
  - Grass without water converts to dirt with a 20% chance to drop seeds.  
  - Tall grass no longer drops seeds.  
- **Bone meal scaling** – success chance depends on difficulty.
- **Animals** – breeding and growth are slower.
- **Hunger** if you run out of hunger, you die.

### I may be missing features from the original, I'm open to being told I've missed something
---

## Disclaimer

**Inspired by the original [Hunger Overhaul](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/hunger-overhaul)** by *iguanaman*, later maintained by *ProgWML6, Parker8283, squeek502,* and *Alexbegt*.  

This is a **from-scratch re-implementation** with completely original code and **no affiliation** with the original creators.

title: BuildAI
description: Allows Large Language Models (AI) to build structures
body:
# BuildAI

## Functionality
BuildAI is a creative mode utility that allows various Large Language Models to build structures ingame. This plugin is meant just for fun, **AI models are generally not advanced enough to build anything good**.
## Setup

After installing the plugin on your server and starting the server, a config.yml file will be created in the  
`plugins/BuildAI` directory. At the bottom of this file, you can configure the provider you want to use. You should be able to add all common providers like OpenAI or Anthropic (both not tested!), but if you are running the server on your PC I suggest [Ollama](https://ollama.com/), as it allows you to run LLMs locally for free.
## Usage

As an operator, you can use the command:  
`/aigenerate {model_preset} {x1} {y1} {z1} {x2} {y2} {z2} {somevar=somevalue} {prompt}`. You can make a selection using a wooden shovel and use the command:   
`/aigenerate {model_preset} {somevar=somevalue} {prompt}`. The variables ("somevar") can be configured in the config.
## Security

Most providers require an API key to access their models. Safeguarding this key is crucial, as anyone with access to it can use the model without your consent. This plugin offers two primary methods for storing API keys:
1. **Storing the key in the `config.yml` file:**  
   While this method prevents players from viewing the key directly, you should carefully consider who has access to the configuration file. Additionally, note that the associated command lacks spam protection, so ensure that only trusted individuals can execute it.
2. **Using `%api-key%` in the configuration and allowing players to input their own key:**  
   It is essential to understand that anyone with terminal access can view the API key. For players, it is strongly discouraged to input your API key unless you own the server.

## Verisons

BuildAI was developed with [Paper](https://papermc.io/downloads/paper) 1.20.1 and is primarly tested with this version. It should be able to run on all bukkit based softwares in all versions after 1.13.
## Official links
- Modrinth: [https://modrinth.com/project/buildai](https://modrinth.com/project/buildai)
- Source: [https://github.com/KEL0002/BuildAI](https://github.com/KEL0002/BuildAI)

title: PokeDetails for Cobblemon
description: A client side mod that adds two commands to check basic details of the pokemon, eg the biomes, dex no, conditions for spawn, etc.
body:
# PokeDetails Fabric Mod

**PokeDetails** is a Client Side Fabric mod that enhances your Pokémon gameplay experience by providing detailed information about various Pokémon directly in-game. With just a simple command, you can retrieve essential details about any Pokémon in the game, helping you strategize and plan your gameplay better.

## Features

PokeDetails offers two primary commands to access Pokémon information:

### `/pokedetails`
The main command that serves as the entry point to access Pokémon information. This command has two subcommands:

1. **/pokedetails dexno [1-999]**  
   Retrieve information about a Pokémon by its Dex Number.

2. **/pokedetails name [mon name]**  
   Retrieve information about a Pokémon by its name.

## Information Retrieved

When you use the PokeDetails commands, the following information is retrieved:

- **Dex No.**: The Pokémon's National Dex number.
- **Pokémon Levels**: The range of levels at which the Pokémon can be found.
- **Rarity**: How rare the Pokémon is in the wild.
- **Context**: Additional contextual information about the Pokémon.
- **Preset**: Any preset conditions associated with finding the Pokémon.
- **Biome**: The biome(s) where the Pokémon can be encountered.
- **Time**: The time of day when the Pokémon is most commonly found.
- **Weather**: The weather conditions that favor the appearance of the Pokémon.
- **Sky**: The type of sky conditions that are ideal for encountering the Pokémon.
- **Conditions**: Any additional conditions required to find the Pokémon.

## Commands Overview

### `/pokedetails dexno [1-999]`

This command allows you to retrieve Pokémon details using their Dex Number. Simply input the Dex Number, and you'll receive a detailed breakdown of all relevant information.

**Example Usage**:
```bash
/pokedetails dexno 25
```
This would return the details for Pikachu.

### `/pokedetails name [mon name]`

This command lets you find Pokémon details by their name. Just type the name of the Pokémon, and the mod will fetch all the related information.

**Example Usage**:
```bash
/pokedetails name Pikachu
```
This would return the details for Pikachu.

## Installation
To install PokeDetails, follow these steps:

- Download the PokeDetails mod file.
- Place the mod file in your Minecraft mods folder.
- Launch Minecraft with Fabric loader.
- Use the /pokedetails command in-game to start retrieving Pokémon information.

title: Not Too Expensive
description: Removes the XP cost penalty that accumulates when you repair/enchant an item with an anvil multiple times.
body:
This data pack removes the "repair_cost" component from all items in the player's inventory while they're at an Anvil.

This pack works by tagging a player whenever they open the Anvil UI and running an item modifier on all of their inventory slots every tick. When the player moves away from the Anvil, they become untagged and their inventory stops being processed. This is to prevent functions from being called constantly when it's not necessary.

This pack is made for the as-of-yet unreleased 1.20.5 version of the game. You must play with version 24w10a or later for this pack to work.

title: Vanilla Unlocked Together
description: Unlock Minecraft's TRUE potential and experience Vanilla in a brand new way! And with crossplay between ALL platforms!
body:
### Bedrock Edition compat is currently broken again due to the new release of Chaos Cubed. It'll take some time to fix. Please be patient as this upgrade to the pack will be the largest one I've had to do so far. You can keep up with progress in the Discord linked below #

What is Vanilla Unlocked Together #### Ever wanted to play Minecraft with your friends, but they don't have Java Edition? Vanilla Unlocked Together is a modpack designed to allow Bedrock and Java players to play together on the same server, and enjoy the best mods Minecraft has to offer. Like the name suggests, you can play together, **_crossplay_**! ## Play with your friends across all platforms! - Java 🖥️ - Windows 10 💻 - Playstation 🎮 - Xbox ❎ - Mobile 📱 - Switch 🍄 ## Experience Java Mods on Bedrock! - Beautiful biomes 🌎 - More structures 🏰 - Improvements to the Nether AND the End 🌌 (WIP) - Advancements/Achievements that reward you (you actually get items!) 🏆 #### All of this is balanced and designed around keeping the original Minecraft "feel", while surprising you and keeping you excited for what you'll find next ### Java players using this modpack to play with their Bedrock buddies get some perks too - Client-side Optimizations ⚡ - Environment/Atmosphere Enhancements 🌿 - Improved Animations 🏃 - Shaders 🕯️ - UI Improvements 🎨 - In-game Voice Chat 🎤 ~~_Significant upgrades to the Java client-side experience will be coming over the next few weeks_~~ done ✅ ##

What can I do in Vanilla Unlocked Together? ### Explore! Exploration is key in this modpack. You will be rewarded greatly for going out and exploring all the new biomes and structures. ### Collect! Acheivements in this modpack often give some sort of reward for completing them. Things like XP, unique trophies to hang on the wall, or even rare items to help you along your journey! ### Fight! (temporarily disabled for balancing reasons. They were far too easy to kill for the broken loot they dropped) Rare mobs have a chance to spawn "powered up". The higher tier they are, the better loot they will drop. They even might drop enchantments at higher level than is usually obtainable! (Think Unbreaking IV) ##

Hosting a server

#### If you want a simple, fast, and affordable server check out [BisectHosting](https://proxivirus.github.io/VanillaUnlockedTogether/). Within a few clicks you and all you friends can be playing together, regardless of platform! If you enter promo code **PROXI** at checkout, you'll get 25% off. You can try it for a month, and if for some reason you don't like it, you can cancel the renewal with no penalties or fees. #### Or, if you're a bit tech-savvy, you have a good computer, and you're looking to selfhost a server for you and your friends, you can get some help from me by joining the Discord server! Speaking of... ##

Join the Discord server!

If you're having issues with something or have a suggestion to make, the Discord server is a great place to do it! You can also share your Minecraft build screenshots, send your best memes, talk with the community, and keep up to date with the latest and greatest information about what I'm working on for Minecraft.
Old Disclaimer ### Disclaimer: This pack is very much in its early stages. Features are extremely subject to change. I'm going to be actively playing it over the next few weeks with a group of playtesters. Their feedback, as well as my own thoughts on the gameplay, will effect the most immediate changes and improvements that will be implemented. TLDR: Things may be removed from the pack. Stuff probably won't break when updating, but if it does, I'll do my best to note it in the changelogs and in my Discord server.
### Known Issues:
Spoiler - The world generation can look a bit wacky sometimes. It comes with the territory of having several things that add new structures and biomes. It will improve over time, but it will always be an ongoing project to streamline it. - When using Actions&Stuff resource pack on Bedrock Edition, some mob head blocks will be animated. - On Java Edition, some entities like armor stands don't have lighting applied to them - When joining a server on Java Edition, occasionally you may get a message saying "_Internal Exception: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "net.minecraft.class_11980.method_744470" because "$$2" is null_". You can ignore it and just try to join the server again. I'll get around to fixing this soon. There's currently more important things to fix. - ~~Some enchantments that are only supposed to be obtained by killing the Ender Dragon can be obtained from general chest loot. This will be hard/time consuming to fix as I have to track down which structures don't filter their loot tables properly~~ Fixed as far as i can tell - Occasionally on Java Edition seemingly random blocks will not display until rerendered. - When leaving a singleplayer world you just created on Java Edition you won't be able to see your world in the worlds list until you restart the game - Unplugging your mic can crash your game - Cliff under a Tree (CliffTree) disables world types (including superflat) - If you disconnect from a server while riding a Happy Ghast, your player data may become corrupted. To fix this, edit the player NBT and delete the Happy Ghast. - When editing an existing world in the singleplayer worldlist, clicking save will cause the game to crash and complain about "Lock no longer valid"
### Backstory about this pack:
Spoiler _I've actually been working on a pack for quite some time now called Vanilla Unlocked, which was designed for 1.21.4 Java only. A large modpack with hundreds of mods and lots of custom intercompatibility. But I've been working on it for over 6 months now as getting it to the quality I feel comfortable releasing is extremely time consuming. Having hundreds of mods work well together requires extensive programming making custom mods and datapacks. There is also a lot of research that I've put into making the pack run well, even on lower-end computers. Minecraft really slows down when many things are added to world generation likenew biomes and structures. But my friends have been wanting to play Minecraft and some of them only have Bedrock edition. So I decided to take what I've learned after all these months and apply it to somewhat of an offshoot of the project, which is what you see here. Vanilla Unlocked Crossplay uses all the configuration I've worked on, everything I've learned about what can and cannot be done server-side, niche couple thousand download gems of mods of seen, my own mods I've written to improve the game, and so much more I can't even describe to make the best experience I possibly can. I worked on my last public modpack for about a year straight to make it the best possible experience, then I worked on Vanilla Unlocked for another 6 months as an improvement to that in every way. And now I'm taking all that hard work and putting it into this, with a commitment to keep it up-to-date and add new features as much as possible._

Players, dazzle yourself and others by having fancy particle trails whenever you go!

Server owners, offer a cosmetic perk to your most valuable players, or let everyone express themselves how they wish!

This plugin allows Minecraft players to have fancy particle trails wherever they go. The activated trails are stored in a database so that they can be active across multiple servers on a network.

There are currently **34 different trails** available, including new particles introduced up to 1.21!


# Installation
1. Download the plugin and place it in your plugins/ directory.
2. Start and stop the server to generate the configuration file.
3. Edit config.yml with your MySQL database information.
4. Start your version, set permissions and try out `/trail`!

# Configuration
`database.host`: Database host  
`database.port`: Database port  
`database.base`: Database name  
`database.username`: Database username  
`database.password`: Database password  

# Commands
`trail`: Used by authorized players to view the available trails (if no parameter specified), activate one (with the correct name) or turn them off (with the 'off' value).

# Permissions
`iotrails.enable`: Access to the /trail command.

# Why is this plugin reliable?
I use all of my plugins on my own servers, and I like my plugins to be stable, reliable and low maintenance. Breaks on version upgrades are not expected, but should they happen, they will be quickly fixed.

If you enjoy my work, I [welcome sponsors](https://www.interordi.com/sponsor.php)! title: All Block Variants
description: Fills in the gaps of vanilla Minecraft by adding (almost) all the missing block variants, from concrete stairs to dyed flower pots.
body:
# All Block Variants

Vanilla Minecraft has a lot of missing blocks. For example, minecraft has concrete blocks, and stair blocks, but no concrete stairs. All Block Variants' goal is to fill in all of these missing blocks, with blocks that have ther functionality and appearance as close to vanilla Minecraft as possible.

The goal of this mod is to add "all" the block variants, but currently the mod doesn't support all of them yet; so this mod's name is aspirational rather than the current state. So far, the mod adds 3,759 blocks and 3,232 items.

## Warnings

> This mod is currently in an "alpha" state. I am using it successfully on a private server with a couple of other people, but I have not exhaustively tested the mod's functionality either on it's own or in combination with other mods. You should make regular backups of any worlds you use this mod with.

> This mod adds an item with the same functionality as the Debug Stick, but makes that functionality available in Survival mode. I'm not sure if this functionality makes it easier to grief or not, but to be on the safe side, only used this mod on servers where you can trust all players.

## What does this mod do?

For each supported block (see below for a list), this mod adds the following variants:

* Fences
* Walls
* Stairs
* Slabs
* Thin Slabs (these are slabs that are half the height of regular slabs)
* Vertical Slabs (these are slabs that are vertical instead of horizontal)
* Thin Vertical Slabs (these are slabs that are vertical instead of horizontal, and half the width of regular slabs)
* Buttons
* Doors
* Trapdoors
* Fence Gates

The mod also adds:

* Dyed Wood (all dye colours)
* Dyed Logs (all dye colours)
* Dyed Stripped Logs (all dye colours)
* Dyed Planks (all dye colours)
* Dyed Signs (all dye colours)
* Dyed Flower Pots (all dye colours)

These block variants and dyed blocks follow vanilla functionality and visual design and texture as closely as possible.

Note that even though I am calling these "block variants" the variants are wholly new blocks themselves.

## Crafting the block variants and dyed blocks

### Mod stick

Because the recipes for some of these variants would conflict with vanilla Minecraft recipies, the recipes for these variants need an extra item in the crafting grid.

This extra item is the All Block Variants Mod Stick, which has the following recipe:

* 1 stick bottom center + 1 lapis lazuli on top of the stick (shaped) => 1 All Block Variants Mod Stick

This Mod Stick is not only used in the recipies, but also has the same functionality as the Debug Stick in Vanilla, with the added ability to use the functionality in Survival mode.

### Block variants

In general the recipe for each block variant is the normal recipe to create that variant + the mod stick.

For example, the recipe for Blue Concrete Stairs is:

```
# !
## 
###

where # = Blue Concrete, and ! = the Mod Stick
```

This shaped recipe will produce 4 Blue Concrete Stairs, mirroring the vanilla stairs recipes. The Mod Stick will also remain in the craftin grid for reuse.

You can also place a Blue Concrete in a Stonecutter, and you can select the Blue Concrete Stairs in the recipe grid to produce 1 Blue Concrete Stairs

So the recipe for any block variant is usually the same pattern as that variant + the mod stick. The mod stick goes in the bottom or top based on what makes sense for that recipe.

I will be adding recipe images in the near future to make this easier, as soon as I can generate them efficiently.

### Dyed blocks

The recipes for the dyed blocks are:

* 1 of the block you want to dye + 1 dye (shapeless) => 1 dyed block
* 1 of the block you want to dye + 1 dye + 1 All Block Variants Mod Stick (shapeless) => 1 dyed block, and the Mod Stick remains in the crafting grid for reuse
* 1 dye in the center + 8 of the block you want to dye surrounding it (shaped) => 8 dyed blocks

title: LPRank
description: A plugin based on the LuckPerms implementation of the ranking system
body:
# LPRank
LPRank is a ranking system plugin based on LuckPerms that allows you to set a custom rank for each player, while enabling other plugins to access the player's rank via the PlaceHolderAPI. Using this plugin requires the installation of the dependent plugin [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/)!

## Features
- **Lightweight**: Rank data is stored via LuckPerms metadata, the plugin itself does not have a folder for data storage
- **User-friendly**: You can set a player's rank directly by command, while other players who are not set will have a default rank (which can also be set)
- **Compatible**: The plugin is compatible with PlaceholderAPI, through which you can access rank

## Commands & Permissions
| Command                   | Permission                | Aliases                   | Description                  |
|---------------------------|---------------------------|---------------------------|------------------------------|
| /rank get [player]        | lprank.command.get        | -                         | Get a specific player rank   |
| /rank set <player> <rank> | lprank.command.set        | -                         | Set a specific player rank   |
| /rank reset <player>      | lprank.command.reset      | /rank [remove, toDefault] | Reset a specific player rank |
| /rank setDefault <player> | lprank.command.setDefault | -                         | Set the default rank         |

## Future Plans
- Add configs so that they can be displayed in chat or on the tab
- Add interface for better rank setting
- Add a rank up feature where players can upgrade their rank in a specific way

This mod adds a knight that occassionally spawns on the overworld during the day, or at least that's how it's supposed to be.

In order to tame him, you must give him iron ingots until he is satisfied. You can also technically heal him with them, but I wouldn't recommend that since it would be fairly expensive and he already heals passively, albeit slowly. 

Now, here is a list of things the knight can do:

- Knight attacks other tamed mobs if you hurt them, or if they hurt him

title: ijo pona poki (AE2Things rewrite)
description: Complete rewrite of the mod AE2Things, a port of ae2stuff. Uses *Quilt*.
body:
# ijo-pona-poki 

![preview.png](https://github.com/Mg138/ijo-pona-poki/blob/main/preview.png?raw=true)



Complete rewrite of the mod `AE2Things`, a port of `ae2stuff`.

Uses **Quilt**.

There may be new features, or not.

## Why a rewrite?

We wanted it to work with `1.19.2`, but then we realized it barely worked anyway, and the code was insufferable.

No offense, we wanted to contribute back to the codebase, too.

## What the heck even is this name

The name is in [Toki Pona](https://tokipona.org/).

The reason for this is that we couldn't find a name similar to `AE2Things` or `ae2stuff`, the only words left are like, `thingies` or `shit` and we'd rather not call it `ae2shit`.

So we asked a person who knows of `Toki Pona` about naming, they told me a bit about how `Toki Pona` grammar works, and we ended up with `ijo pona poki`.

- `ijo ` - thing
- `pona` - good
- `poki` - container/box/storage

So, quite literally, "thing good storage," or good things about storage.

## Differences and Contents

### Cut Content

- The bigger cells.
  * We don't see a reason to add them,
    some of them already overlap with the new AE2's introduction of 256k cells,
    and then there are many other mods adding bigger ones. 

### Crystal Growth Chamber

Now acts as an easy one-block solution of growing Certus Quartz.

However, there are some caveats.

### ~~Fortune Upgrades~~

~~An upgrade for the Crystal Growth Chamber, improves yields, but increases resource usage.~~

Might work on this in the future.

### Advanced Inscriber

Literally: Inscriber that holds a stack instead of a single item, and has more slots for acceleration cards.

Also inserts the output to the ME System directly; this is an ae2things feature that we simply copied over -- not sure whether to keep it or not.

### DISK - "Deep Item Storage disK"

We're not sure how the original was designed, but here's the specification of a DISK:

- Only items allowed.
  * (obviously)
- No types, you can store all items equally.
  * *(This is identical to AE2Things)*
- 1K, 4K, 16K, 64K are in multiples of 1000, instead of 1024.
  * aka: a 64K ae2 cell has 65536 bytes, but a 64K DISK only has 64000.
  * *(This is identical to AE2Things)*
- However, each item takes up one byte.
  * compared to ae2 cells, which can hold *8* items in one single byte: bad!
    if you want bigger storage for a fixed set of items, prefer the ae2 cells!
- Expensive
  * Expensive. *(This is identical to AE2Things)*
- The biggest DISK is only 64K
  * Due to balance reasons, there won't be bigger DISKs.
- Portable DISKs
  * They only have 1/3 the bytes compared to normal DISKs
  * Backpack anyone?

# Credits

The [original AE2Things mod](https://github.com/ProjectET/AE2Things), for the art, concepts and namesake.

The [original ae2stuff mod](https://github.com/bdew-minecraft/ae2stuff), for concepts and namesake.

title: Silkablooie
description: Creepers may drop TNT when killed by a player with a Silk Touch pickaxe.
body:
## Overview

*How could he be both so controversial and so, so wrong?*

This mod adds the tools to allow certain mobs (such as creepers and as of 1.19.2, spiders) to drop specific bonus items if killed by pickaxes enchanted with Silk Touch.

By default, creepers have a 35% chance of dropping TNT. Spiders have a 35% chance of dropping cobwebs, and cave spiders have a 70% chance.

## Datapack-ability

There are two tiers of entities for TNT droppers and cobweb droppers, with different probabilities of dropping their respective goods (determined via the config). This leaves modpack devs with [four total tags](https://github.com/davidjjung/silkablooie/tree/master/src/generated/resources/data/silkablooie/tags/entity_types) to work with.  They can be replaced via datapack with the following tags in the namespace `silkablooie/tags/entity_types`:

`tnt_droppers`, `advanced_tnt_droppers`, `cobweb_droppers` and `advanced_cobweb_droppers`.

By default, the `advanced` title is reserved for more challenging variants such as cave spiders, cave creepers from [Creeper Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/creeper-overhaul), or deepers/peepers from [Caverns & Chasms](https://modrinth.com/mod/caverns-and-chasms).

## Config

You can configure the percent chance of the bonus drop occurring with each of the four tiers.

In addition, there is some extra compatibility with [Savage & Ravage](https://modrinth.com/mod/savage-and-ravage), wherein enabling `"SNR optional compat"` allows specifically creepers to drop spore bombs instead of TNT.

---

**Requires [Blueprint](https://modrinth.com/mod/blueprint) 6.2.0+.** Optional compatibility is included for [Savage & Ravage](https://modrinth.com/mod/savage-and-ravage), [Caverns & Chasms](https://www.teamabnormals.com/blog/caverns-and-chasms-beta), [Creeper Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/creeper-overhaul), and [Neapolitan](https://modrinth.com/mod/neapolitan).

Feel free to direct any tweaks/suggestions towards the [issue tracker](https://github.com/davidjjung/silkablooie/issues). Thank you!

title: Greedy Meshing Mod
description: Optimizes chunk rendering by merging identical adjacent block faces into larger quads, reducing the total number of quads the GPU needs to render.
body:
# Greedy Meshing Mod

A client-side Fabric optimization mod that merges identical adjacent block faces into larger quads, reducing the total vertex count for better GPU performance.

## Features
- Automatic merging of opaque full-cube block faces
- Custom terrain shaders for correct texture tiling on merged faces
- **Aggressive Greedy (Absolute)** option. It merges across ambient-occlusion boundaries for even fewer quads, at the cost of slightly coarser lighting (note: it may not work properly with VulkanMod)
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) compatible
- [VulkanMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod) compatible (1.21-1.21.5, 1.21.9-1.21.11, 26.1-26.1.2 [1.21.6-1.21.8 not available, VulkanMod was never released for those])
- Works with Minecraft 26.2's native experimental Vulkan rendering backend
- Debug wireframe and split-screen comparison mode
- In-game config screen (requires [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) + [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu))

## Supported Versions

| Minecraft | Loader |
|-----------|--------|
| 1.21 - 1.21.11 | Fabric |
| 26.1 - 26.2 | Fabric |

## Performance
Performance gains vary depending on your hardware and world. If your GPU is already underutilized (high FPS), the improvement may be minimal. The mod benefits most on lower-end GPUs, higher render distances, and worlds with large flat surfaces of the same block type (e.g. superflat, underground caves, large builds).

## Known Limitations
- **Experimental** - some mods that modify chunk rendering or terrain shaders may be incompatible. Disable via config if issues occur.
- **Shader packs** (Iris/OptiFine) are not fully supported. The mod falls back to face-culling-only mode.
- **Lighting** on large merged surfaces may look slightly different from vanilla.

## Credits
Fork of [Greedy Meshing](https://modrinth.com/mod/greedy-meshing) by BuggiestStudios, with significant modifications including multi-version support (via [Stonecutter](https://github.com/stonecutter-versioning/stonecutter)), binary meshing.

title: Restart Plugin
description: This plugin allows for a scheduled restart of the server at a specific time.
body:
Reliable, Safe, and Fully Automated Server Restarts

This plugin provides a clean, controlled, and player-friendly restart system designed for production Minecraft servers. Whether you run scheduled restarts or need to trigger one manually, it ensures your server shuts down safely—without corruption, player confusion, or unexpected joins during critical moments.

Built with stability, automation, and usability in mind, the plugin integrates seamlessly with external auto-restart systems while maintaining full in-game control.

🔧 Core Restart System
- Safe and orderly server restart process
- Automatically prevents players from joining during restarts
- Gracefully kicks players before shutdown
- Waits until 0 players are online before stopping the server
- Designed to work alongside external restart schedulers

⏰ Flexible Scheduling
- Automatic restarts based on a configurable hourly interval
- Manual restart scheduling in minutes
- Persistent restart timer during runtime
- Built-in countdown warnings before restart

🧾 Powerful Commands
- /rptime – View time remaining until the next restart
- /rprestart – Start an immediate safe restart
- /rprestart <minutes> – Schedule a restart with live countdowns
- /rplock – Enable partial server lock (ops & whitelisted users only)
- /rplock off – Disable partial lock
- /rplock status – View current lock status
- /rpkick – Remove all non-ops and non-whitelisted players
- /rpadd – Add users to the whitelist instantly

🔐 Access Control & Whitelisting
- OP-based and permission-based command access
- Name-based whitelist stored in whitelist.yml
- Whitelist automatically created on first startup
- Whitelist auto-reloads when modified via commands

⚙️ Smart Configuration Handling
- Automatically detects legacy configuration files
- Creates backups of old configs
- Seamlessly migrates outdated keys to the new format
- No data loss during updates

🖥️ Player-Friendly UX
- Server-wide chat announcements for restarts
- Large on-screen title countdown warnings
- Fully customizable messages via config.yml

🛡️ Built-In Safety Protections
- Prevents duplicate restart sequences
- Blocks overlapping countdown timers
- Stops players from joining during critical shutdown phases

✅ Ideal For

- Servers requiring scheduled restarts
- Admins who want maximum safety with minimal setup

description: The best Treecapitator plugin for your server! Simple, clean, and customizable
body:
If you're tired of looking for treecapitator plugins that are easy to use, this will be a tree-t for you! It's simple, clean, and most importantly, customizable. Below is a lsit of features and how to use the config.yml file
Features - Instant Leaf Decay (doesn't fully work, will be patched next update)
- Instantly Break Trees
- Shift in-game to break logs like normal minecraft
- Axe loses durability like normal minecraft
- Prevents axe from breaking accidently
- Configurable durability loss for axe
- Configurable maximum number of logs will break
- Configurable allowed trees to be instamined
- Configurable option to allow instamine trees with or without stripped logs
Config.yml ``` enabled: True ``` Controls if the plugin is enabled or not. Set it to true for enabled and false for disabled, don't forget to capitalize! ``` durabilityPerLog: x ``` Controls how much durability is lost per log broken. (ex. if x=1, then the axe will lose 1 durability for every log broken on the tree. So if the tree has 5 logs, the the axe will lose 5 durability. Default is 1.) ``` maxLogsPerTree: x ``` Controls the maximum number of logs its possible to break. (ex. if x=3, then the axe will only break 3 logs instantly. Set it to -1 for infinite. Default is -1.) ``` allowedTrees: - OAK - BIRCH - SPRUCE - JUNGLE - ACACIA - DARK_OAK - CHERRY - PALE_OAK - MANGROVE ``` Controls which trees can be instamined and which cannot ``` allowStrippedLogs: true ``` Controls if trees with stripped logs can be instamined or not

Alternatively, you can download the official Cobblemon modpack on Modrinth or CurseForge! We recommend downloading the modpack with the Modrinth App, but Prism Launcher is also a good alternative launcher that can download modpacks from any of these sites.

title: Moonrise Compats
description: Compatibility patches for Moonrise. Helps mods that conflict with Moonrise run together by applying targeted integration fixes.
body:
# Moonrise Compats

**Moonrise Compats** is a compatibility layer for **Moonrise** that provides targeted fixes/patches for mods that don’t work properly when Moonrise is installed.

Moonrise can replace/rewire large parts of vanilla internals for performance. While that’s great for optimization, it can break assumptions made by other mods - resulting in crashes, broken features, or subtle behavior issues. Moonrise Compats exists to bridge those gaps.

## What does it do?

Depending on the patch and supported mods, Moonrise Compats may:

- Fix incompatibilities caused by mixins/overwrites and changed internals
- Add small “bridge” integrations where another mod expects vanilla behavior
- Patch specific edge-cases to let both mods coexist more reliably

> - This mod does **not** replace Moonrise.  
> - It is intended to be installed **together with Moonrise**.

## Why does this exist?

We rely on Moonrise for the performance improvements it brings.  
Not every mod is built with Moonrise in mind, and compatibility is often highly mod-specific - so this project maintains the required patches in one place.

## Versioning (Moonrise matching)

Moonrise Compats follows the **same base version as Moonrise**, plus an additional patch suffix.

Example:

- `Moonrise-NeoForge 0.1.0-beta.15+2eae1b1`
- `MoonriseCompats 0.1.0-beta.15+2eae1b1.1`

The trailing suffix:

- `.1 ... .x`

means **Moonrise Compats patch revisions** for that exact Moonrise build:

- `...+2eae1b1.1` = first Compats patch for Moonrise build `+2eae1b1`
- `...+2eae1b1.2` = second patch, etc.

## Compatibility & expectations

- Compatibility work is **mod-dependent** - a patch may exist for one mod but not another.
- This mod aims to be **safe**, but always test updates first, especially in large modpacks.
- In a modpack environment, keep Moonrise and Moonrise Compats base versions aligned.

## Reporting issues

If something breaks, please include:

- Minecraft version
- Loader (NeoForge/Fabric/etc.)
- Exact versions of:
  - Moonrise
  - Moonrise Compats
  - The mod(s) that conflict
- `latest.log` (and crash report if present)
- Minimal steps to reproduce

# RomeCraft II – A Historical Roleplay Experience

Step into the grandeur of the **Late Roman Republic** (circa 100 BC) with RomeCraft II, a meticulously crafted resource pack designed for _immersive historical roleplay_. Whether forging alliances, building a life, or engaging in rich cultural interactions, players will experience the ancient world with a depth and authenticity rarely seen.

Featuring **seasonal changes**, **custom armor and items**, **professions**, and an emphasis on **historically accurate** roleplay, RomeCraft II is more than a server—_it’s a journey into the past_. And while our focus is on realism and detailed storytelling, we also embrace **mythological elements** to add intrigue and excitement to the gameplay, blending history with legend.

Accompanying the server is the **RomeCraft II: Mithridatvm** Resource Pack featured here, designed to enhance the world’s aesthetics for single-player adventurers and dedicated roleplayers alike. With access to dozens of custom armor, banners, and beautiful vases, our work is truly an epic experience. Currently the resource pack is catered towards the server development but over time will become more comprehensive and include more customizable features.

Join us and become part of a thriving, historically rich community, where your story unfolds within the legacy of Rome.

<details>
<summary>Who Can I Play As?</summary>

While the Roman Senate & historical figures like _Julius Caesar_ are not accessible to players, there are still countless opportunities to immerse yourself in the era, whether as a Roman citizen, a Cappadocian from Melitene, or a Seleucid embracing Hellenic, Roman, Celtic, and the many other cultures of this region.

Romans will be encouraged to participate in either the Legion as soldiers or as citizens in the city of **Lycia**. Special rights will be given to players who earn the favor of their Patrons such as access to rural properties known as _villas_ while the majority of players are restricted to the urban insulae and domus (apartments and suburban homes). 

Hellenic players will operate through city-states known as **_Polis_** with the exception of some like the Seleucids which operate as an empire. Players will be encouraged to create their own experience as the harsh environment forces citizens to unite against the wilderness and opposing factions. 

As time progresses and the playerbase expands, we will then allow more factions to be formed with the support of staff developers including but not limited to building, terraforming, customized banners and armor, and much more!

</details>

<details>

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

</details>

**Coleus**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Red dense Coleus found in the plains biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b4e16d1ea8e0c81ea451ad38ef6860af2b76739.png)

The tall variant can be obtained by **shearing** the dense one or by putting the two items in crafting _**>THE CRAFTING CURRENTLY DESTROYS THE SHEARS!!.**_
Vice versa, if you only have the tall variant, you can use **bonemeal** and it will grow into the dense variant.

</details>

**Syngonium**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The **light** and **dark** variants can be found spawning in every **forest** biome.
![Light Syngonium found in a forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ada0dd635060d09c9ca7f6f1e6eb738eae6f3ca.png)

title: AnimatedArchitecture
description: BigDoors v2: Create big, ANIMATED doors, drawbridges, portcullises, flags, windmills, and more!
body:
# AnimatedArchitecture [![](https://jitpack.io/v/PimvanderLoos/AnimatedArchitecture.svg)](https://jitpack.io/#PimvanderLoos/AnimatedArchitecture) AnimatedArchitecture is a plugin for the Minecraft server mod [Spigot](https://spigotmc.org). Its aim is to enhance your server with animated blocks that can be used to create many kinds of animated architectural structures. AnimatedArchitecture is a rewrite of the old BigDoors plugin. You can find the legacy BigDoors plugin [here](https://github.com/PimvanderLoos/BigDoors/). ## Preview [![AnimatedArchitecture Showcase](https://img.youtube.com/vi/45TwFLBv8yY/0.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=45TwFLBv8yY)
(Click the image to go to YouTube and watch the video) ## Supported structure types The following structure types are currently supported: - Big Doors - Clocks that display the in-game time - Drawbridges - Flags - Garage Doors - Portcullises - Revolving Doors - Sliding Doors - Windmills ## Using AnimatedArchitecture ### Requirements: * Java 21+ * A Spigot server (or a fork of Spigot) for Minecraft 1.20+ * Vault ### Installation: * Grab the files of the latest [release](https://github.com/PimvanderLoos/AnimatedArchitecture/releases). You will need to grab the `AnimatedArchitecture-Spigot.jar` file. * Place the `AnimatedArchitecture-Spigot.jar` in the plugins directory of your server. * (Re)start your server. * Optionally, configure the plugin to your liking by editing the config files in the newly generated `AnimatedArchitecture` folder. ### Importing BigDoors' Database As of [release](https://github.com/PimvanderLoos/BigDoors/releases) Alpha 0.1.8.44, BigDoors has a command that allows you to export the old database to the new format. Newer versions may contain additional improvements to the export process, so it is recommended to use the latest version of BigDoors to export your database. While running a supported version, you can run the `BigDoors PrepareDatabaseForV2` command in the console to export the database. Read the output in the console to see if everything was exported correctly. Running this command does not affect the existing database for BigDoors. After the export process has completed, you can copy the new `structures.db` file out of the `BigDoors` folder into the `AnimatedArchitecture` folder. You will now be able to use the structures you created in BigDoors! Please note that the export process may not always produce a perfect conversion, potentially leading to minor inconsistencies, such as incorrect opening directions under certain circumstances. Despite these occasional discrepancies, the majority of exported structures should function properly. Any errors can be easily rectified in-game using available commands or the menu. ## Add-ons - [AnimatedPhysics](https://modrinth.com/plugin/animatedphysics) (Created by bonn2) It adds collisions to the animated blocks! ## Translations ### Official translations Official translations are managed through [Weblate](https://hosted.weblate.org/projects/AnimatedArchitecture/): ### Custom translations By default, the plugin will use the messages from `localization/translations.bundle`. This file is regenerated every time the plugin restart, so please do not edit this file manually. All translation keys used by the plugin are also written to a `localization/translations.properties` file.
When you provide one or more keys with a value, the plugin will create a new file the next time it restarts: `localization/translations_patched.properties`. This file contains the same data as the 'base' bundle, except for any lines you changed in the properties file.
To put it simply, you can override any of the official translations using the properties file. One thing to keep in mind when trying to override translations is that it respects the locale entry. This means that the `translations.properties` file only overrides the base localization messages. The way the localization system works, is that it first tries to get the translated message from the locale defined in the config, and, if that does not exist, from the base localization file. For example, if you set the locale to `nl_NL` (Dutch) in the config, the plugin will try to retrieve messages from `translations_nl_NL.properties` first. If no value is provided for the key the plugin is looking for, it will try the `translations.properties` file next. So, if you have set your locale to `nl_NL` in the config and want to override the default translations, follow these steps: 1) Copy `translations.properties` to `translations_nl_NL.properties`. 2) Apply the changes you wish to make. * You can check the files in `localization/translations.bundle` to see the current translations. 3) Restart either the server or the plugin. * You can restart the plugin with `/AnimatedArchitecture restart` ## Compiling AnimatedArchitecture Compilation requirements: * Java 21+ * Maven You can then compile the project by running the following command in this directory: ```mvn package``` To also run all the tests, static analysis tools etc., you can run the following command: ```mvn -P=errorprone test package checkstyle:checkstyle pmd:check``` The `AnimatedArchitecture-Spigot.jar` file can then be found in `animatedarchitecture-spigot/spigot-core/target/AnimatedArchitecture-Spigot.jar`.
The jars for each structure type can be found in `structures/StructuresOutput/.jar`. ## Developers This project can be included as a dependency using [JitPack](https://jitpack.io/#PimvanderLoos/AnimatedArchitecture). For the `artifactId` field, you can use any of the `core` modules. For the following examples below, we will use `spigot-core`. This module contains the implementations for the Spigot platform, as well as some utility methods and classes that make it easier to work with. You could also use `animatedarchitecture-core` if you wish to only use the API and not the Spigot platform. ### Maven ```xml jitpack.io https://jitpack.io ``` ```xml com.github.PimvanderLoos.AnimatedArchitecture spigot-core 0.7.2 provided ``` ### Gradle ```gradle repositories { maven { url "https://jitpack.io/" } } dependencies { compileOnly("com.github.PimvanderLoos.AnimatedArchitecture", "spigot-core", "0.7.2") } ``` ### Documentation The javadocs for this project can be found [here](https://pimvanderloos.github.io/AnimatedArchitecture/javadoc/).

body:
**DISCLAIMER: This pack is not compatible with datapacks that modify biome distribution or add their own biomes to the Overworld.** Mods or datapacks that change the features of vanilla biomes should be fine.

In the base game, the Pale Garden biome can only generate by replacing Dark Forest biomes on plateaus or high elevations during worldgen, causing them to be particularly sparse or limited in size for particularly unlucky players. This small datapack allows Pale Gardens to replace a larger portion of Dark Forest biomes during world generation, meaning Pale Gardens can be found much more frequently and tend to be much larger. ## Synopsis
- Get infinite status effect in survival.
- Change the max stack count of potion.
## Profile
The duration of status effects of foods and potions in player's inventory are added up. Provide infinite duration of effect for those whose duration are greater than one hour. If food has a probability of providing status effects, calculate its expected (probability) × duration. The duration threshold can be configured.

Supports the Ender chest, Traveler's Backpack (must be worn), Shulker Box, and Potion Bag of Extra Alchemy (everywhere).

Run command `/permanent_status_effect enable|disable <status effect ID>` can disable or enable a specific permanent state effect for yourself.

This mod can be added or deleted anytime, which won't damage saves.

This mod can be installed only at server side, but if client side doesn't install it and max stack count is modified, it might cause a few sync issues.
## Trivia
This mod is inspired by classic utility mods of Terraria, LuiAFK and Fargo's Mutant. In these mods, if players carry 30 bottles of potiont, they get infinite buff.

body:
Arachnophobia adds a variety of new spiders and arachnids to the world. From small, harmless species like Cellar Spiders, to deadly and venomous creatures such as Tarantulas and Funnel Web Spiders, and even other arachnids like Scorpions and Ticks. The mod also includes new items and tools, such as Slingshots, Spider Spray and even new types of food. Explore the new Spider Cave biome! A dark, web-filled environment crawling with eggs, webs, and lurking spiders, hiding valuable loot within. Some creatures can provide unique advantages, including pest control abilities, spider removal, or even new transportation methods like riding Jumping Spiders. Every encounter is creepy, immersive, and absolutely terrifying for players with true arachnophobia.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)


● Important FaQ


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► How can I disable the Random Generation of Spider Eggs?

The Generation of Spider Eggs can be disabled if you set the gamerule "spiderEggGeneration" to false.

Keep in mind that spiders can still place Spider Eggs when they killed an entity!

► Where can I find the mobs?

Most mobs can be found in regular plains or forest biomes. Some are only be found in jungles, deserts, savannas, during the night or in caves

► How can I tame a Jumping Spider?

You can tame a jumping spider by right clicking it with a Spider Eye Soup and instantly right clicking them with a saddle to tame them. If a Jumping Spider is tamed, it will not despawn naturally.

► How can I remove Mite Infection?

Mite Infection can be cleared by burning. If you clear the Mite Infection without burning, new mites will spawn, eventually infecting you again. Mites only infect a player if they don't wear full armor.

You can also disable the Mite Infection by setting the gamerule "disableMiteInfection" to true.

► Why is the Spider Cave so common/uncommon

The Spider Cave is a new custom cave biome and making a cave biome in mcreator is complicated. Sometimes, the cave is to big or to common, but sometimes it's to small or uncommon. Finding a balance with the generation is hard.

If you don't find any spider cave, you can also use the /locate biome command.

► Why does the spider cave decoration take so long?

The Spider Cave uses features as decorations. Those features places small blocks that doesn't use the default tick update. Instead, they have to tick randomly for generating the whole decoration due to naturall spawning placement within those blocks.

But most of the time, a player won't notice this as most of the stuff is already loaded. But if a player teleports to a spider cave or somehow find a cave while the decoration is loading, you might notice this.

► Why do I find random cobwebs under blocks?

This meant that there was a cellar spider, a black widow, a long horned orb weaver or a golden orb weaver hanging from the ceiling. Those spiders spawn often under blocks while creating a cobweb.

► How can I turn off the Cobweb spawning under trees?

The Generation of Cobwebs under blocks can be disabled if you set the gamerule "disableNaturalSpiderCobwebs" to true

► Why can't I read the descriptions of the spiders within the Bestiary of Spiders book?

To read all descriptions, you have to find the spider first and approach it within a 10 block range. After that, you should have access to the description of the spider, making the book a bit of a collection task.

</details>

title: Special Golems
description: Adds unique Golems
body:
About Special Golems

Special Golems is a mod focused on adding vanilla style golems to protect the player from hostile enemies.

 

Features

Special Golems features 4 golems. The Clay Golem, Terracotta Golem, Gold Golem, and the Diamond Golem.

 

Terracotta/Clay Golem

Stats (Normal Difficulty)

  • 1.95 blocks high (hitbox height)
  • 20 health points
  • The Terracotta Golem has 2 armor points
  • 2 armor toughness
  • The Terracotta Golem has an attack strength of 2
  • The Clay Golem has an attack strength of 1
  • 20% knockback resistance
  • 0.35 speed
  • Average sight

 

Specialty

  • The Terracotta/Clay Golem can pick up items, wearing armor, and welding weapons
  • Will drop items when the owner shift+right-clicks them
  • A burning Clay Golem will turn into a Terracotta Golem
  • The Terracotta Golem is immune to fire
  • Repairable with bricks/clay from the owner right-clicking on them

 

How to Summon

  • 2 Terracotta/Clay blocks
  • 1 Pumpkin
  • Place the 2 Terracotta/Clay blocks on top of each other (1x2x1), then place the Pumpkin on top

 

Gold Golem

Stats (Normal Difficulty)

  • 2 blocks high (hitbox height)
  • 200 health points
  • 12 armor points
  • 6 armor toughness
  • 100% knockback resistance
  • 0.135 speed
  • Very far sight

 

Specialty

  • The Gold Golem charges up its attacks to either shoot a powerful piercing laser dealing 15 (Normal Difficulty) magic damage or slam the ground dealing 10-6 (Normal Difficulty) generic damage
  • Lasers deal +5 more damage to undead mobs

If a brewing stand, or nether wart is currently unavailable, this mod allows the player to gain short, weak, potion effects by using their ingredients. Potions will initially last for 10 seconds with an amplifier of 1.

**DuraView**

DuraView is a lightweight client-side mod that provides a clean and intuitive way to monitor your equipment's durability in real-time.

title: One Block
description: This data pack adds one block a popular challange to your minecraft
body:
# One Block — Random Item Void

**Spawn on a single block floating in an empty world and survive on a never‑ending rain of random items.**

One Block drops you onto one lonely block in the middle of the void. Every few seconds a fresh item appears on your block — and it can be *anything*. Every item in the game has exactly the same chance to show up, so no two runs ever feel the same. Collect what you get, craft, and build your way out into the emptiness.

## Features

- **True void world** — the whole overworld generates empty. All you start with is your block.
- **Random item rain** — a new item drops onto your block at a set interval, with every item equally likely (over 1,400 possible items).
- **Completely fair loot** — no weighting and no luck stat, just pure equal chance across every normally obtainable item. Creative‑only and technical items (command blocks, spawn eggs, barriers, etc.) are excluded.
- **Two modes:**
  - **Singleplayer / co‑op** — one shared block for everyone in the world.
  - **Server** — every player automatically gets their own private island, far away from the others. The world scales itself as people join, and you always respawn back on your own island.
- **No falling out** — drop into the void and you're safely returned to your block instead of dying.
- **Configurable** — change the spawn interval (and the island spacing on servers) with a single command. No file editing needed.

## Compatibility

Builds are provided for **every Minecraft version from 1.18 to the latest snapshot**, each with the exact pack format so you never get a version warning. The server version requires **1.20.2 or newer** (it uses function macros to give every player their own island).

## Installation

- **Singleplayer:** When creating a world, open *More → Data Packs*, drag the matching ZIP into the left box, and create the world.
- **Server:** Place the matching ZIP into `<server>/<world>/datapacks/` before the first launch.

> The void only generates on a **freshly created world**, so start a brand‑new world with the pack enabled.

## Settings (in‑game commands)

- **Spawn interval** — `/scoreboard players set #interval ob_config <ticks>` (singleplayer) or `/scoreboard players set #interval ob <ticks>` (server). Default is 60 ticks (3 seconds).
- **Island spacing (server only)** — `/scoreboard players set #spacing ob <blocks>`.

---

*Stand on the block. Take what the void gives you. Build something out of nothing.*

title: Cortex
description: An overhaul of the 'mine' part of Minecraft without redesigning or adding ores.
body:
Cortex functions primarily as a cosmetic reconstruction of gemstones, and a overhaul of the Netherite system for a more interesting and engaging gameplay. No additional ores or blocks have been added.

**Dripstone is now not ugly** (everyone cheered). See gallery.

### Gemstones
- Non-metal ores (emeralds, diamonds) have been changed to drop raw material that must be polished _(right-clicked)_ on a grindstone before use.
- Redstone and lapis lazuli now also spawn with varied formations on top of them. Their drop counts have been reduced slightly.

![Redstone and lapis formations in a cave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc46d4ea743b28488a389134d19e960a2240bf4b_0.webp)

- Copper ore spawning has been reduced significantly.
- The appearance of diamond, its tools and armor, has been changed to reflect a "more real" color.

![Showcase of new diamond armor, slightly bluer and paler](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2332eb210166e64bfbd9d903c7bc2cd90f9fc32d.jpeg)

### Netherite

Ancient debris is not an ore anymore. Instead it is now a proper deposit under some fossils in soul sand valleys, and ruined portals (only in the Nether).\
It operates under the same system as archeology, making "suspicious netherrack" not a mineable block.

![Ancient debris deposit 4 layers under a fossil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59df0b2147610d0e03d714ca3c7c08cedb484fe5_0.webp)

- Suspicious netherrack can drop ancient debris scraps, or eventually a full ancient debris. You can craft ancient debris with 9 scraps.
- Ancient debris must then be smelted. Holding the then molten debris on your left hand, and a diamond pickaxe in your right one, right click an anvil to hammer it into a netherite ingot.
- Netherite smithing templates have been disabled. You can apply netherite to a piece at any anvil for the cost of 5 levels.

title: CDisc Music
description: Turn any track (YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, VK, Yandex…) into a real music disc — played from a jukebox through proximity voice chat, with an in-game player GUI and disc queues. Works with Simple Voice Chat or Plasmo Voice.
body:
# 🎵 CDisc Music

**Turn any track from the internet into a real, playable music disc in Minecraft.**
Drop it in a jukebox and everyone nearby hears it through proximity voice chat — the closer you stand, the louder it gets.

Supports **YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Yandex Music, VK, TikTok** and more.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🎧 **Custom discs from anywhere** — create a disc from a search query or a direct link.
- 📡 **True proximity audio** — the music plays from the jukebox and fades with distance. No global spam, no plugin messages — just sound in the world.
- 🔊 **Two voice backends** — works with **Simple Voice Chat** *or* **Plasmo Voice**. Pick whichever your server already runs.
- 🎛️ **In-game player GUI** — right-click a playing jukebox to open a full player: play / pause, seek ±5 s, previous / next track, and repeat modes.
- 📀 **Disc queue system** — load up to **42 discs** into one jukebox and let them play back-to-back. Choose what happens to a finished disc (keep it, eject it, or move it to the end) and set repeat to **off / whole queue / single track**.
- 📊 **Now-Playing boss bar** — sneak near a jukebox to see the current track and a progress bar that fills as it plays.
- 🔦 **Beacon range boost** — build a beacon pyramid under a jukebox to extend how far the music can be heard (bigger pyramid = bigger range).
- 🌍 **Many sources** — YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify, Yandex Music, VK, TikTok, Bandcamp, Vimeo, Twitch, Mixcloud, and direct HTTP streams.

---

## 📥 Requirements

- **[Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)** *or* **[Plasmo Voice](https://modrinth.com/plugin/plasmo-voice)** — required (one of them)

Drop the plugin (and the voice-chat plugin) into your server's `plugins/` folder and restart. Players need the matching voice-chat **client mod** installed to hear anything.

---

## 🚀 How to use

### 1. Create a disc
Hold any music disc in your hand and run:

```
/cdisc create <search or link>
```

Examples:
- `/cdisc create yt:never gonna give you up` — search YouTube
- `/cdisc create https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ` — a direct link
- `/cdisc create sc:lofi hip hop` — search SoundCloud

The disc in your hand becomes a **custom CDisc** with the track baked in — its name and author show up in the tooltip. From here it's a normal item: carry it, trade it, store it in a chest, give it to a friend.

> Tip: a link that contains a playlist (`...&list=...`) automatically plays just the single track it points to.

### 2. Play it
Put the custom disc into a **jukebox**, exactly like a vanilla record. The track streams through the voice chat and plays **from the jukebox itself** — walk away and it fades out, walk closer and it gets louder. Everyone in range hears the same thing, in sync.

### 3. See what's playing — the boss bar
**Sneak (Shift) while looking at the jukebox.** A bar appears at the top of your screen showing `Author - Track [time / length]` and fills up as the song plays. It stays until you sneak at the jukebox again — so you can turn away and it keeps updating.

This also "arms" the jukebox for the next step.

### 4. Open the player — right-click
While the boss bar is showing, **right-click the jukebox** to open the player GUI:

- ⏯️ **Play / Pause**
- ⏪⏩ **Seek −5s / +5s** (or click the info item to type an exact timecode in chat)
- ⏮️⏭️ **Previous / Next track** in the queue
- 🔁 **Repeat**: off → whole queue → single track
- 📀 **Open the disc queue**
- 🔦 **Sound range** (beacon boost — see below)

> ⚠️ Right-clicking **without** sneaking first ejects the disc, just like vanilla. Sneak first, then right-click, to open the player.

### 5. Build a queue
A single jukebox can hold a whole playlist.

- **Shift + right-click** a playing jukebox (or hit the queue button in the player) to open the **queue GUI**.
- Drop custom discs into the **42 cells** — they play top-to-bottom, one after another.
- Click a disc to jump straight to it — confirm with the **green wool**, cancel with the **red wool**.
- The **played-disc policy** button decides what happens to each disc once it finishes:
  - **Keep in the queue** — it stays where it is.
  - **Eject** — it pops out of the jukebox.
  - **Move to the end** — it goes to the back, so the queue keeps cycling through your discs.
- Combine the policy with **repeat (queue / track)** for endless playback.

### 6. Extend the range with a beacon
Build a **beacon pyramid** under the jukebox (you don't even need the beacon block — just the pyramid). Then open the player and click **Sound range** to raise the level:

| Pyramid level | Extra range |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | +16 blocks |
| 2 | +32 blocks |
| 3 | +64 blocks |

![Sound Range demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9615566c277f8ac203e6e4416838e74b38a3415d.gif)

Perfect for a town square, an arena, or a club. The boost is added on top of the base distance from `config.yml`.

### 7. Breaking the jukebox
Break the jukebox and **every disc in its queue drops on the ground** — nothing is lost and nothing is duplicated.

---

## ⌨️ Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/cdisc create <query / URL>` | Turn the disc in your hand into a custom music disc |
| `/cdisc seek <SS \| MM:SS \| HH:MM:SS>` | Jump to a timecode in the current track (look at the jukebox) |
| `/cdisc clear` | Reset the held disc back to normal |
| `/cdisc reload` | Reload the configuration |
| `/cdisc ytsetup` | Set up YouTube OAuth |

### Search prefixes
`yt:` YouTube · `sc:` SoundCloud · `sp:` Spotify · `ym:` Yandex Music · `vk:` VK · `tt:` TikTok

> A direct link works too — e.g. `/cdisc create https://youtu.be/...`

---

## ⚙️ Optional setup

Some sources work better (or only) with credentials in `config.yml`:

- **YouTube** — OAuth (`/cdisc ytsetup`) and/or a Remote Cipher Server
- **Spotify** — client ID + secret
- **Yandex Music** — access token
- **VK Music** — user token

title: BetterVanilla SMP
description: A lightweight, drop‑in plugin made for cozy survival multiplayer (smp) servers with friends. Upgrade vanilla with modern quality‑of‑life features - no mods, just pure fun.
body:
# BetterVanilla ✨ SMP All-in-One

A lightweight, drop-in plugin built for cozy SMP servers with friends. BetterVanilla adds modern quality-of-life upgrades to a vanilla Paper server—no client mods or loaders required.

👑 Core Feature: Configure every player and server toggle through the in-game `/settings` menu and [jump straight to the full settings guide](#settings) when you need the details.

[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/davidstoegmueller/bettervanilla?style=flat-round)](https://github.com/davidstoegmueller/bettervanilla/releases)
[![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg?style=flat-round)](LICENSE)

Tested on Paper 1.21.11 and newer.

## Table of Contents

- [Why BetterVanilla?](#why-bettervanilla)
- [Highlights](#highlights)
- [Installation](#installation)
- [Commands](#commands)
- [Settings](#settings)
- [Permissions](#permissions)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [License](#license)

## Why BetterVanilla?

Your SMP deserves more than plain vanilla. BetterVanilla keeps the familiar Minecraft feel while adding carefully scoped tools that reduce admin busywork and smooth out day-to-day play. Everything ships in one polished plugin you can drop in and go.

## Highlights

### Player-Focused Features

- 🧭 **Waypoints** - Add, share, and filter public or private waypoints with visibility cycling, GUI navigation, optional particle trails, plus auto-cancel and reach-radius controls.
- 🎒 **Backpacks** - Carry expandable storage with configurable rows and pages.
- ⛏️ **Vein Miner & Tree Chopper** - Sneak-break to harvest entire ore veins or tree trunks instantly.
- 💀 **Death Points & Chests** - Track every death, teleport back, and safely reclaim your belongings.
- 🧠 **Heads Explorer** - Browse decorative heads by category, search instantly, and preview icons in the GUI.
- ✨ **Chest Sorting** - Right-click outside inventories to auto-organize loot with selectable sort modes.
- 🔁 **Item Restock Automation** - Automatically refill empty hotbar slots with matching items using global and per-player toggles.
- 🏷️ **Player Tags** - Set a custom name tag from the settings menu, including color selection.
- 🧰 **Settings Menu** - Toggle personal QoL options in an in-game UI.
- 🎨 **Colored Chat & Mentions** - Use `&` color codes and ping friends with `@name`.
- 📬 **Private Messages** - Chat directly with `/msg` and reply quickly using `/r`.
- 🪧 **Sign Colors** - Decorate signs with vibrant color codes.
- 👀 **Inventory Viewer** - Peek inside another player’s inventory when permitted.
- ⏱️ **Timer** - Global stopwatch with resume, pause, reset, and set commands.
- 🕒 **Playtime** - View detailed play history with AFK tracking for yourself or other players.
- 📶 **Ping** - Check personal or remote player latency.
- 📍 **Here/Coords Broadcast** - Share your current location with `/here` (alias `/coords`).
- 📊 **Dynamic Tab List** - Live header/footer shows day/time, moon phase, weather, online counts, personal playtime, ping, TPS, and MSPT, while nameplates add AFK tags, death totals, and respect vanish.
- 📍 **Action-Bar Location** - Display live XYZ coordinates in your HUD.
- 🧭 **Bossbar Compass** - Minimal directional overlay in the boss bar.
- 🪑 **Sittable Stairs** - Sit on stairs with an empty hand.
- 🪑 **Sit Anywhere** - Use `/sit` to plop down on any solid block and stand with Shift.
- 🌧️ **Sleep to Clear Weather** - Skip rain and fast-forward the day by sleeping.
- 🧚 **Navigation Particles** - Follow a beam and optional trail during waypoint navigation.
- 🌾 **Crop Protection** - Prevent farmland trampling.
- 🌱 **Right-Click Harvest** - Harvest and replant crops with a single interaction.
- 🚪 **Double Door Sync** - Sync state across connected double doors.
- 📖 **Help** - Built-in `/help` overview of every command.

### Admin & Server Tools

- 🛠️ **Admin Settings Menu** - Configure every feature live from the GUI.
- 🗝️ **Permissions System** - Manage groups and users with hot-reload via `/permissions`.
- 💤 **AFK Protection** - Shield idle players from damage, movement, and collisions.
- 🧭 **Waypoint Management** - Review and edit public/private waypoints with dedicated staff tools.
- 🫥 **Vanish Mode** - Hide from players, tab lists, join/leave messages, the server list, and AFK timers with `/vanish`.
- ⚰️ **Deathchest Toggle** - Switch global deathchests on or off without leaving the GUI.
- 🔨 **Moderation Toolkit** - Kick, ban, mute, unmute, and unban directly in-game.
- 🧩 **Crafting Recipe Manager** - Manage predefined crafting recipes.
- 🧠 **Heads Explorer Controls** - Enable/disable the explorer, set the API key, and refresh cached data.
- 📣 **Server MOTD** - Edit the server list message from the admin menu.
- 🧭 **Locator Bar Gamerule** - Flip the `/gamerule locatorBar` setting across every world without leaving the GUI.
- 🛌 **Sleeping Percentage** - Set the `playersSleepingPercentage` gamerule from the admin menu.
- 🚧 **Maintenance Mode** - Toggle server access with custom messaging and bypass support.
- 🧾 **Recipe Sync Toggle** - Control whether custom recipes are synced to players.
- 🧰 **Remote Settings Access** - Admins can open player settings menus for other online players.

### Custom Crafting Recipes

#### 💡 **Invisible Light Source**

Craft an invisible light block that emits light at level 15.

##### 🧾 Default Recipe

| Slot 1 | Slot 2    | Slot 3 |
| ------ | --------- | ------ |
| empty  | torch     | empty  |
| torch  | glowstone | torch  |
| empty  | torch     | empty  |

#### 🖼️ **Invisible Item Frame**

Craft an invisible item frame that becomes invisible once an item is placed inside.

##### 🧾 Default Recipe

| Slot 1 | Slot 2     | Slot 3 |
| ------ | ---------- | ------ |
| glass  | glass      | glass  |
| glass  | item frame | glass  |
| glass  | glass      | glass  |

## Installation

```
1. Download the latest BetterVanilla release jar.
2. Drop it into your server's plugins/ folder.
3. Restart the server and you are ready to go!
```

## Commands

### Core Command

- `/settings` - Open your personal settings dashboard. Admins can enter the full server control panel from here, making it the fastest way to tweak any BetterVanilla feature. [See everything it unlocks](#settings).

### Player Utilities

- `/settings` - Open the settings GUI for players.
- `/waypoints` - Open the waypoint GUI. Use `player <name>` or `coords <x> <y> <z>` for direct navigation.
- `/backpack` - Open your personal backpack storage.
- `/deathpoints` - Manage recent death locations and teleport back via GUI.
- `/heads` - Open the heads explorer GUI.
- `/playtime [player]` - Show detailed playtime (AFK included) for you or another player.
- `/ping [player]` - Check network latency for yourself or another player.
- `/sit` - Sit on any solid block; sneak to stand up.
- `/msg <player> <message>` - Send a private message. Alias: `/message`.
- `/r <message>` - Reply to the last private message.
- `/here` - Broadcast your current location. Aliases: `/coords`, `/h`.
- `/help` - View all available commands pulled directly from `plugin.yml`.

### Admin & Moderation

- `/adminhelp` - List key staff commands.
- `/settings` - Open the settings GUI for players and admins.
- `/invsee <player>` - Inspect another player’s inventory.
- `/timer <resume|pause|reset|set>` - Control the global timer.
- `/vanish` - Toggle vanish mode with movement safeguards.
- `/kick`, `/ban`, `/unban`, `/mute`, `/unmute` - Moderation toolset with duration parsing (e.g. `1d2h30m`).
- `/permissions` - Manage groups and assignments:
  - `group addperm <group> <permission>`
  - `group removeperm <group> <permission>`
  - `group delete <group>`
  - `user addperm <player> <permission>`
  - `user removeperm <player> <permission>`
  - `user setgroup <player> <group>`
  - `default <group>` - Sets the default group for all players
  - `assignments` - Show current group and user mapping
  - `list` - Display built-in permission nodes
  - `reload` - Reload configuration and refresh online players

## Settings

### Player Settings

- 📍 Action-bar location HUD
- 🧭 Bossbar compass overlay
- 🏷️ Player tag (name tag color + text)
- ⏲️ Action-bar timer overlay toggle
- ✨ Navigation particles
- 🧭 Navigation auto-cancel
- 📏 Navigation reach radius
- 🧹 Chest sorting toggle
- 🧺 Inventory sort mode
- 👁️ Waypoint visibility filter
- 🔁 Item restock automation toggle
- 🚪 Double Door Sync
- ⛏️ Vein miner toggle with per-player limits
- 🪓 Vein chopper toggle with per-player limits

### Admin Settings

- 🚧 Maintenance mode and custom message
- 💣 Creeper explosion protection toggle (blocks + entities)
- 🔭 End travel toggle
- 🔥 Nether travel toggle
- 🌧️ Sleeping rain skip
- 🛌 Players sleeping percentage gamerule
- 📣 Server MOTD editor
- 🧭 Locator bar gamerule toggle
- 💤 AFK protection toggle and AFK timeout
- 🏷️ Player tags global toggle
- ⚰️ Deathchest toggle
- 🔁 Item restock automation defaults and global toggle
- 🌾 Crop protection
- 🌱 Right-click harvest
- 🎒 Backpack availability, page count, and row count
- ⛏️ Vein miner global options (limits, tools, blocks, sound)
- 🪓 Vein chopper global options
- 🧠 Heads explorer (enable, API key, refresh)
- 🧾 Recipe sync toggle

## Minecraft Heads Explorer

This plugin now features a built-in Minecraft Heads Explorer, powered by
[Minecraft-Heads](https://minecraft-heads.com/).

![Minecraft-Heads Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f3d37c903a07201acae849849b9e3c6d3d7490d_0.webp)

## Permissions

### Built-in Groups

- `player` - default fallback that grants all player-facing QoL features such as `/settings`, waypoints, backpacks, and automation toggles.
- `moderator` - inherits the player group and adds moderation, vanish, inventory viewing, and timer controls.
- `admin` - includes every BetterVanilla permission, covering server maintenance, admin settings, and permission management.
- Use `/permissions default <group>` (e.g. `/permissions default player`) to choose which group new players fall back to. Switching the default moves existing players that still belonged to the previous default.

| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------ |

title: Auto Parkour
description:
A mod that auto jumps off the edges of blocks for you, making it easier to parkour 

(no guarantee of success)
body:
# Auto Parkour

Auto Parkour is a client-side Minecraft mod designed to enhance your movement by automatically performing jumps when you approach the edge of a block. It is perfect for parkour maps, bridging gaps, or simply making navigation more fluid.

## Features

- **Auto Parkour**: Automatically jumps when you reach the edge of a block if a gap is detected.
- **Auto Sprint**: Ensures you are always sprinting while moving forward.
- **Highly Configurable**: Fine-tune the behavior to suit your needs:
  - **Minimum Depth**: Set the minimum depth a gap must have for the mod to trigger a jump.
  - **Edge Distance**: Adjust how close to the edge you need to be before jumping.
  - **Jump While Sneaking**: Choose whether the mod should function even while sneaking.
  - **Jump Cooldown**: Prevent accidental double-jumps with a configurable cooldown.
  - **Visual Indicator**: Shows a status message in the action bar when the jump cooldown is active.

## Supported Versions

- **Minecraft**: 1.21.1+ (Fabric)
- **Java**: 21 or higher

## Dependencies

To use this mod, you need to install the following:

- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) (>= 0.16.9)
- [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)
- [Cloth Config API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cloth-config) (Required for the settings menu)
- [ModMenu](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/modmenu) (Recommended to access the configuration screen)

## How to Build

If you want to build the mod from source, follow these steps:

1. Clone the repository: `git clone https://github.com/TomerGamerTV/AutoParkour.git`
2. Navigate to the project directory: `cd AutoParkour`
3. Run the Gradle build command:
   ```bash
   ./gradlew build
   ```
4. The compiled `.jar` file will be located in `build/libs/`.
